### 1. [LatentLens: Rethinking Latent Interface in Multi-Agent Systems](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31582v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31582

**作者：** Ziqing Yang、Kewei Cheng、Mingjie Li、Yang Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31582v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31582v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P0

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LatentLens 框架，把多智能体系统中的 latent 通信接口与 agent harness 解耦，并在内部拆分为「重新对齐兼容性、信息可访问性、传播动态」三个维度，在七个基准上检验其真实贡献。

**相关性简评：** 结论偏负：接口本身不带来增益甚至显著掉点，latent 保留了部分领域信息却未必可被有效使用，重复 latent 步会放大表示层失败；这与本研究关心的 latent 内容是否被使用、信息坍缩与传播稳定性直接相关，其解耦评估设计可供核查「收益归属」问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LatentLens: Rethinking Latent Interface in Multi-Agent Systems

**abstract/A1：** Latent interfaces let agents in a multi-agent system communicate through continuous representations rather than decoded text. Prior work reports performance and efficiency gains, but neither separates latent communication from the agent harness nor examines its internal components, leaving its actual contribution unclear. We propose LatentLens, a framework that decouples the latent interface at two levels: externally from the agent harness, to measure its contribution to overall performance (RQ1), and internally into realignment compatibility, information accessibility, and propagation dynamics, to identify the benefits and limitations of each (RQ2). Across seven benchmarks with Qwen3 models, adding the latent interface to the same harness does not improve and can even substantially degrade accuracy. Internally, latent representations retain some domain information, but incompatible realignment can substantially degrade performance, and repeated latent steps can amplify representation-level failures. Thus, while latent representations may preserve information, they do not necessarily ensure effective communication, which also requires compatible realignment, information accessibility, and stable propagation.

</details>

### 2. [Look Where Camouflage Breaks: Concealment-Guided Observation for Camouflaged Object Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31392v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31392

**作者：** Dingming Zhang、Fengyang Xiao、Jingjia Feng、Chunming He、Sina Farsiu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31392v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31392v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CamoBreak 主动式伪装目标检测框架，用跨尺度比较得到的「Concealment Spectrum」度量区域相似度与边界歧义，据此从已有图像中选择裁剪观察、以全局前景/背景参照做出判断，并将局部证据选择性地写入预测与特征记忆。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应「LOOK 与 STOP」：多尺度遮蔽度量驱动看哪里、局部证据按目标条件筛选写入状态，并以预测分割收益决定是否再观察，可供核查视觉证据筛选与停止决策的收益–成本；但方法基于单图裁剪的检测分割，不涉及 VLM 内部 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Look Where Camouflage Breaks: Concealment-Guided Observation for Camouflaged Object Detection

**abstract/A1：** A camouflaged object can blend into its surroundings at one scale and become distinguishable at another. Yet a region's apparent ambiguity gives limited guidance on which observation would resolve it. The challenge is to connect the form and scale of concealment to the evidence that a new view can reveal. We introduce CamoBreak, an active framework for camouflaged object detection guided by a Concealment Spectrum. From the image and current predictions, the spectrum measures regional resemblance and boundary ambiguity across comparison scales, distinguishing persistent concealment from separation emerging at finer or broader scales. These measurements guide crop selection from the already-captured image and recognition against global foreground and background references. An object-conditioned spatial preference then selects where local evidence should update the prediction and feature memory, retaining target corrections while suppressing background distractions. Accepted corrections reshape the next measurement, while predicted segmentation benefit determines whether to observe again. Experiments across encoder families and related segmentation tasks show consistent improvements. Targeted analyses support improved small-target recovery, multiple-object coverage, and selective evidence integration. Code will be released.

**comment/C1：** 12 pages, including supplementary material

</details>

### 3. [SpatialCraft: Evolving Procedural Intelligence from Experience and Skills for Spatial Reasoning Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31475v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31475

**作者：** Xiwei Liu、Yulong Li、Xuhui Li、Zhixiang Lu、Haolin Yang、Jianxu Chen、Yifan Lu、Di Fan、Yutong Xie

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31475v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31475v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** SpatialCraft 研究冻结的多模态空间推理智能体如何在无参数更新下从自身交互历史改进工具编排，维护「经验」（对比同一任务多次 rollout 蒸馏出的条件—动作策略）与「技能」（带激活与终止条件的多步流程），并用随机扣留经验估计对比效用分数、将稳定正效用的经验固化为技能。

**相关性简评：** 工具调用顺序与技能终止条件直接对应 LOOK/STOP 的证据获取与停止决策；随机扣留估计单条经验贡献的做法，可供核查能否迁移到 latent 轨迹监督中的贡献分配与视觉证据筛选。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SpatialCraft: Evolving Procedural Intelligence from Experience and Skills for Spatial Reasoning Agents

**abstract/A1：** Spatial reasoning agents increasingly rely on external tools, such as 3D reconstruction, segmentation, and geometric computation, to answer questions that a multimodal large language model (MLLM) cannot resolve from pixels alone. Tool access, however, shifts the bottleneck to orchestration: the agent must decide which tools to call, in what order, and how to interpret their outputs, yet a stateless agent repeats the same mistakes across tasks. We ask whether a frozen tool-using agent can improve its orchestration from its own interaction history, without parameter updates. We present SpatialCraft, a self-evolving framework that maintains two forms of external knowledge: Experiences, condition-action tactics distilled by contrasting rollouts of the same task, and Skills, multi-step procedures with explicit activation and termination conditions. Three designs couple the two streams. Experiences can be anchored to a Skill, appearing only while it is active rather than once per task. A Contrastive Utility Score estimates each Experience's effect by randomly withholding it across rollouts of the same task, separating its contribution from task difficulty, and Experiences with consistently positive utility are consolidated into the Skills they support. Across five spatial benchmarks and four backbones, SpatialCraft achieves the best accuracy in all 20 settings, showing that a frozen agent can learn to orchestrate spatial tools from its own experience.

</details>

### 4. [Lit Up but Not Needed: Scoped Lesions Show Where Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts Depend on Their Experts](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31576v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31576

**作者：** Zhixuan Ge、Anqi Li、Kexin Geng、Wei Qiu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31576v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31576v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 Qwen3-VL、Kimi-VL、Gemma-4 等 MoE 视觉语言模型上做「范围化消融」——只在图像位或只在文本位移除专家集合——来检验路由激活图所标示的视觉专用专家是否真的被模型需要。

**相关性简评：** 以因果消融区分「激活」与「必需」，发现图像位依赖仅 2–3 分、视觉专用专家可删而几乎无损（仅图中读字例外），可作为视觉旁路与信息坍缩诊断，以及判断路由/激活证据能否反映视觉内容实际被使用的核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Lit Up but Not Needed: Scoped Lesions Show Where Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts Depend on Their Experts

**abstract/A1：** Cognitive neuroscience learned that an activation map is not a map of necessity. Regions that light up during a task are not always needed for it, and only lesions reveal which ones are. Mixture-of-experts (MoE) vision-language models come with an activation map for free, since the router records which experts respond to image and text tokens, and recent work reads modality-specialized experts off this map. We bring the lesion. In Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B, Kimi-VL-A3B and Gemma-4-26B-A4B, 3 to 12% of the experts are vision-exclusive: image tokens route to them at up to five times the uniform rate and text tokens almost never. In Qwen3-VL they receive a quarter of all image-token routing, and lesioning all of them costs less than one percentage point on average over eight perception benchmarks and free-form OCR, no more than lesioning a random set of the same size. In Kimi-VL and Gemma-4 the lesion also costs no more than a random set. Scoped lesions, which remove an expert set only at image positions or only at text positions, then show where the models do depend on their experts. In Qwen3-VL, silencing every expert at every image position costs 3 points, against 45 at text positions, where the dependence sits in dual-use experts that text-only tasks need as well. Across models the image-side dependence is 2 to 3 points in Qwen3-VL and Kimi-VL and 26 in Gemma-4. Reading text in images is the one ability that needs image-position experts in every model. The exclusive experts receive informative patches, produce outputs of ordinary size, and stay inert under sensory deprivation: text-only training recruits them only when load balancing forces it. In Kimi-VL the balancing bias itself manufactures most of them. Load balancing draws the modality map in the part of the computation the models depend on least. Expert selection, pruning and skipping should follow the lesion, not the map.

**comment/C1：** 14 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables. Code: https://github.com/gezhixuan/moedep

</details>

### 5. [GoldiBench: Right Tools, Wrong Amount -- Benchmarking Agents on Effect Judgement in Professional Editing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31590v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31590

**作者：** Wang Yang、Xinpeng Li、Yanyan Zhang、Chaoda Song、Shouren Wang、Debargha Ganguly、Vikash Singh、Chuang Ma、Xiaoran Cai、Kai Ye、Xiaotian Han、Vipin Chaudhary

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31590v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31590v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GoldiBench，用 500 个专业编辑任务（给出 START 图与隐藏程序渲染的 TARGET），并将同一任务分别以「工具+数值」「仅工具」「仅目标描述」三种形式给出，以分离「会操作」与「能判断效果强度」，评测 25 个模型后发现它们在工具操作上近乎满分，但需自行判断改动量时通过率骤降，且几乎不做多次渲染比较。

**相关性简评：** 直接诊断 agent 能否读取视觉差异证据来校准改动量并据此迭代、停止，与 LOOK/STOP 的收益成本和多轮验证机制高度相关；其中「被强制比较后通过率翻倍」「只渲一次就停」可为迭代式视觉反馈与验证策略提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GoldiBench: Right Tools, Wrong Amount -- Benchmarking Agents on Effect Judgement in Professional Editing

**abstract/A1：** Real editing requests describe a look, not the steps to reach it, so an agent that serves them must judge how much of each tool the look takes. Existing benchmarks do not measure this: their tasks either state the tools and values, or leave the amount open and are scored by VLM judges that pass more than half of half- and triple-strength results. We introduce GoldiBench, a benchmark of 500 editing tasks in five professional applications (darktable, RawTherapee, GIMP, Inkscape, Blender), solvable by writing a program or by operating the GUI. Each task pairs a START image with a TARGET rendered from a hidden program, so the amount is fixed by a known target; the agent's edit is re-rendered and compared with TARGET, and the same task is posed with the tools and values, the tools only, or the goal only, separating operation from effect judgement. Across 25 open, GUI and closed models, agents operate well (99-100% with programs from 4B up when told the values) but fall off a cliff when they must judge the amount: given only the tools, the best model passes 19% of the tasks with programs and 33% through the GUI, and scale does not close the gap. Manuals barely help; the measured TARGET-START difference more than doubles the pass rate, but the same difference shown as an image does not for open models. Allowed four renders, agents almost always stop after the first; forced to compare, the strong models double their pass rate. Agents know the tools, but neither read nor check the amount.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages. Project page: https://uservan.github.io/GoldiBench

</details>

### 6. [What You See Is What You Certify: Concept-Based Certificates for Unseen Compositions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31627v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31627

**作者：** Phuc Linh Ngo、Thang Nguyen Duc、Truong Thanh Hung Nguyen、Hung Cao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31627v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31627v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文考察概念瓶颈模型在未见部件组合上能否作为「证书」：发现标准训练的联合概念模型与概念嵌入模型在正确本体下仍以 93–94% 的比例认证错误类别，原因是部件读数会复制共现值形成跨概念捷径，并据此提出每个部件单独裁剪、独立前向读取的最小参考设计 OCVE。

**相关性简评：** 其「部件级证据是否真正被使用、证据是否足以排除竞争类别」的诊断与 LVR 关注的视觉细节保留、答案是否依赖视觉内容高度吻合，跨概念捷径与隔离读取的对比可供核查 latent 状态中视觉证据坍缩与定位性问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What You See Is What You Certify: Concept-Based Certificates for Unseen Compositions

**abstract/A1：** Concept-based models justify a decision by concepts they claim to see, decoded through an explicit ontology. Yet concept predictions are known to leak label information, ignore locality, and be poorly grounded on new attribute combinations. A decision decoded from such concepts can satisfy the ontology and still be wrong, so we ask when it can serve as a certificate. On unseen combinations of familiar parts, a joint concept bottleneck model and a concept embedding model, trained as is standard, certify wrong classes 93-94% of the time despite a correct ontology (60% for a joint model trained only on visible parts and gated by a localizer). The joint model's part errors copy co-occurring values more often than chance (cross-concept shortcutting). Treating the ontology as an error-detecting code, we show that a certificate needs visible evidence excluding every rival, unseen parts reported as such, and rare misreads not driven by a shared shortcut. A minimal reference design, OCVE, reads each part from a local crop in its own forward pass. On unseen FunnyBirds classes, it certifies 52% of images at 0.4% risk, against 14% for mask-pooled features and 33% for full-image part readers (5.6% when trained and gated alike), at similar zero-shot accuracy. The best baselines, even calibrated or restricted to unseen classes, and a decoder counting only agreeing parts remain about 3-8 times riskier. On CUB, isolated region readers are more accurate than an attribute-prototype model (63.1% vs. 55.3%) and certify unseen species at about 6 points less risk than it and about 10 points less than features pooled in the same keypoint boxes. On real traffic signs, isolated readers lower certified risk from 99.8% to 67%, which is still far too high; most remaining errors are misread pictograms. On seen classes the ontology brings no gain over a fairly trained black box, and isolation costs accuracy.

**comment/C1：** 25 pages, 7 figures, 22 tables

</details>

### 7. [Anchoring VAE Fine-Tuning to Its Latent Diffusion Prior](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31651v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31651

**作者：** Rafael Bischof、Dominik Narnhofer、Julius Erbach、Michael Kraus、Konrad Schindler、Bernd Bickel

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31651v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31651v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对迁移学习中冻结 VAE 编码器会丢失非 RGB 输入细节、且受三通道限制的问题，提出 Diffusion Prior Anchoring：在 VAE 微调时用 score-distillation 式更新把 latent 约束回预训练扩散模型可靠去噪的高密度流形，并在深度、MRI、风场、法向估计四个任务上验证预测误差下降。

**相关性简评：** 直接触及「任务必要的几何与视觉细节是否保留在潜在内部状态」这一表示问题，冻结编码器的信息损失与 latent 偏离先验流形可作为信息坍缩的对照线索，可供核查；但该工作为单次前向的密集预测/回归，不涉及推理期 latent 状态生成与停止决策，与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 关联有限。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Anchoring VAE Fine-Tuning to Its Latent Diffusion Prior

**abstract/A1：** Pretrained latent diffusion models are effective priors for transfer learning, from geometry estimation to physics simulation. Existing approaches fine-tune the diffusion backbone but freeze the encoder of the VAE to preserve the latent distribution. However, a frozen encoder may miss salient details in non-RGB inputs and is limited to three channels. We introduce Diffusion Prior Anchoring (DPA), a regularizer applied during VAE fine-tuning that uses a score-distillation update to steer latents toward the high-density manifold on which the pretrained diffusion model denoises accurately. We validate DPA across three image and video models (FLUX 3, LTX-Video, Wan2.2) and four tasks: monocular depth estimation, MRI reconstruction, wind-flow simulation, and surface normal estimation, where DPA lowers the prediction error by 7.5% relative to the frozen VAE, 4.9% to decoder-only fine-tuning, and 4.0% to unanchored VAE fine-tuning. Its gain grows the further the target data lies from the RGB training distribution, from 3.3% on monocular depth estimation to 7.2% on complex-valued MRI. DPA also applies to modified VAEs, including pruned and multi-channel variants. With a four-channel VAE that encodes depth and surface normals, it lowers depth estimation error by 9.3%.

</details>

### 8. [Look Before You Commit: Visual-Evidence-Guided Decoding for Multimodal Diffusion Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31677v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31677

**作者：** Tongxiao Hu、Yikai Zhao、Qiyan Zhao、Xiaosong Yuan、Xuhang Chen、Pengzhou Cheng、Xiaofeng Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31677v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31677v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文诊断多模态扩散语言模型中「置信度无法区分候选来自图像证据还是语言先验」的问题：通过配对前向消融发现近九成高置信提交对图像不敏感，且幻觉样本深层注意力组织熵升高；据此提出免训练的 CD-APC 解码，在证据校正打分、可接受性与对比集中度双重门控下决定是否提交候选。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应 LVR 中「何时提交（STOP）应以视觉证据为依据」及视觉旁路、证据筛选问题，其消融诊断与提交门控可供核查 latent 状态是否真正使用视觉信息；但方法作用于 token 级扩散解码，与内部 latent 推理状态的映射仍需阅读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Look Before You Commit: Visual-Evidence-Guided Decoding for Multimodal Diffusion Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion multimodal large language models rely on confidence to decide when to commit candidate tokens during generation. In multimodal tasks, however, confidence cannot distinguish whether a candidate originates from image evidence or the language prior. We perform paired forward ablation and find that nearly nine out of ten high-confidence commits are insensitive to the image, while degenerate and hallucination samples exhibit significant increases in the entropy of deep-layer attention organization. Based on this diagnosis, we propose CD-APC, a training-free decoding method. CD-APC performs evidence-adjusted scoring within a base-supported pool and uses dual gating based on model acceptability and contrastive concentration to decide whether to commit, together with an inverse-window mechanism that adapts to inter-step difficulty. Across two backbones and five benchmarks, CD-APC consistently improves performance, indicating that stable visual evidence improves model outputs.

</details>

### 9. [RVLM-X: Towards a Universal VLM Harness](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31755v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31755

**作者：** Aadi Palnitkar、Dmytro Kurdydyk、Xiaomin Lin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31755v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31755v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RVLM-X：让 VLM 在持有全分辨率图像的代码 REPL 中自主决定递归查看哪些区域并汇总证据，同时构建 MapGenBench 评估细粒度感知与多步推理。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及 LOOK/STOP 与视觉证据筛选：把固定 zoom 树换成模型自写的递归搜索，可供核查动态区域选择、证据组合与计算成本；MapGenBench 也可检验细节保留与多步推理的耦合。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RVLM-X: Towards a Universal VLM Harness

**abstract/A1：** Harnesses for vision-language models (VLMs) have grown with the models' capabilities, notably for images far larger than those seen in training, where downscaling loses small details. Most of them wrap the VLM in a fixed procedure, such as a zoom tree, that decides in advance where it looks and how the evidence is combined. These procedures make up for the weaknesses of older models by keeping them on a task-specific path, but with frontier models that reliably plan and use tools, they can lower accuracy. We propose RVLM-X, a task-generalizable recursive VLM harness that runs unchanged across photographs, charts and maps. Following the recursive inference of Recursive Language Models, the VLM programmatically controls its own visual context in a code REPL that holds the full-resolution image and calls itself recursively on regions that it chooses. With a cost-efficient frontier model as the base of every method, RVLM-X is more accurate than a single call on all 7 public benchmarks and has the highest pooled accuracy. Because existing benchmarks mostly test whether a model finds one small detail, we also introduce MapGenBench, procedurally generated maps whose questions combine fine-detail perception with multi-step reasoning. There, RVLM-X answers 71.4% of held-out questions against 55.5% for the strongest baseline. Overall, our findings suggest that as VLMs plan and use tools more reliably, letting the model write its own visual search works better than fixing one in advance.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables

</details>

### 10. [JECT: Addressing the Context Shortcut in Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for Chest CT](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31849v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31849

**作者：** Hanbin Ko、Hong-Jun Choi、Jihun Kim、Young-Gon Kim、Dongheon Lee、Chang Min Park

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31849v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31849v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文在胸部 CT 的 JEPA 式掩码特征预测中提出「context shortcut」问题：小结节等决定诊断的发现无法由周围解剖预测，预测损失因而不再奖励编码器表示它们；JECT 让放射报告同时充当 predictor 的条件和（经掩码章节文本预测）编码器的目标，并用分层 3D 编码器在各尺度上预测，在 173k 体数据上从头训练达到现有 CT 基础模型水平。

**相关性简评：** 论文直接揭示了预测式自监督会使不可由上下文推断的细微视觉证据被压向「正常解剖」而丢失，与 LVR 关注的内部状态是否保留任务必要视觉细节、信息坍缩与视觉旁路高度对应；其「文本作条件 vs 文本作目标」的消融，以及无需额外训练即可复用 predictor 定位报告句子作用位置的探针，可供核查 latent 表示中的证据保留与贡献分配。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** JECT: Addressing the Context Shortcut in Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for Chest CT

**abstract/A1：** Joint-embedding predictive architectures learn by predicting features of masked regions from visible context. In chest computed tomography, the findings that decide a diagnosis, such as a small nodule, are often not predictable from the surrounding anatomy. A hidden finding is then best predicted toward normal anatomy, and the prediction loss stops rewarding the encoder for representing it. We call this the context shortcut. Conditioning the predictor on the radiology report repairs the prediction, but in our setup the encoder gains little over image-only pretraining: the report supplies what the encoder never had to learn. JECT therefore gives the report two roles: a condition for the predictor and, through masked section-text prediction, a target for the encoder, which must predict the report's anatomical sections from the unmasked scan. A hierarchical three-dimensional encoder that predicts at every stage keeps this clinical content at every scale. In ablations, the text target improves classification and localization, while conditioning adds little to the encoder. Trained from scratch on 173k volumes, the recipe reaches the level of current computed tomography foundation models in classification, retrieval and nodule malignancy, and of task-specific models in lung-cancer risk prediction after fine-tuning. Conditioning still matters: its predictor can be reused, with no extra training, to show where a report sentence acts, changing most at the finding the sentence describes. Code and pretrained weights are available.

**comment/C1：** 24 pages, 7 figures, 23 tables, including supplementary material. Code and weights: https://github.com/lukeingawesome/JECT

</details>

### 11. [Rethinking Video Agents: When and Why Video Harnesses Work](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31883v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31883

**作者：** Luoyuan Zhang、Xuanyu Zheng、Yancheng Long、Haoyang Xu、Bin Wen、Tingting Gao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.MM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31883v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31883v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文以 Video-Relook 为实验框架，让模型从统一默认配置出发自适应调整时间与空间观察范围，分析不同模型与任务下自适应观察的性能变化及交互轨迹，并总结 harness 生效取决于「信息性观察机会」与「模型将交互转化为可靠修订的能力」之间的匹配。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应「何时 LOOK、获取何种视觉证据」及收益–成本问题，其模型间证据寻求与答案修订差异可供核查 LOOK/STOP 收益对模型能力和任务需求的依赖；但机制是视频 agent 的外部观察接口，而非 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rethinking Video Agents: When and Why Video Harnesses Work

**abstract/A1：** Video understanding depends not only on how models reason about visual evidence, but also on which evidence they observe. Fixed observation policies determine this evidence in advance; agentic harnesses allow models to seek further observations as their understanding develops. This shift creates an opportunity to realize capabilities that fixed inputs leave untapped, yet the ability to request observations does not ensure their effective use. We investigate when and why video harnesses improve understanding, examining how task demands and models' capacity for interaction jointly shape their benefits. Using Video-Relook as an experimental framework, we let models adapt their temporal and spatial observations from a common default configuration, and analyze performance and interaction trajectories across models and tasks. Adaptive observation yields substantial gains on fine-grained action understanding, with benefits also extending to Video-MME-v2. Even under the same observation interface, gains differ substantially across models; interaction traces reveal corresponding differences in evidence seeking and the reliability of answer revision. The benefits also vary across tasks for the same model, ranging from substantial improvements to limited gains and regressions. Together, these findings support an account in which harness effectiveness depends on the alignment between opportunities for informative observation and the model's ability to turn interaction into reliable revisions. They motivate video harnesses that coordinate perception and reasoning, matching observational autonomy to task demands and model capabilities.

</details>

### 12. [Open-OmniCoach: Evidence-Enhanced Trajectory Learning for Omni Video Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31891v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31891

**作者：** Weisong Liu、Xiangtai Li、Haochen Wang、Haiquan Wen、Zhaoxiang Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31891v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31891v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Open-OmniCoach 框架：构建含 24.8 万条多跨度与反思交互轨迹的全模态视频数据集 OmniCoach-240K，并提出按证据覆盖提升与时间定位改进分配轮级信用的 agentic RL 方法 SEPO，训练出 Open OmniAgent 模型。

**相关性简评：** 多跨度证据搜索、基于自身错误的反思路径与轮级信用分配，与 LVR 关注的证据筛选、THINK/LOOK/STOP 决策及贡献分配直接相关；待核查其状态是显式交互轨迹而非 latent 推理状态，且以视频问答准确率作为主要评价。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Open-OmniCoach: Evidence-Enhanced Trajectory Learning for Omni Video Agents

**abstract/A1：** Training capable omni video agents requires more than diverse question-answer pairs: agents must learn to reliably find, connect, and correct task-relevant evidence in omni-setting. However, we argue that existing data pipelines provide limited control over task-relevant evidence and weak supervision for these capabilities. In this work, we present Open OmniCoach, a new framework for evidence-seeking omni video agents. It contains a high-quality dataset, OmniCoach-240K, and a new agentic reinforcement learning (RL) method, Step-Level Evidence-Guided Policy Optimization (SEPO). For the former, OmniCoach-240K comprises 248.2K interaction trajectories, including 230.7K multi-span trajectories and 17.4K reflection trajectories. We design a three-stage data pipeline by leveraging both fine-grained omni-evidence and the agent's own errors. Meanwhile, compared with other RL baselines, SEPO provides turn-level credit based on improvements in evidence coverage and temporal localization. Applying both trajectory data and the SEPO method, we obtain Open OmniAgent models. The resulting models outperform the baselines across multiple video and audio-visual understanding tasks by significant margins, demonstrating the effectiveness of the Open OmniCoach framework. In particular, Open OmniAgent-30B improves average accuracy over Qwen3-Omni by 6.3 percentage points across nine benchmarks, with gains of 12.2 and 13.3 points on LVOmniBench and LVBench, respectively.

**comment/C1：** 24 pages. Project Page: https://open-omnicoach.github.io , Code: https://github.com/Open-OmniCoach/omnicoach , Models &amp; Data: https://huggingface.co/Open-OmniCoach

</details>

### 13. [Your VLM Knows What to Inspect: Semantic Probe-Guided Adaptive Focusing for GUI Grounding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31909v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31909

**作者：** Ruixiao Shi、Fu Feng、Yucheng Xie、Jing Wang、Xin Geng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31909v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31909v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的 SPARK 框架，让冻结 VLM 通过「探索探针」描述上下文与关键细节、「验证探针」指出评估假设所需证据，再用其空间注意力与上下文响应决定裁剪位置和范围，并以不确定性加权投票融合多次观测，提升 GUI grounding 精度。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及「看哪里」的视觉证据筛选与测试时计算分配，与 LOOK/STOP 的收益成本、证据互补与停止决策相关；可核查其探针注意力如何定位裁剪区、观测历史如何避免重复并隐含终止条件，以及投票机制对多视图证据的加权合理性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Your VLM Knows What to Inspect: Semantic Probe-Guided Adaptive Focusing for GUI Grounding

**abstract/A1：** GUI grounding requires resolving fine visual details within the context that gives them meaning. Additional views can improve localization, but their value depends on what evidence they expose and how much context they preserve. We explore a capability of vision-language models (VLMs): even when their coordinate predictions are incorrect, they can describe visual evidence worth inspecting. We introduce \\textbf{SPARK}, \\textit{\\textbf{S}emantic \\textbf{P}robe-guided \\textbf{A}daptive \\textbf{R}egion see\\textbf{K}ing}, a training-free framework that turns this semantic guidance into targeted visual observations. Exploration probes describe relevant context and distinguishing target details, while verification probes identify evidence needed to assess emerging hypotheses. Their spatial attention guides view placement, contextual responses determine crop extent, and observation history encourages complementary inspection. The resulting predictions are combined through uncertainty-weighted voting. On ScreenSpot-Pro, SPARK improves grounding accuracy over single-view inference by 13.9, 25.2, and 16.1 percentage points with Qwen3-VL, Qwen2.5-VL, and UI-TARS, outperforming all compared test-time methods for each backbone. Consistent gains across four additional benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness across diverse interfaces and grounding tasks. These results establish semantic probing as an effective mechanism for turning a frozen VLM's understanding of what to inspect into more accurate GUI grounding.

</details>

### 14. [Visual Thinking: Training-Free Active Perception for Counting and Localizing Hard-to-Find Objects](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31973v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31973

**作者：** Emil Kielar、Pratik Chaudhari

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31973v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31973v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的「Visual Thinking」框架：VLM 在多轮主动感知循环中依据原图、候选裁剪和历史生成短语查询，由基于相似度、熵优先与新意的控制器排序后驱动 SAM 3 检测，并用跨轮关联、置信度加权、正例提示与图像切块提升难找物体的计数与定位。

**相关性简评：** 该工作把「看哪里、用什么描述取证据、证据如何累积」外化为显式循环，其短语排序、熵驱动的验证优先与跨轮置信度更新，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 成本收益的对应关系；但其推理状态外在于语言与检测器，而非模型内部 latent，需区分。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Visual Thinking: Training-Free Active Perception for Counting and Localizing Hard-to-Find Objects

**abstract/A1：** Vision foundation models can precisely segment objects based solely on a text prompt. However, they struggle to recover objects that are small, occluded or whose appearance is poorly captured by the original textual description. Vision language models can examine the image and its context, they can propose richer descriptions of the objects to be detected. But these models struggle with precise segmentation and localization. We introduce Visual Thinking, a training-free framework that combines a vision-language model with Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) through an iterative active perception loop. At each iteration, the VLM proposes short noun phrases using the image, candidate crops and history from past iterations. A controller ranks these phrases using embedding similarity between the original prompt and the proposal, an entropy-based verification priority and the novelty of the prompt. Next, SAM 3 uses prompts to detect objects in the image. We associate detections across iterations and update each object's confidence score using a weighted mean of scores obtained from SAM 3 with a larger weight for detections using narrower prompts. We supply confident detections as positive visual exemplars for SAM 3, and incorporate image tiling to recover small objects in cluttered images. We evaluate counting and localization on CARPK, FSCD-147, PixMo-Count, and OmniCount (Fruits). Compared with SAM 3, Visual Thinking reduces the counting mean absolute error (MAE) by about 18 on FSC-147 and about 8 on CARPK. It improves box average precision (AP) by more than 12 on FSCD-147 and CARPK. Visual Thinking, with fixed or no tiling, performs on par with Claude Opus 5.5 at extra-high reasoning effort, while running on single desktop GPU in about 5.91 seconds per image, compared to about 46.53 seconds per image for Claude through its API.

</details>

### 15. [InCue: Making Better Use of What Multimodal LLMs Already See at Test Time](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31987v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31987

**作者：** Shuwei Wu、Siyue Yu、Longin Jan Latecki

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31987v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31987v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文指出现有「放大裁剪区域」的收益大多不来自新细节，而来自把注意力引向模型已见的证据；据此提出 InCue，将视觉注意力与预测熵梯度耦合为空间目标，仅优化现有视觉 token 的偏移来重定向注意力，在多个 MLLM 与基准上取得提升。

**相关性简评：** 其「无需新增视觉输入、收益来自注意力重定向」的发现直接触及视觉细节保留与视觉旁路假设，且测试时的证据定位与视觉 token 偏移机制可供核查 LVR 中证据筛选与内部状态利用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** InCue: Making Better Use of What Multimodal LLMs Already See at Test Time

**abstract/A1：** Even when multimodal large language models (MLLMs) answer incorrectly, their internal cues often point to the relevant region. A widely used remedy re-presents the cue-selected region as an enlarged crop to supply finer detail. However, we find that much of its gain requires no new detail: it largely survives when the crop comes from the already-seen low-resolution input, and partly even when the region's cached tokens are merely copied. Part of re-presentation's gain thus comes from drawing attention to evidence the model already holds. We propose InCue, a test-time framework that makes better use of this evidence without additional visual input. InCue treats visual attention and predictive-entropy gradients as Internal Cues, couples them into a spatial target, and optimizes only an offset on the existing visual tokens to steer attention toward it. Under matched visual-token budgets, InCue achieves state-of-the-art performance, consistently outperforming recent test-time methods and improving four MLLMs by up to 8.9% on V$^\*$ and 23.4% on its hard samples. Its gains carry over to eight general benchmarks. Code will be available at https://github.com/paul-swu/InCue.

</details>

### 16. [Describe, Don't Decide: Correcting Answer Bias in Multimodal LLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31988v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31988

**作者：** Shuwei Wu、Longin Jan Latecki

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31988v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31988v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文诊断多模态 LLM 在图像实体比较题上的答案偏置：模型自己的实体描述往往已含正确答案，错误却发生在「看着图做决定」时。为此提出免训练 D^3：分别描述两个实体，去掉图像仅凭描述作答，再与直接答案融合，在 8 个 7–9B 模型、10 个基准的 79 个组合上均提升。

**相关性简评：** 该工作给出「感知阶段已保留答案、决策阶段被图像干扰」的解耦证据，可供核查 VLM 答案是否真正使用视觉证据，以及推理时分离描述与决策能否缓解信息旁路与视觉证据筛选问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Describe, Don't Decide: Correcting Answer Bias in Multimodal LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Comparing two entities in an image, multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) often answer wrongly. We find that the answer bias enters not when the model sees, but when it decides with the image in view: the model's own descriptions of the two entities often already hold the right answer. We therefore propose D$^3$ (Describe, Don't Decide): the model describes each entity alone, decides from these descriptions without the image, and merges this decision with its direct answer. Without any training, D$^3$ improves all 79 model-benchmark pairs across ten benchmarks and eight 7-9B MLLMs. On held-out GQA comparison questions, the mean accuracy of these models rises from 72.4% to 83.2% (up to +21.5% per model), higher than that of Qwen2.5-VL-32B answering directly (82.8%). Code will be available at https://github.com/paul-swu/describe-dont-decide.

</details>

### 17. [Beyond Before-and-After Images: Evaluating Temporal Grounding in a Lightweight VLM for Disaster Assessment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32022v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32022

**作者：** Shubh Garg、Pratham Arora、Debabrata Ghosh

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32022v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32022v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文对轻量 VLM（InternVL3-2B）在灾害评估双时相卫星图像上的时序 grounding 做受控诊断：用 41 个事件的 1,659 对光学/SAR 图像和 9,031 个问题，比较仅后时相、真实前后对、后图重复两次、反序以及来自其他事件的前图等输入，发现真实前图内容与时间顺序几乎不带来增益。

**相关性简评：** 该诊断直接检验答案是否依赖预期视觉证据，与 LVR 关注的视觉旁路、证据筛选与贡献分配问题直接相关；其配对对照和置换输入协议可供核查跨帧证据使用、答案对顺序不敏感等假设。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Before-and-After Images: Evaluating Temporal Grounding in a Lightweight VLM for Disaster Assessment

**abstract/A1：** Bi-temporal satellite imagery is central to disaster assessment: deciding what was damaged requires comparing a pre-event scene with its post-event counterpart. A vision-language model (VLM) can nonetheless appear to answer change questions while relying mainly on the post-event image or on the prompt's temporal framing. We present a controlled diagnostic of temporal grounding and apply it to one lightweight VLM, InternVL3-2B, on DisasterM3: 1,659 optical and SAR image pairs from 41 events and nine disaster types, in event-disjoint partitions, with 9,031 reasoning questions. We compare post-only input, the true pre/post pair, the post image repeated twice, reversed image order, and an unrelated pre-event image. The true pair scores $+0.5$ accuracy points above the repeated-post control (95\\% paired bootstrap CI $\[-0.2, +1.2\]$), and reversing the order changes accuracy by $-0.2$ points ($\[-0.8, +0.5\]$). Under this protocol we therefore find no measurable benefit from the content of the true pre-event image and little sensitivity to temporal order. The model is not blind to the first image, however: the true pair scores $2.5$ points above a pair whose pre-event image comes from another event ($\[+1.6, +3.4\]$). State-transition and multi-hop questions remain hard, and optical and SAR inputs show different profiles. We outline temporal scene graphs as a testable next step, not a validated solution, and argue that temporal benchmarks for Earth observation should report whether answers depend on the intended evidence, not only how often they are right.

**comment/C1：** 13 pages (4 main + references + supplementary), 4 figures, 14 tables. Accepted at the CV4EO Workshop, WACV 2027

</details>

### 18. [More Powerful, Less Verifiable? Mitigating Hard-to-Verify Hallucinations in MLLM's Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32055v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32055

**作者：** Jianhong Pang、Ziyi Ye、Qiuxia Hou、Yanhao Zhang、Zuxuan Wu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32055v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32055v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建了区分「明显」与「隐蔽」幻觉的图文数据集 ITHV，并提出 DAPO-V，在可验证性感知的风险预算约束下用自适应双重控制加大对人难以察觉错误的惩罚，以缓解 RL 后难以核验的幻觉。

**相关性简评：** 对隐蔽幻觉的区分可作为「视觉证据是否被真正使用」的评测与失败分析资源，其可验证性加权奖励也可供核查 latent 视觉接地与监督分配的线索；但该方法只在输出奖励层面施加约束，未涉及推理期 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** More Powerful, Less Verifiable? Mitigating Hard-to-Verify Hallucinations in MLLM's Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning (RL) strengthens model capabilities through feedback from humans and environments. However, emerging evidence suggests that reward optimization can produce outputs whose errors are harder for humans to detect. To address this issue, we construct ITHV (the Image-Text Hallucination Verifiability Dataset), comprising 2,728 visually grounded instances that distinguish between obvious hallucinations, which humans readily detect, and elusive hallucinations, which humans struggle to identify. We then propose DAPO-V, an extension of DAPO that maximizes correctness subject to a budget on verifiability-aware risk. Specifically, DAPO-V combines a verifiability-aware reward with adaptive dual control, where larger penalties are assigned to incorrect responses on questions with lower human verification accuracy. An adaptive multiplier further adjusts the penalty strength according to risk-budget violations. Across three MLLM base models, DAPO-V improves overall accuracy while substantially improving accuracy on elusive hallucination questions by 5.78--9.72 percentage points over accuracy-only DAPO. We further test DAPO-V with a blinded human study, which shows that hallucinations are more readily detected in DAPO-V than those of the base model.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 11 figures

</details>

### 19. [Clinical3D-Bench: Evaluating and Improving Spatial Intelligence of Multimodal LLMs in Hospital Environments](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32094v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32094

**作者：** Yang Bai、Yingzhi Xia、Ling Lin、Jun Cheng、Lin Fu、Huazhu Fu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32094v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32094v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 构建 Clinical3D-Bench 医院场景空间推理基准（3,368 题、373 种布局），测评 35 个 MLLM，并提供 44,750 题训练集；同时提出 GeoJeV，从视频重建场景记忆、依问题状态选择 3D 操作，并将其证据并入选项打分。

**相关性简评：** 配对场景状态检验模型是否随证据变化作答，以及「输入 3D 地图却几乎不被使用」的诊断，直接关联 LVR 关注的视觉旁路与证据使用；GeoJeV 依问题状态选取证据并注入打分，可供核查视觉证据筛选与 latent 状态利用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Clinical3D-Bench: Evaluating and Improving Spatial Intelligence of Multimodal LLMs in Hospital Environments

**abstract/A1：** Spatial reasoning in hospitals requires tracking look-alike equipment, interpreting patient-relative directions, and judging passage widths, yet existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of these abilities. We introduce Clinical3D-Bench, a simulated benchmark with 3,368 questions of eight types on egocentric walkthroughs of 373 hospital-room layouts. Layouts follow hospital design guidelines, answers are computed from the 3D scenes, and paired scene states test whether models change their answers when relevant evidence changes. Videos are photorealistic, and ten physicians screened the layouts. Among 35 multimodal large language models (MLLMs), the best open and proprietary models reach 45.7% and 53.6% macro accuracy, against 40.8% for an answer prior and 79.0% for physicians on a subset, and 27 of 32 open models score below 40% on two-way patient-relative directions. Fine-tuning on Clinical3D-45K, our 44,750-question training set, lifts two MLLMs 16-20 points above the best proprietary model. 3D maps given to the fine-tuned MLLM as input go largely unused: replacing them with another video's, even when they are ground truth, barely changes its accuracy. The proposed GeoJeV instead lets the MLLM compute with 3D: it reconstructs a scene memory from each video, selects 3D operations and their arguments from the MLLM's question state, and adds their evidence to its option scores. It achieves the highest accuracy of all evaluated models, narrowing the gap to physicians.

</details>

### 20. [RISE: Reasoning with Implicit State Embeddings for GUI Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32102v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32102

**作者：** Enqi Liu、Zhi Gao、Liu Liu、Lifeng Fan、Liyuan Pan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32102v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32102v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RISE 框架，将 GUI agent 面向动作的推理压入隐式状态表示，再用全 CoT 状态对齐、动作分布对齐和推理-动作边界对齐三种监督目标训练，以提升下一动作 token 预测准确率，并在多个基准上报告了 8B 规模的最优结果。

**相关性简评：** 用隐状态替代显式 CoT 并对其施加多粒度监督，直接对应 LVR 中 latent 状态承载推理内容与训练信号的议题；可供核查其隐表示是否真在推理期被使用、以及三种对齐目标分别贡献了什么。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RISE: Reasoning with Implicit State Embeddings for GUI Agents

**abstract/A1：** Graphical user interface (GUI) agents translate user instructions and screenshots into executable actions. To learn executable actions, existing approaches often rely on explicit reasoning during training, which encourage over-reliance on specific reasoning patterns rather than generalizable action-relevant information. In this paper, we propose an implicit framework, RISE, which integrates action-relevant reasoning into implicit state representations to guide GUI action prediction. To this end, action-relevant reasoning is captured through three complementary supervision objectives: full-CoT state alignment preserves information across the reasoning process, action-distribution alignment encodes action preferences, and reasoning-to-action boundary alignment captures the representation immediately before action generation. In this case, our RISE effectively learns informative implicit representations, thereby improving the accuracy of next-action token prediction. RISE achieves 70.6\\% accuracy on OSWorld-G, establishing state-of-the-art performance among compared 8B models with a 4.3-point gain over its backbone. Results across two distinct backbones and six diverse benchmarks further demonstrate its effectiveness in GUI grounding and action prediction. Our code is available on our project page.

</details>

### 21. [CoverMem: Coverage-Constrained Visual Memory for Budgeted Embodied Question Answering](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32119v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32119

**作者：** Ruijie Ma、Haoyue Liu、Mingda Zhang、Dongxu Yue、Xiaoying Tang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32119v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32119v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向具身情节记忆问答，提出 CoverMem：在有限视觉预算下按覆盖率约束挑选代表性全帧、增量维护记忆，并兼顾问题相关性、需求补充与冗余度补选互补帧。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应「视觉证据筛选」与预算受限的证据获取问题，其覆盖率与互补性准则可能为 LVR 中的视觉旁路保留和信息坍缩提供可核查的选取标准，但方法停留在帧级检索，与 latent 状态生成无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CoverMem: Coverage-Constrained Visual Memory for Budgeted Embodied Question Answering

**abstract/A1：** Episodic-memory embodied question answering enables agents to answer questions based on previously recorded visual observations of the surrounding scenes. However, growing observation histories, varying observation quality across viewpoints, and limited computational resources make it challenging to construct and maintain compact visual memories while retrieving sufficient evidence for question answering. To address these challenges, we introduce CoverMem, which incorporates three key components: (1) a coverage-constrained memory construction method that selects a compact set of informative full frames satisfying object-quality and representative-scene coverage requirements; (2) a coverage-preserving incremental maintenance strategy that locally reselects only the affected frames to satisfy updated coverage requirements as observations arrive; and (3) a budgeted complementary frame selection method that balances question relevance, additional support for question requirements, and redundancy with selected frames within a fixed budget. Experimental results on three benchmarks covering diverse environments and question types demonstrate that CoverMem improves question-answering performance under limited visual budgets.

</details>

**作者：** Jiawei Gu、Linjie Li、Yiming Liu、Yunzhuo Hao、Huichen Wang、Guanzheng Chen、Zhichao Peng、Luxin Xu、Xinyu Zhang、Li Luo、Disen Lan、Zican Hu、Mingyang Song、David Valente、Alex Jinpeng Wang、Yafu Li、Ganqu Cui、Zhengyuan Yang、Qizhe Xie、Yejin Choi、Ranjay Krishna、Yu Cheng

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32183v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32183v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ThinkMorph-SSL 两阶段训练方案：先用图像上色、去噪等视觉 pretext 任务自动构造无指令的交错多模态轨迹，让模型描述损坏图像、生成恢复图像并解释结果，再用自动构建的示例做问题驱动的指令微调。

**相关性简评：** 直接在像素空间生成中间视觉状态引导推理，与「生成」和「轨迹训练/监督来源」主线高度相关；其 pretext 轨迹能否替代昂贵人工示例、以及中间图像是否真正被后续步骤使用，可供核查，但属显式图像而非 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ThinkMorph-SSL: Scaling Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning with Pretext Tasks

**abstract/A1：** People reason with pictures as well as words. Interleaved multimodal reasoning gives models a similar way to solve problems by creating intermediate images and using them to guide further reasoning. Training models with this ability usually relies on task-specific demonstrations, which are difficult to collect. We introduce ThinkMorph-SSL, a two-stage training recipe that uses images themselves as a source of supervision. The first stage, pretext reasoning, converts visual pretext tasks, such as image colorization and denoising, into instruction-free interleaved traces. Models describe a corrupted or transformed image, generate a restored or canonical image, and interpret the result. The second stage uses automatically constructed demonstrations for question-driven instruction tuning. At the same instruction-tuning budget, models trained with pretext reasoning outperform those trained with instruction tuning alone. The full recipe improves over the base model by an average of 11.33 accuracy points across twelve benchmarks. These results show that supervision derived from images can build the visual skills needed for interleaved reasoning and improve learning from task-specific demonstrations.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://thinkmorph.github.io/ssl/

</details>

### 23. [Seeing Is Not Reaching: Instruction Shortcuts Override Visual Grounding in Vision-Language-Action Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32206v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32206

**作者：** Qing Zhang、Xuesong Li、Zhaoyuan Yang、Changlin Song、Xinyu Tian、Jing Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32206v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32206v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在六个 VLA 模型中发现物体移走后机械臂仍伸向训练位置的「看到却未触及」现象，归因于场景捷径与指令捷径；作者分别掩码图像中介的接地通路与指令直达动作通路，确认接地已影响动作但常被捷径压制，并提出免训练的 Pathway-Separated Guidance 放大接地、抑制捷径。

**相关性简评：** 与「视觉内容是否真正被使用」「视觉旁路与捷径覆盖」直接相关，其通路分离与掩码干预可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与贡献分配；但研究对象是机器人动作输出而非 latent 推理状态，需进一步确认可迁移程度。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Seeing Is Not Reaching: Instruction Shortcuts Override Visual Grounding in Vision-Language-Action Models

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are expected to inherit visual grounding from vision-language models, yet often reach for an object's training location after it has been moved. Across six VLAs, we identify two shortcuts: a scene shortcut, where the arm follows the scene's original task despite a new instruction, and an instruction shortcut, where the instruction retrieves the requested object's training location. In $π\_{0.5}$, the instruction shortcut persists even though object-name attention follows the moved target. We call this Seeing Is Not Reaching. To determine whether this grounding is unused or overridden, we separately mask an image-mediated grounding pathway and a direct instruction-to-action pathway. Masking the grounding pathway eliminates reaches to moved targets, whereas masking the direct pathway increases them. Thus, grounding already guides action but is often overridden by the instruction shortcut, which acts through the direct pathway. We introduce Pathway-Separated Guidance (PSG), which amplifies grounding and suppresses the shortcut without training or external target locations. On LIBERO-PRO Object under Position perturbations, PSG raises the target-reaching rate from 22.0% to 52.6% and task success from 16.6% to 40.8%, while largely preserving performance on the original tasks.

**comment/C1：** 31 pages, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/QZhang2111/psg

</details>

### 24. [EvoSearch: Self-Evolving Active Perception for Wide-Area Geospatial Search](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32214v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32214

**作者：** Zhenghao Xie、Jing Xiao、Zihao Yu、Wanyi Yu、Liang Liao、Gui-Song Xia、Mi Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32214v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32214v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 EvoSearch 自演化主动感知框架，联合优化感知策略与探索程序，利用已完成分支的质量—成本比较学习保留有用观测、避免冗余并在证据充分时停止，同时构建 GeoSearchBench 评估搜索质量与视觉处理效率。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及视觉证据获取、冗余筛选与停止决策，其轨迹压缩和成本约束可为 LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本权衡及证据充分性判断提供参照；但未涉及 latent 状态，需核查其策略与停止信号能否迁移到 LVR。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EvoSearch: Self-Evolving Active Perception for Wide-Area Geospatial Search

**abstract/A1：** Geospatial search is fundamental to resource surveys and environmental monitoring, requiring the discovery of relevant evidence across large geographic areas and multiple spatial scales. Existing active perception methods adaptively select observation locations and scales to improve search efficiency, yet their search trajectories become increasingly long and costly as the search area expands. A key limitation is that final-answer correctness alone provides little guidance on which observations to retain and when to stop, hindering efficient wide-area search. To address this challenge, we propose EvoSearch, a self-evolving active perception framework that co-evolves the perception policy and exploration program to compress search trajectories while preserving answer quality. Specifically, quality-cost comparisons between completed branches from shared evidence train the policy to acquire useful observations, avoid redundant ones, and stop when sufficient evidence is available. Execution feedback from the updated policy then guides exploration-program revision, adapting experience generation to the policy's changing observation needs. We further introduce GeoSearchBench, a benchmark for evaluating search quality and visual processing efficiency through relational search and region search. Experiments demonstrate that EvoSearch shortens search trajectories and substantially reduces visual processing while maintaining overall search quality, supporting scalable active perception for wide-area geospatial search.

</details>

### 25. [Relational Bottleneck Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32227v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32227

**作者：** Shin'ya Yamaguchi、Kosuke Nishida

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32227v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32227v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的 Relational Bottleneck Models，把现成 LVLM 转为可解释模型：先用主谓宾三元组显式刻画视觉概念间关系生成结构化理由，再用重要度加权的专家乘积解码，把理由当作答案的唯一因果依据。

**相关性简评：** 其「从解码上下文中严格剔除图像输入、只让理由驱动答案」的做法，与 LVR 关心的答案是否真正使用中间推理状态、视觉旁路与理由忠实性直接可比，可供核查如何因果约束推理状态对输出的贡献；但状态为显式文本三元组而非 latent。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Relational Bottleneck Models

**abstract/A1：** Achieving both interpretable and high-performance inference is a key challenge in deep learning. While Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) provide inherent interpretability, they are constrained by task-specific training and rely on isolated visual concepts that fail to capture higher-order visual semantic relationships. Conversely, Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate zero-shot capabilities through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. However, standard CoT lacks a strict causal dependency between the generated rationale and the final output, compromising faithfulness. To bridge this gap, we propose Relational Bottleneck Models (RBMs), a novel training-free framework that transforms any off-the-shelf LVLMs into inherently interpretable models in a plug-and-play manner. RBMs consist of two stages: (i) Structured Rationale Generation (SRG), which explicitly models semantic interactions between visual concepts as subject-predicate-object triplets, and (ii) Rationale-Grounded Decoding (RGD), which enforces a strict causal dependency between the rationales and the final output. RGD aggregates rationale-conditional next-token distributions via an importance-weighted product-of-experts strategy, strictly excluding the image inputs from the decoding context. Extensive zero-shot evaluations across diverse benchmarks and LVLM backbones demonstrate that RBMs achieve superior interpretability while improving task performance over CBM baselines, entirely without task-specific fine-tuning.

**comment/C1：** 14 pages, 8 figures

</details>

### 26. [CaveBench: Benchmarking Abductive Physical Reasoning from Internal Observations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32251v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32251

**作者：** Guanxin Lin、Chen Yang、Shenxiang Zeng、Honghui Zhu、Xin Li、Wenbo Deng、Jiansheng Fan、Chen Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32251v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32251v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CaveBench：模型只能看到装置描述与内部观测图像，外部控制隐藏，需反推导致观测响应的操作；含 5 个物理域、20 个场景、10,200 条模拟 episode，问题覆盖 1–6 个事件且要求给出完整控制集，并评测 27 种 VLM 配置与 7 个适配基线。

**相关性简评：** 属于视觉证据到因果解释的诊断型基准，其「单事件提升未必迁移到完整序列」及视觉识别、物理推断、证据整合、动作组合四类失败，可供核查多事件推理中证据筛选与状态累积的瓶颈。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CaveBench: Benchmarking Abductive Physical Reasoning from Internal Observations

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models (VLMs) are advancing in physical reasoning, but whether they can understand external physical drivers from internal observations remains an open question. Existing benchmarks have not specifically targeted this setting. To this end, we introduce CaveBench, a benchmark for abductive physical reasoning from internal observations. Models receive apparatus descriptions and internal images while the external controls remain hidden, and must infer the operations responsible for the observed responses. CaveBench spans 20 apparatus scenes in five physical domains and contains 10,200 simulated episodes, split into 9,000 training, 1,000 validation, and 200 test episodes. Questions span one to six events and require the complete control set at every event, testing whether an explanation accounts for the entire process. Synchronized observations and control records provide the inputs and reference answers. Evaluating 27 VLM configurations yields six-event exact-match accuracies of 68.0% for the strongest closed-source model and 12.5% for the strongest open-weight model. Seven adaptation baselines show that single-event gains need not improve complete sequences. Error analysis identifies failures in visual identification, physical inference, evidence integration, and action composition, specifying where current models struggle to connect internal phenomena with their external causes.

**comment/C1：** 50 pages, 47 figures, 13 tables, including the appendix. Guanxin Lin and Chen Yang contributed equally. Chen Wang is the corresponding author. Project page: https://pier-lab.github.io/CaveBench/

</details>

### 27. [StreamCoach: Proactive Sports Coaching via Continuous Visual Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32281v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32281

**作者：** Xiaoye Liang、Yiming Huang、Jialu Wu、Yushe Cao、Ruxiang Duan、Yi Sun、Tie Liu、Lai Jiang、Mai Xu、Shikun Feng、Yiheng Zhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32281v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32281v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出流式体育动作质量评估框架 StreamCoach：用持续 CoT 追踪身体部位运动与动作阶段转换，并以证据门控的主动反馈整合累积证据，另构建 EE4D-Stream 数据集，用时序-语义对齐强化学习联合优化反馈时机与内容。

**相关性简评：** 其证据门控的介入时机与流式证据累积，可供核查 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 决策、视觉证据筛选与贡献分配；但推理以文本 CoT 为主、面向体育指导应用，与内部 latent 状态表示的机制距离较远，需读原文确认状态与证据如何进入决策。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** StreamCoach: Proactive Sports Coaching via Continuous Visual Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** In fitness and sports training, timely action quality assessment (AQA) is essential for learners to identify and correct technical errors during movement execution. However, most AQA methods assess completed performances, limiting their ability to provide timely feedback. Streaming methods alleviate this latency, but limited reasoning hinders their use of subtle movement cues and sport-specific knowledge. Moreover, their fragmented feedback focuses on one body part at a time, overlooking movement details of other body parts and transitions between action phases. To address these limitations, we propose StreamCoach, a streaming AQA framework under the OnCueCoaching paradigm that couples continuous chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning with proactive, evidence-gated coaching. Technique-Aware Reasoning tracks body-part movements and action-phase transitions against sport-specific criteria, while Holistic Coaching integrates accumulated evidence to deliver timely, comprehensive feedback on strengths and technical errors. To support training and benchmarking, we construct EE4D-Stream from 1,213 sports video sequences in Ego-Exo4D through LLM-assisted reannotation and manual review of selected claims, pairing dense CoT annotations with evidence-gated speech content. Building on this dataset, we train StreamCoach using Temporal-Semantic Alignment Reinforcement Learning to jointly optimize feedback timing and content. We benchmark 11 offline and streaming baselines on EE4D-Stream, including three proprietary models. StreamCoach achieves state-of-the-art results across intervention timing, action assessment, and coaching quality, surpassing both GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 6 figures

</details>

### 28. [SofaSpace: A Benchmark for Executable Visual Spatial Reasoning in Continuous Motion and Environment Construction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32285v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32285

**作者：** Ze Rong、Kun Shi、Zhedong Zheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32285v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32285v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SofaSpace，一个面向连续平面刚体搬运与环境构建的视觉空间推理基准，包含 3000 个场景、四类任务视图及 534 个困难任务，并用几何验证器检查提交运动的全程有效性。

**相关性简评：** 其「端点吻合但连续运动无效」的诊断直接关联 VLM 是否在内部状态保留几何与轨迹约束，也提示 LVR 评价需区分可执行有效性与结果吻合，可作为基准类工作近期阅读。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SofaSpace: A Benchmark for Executable Visual Spatial Reasoning in Continuous Motion and Environment Construction

**abstract/A1：** A rigid body can fit at its start and goal yet collide with a wall as it moves between them. Inspired by the moving sofa problem, we introduce SofaSpace, a benchmark for visual spatial reasoning through continuous planar rigid-body transport and environment construction. SofaSpace contains 3,000 scenes organized around three challenges: geometric compatibility, nonlocal maneuver planning, and interactive and temporal coordination. Four task views ask models to plan a motion, reconstruct a layout, design an environment that meets transport requirements, or jointly generate a layout and a motion. A separate set of 534 SofaSpace-Hard tasks tests planning and judgment. A geometric verifier checks the entire body throughout each submitted motion. On static planning tasks, endpoint agreement and continuous validity differ substantially within the same submitted plans: Claude drops from 97.2% to 52.8%, DeepSeek from 100.0% to 30.6%, and Kimi from 97.2% to 29.4%, while the strongest configuration retains 98.3% full validity. Environment construction reveals a further gap. Of 295 feasible layouts generated by the strongest configuration, 181 satisfy all evaluated functional requirements; for Kimi, one of 172 does. These results show how executable checks distinguish endpoint agreement from valid motion and geometric feasibility from functional compliance.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages, including supplementary material

</details>

### 29. [VC-OPD: Learning to See What Matters via Visual Cue On-Policy Self-Distillation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32292v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32292

**作者：** Qinxuan Wang、Zheyu Zhang、Yijing Yang、Han Shu、Chuang Wang、Peipei Yang、Shuo Tang、Jie Hu、Shiming Xiang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32292v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32292v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 VC-OPD，将教师侧特权信息从局部裁剪扩展为问题条件化的视觉线索：由先进 MLLM 生成关键细节、结构关系与语义证据，经多阶段质量过滤后仅在训练时提供，沿学生自生成轨迹进行 token 级蒸馏，使小模型学会从原图定位并推理关键证据。

**相关性简评：** 直接关联「视觉证据筛选」与推理监督分配；可供核查线索过滤是否真让学生内部状态保留必要证据，以及训练期特权信息与推理期零额外成本的权衡是否成立。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VC-OPD: Learning to See What Matters via Visual Cue On-Policy Self-Distillation

**abstract/A1：** Visual On-Policy Distillation (OPD) commonly uses cropped or zoomed-in image regions as teacher-side privileged information to improve fine-grained perception in small Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). However, local pixel-level cues are insufficient for complex visual reasoning that requires global structure, spatial relationships, and high-level semantics. We propose Visual Cue On-Policy Self-Distillation (VC-OPD), which extends teacher-side privileged information beyond local image regions to question-conditioned visual cues. Advanced MLLMs generate cues capturing key visual details, structural relationships, and semantic evidence needed to answer each question. A multi-stage quality filtering process selects reliable cues, which are provided only to the teacher during training. This enables informative token-level supervision along student-generated trajectories, helping the student learn to identify and reason over critical evidence directly from the original image. No additional information is required at inference time. Since advanced MLLMs are used only for visual cue generation, VC-OPD is compatible with both open-weight and proprietary black-box models. Experiments on STEM and general visual reasoning benchmarks show consistent improvements across model scales over reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation baselines. Notably, a 4B model trained with VC-OPD outperforms many baselines with 8B or more parameters, demonstrating effective capability transfer through question-conditioned visual cues.

</details>

### 30. [ASTERISM: Do Multimodal LLMs Actually Look at All the Images?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32316v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32316

**作者：** Chanseul Cho、Dongwoo Kim、Noori Bae、Seungjae Moon、Seongsu Lee、Youngmin Ro

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32316v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32316v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 审计19个公开多图基准约3.3万题，发现24.2%的题仅凭单图或问题本身即可作答，且MLLM普遍采取这种「单图捷径」，即使单图不足也会重复单图答案；据此筛选出1.87万题构建ASTERISM基准与难例子集，并提出跨图信用分配CICA，在RLVR中把奖励分配到真正需要多图证据的token上，三个开源MLLM上提升2.6–6.0分。

**相关性简评：** 该工作直接诊断模型是否真正整合跨图视觉证据，并给出训练期的贡献分配方案，与「答案是否使用视觉内容」「视觉证据筛选」「贡献分配与监督」高度相关；但CICA作用于输出token的奖励分配而非latent推理状态，其机制是否可迁移到LVR仍需核查原文。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ASTERISM: Do Multimodal LLMs Actually Look at All the Images?

**abstract/A1：** Multi-image benchmarks aim to test whether a multimodal large language model (MLLM) combines evidence across images, but many of their items can be answered from a single image. Across about 33k items from 19 public benchmarks, our audit and a two-stage single-image filter find that one image or the question alone settles 24.2% of them. On these items, MLLMs recover from one image a median 78% of the accuracy that all images add over the text alone, so these items reward answering from one image, which we call the single-image shortcut. MLLMs take this shortcut even on items where one image is not enough. On such items, most of their wrong answers repeat an answer they give from one image, at a rate well above chance. We build ASTERISM, to our knowledge the largest audited multi-image benchmark, from these 19 benchmarks by keeping their items that need more than one image. Its 18.7k items, 2.0k of them corrected or rewritten, share one format, one scorer and seven task categories. We also release ASTERISM-Train with 49k training items and ASTERISM-Lite, a hard subset whose items we manually verify one by one. On ASTERISM-Lite, the strongest proprietary MLLM scores 68%. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), now common in MLLM post-training, rewards the shortcut as well, because a correct answer read off one image earns as much reward as one that combines images. In line with this, existing RLVR objectives add little to the ASTERISM score. To stop rewarding the shortcut in training as ASTERISM does in evaluation, we propose cross-image credit assignment (CICA), an extension of RLVR that moves the credit toward the tokens that need more than one image. On three open-source MLLMs, CICA raises the ASTERISM score by 2.6 to 6.0 points, more than twice the gain of each general and vision-specific RL objective trained on the same data.

**comment/C1：** Code and datasets: https://github.com/chanseul01/ASTERISM

</details>

### 31. [Visual-State Graph Memory for Streaming Video Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32369v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32369

**作者：** Ailar Mahdizadeh、Pritam Sarkar、Xiangteng He、Leonid Sigal

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32369v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32369v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出无需训练的 Visual-State Graph 流式视频记忆：将视频流抽象为对象及关系的动态场景图和带时间戳的事件日志，用关系匹配合并重复对象，并在问题到来时于固定输入预算下检索相关对象、事件与近期帧。

**相关性简评：** 其以实体关系和状态历史替代原始帧堆叠，直接涉及视觉证据保存与筛选、有限预算下的过去信息使用，可为 LVR 的持久视觉状态表示和证据选择提供对照，但需核查图记忆是否真正被 VLM 推理使用及关系匹配的可靠性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Visual-State Graph Memory for Streaming Video Understanding

**abstract/A1：** In streaming video understanding, the evidence needed to answer a question may have already left the recent-frame window. Keeping all frames does not scale with video length, while dropping older frames limits the model's ability to reason about the past. We propose Visual-State Graph (VSG), a training-free memory that stores the state of a stream rather than the raw sequence of frames. VSG represents the stream as a graph of objects and their relations, together with a log of events; similar to a dynamically evolving scene graph. An object observed repeatedly is represented by one persistent node, with a timestamped history of how its state changes. To determine whether a newly mentioned object already exists in the graph, we compare the relations it takes part in with those of stored objects. We build this memory as the video arrives, before the questions are known. When a question arrives, we retrieve relevant objects and events alongside recent frames under a fixed input budget. Our evaluation spans four streaming-video benchmarks and seven open-source vision-language models ranging from 7B to 32B parameters. Under matched input budgets, VSG improves reasoning about the past while preserving real-time understanding.

</details>

### 32. [ViDM: Efficient and Order-Robust Parallel Visual Decision Making](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32461v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32461

**作者：** Xudong Tan、Peng Ye、Chenyu Huang、Yaoxin Yang、Huafeng Qin、Tao Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32461v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32461v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** ViDM 把共享视觉上下文、多个问题与问题专属决策槽组织进同一序列，在单次前向中并行产生全部答案分布，并用 Decision-Query Mask 与多顺序平衡训练提升准确率和对问题顺序的鲁棒性。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应「parallel 生成」路线：以决策槽取代逐 token 自回归解码，其掩码如何限制各槽对视觉证据的取用、并行多题下的信息共享与顺序敏感性，可供核查 latent 并行推理状态与视觉证据筛选的设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ViDM: Efficient and Order-Robust Parallel Visual Decision Making

**abstract/A1：** Visual decision-making demands accurate judgments and timely responses. Yet for multiple questions sharing the same visual input, autoregressive multimodal large language models generate answers token by token, accumulating sequential decoding costs as question count grows and delaying completion of the decision set. Their predictions can also vary with question order. We introduce ViDM, which transforms multi-question visual inference into parallel decisions in a single forward pass, improving both accuracy and inference efficiency. ViDM organizes shared visual context, multiple questions, and question-specific decision slots into one sequence, reusing the native language-model head to produce all answer distributions simultaneously. A Decision-Query Mask aligns each decision query's direct attention with shared context and its corresponding question, while case-balanced multi-order training strengthens robustness to question reordering. Across nine benchmarks spanning image, multi-image, and video tasks, ViDM improves Qwen3.5-4B's average accuracy from 73.49% to 77.55% while achieving 8.4x the baseline's average end-to-end throughput. On GQA, where each evaluated image has 11.4 questions on average, the end-to-end speedup reaches 20.3x. ViDM also improves mean and worst-order accuracy while reducing order-induced variation across multiple benchmarks, with further validation on LLaVA-OneVision-7B and InternVL3.5-4B.

</details>

### 33. [STAR: Counterfactual Dual-World Rollouts and Spatial Target Adaptive Reconstruction for Visual On-Policy Distillation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32472v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32472

**作者：** Yi Zou、Zhuang Yan、Yudong Zhang、Xu Wang、Yang Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32472v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32472v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文诊断出 VLM 即使遮蔽局部证据仍能保持较高准确率，并提出 STAR：用局部图像编辑构造反事实双世界 rollout，结合教师对比真实与均值色裁剪的校正方向，以及按学生—教师空间注意力差异自适应重建 token 级目标，实现视觉 on-policy 自蒸馏。

**相关性简评：** 其「图像正确不等于依赖局部证据」的诊断与反事实配对监督，直接关联视觉证据是否真正参与答案、视觉旁路及贡献分配问题；注意力差异驱动的 token 级校正可供核查其是否促进证据使用，但该工作属训练期蒸馏而非 latent 推理状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** STAR: Counterfactual Dual-World Rollouts and Spatial Target Adaptive Reconstruction for Visual On-Policy Distillation

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models often rely on global context and language priors while overlooking answer-determining local details. Privileged visual on-policy self-distillation supervises full-image student rollouts using a frozen teacher that views high-resolution evidence crops. Yet our cross-scale diagnostics show that models retain over half of their full-image accuracy when local evidence is completely masked, indicating that single-image correctness does not guarantee reliance on local evidence, while the need for visual correction also varies across tokens with their spatial attention states. We propose STAR, a visual on-policy self-distillation framework combining independent counterfactual dual-world rollouts with spatial-attention-guided target reconstruction. Local image editing constructs paired worlds with identical questions and backgrounds but distinct answer-determining facts, where a shared student samples trajectories independently to expose contextual shortcuts under image-consistent prefixes. Within each world, the teacher contrasts real and mean-color crops to determine the visual correction direction, while the divergence between student image attention and a teacher-centroid spatial reference adaptively controls token-wise target log-probability reconstruction. Without auxiliary attention losses or test-time tool overhead, STAR improves Qwen3.5 across scales by up to 8.04 percentage points in average accuracy over initialization across six fine-grained benchmarks, reaches OPSD's final accuracy $4.7\\times$ faster, and generalizes to out-of-domain reasoning tasks.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables

</details>

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** GeoVLDrive 提出一种几何接地的驾驶 VLA 框架，用 3D 基础模型多层特征增强视觉语言主干，并将未来场景几何、关键智能体运动与元动作组织为有序、分别监督的 latent CoT 状态，再由动作专家生成并排序轨迹。

**相关性简评：** 其结构化 latent 状态及分项监督直接关联 LVR 中推理状态表示、视觉证据注入与贡献分配问题，但研究场景为自动驾驶规划，需核查 latent 状态是否真正承载并驱动最终决策。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GeoVLDrive: Geometry-Grounded Vision-Language Reasoning for Autonomous Driving

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language-action (VLA) planners inherit semantic knowledge from pretrained vision-language models, but their reasoning is rarely grounded in 3D scene structure and its evolution over time. We introduce GeoVLDrive, a geometry-grounded VLA framework for 3D spatiotemporal reasoning and planning. Multi-layer features from a 3D foundation model augment the vision-language backbone through gated cross-attention. A structured latent chain of thought (CoT) organizes future scene geometry, key-agent motion, and meta-actions into ordered, separately supervised latent states. An action expert generates trajectory proposals from these states and multi-layer scene features, and ranks them using scene-grounded, interacting score tokens. We also introduce NAVSIM 3DQA to train and evaluate metric 3D spatial and motion understanding. GeoVLDrive achieves 91.8 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.9 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2. On NAVSIM 3DQA, the geometry-grounded backbone scores 89.2% overall, 4.6 percentage points above the fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-2B baseline. On LingoQA, the backbone achieves 68.6% Lingo-Judge accuracy.

</details>
