### 35. [Are We Rewarding the Wrong Module? Module-Specific Policy Optimization for Multimodal Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32687v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32687

**作者：** HuiSeong Cho、Jun Yeong Park、Yu Rang Park

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32687v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32687v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对多模态 RLVR 中视觉编码器、projector 与 LLM 共用同一 advantage 的「模块级信用纠缠」问题，提出 MSPO：用感知清单问答构造置信度感知的感知奖励（阈值定方向、Beta 后验置信度定幅度），并结合主任务成功率缩放得到视觉编码器专属 advantage，其余模块仍用结果型 GRPO。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应「贡献分配与监督」主线，可供核查分离感知与结果信号能否缓解视觉旁路、感知奖励是否真让答案使用视觉证据，以及清单与额外前向的成本收益。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Are We Rewarding the Wrong Module? Module-Specific Policy Optimization for Multimodal Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been widely adopted to enhance the multimodal reasoning of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing methods share a common limitation of Module-Level Credit Entanglement, in which the vision encoder, projector, and LLM modules are jointly optimized using the same advantage signals even when perceptual correctness and final-answer correctness differ. To address this limitation, we propose Module-Specific Policy Optimization (MSPO), a framework that separates perceptual and outcome-based learning signals across model modules. Specifically, MSPO uses responses to perception checklists comprising auxiliary questions about visual information to derive an advantage for training the vision encoder. From these responses, MSPO computes the Confidence-aware Perception Reward (CaPR), using a perception sign obtained by thresholding checklist accuracy to determine reward direction and posterior confidence from a Beta distribution over latent perception accuracy to scale reward magnitude. We then derive the vision advantage through group-relative normalization of CaPR and scale it using main-task success rates. This advantage guides updates to the vision encoder, while the projector and LLM retain outcome-based GRPO updates. Extensive experiments on seven mathematical and general reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that MSPO outperforms existing RL-tuned models on average at both the 3B and 7B scales.

</details>

### 36. [Knocked Off Course: Tracing Uncommanded Motion from Perception to Action in Embodied VLAs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32705v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32705

**作者：** Dan Zlotnikov、Nadav Alali、Ohad Ben-Shahar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32705v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32705v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文基准测试三个跟踪型 VLA 在风扰、地形不平等未指令自运动下的表现，沿像素到动作追踪信息流，定位表征中小运动读数减弱与动作解码中旋转方向效应衰减两处缺口，并用约 1.7% 原始数据微调 Uni-NaVid 验证。

**相关性简评：** 其从感知到动作的诊断直接对应视觉运动细节是否保留在内部状态、决策状态是否真正使用该内容，可供核查信息坍缩与视觉旁路；小数据定向微调也为轨迹监督与贡献分配提供线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Knocked Off Course: Tracing Uncommanded Motion from Perception to Action in Embodied VLAs

**abstract/A1：** Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) enable simultaneous processing of egocentric video and textual target descriptions to produce action commands for embodied tracking platforms. However, these platforms rarely move exactly as commanded, in part due to unexpected environmental disturbances such as wind, unleveled terrain, and road bumps. Here we study how such models handle uncommanded egomotion. First, we explore performance across diverse disturbances by benchmarking three tracking VLAs on three datasets. We find that models differ in which environmental disturbances hurt them most, but all are sensitive to sudden target loss. Tracing egomotion from pixels to emitted actions, we identify two gaps. In representation, motion is reliably recovered through explicit relations between frames, but aggressive compression of past frames weakens small-motion readouts. In action, large rotations do reach the decision state, yet the decoded direction carries only a few percent of a mirrored rotation's effect on the turn. Targeting both gaps, we fine-tune one model, Uni-NaVid, on data amounting to just 1.7% of its original training set in a ladder of analysis-motivated variants. These gain 5-22 points after target-loss without degrading clean success; after a smooth loss, the best one improves success by 72% (relative), recovering 76% of its gap to clean. We also show that targeted fine-tuning improves recovery partly via a text-mediated action dependency, without new architecture, large-scale data collection or training from scratch.

</details>

### 37. [Lazy Agents Answer Against Their Own Beliefs: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs Teaches Them to Act on What They Believe](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32884v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32884

**作者：** Richmond Sin Jing Xuan、Peilin Feng、Wenbin Wang、Soujanya Poria

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32884v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32884v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究视觉谜题代理在证据不足时过早提交答案的「laziness」，提出 RLVB，用模拟器可计算的答案后验奖励鼓励继续探查或及时提交，并构建 Pro Worlds 基准。

**相关性简评：** 直接落在 VLM 推理的停止决策与证据获取上，关系 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益成本；其不读取 belief 行的后验奖励可供核查如何监督「何时停」，以及是否会被策略以投机方式利用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Lazy Agents Answer Against Their Own Beliefs: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs Teaches Them to Act on What They Believe

**abstract/A1：** AI agents working on long tasks often commit to an answer before they have enough evidence, a behavior called laziness. In our evaluations, they frequently commit even while their stated belief still names several possible answers. An outcome reward at the end of the episode scores only the final answer, so it cannot teach the agent when to commit, because a lucky guess receives the same reward as an answer backed by evidence. During training, however, the simulator can compute the exact posterior over the answer at every step and tell whether the evidence is already enough. We propose Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs (RLVB), which rewards the agent for taking further steps while this posterior still allows several answers and for committing once the evidence is sufficient. The reward needs no judge, critic or reward model, and it never reads the belief line the agent writes before each action. We also introduce Pro Worlds, a benchmark of visual puzzles where the agent views a large world through a small window. We evaluate three vision-language models on three benchmarks, two of which are never seen in training. RLVB improves the base model in all nine settings, by 17.1% on average. Under the outcome reward, GRPO and PPO fall below the base model on average. RLVB also outperforms PPO with a process reward from an LLM judge by 9.3% on average while using 1.6 times fewer GPU-hours. The trained agent answers with sufficient evidence in 51%, 12% and 74% of the episodes on the three benchmarks, against 8%, 0.4% and 36% for the base model. Its accuracy gain therefore comes from answering more often at high levels of evidence. The belief line shows how the agent reaches this evidence: it acts on its own belief. It commits at only 0.1 to 2.2% of the turns at which the evidence is insufficient and its line still names several answers, against 3 to 68% for the base model.

</details>

### 38. [Efficient Video Retrieval Augmented Generation via Token Allocation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32938v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32938

**作者：** Ayush Barik、Fan Lai、Francis Y. Yan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG、eess.IV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32938v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32938v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Lembas，把视频 RAG 建模为帧与字幕在共享预算下的 token 分配问题，用带收敛保证的迭代注水算法求解，并在多轮对话中复用已处理 token、借 VLM 注意力免费细化相关性。

**相关性简评：** 其「token 边际价值随同一项内递减、相似证据越多越贬值」的目标直接对应 LVR 关注的视觉证据筛选与计算预算分配，可供核查；但优化的是输入 token 选择而非 latent 推理状态的生成与停止决策。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Efficient Video Retrieval Augmented Generation via Token Allocation

**abstract/A1：** Efficient long-video understanding requires identifying relevant evidence while minimizing the tokens processed by vision-language models (VLMs). Existing video retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods rely on frame selection and token compression, but overlook how much each additional token is worth. We introduce Lembas, a plug-and-play framework that formulates video RAG as a token allocation problem over frames and subtitles under a shared budget. Our key insight is that the value of a token diminishes within each item and decreases further as similar evidence receives more tokens. Lembas captures both effects in a single objective and solves it with an efficient iterative water-filling algorithm that has a provable convergence guarantee. For multi-turn conversations, Lembas reuses the tokens processed in earlier turns and refines relevance with the VLM's attention at no extra cost. Our evaluations show that Lembas improves accuracy by up to 7.2 percentage points over state-of-the-art baselines at comparable compute. On multi-turn video understanding, Lembas achieves up to 1.5 percentage points higher accuracy with 1.7-17.3x fewer TFLOPs.

</details>

### 39. [Do Vision-Language Models Know Their Own Visual Weaknesses? Probing Capability-Level Metacognition](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32940v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32940

**作者：** Dohoon Kim、Taesup Moon

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32940v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32940v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在多种开源与专有 VLM 上检验模型能否预先判断哪些视觉任务类型与图像退化条件对自身困难，区分所有模型共有难度与模型特有弱点，并训练模型预测自身准确率；结果显示显式自评普遍失准，但模型对自身答案的概率在少量未标注问题上能反映其特有弱点。

**相关性简评：** 直接关联 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益判断与停止决策：显式自评不可靠、而答案概率已含未言明的能力信息，可供核查 LVR 是否能用内部状态估计视觉证据需求并触发额外查看或终止。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Do Vision-Language Models Know Their Own Visual Weaknesses? Probing Capability-Level Metacognition

**abstract/A1：** Metacognition includes knowing one's own strengths and weaknesses across kinds of tasks, not only judging whether a single answer is correct. We test whether vision-language models (VLMs) know in advance which kinds of visual tasks and image conditions are hard for them, across a wide range of open and proprietary models. Because some tasks are hard for every model, we separate what a model knows about this shared difficulty from what it knows about itself. We find that VLMs know little in advance about their visual weaknesses. They misjudge their overall accuracy and do not even know which kinds of tasks are hard for every model, and most misjudge how degraded images affect them. We further train VLMs to predict their own accuracy, which teaches them their own level of accuracy on kinds unseen in training but not which kinds are hard for them. However, information about these weaknesses appears once a model starts solving. On a few unlabeled questions of a kind, the probability a model assigns to its own answers follows weaknesses particular to the model, across kinds of tasks and image conditions. VLMs thus hold information about their own weaknesses that their stated predictions do not yet reflect. By separating what is particular to a model from what holds for every model, our evaluation offers a test for methods that aim to teach VLMs their own weaknesses, and the answer probability offers them a signal to start from.

**comment/C1：** 24 pages, 16 figures

</details>

### 40. [Benchmarking Evidence Sufficiency in Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32964v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32964

**作者：** Nhat Ha Nguyen、Sudipta Chowdhury、Lokesh Das

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32964v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32964v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DriveAnswer 基准（20,151 题、七个推理族），用保持语义答案不变、仅改变观测是否足以支撑回答的强/弱证据配对，要求模型在弱证据下弃答，并联合评价答案正确性与 grounding。

**相关性简评：** 与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 中的证据筛选和停止决策直接相关，「语义正确但证据不足」的配对设计可供核查内部状态是否编码证据充分性、以及定位与弃答是否应共享同一判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Benchmarking Evidence Sufficiency in Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving

**abstract/A1：** Reliable driving VLMs must do more than answer correctly or localize relevant scene actors: they must determine whether the available visual evidence is sufficient to support an answer. Existing evaluations largely treat grounding and answerability as separate measurements, making it difficult to distinguish well-supported predictions from those localized to relevant but insufficient evidence. We introduce DriveAnswer, a benchmark of 20,151 questions across seven reasoning families, that operationalizes this distinction using matched strong- and weak-evidence configurations. Each pair preserves the underlying scene fact and semantic answer while changing whether the observations support answering, making abstention the appropriate response under weak evidence. On the six-family evaluation, the strongest zero-shot baseline reaches 67.31% strong-evidence accuracy, yet only 21.55% of matched questions satisfy both answer-abstain behavior and complete grounding. With controlled adaptation, Gemma-4-12B reaches 63.29% on this joint capability, nearly tripling its zero-shot performance. Qwen3-VL-8B exhibits the same broad improvement in evidence-sensitive answering and grounding. These results show that semantic correctness, evidence sufficiency, and grounding are distinct capabilities that should be evaluated jointly.

</details>

### 41. [When Repair Accuracy Misleads: Training a VLM on Its Own Failures](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32982v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32982

**作者：** Ang Qi、Yue Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32982v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32982v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究用模型自身失败样本微调来修复 VLM，并指出 held-out 失败准确率会误导：人工审计发现 100 条失败中 37 条是标签错误，且失败样本存在措辞规律，只读问题的分类器即可答对 73.2%。据此提出 VFR——类型化最小对比失败挖掘、三名不看标签的 LLM 裁判验证、答案优先的纠正目标、带 replay 的 LoRA 微调；空间关系大幅修复，但否定与多图关系推理反而退化。

**相关性简评：** 其失败筛选、措辞捷径与指标失真的证据，可为 LVR 中视觉证据是否被真正使用、贡献分配与训练后能力遗忘的诊断提供具体参照；「准确率上升但依赖语言规律」的现象也提示 latent 增益需做因果核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Repair Accuracy Misleads: Training a VLM on Its Own Failures

**abstract/A1：** Fine-tuning a vision-language model on its own failures is a direct way to repair it, but accuracy on held-out failures, the obvious measure of success, misleads. Many mined failures are not model errors: a human audit of 100 failures of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on questions generated from COCO and GQA found label errors in 37. And mined failures share wording regularities: question-only classifiers get both answers right on 73.2% of held-out failure pairs. We study both traps with verified failure-driven repair (VFR): typed minimal-pair failure mining, verification by three LLM judges that answer without seeing the stored labels, answer-first corrective targets, and LoRA fine-tuning with replay. VFR repairs 82.8% of held-out failures (base model: 10.0%), and on independently labeled, unconditioned pairs it raises overall accuracy from 87.4% to 92.4% through spatial relations, whose accuracy rises from 66.7% to 96.8% even where the wording points to the wrong answer. Yet on negation, of which it repairs 88.9% of held-out failures, its accuracy on unconditioned pairs falls from 88.7% to 79.7%: it breaks negations about absent objects, rare in its training set. Without verification, accuracy on unconditioned pairs falls to 80.8%, below the base model's 87.4%, through a negation shortcut our development benchmarks miss; without failure selection, it stays at 92.0% (one seed) while repair falls to 73.4%. Training also lowers two-image relation accuracy (74.3% to 49.6%; replay data alone: 48.4%); multi-image replay partly and unevenly reverses this. Paraphrasing the spatial questions keeps most of the gain (87.3% vs. the base model's 62.0%), though rewording lowers spatial repair on held-out failures from 92.9% to 76.8%. On What'sUp's independent photos of objects under others, caption choice stays perfect while accuracy on our yes/no pairs falls from 84.5% to 26.4%.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages, 2 figures, 16 tables

</details>

### 42. [GRAPE-Bench: When Vision Degrades, Does Video Reasoning Hold?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33020v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.33020

**作者：** Ce Zhang、Junyi He、Tianshi Ming、Jinxi He、Jianshu Zhang、Xiyuan Yang、Jianuo Zhu、Yicheng Tao、Xiyu Luo、Minghao Fu、Jiahui Zhu、Kehan Guo、Yunzhong Xiao、Jingyang Lin、Wei Chow、Lingdong Kong、Katia Sycara、Yaqi Xie

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33020v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.33020v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GRAPE-Bench，把视觉退化条件与问题难度联合纳入视频推理评测：合成十二类损坏加入夜、雨雪雾真实驾驶视频，每题配三级递进问题，测试开放权重与前沿模型，并尝试合成数据微调与偏好引导。

**相关性简评：** 该基准为视觉证据受损时的多模态推理提供诊断与失败分析，可供核查模型是否真正使用视觉细节、以及安全相关简单判断的薄弱环节；其偏好引导对「安全判断与高难推理」权衡的连续调控，可能为视觉证据筛选与贡献分配提供线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GRAPE-Bench: When Vision Degrades, Does Video Reasoning Hold?

**abstract/A1：** Despite strong performance on standard benchmarks, video reasoning models remain vulnerable to visual degradation, raising concerns about their reliability in safety-critical scenarios. Existing benchmarks address this concern in part by simulating visual degradation or probing model reasoning with challenging questions, leaving open how well models handle naturally degraded video and whether they can make the simpler judgments that matter for safe driving. To this end, we introduce GRAPE-Bench, which jointly evaluates video reasoning across visual degradation conditions and question difficulty. It combines a synthetic set spanning twelve corruption types across daily-life and driving videos with real-world footage of driving at night or in rain, snow, or fog. Each video is paired with three progressively challenging questions, from fundamental judgments with potential safety implications to demanding reasoning stress tests. Across open-weight and frontier models, we observe ranking reversals between synthetic and real-world conditions and level-specific weaknesses obscured by overall accuracy. Synthetic-data fine-tuning improves Qwen3.5-9B's real-world accuracy from 76.7% to 81.1%, while clean-privileged on-policy distillation reaches 80.4% in a separate reasoning-enabled setting. Through preference steering, we further demonstrate continuous control over a frozen model's trade-off between safety-relevant judgments and challenging reasoning, with little change in overall accuracy. Together, GRAPE-Bench provides a unified testbed for evaluating, improving, and controlling video reasoning under degraded visual conditions.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://zhangce01.github.io/grape-bench/

</details>

### 43. [Chain-of-Thought Is Not Explainability](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31271v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31271

**作者：** Fazl Barez、Tung-Yu Wu、Iván Arcuschin、Michael Lan、Vincent Wang、Noah Siegel、Nicolas Collignon、Clement Neo、Isabelle Lee、Alasdair Paren、John Yan、Adel Bibi、Damiano Fornasiere、Robert Trager、Yanai Elazar、Yoshua Bengio

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31271v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31271v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 这是一篇 position paper，综合既有证据论证当前 CoT 生成的显式推理链常与驱动预测的隐藏计算不一致，并统计约千篇 CoT 相关论文中约 21.7% 将 CoT 当作承重式可解释性依据，进而提出应在使用前做忠实性核验并报告结果。

**相关性简评：** 其关于「言说推理是否反映实际计算」的忠实性框架，可能为 LVR 中 latent 内容是否被答案真正使用、贡献分配与视觉旁路的诊断提供可核查的评估思路，但原文面向纯文本 CoT，迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Chain-of-Thought Is Not Explainability

**abstract/A1：** Chain-of-thought (CoT) allows language models to verbalise multi-step rationales before producing their final answer. While this technique often boosts task performance and offers an impression of transparency into the model's reasoning, this position paper argues that rationales generated by current CoT techniques can be misleading and are neither necessary nor sufficient for trustworthy interpretability. We analyse faithfulness as whether CoTs are not only human-interpretable but also reflect the model's underlying reasoning well enough to support responsible use. By synthesising evidence from prior work, we systematically show that verbalised chains are frequently unfaithful, diverging from the critical hidden computations that drive a model's predictions. As CoT is increasingly relied upon in application domains, including high-stakes ones such as medicine, law, and autonomous systems, we further argue that this unfaithfulness is not taken seriously enough in these settings: our analysis of 1,000 recent CoT-centric papers finds that approximately 21.7% explicitly treat CoT as a load-bearing interpretability technique, building pipelines or safety arguments that would not hold if CoT is unfaithful to the model's actual reasoning. They include papers in high-stakes domains that heavily hinge on such interpretability claims. Building on prior work, we make three proposals: (i) avoid treating CoT as being sufficient for interpretability without additional verification, (ii) adopt rigorous methods that assess faithfulness for downstream decision-making, and (iii) report such assessments alongside any interpretability claims based on CoT, while continuing to use CoT for its communicative and monitoring benefits.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Position Paper Track). 27 pages, 3 figures

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31397

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** CoRe 从零训练约 383M 参数的图文模型，使每种模态的上下文表示同时承担理解读出、条件化另一模态和以连续流从噪声生成自身的功能，并在同等数据与架构下比较「理解塑形后冻结」与联合塑形的表示。

**相关性简评：** 其控制实验指出理解负责语义组织、生成迫使表示保留更多信息，且中间状态可被冻结探针读取与引导、可少步蒸馏，这为核查 LVR 中 latent 是否保留视觉细节、是否被下游答案使用以及状态更新方式提供线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CoRe: Jointly Learning Contextual Representations for Understanding and Generation

**abstract/A1：** We introduce CoRe, in which understanding and generation jointly shape one contextual representation for images and one for text, trained from scratch. Each representation is read for understanding, conditions the other modality, and is the space in which that modality is generated by a continuous flow from Gaussian noise. With 383M parameters trained on CC12M and no pretrained language model, text encoder, or VAE at inference, CoRe matches a same-data contrastive-only baseline in global understanding and reaches COCO-30K FID 10.10, comparable to much larger generators built on pretrained components. In controlled comparisons at equal data and architecture, CoRe generates better in both directions (text to image and image to text) than a representation shaped by understanding alone and then frozen, and follows prompts better than generating in a space that understanding does not shape. In the other direction, with an attentive segmentation probe, on monocular depth, and when read by a frozen language model, CoRe surpasses the contrastive-only baseline: generation adds information that stronger readouts reach. Because generation runs inside the understanding representation, frozen real-image probes read and steer intermediate states and the model ranks its own samples without extra training. Because both modalities use continuous flows, both also distill to a few steps. Our controls indicate why one representation suffices: understanding organizes the representation semantically, while generation makes it retain more information.

</details>

### 45. [SwiftLoop: Selective Refinement for Adaptive Implicit Reasoning in Looped Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31481v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31481

**作者：** Tianyi Zhao、Ke Wan、Chen Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31481v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31481v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** SwiftLoop 提出一种推理期的 looped Transformer 选择性循环精炼框架，按位置冻结 latent 更新，并用 K/V 可复用性与输出功能影响两类事后监督学习轻量冻结策略，以在循环深度和活跃宽度上自适应分配计算。

**相关性简评：** 逐位置冻结与「K/V 可复用性／功能影响」双准则可供核查 LVR 的 STOP 决策和 latent 状态价值估计；但该文在文本隐式推理与通用 looped 模型上验证，向视觉证据筛选的迁移仍待检验。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SwiftLoop: Selective Refinement for Adaptive Implicit Reasoning in Looped Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Looped Transformers advance implicit chain-of-thought reasoning through recurrent latent refinement. However, existing looped reasoners typically employ fixed-depth recurrence, updating all latent positions at every iteration and incurring redundancy when further refinement is unnecessary. We introduce \\textsc{SwiftLoop}, an inference-time framework for selective recurrent refinement through position-wise freezing, enabling adaptive computation allocation across both recurrent depth and active width. SwiftLoop learns lightweight freezing policies through hindsight-guided supervision derived from two complementary criteria: K/V reusability at the internal representation level and functional impact at the output level. At inference time, these policies guide adaptive freezing based on observed hidden states. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SwiftLoop achieves favorable accuracy--computation trade-offs over fixed-loop inference and adaptive baselines, with measured inference acceleration. Beyond implicit reasoning, we further demonstrate its applicability to recurrent prompt prefilling in general looped models.

</details>

### 46. [How to build and train your recurrent-depth model: A fixed-point perspective](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31513v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31513

**作者：** Thomas Pethick

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31513v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31513v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文从不动点视角解释循环深度模型为何可用截断反传训练：指出常用的输入注入等价于 Halpern 迭代，在 Lipschitz 算子假设下步长缓慢衰减即可用 polylog 深度窗口收敛，并据此给出按参数组施加行范数与谱范数约束的优化器 Sparrow。

**相关性简评：** 循环深度即重复更新同一 latent 状态，其不动点收敛与截断窗口分析可供核查 LVR 中循环式 latent 推理的训练稳定性、深度/长度泛化及状态更新是否真正收敛，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态证据。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How to build and train your recurrent-depth model: A fixed-point perspective

**abstract/A1：** Recurrent-depth models are trained with truncated backpropagation, yet it remains unclear why this works. We show that input injection, commonly used in recurrent-depth models, is exactly Halpern iteration, and that a slowly vanishing stepsize provably converges with a backpropagation window polylogarithmic in the depth. The guarantees require a Lipschitz operator, which for SwiGLU leads to a weight constraint in both row and spectral norm, while only a row norm constraint for gates. Based on these constraints, we develop an optimizer tailored to each parameter group, Sparrow, which provides a drop-in replacement of Muon/MuonH with no overhead, that speeds up training even beyond recurrent models.

</details>

### 47. [Self-Improving Long-Horizon Reasoning by Learning Summaries from Local Continuations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31621v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31621

**作者：** Haoqun Cao、Tengyang Xie

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31621v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31621v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对长程推理中上下文增长导致性能退化的问题，提出截断推理轨迹、将其压缩为摘要状态并从摘要继续推理；同时训练独立摘要器，以冻结推理模型在采样续写上的 token 级预测构造 Delta-KL 奖励，无需答案或外部教师。

**相关性简评：** 其「压缩历史为状态并从状态续推」以及仅衡量状态自身贡献的 Delta-KL 监督，与 LVR 关注的 latent 状态信息保留、信息坍缩和贡献分配可能直接相关，可供核查；但论文面向纯文本推理，迁移到多模态状态仍需验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Self-Improving Long-Horizon Reasoning by Learning Summaries from Local Continuations

**abstract/A1：** Reasoning models degrade as their context grows, so longer reasoning traces do not by themselves give longer effective horizons. One way to extend the horizon is to compress the reasoning history into a compact state from time to time and continue from the state. Existing methods train the state with the final-answer reward or distill it from a stronger model. Neither signal is tailored to measure the contribution of the state alone. We observe that a reasoning model that degrades over long trajectories still behaves reliably in short contexts. We aim to preserve this short-context behavior when compressing the reasoning history. Motivated by this, we train a separate summarizer with Delta-KL, a reward computed from the frozen reasoning model's token-level predictions on sampled continuations, and run inference by truncating the trace, summarizing it, and continuing from the summary (TruSuCo). Training uses a few thousand questions with 4k-token reasoning prefixes and does not need answers or external teachers. Under a fixed 32k-token budget, the trained summarizer improves on vanilla reasoning and on an untrained summarizer in all nine settings across mathematical benchmarks and Reasoning Gym puzzles, by up to 7.7 points and 12 points, respectively. The improvement over vanilla reasoning grows with the budget. At 128k tokens, our method outperforms it by 10 points on AIME 2024--2026. Analyses show that truncation prevents the collapse of vanilla reasoning and that the trained summaries retain more of the reasoning history.

</details>

### 48. [Compressible Representations: Functional Spines in Deep Neural Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31817v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31817

**作者：** Niranjan Rajesh、Meenakshi Khosla

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31817v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31817v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出用隐表示上的 Fisher 类矩阵衡量各方向对下游计算的影响，逐层识别任务敏感子空间并投影压缩；在预训练视觉网络上显示少量维度即可保留大部分性能，且该子空间支撑对抗鲁棒、shape/texture 子空间分离、持续学习与跨模型对齐分析。

**相关性简评：** 其对表示方向的“功能敏感性”排序与定向消融，可能为 LVR 中判断 latent 内容是否真正被答案使用、以及只在高功能方向比较 latent 相似度（涉及深度与位置效应）提供可核查工具，但在多模态推理状态上的适用性尚待验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Compressible Representations: Functional Spines in Deep Neural Networks

**abstract/A1：** Deep networks embed inputs in high-dimensional representations, but how much of this capacity actually drives behavior? We introduce a framework for identifying, at each layer, the subspace of the representation that is functionally sensitive to the task. Using a matrix analogous to the Fisher information but defined over the hidden representation, we rank directions by their influence on downstream computation and project onto the most task-sensitive subspace. Across pretrained vision networks, representations are remarkably compressible: a small fraction of the task-sensitive subspace preserves most performance, often requiring far fewer dimensions than geometric alternatives. We find that this compressed representation is also more robust to adversarial attacks generated on the full network. We additionally show that this decomposition recovers functionally distinct subspaces within the same representation: on cue-conflict stimuli, shape-sensitive and texture-sensitive directions are largely non-overlapping, and ablating one selectively impairs the corresponding task while leaving the other intact. Task-sensitive subspaces also provide a principled foundation for continual learning: constraining gradient updates to lie orthogonal to the task-sensitive subspaces of prior tasks outperforms standard variance-based gradient projection methods. Finally, restricting representational comparisons to task-sensitive subspaces reveals that inter-model alignment is higher in task-sensitive directions than in task-insensitive directions at later layers, and that conditioning on different tasks over the same stimuli uncovers asymmetries that full-space similarity measures cannot detect. Together, these results establish that deep networks compute through a low-dimensional functional spine embedded within a much larger representational space.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 49. [Beyond the Last Loop: Reinforcement Learning with a Teacher Extrapolated from the Model Itself](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31939v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31939

**作者：** Linghua Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31939v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31939v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对 looped language model 的 RL 后训练，提出 ELGO：把从第一轮到最后一轮外推得到的 next-token 分布当作教师，在 GRPO 上加入逐 token 稠密蒸馏项，并用冻结锚点副本按 KL 阈值刷新教师，在五个数学基准上超过 GRPO。

**相关性简评：** 原文关于「结果奖励摊到各 loop 会让中间轮去拟合末轮采样 token」的诊断，以及外推教师提供的逐 token 监督，可能为多模态循环模型的中间推理状态监督与 loop 间贡献分配提供线索，尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond the Last Loop: Reinforcement Learning with a Teacher Extrapolated from the Model Itself

**abstract/A1：** Looped language models apply one shared transformer stack several times per token, and every loop can be read out through the shared language-model head. Post-training them with verifiable rewards is hard: the outcome reward carries one bit per response, spreading it over loops trains intermediate loops on tokens sampled from the last loop, and distillation needs either a teacher that ignores the reward or an external, larger model. We observe that a looped model already contains a teacher stronger than its last loop: the next-token distribution extrapolated from the first loop through the last. ELGO (Extrapolated-Loop Group-relative Optimization) adds to GRPO a dense per-token distillation term towards this distribution. The teacher is computed from an anchor copy of the model, which stays frozen and is replaced by the current model once the student's KL to the teacher falls below a threshold, so the teacher improves with the student without chasing its own extrapolation. The outcome reward splits probability between correct and incorrect responses, and the teacher decides which tokens are preferred inside a response. Between refreshes the objective is KL-regularised RL anchored at the teacher, whose optimum tilts the teacher by the reward. On Ouro-1.4B-Thinking, ELGO raises the average avg@8 over five math benchmarks from 62.32 with GRPO to 64.20 and is the best compared method on every benchmark, while spreading the reward over loops falls below the base model.

</details>

### 50. [On the Information Loss of Multi-Token Prediction: Origin and Solution](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31966v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31966

**作者：** Tangyu Jiang、Zhanke Zhou、Haodi Wang、Yiu-ming Cheung、Xiaohua Jia、Bo Han

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31966v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31966v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文分析多 token 预测（MTP）在自生成前缀下跨块误差累积与累积信息损失，并提出 Dual-MTP，以完整前缀和随机掩码上下文双重监督共享预测头，兼顾准确率与多 token 解码吞吐。

**相关性简评：** 其块式并行生成、误差累积刻画和掩码上下文监督，可供核查如何改善 LVR 中并行或多步 latent 状态生成对不完美前缀的鲁棒性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** On the Information Loss of Multi-Token Prediction: Origin and Solution

**abstract/A1：** Multi-token prediction (MTP) accelerates autoregressive decoding through block-wise prediction, but remains vulnerable to error accumulation across sequentially generated blocks. To investigate this limitation, we analyze the distinction between block-wise and sequence-level cumulative information loss (CIL). Specifically, when the model generates using its own previous outputs without access to reference answers, the input-conditional gap equals the cross-block dependence of the reference targets. To improve prediction when these generated prefixes are imperfect, we propose Dual-MTP, which supervises shared prediction heads under full and randomly masked contexts. Together, complete-prefix supervision and context perturbations provide complementary training signals while retaining the MTP architecture. To characterize this training objective, we use the normalized dual loss to bound the divergence between the model's predictive distributions under full and masked contexts. Experiments across five backbones and six tasks spanning mathematical reasoning and GLUE understanding show that Dual-MTP achieves the highest average task score on four of five backbones, with gains of up to 2.46 points over MTP. On mathematical reasoning tasks, Dual-MTP also achieves 1.4 to 1.9 times the decoding throughput of the NTP reference. Together, these results show that dual-context supervision can improve prediction accuracy while retaining efficient multi-token decoding.

**comment/C1：** 29 pages, 7 figures

</details>

### 51. [Integral DeltaNet: Improved Linear Attention with Adaptive Memory Integration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32063v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32063

**作者：** Junsoo Oh、Jihun Yun、Junhyuck Kim、Hanbaek Lyu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32063v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32063v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Integral DeltaNet：在 DeltaNet 快速更新的 delta 状态之外，额外维护一个记录该状态加权历史的积分状态，读出时自适应融合两种时间尺度，并给出 chunkwise 并行训练实现；以 340M 和 1.3B 模型在语言建模、检索、长上下文理解与长度外推上对比循环基线。

**相关性简评：** 双时间尺度循环状态与自适应读出可为 LVR 中 latent 工作区的信息保留、记忆碰撞缓解与长度泛化提供可核查线索，但该工作属纯文本线性注意力，能否迁移到多模态推理状态仍需判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Integral DeltaNet: Improved Linear Attention with Adaptive Memory Integration

**abstract/A1：** Linear attention replaces softmax attention with a linear formulation, enabling linear-time computation with a fixed-size recurrent state instead of a growing key-value cache. These computational and memory advantages have attracted growing interest in linear attention for long-context language modeling. However, compressing past information into a fixed-size state causes memory collisions that hinder long-context understanding. Although DeltaNet mitigates memory collisions through delta-rule updates and Gated DeltaNet extends this approach with gating, these mechanisms may also discard information relevant to future predictions. To address this limitation, we introduce Integral DeltaNet, which maintains two complementary recurrent states: a fast-updating delta state that captures current key-value associations and an integral state that preserves a weighted history of the delta state. At readout, the model adaptively combines these states to access information across different timescales. We further derive a chunkwise parallel formulation that enables hardware-efficient training. We evaluate Integral DeltaNet using 340M and 1.3B parameter models trained from scratch on 15B and 100B FineWeb-Edu tokens, respectively. Comparisons with strong recurrent baselines show improved overall performance in language modeling, commonsense reasoning, real-world and synthetic retrieval, long-context understanding, and length extrapolation. We also compare training throughput and activation memory, as well as decoding latency and memory.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages

</details>

### 52. [Rethinking Reasoning Effort Training in Large Language Models: On-Policy Distillation or Reinforcement Learning?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32131v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32131

**作者：** Tianliang Lv、Hao Li、Xinchao Xu、Zhengkun Zhang、Ju Huo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该技术报告系统比较强化学习与多教师 on-policy distillation 在推理努力（thinking 长度）控制上的差异：长度惩罚 RL 能压缩单一策略但在联合训练时使档位塌缩，OPD 则在每个访问状态提供档位特定目标从而分离低/中/高档，并发现单一 token 级 KL 锚点与自然语言努力指令即可在单阶段 RL 中复现该分离，但稠密目标带来的分离无法迁移到未见 agentic 任务。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯文本研究，其「序列级奖励难以区分共享行为与档位行为、逐状态稠密目标才能塑造包括停止决策在内的行为」这一训练信号分析，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态监督与 THINK/STOP 预算控制的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rethinking Reasoning Effort Training in Large Language Models: On-Policy Distillation or Reinforcement Learning?

**abstract/A1：** Large language models have shown strong capabilities on complex tasks, yet how to control their reasoning effort remains a significant challenge for practical deployment. This paper provides a systematic investigation of reasoning-effort training, contrasting reinforcement learning (RL) with on-policy distillation (OPD). We find that compressing reasoning and separating effort tiers are governed by different signals. Length-penalized RL reliably compresses a single policy, reducing thinking on AIME25 by 70\\% without accuracy loss, but collapses the tiers when they are trained jointly. Multi-teacher OPD separates them: across 33 benchmarks, low and medium use 58\\% and 43\\% fewer thinking tokens than high, while high improves on the reference policy by 3.1 points. We trace this difference to the training signal. A sequence-level reward cannot tell tier-specific behavior from shared behavior, whereas OPD supplies a tier-specific target at every visited state, including the decision to stop. Building on this analysis, we show that a single token-level KL anchor on the high tier is sufficient to learn separated tiers within one RL stage, and that natural-language effort instructions make this separation emerge from the start of training, yielding a policy competitive with multi-teacher OPD at matched thinking length. Finally, the separation built by dense targets holds only on the states seen in training: it does not carry over to unseen agentic tasks, where effort acts mainly through the number of interaction turns, whereas the compression induced by sequence-level rewards does.

**comment/C1：** Technical Report

</details>

### 53. [Calibrated Reading of Latent Reasoning and Communication](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32143v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32143

**作者：** Zixi Wang、Gaohao Zhou、Yubo Huang、Xin Lai、Yushe Cao、Jingzehua Xu、Shuai Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32143v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32143v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Calibrated Latent Reader（CLR），用紧凑 transformer 通过状态与候选答案的任务条件交互来预测推理结果与消息内容，并以 source adapter 支持跨模型迁移、用 conformal calibration 给出覆盖率与误报保证；在 CODI 模型和合成 Qwen3-4B 通信上验证其优于 MLP/attention probe，且比大模型 verbalizer 省算力。

**相关性简评：** 其「从 latent 状态读出答案/消息内容并带误报控制」的探针思路，可供核查 latent 表示是否真正承载任务信息与通信保真度，含视觉或多模态场景的可迁移性尚待确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Calibrated Reading of Latent Reasoning and Communication

**abstract/A1：** Latent reasoning and key-value communication store intermediate information in continuous representations, limiting direct inspection of model behavior. Existing activation readers trade the low cost of task-specific probes against the flexibility of language-model decoders. We propose the Calibrated Latent Reader, CLR, a compact transformer that predicts reasoning outcomes and message content through task-conditioned interactions between states and candidate answers. Source adapters support transfer across models, while conformal calibration provides coverage and false-alarm guarantees under exchangeability. On two CODI models, CLR improves accuracy over MLP and attention probes by 4-18 percentage points for final-answer prediction and reference-value membership. On CODI-GPT-2, it achieves accuracy comparable to a 1.7B LatentQA-based verbalizer using 437-648 times fewer inference FLOPs. On synthetic Qwen3-4B communications, comparing decoded facts with public commitments detects 93.1% of message substitutions at a nominal 5% false-positive rate.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages, including appendices

</details>

### 54. [LoopFit: Retrofitting Pretrained Diffusion Transformers with Recurrent Refinement](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32175v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32175

**作者：** Xiaocheng Lu、Haoxi Li、Dazhao Du、Tao Han、Jian Liu、Hao Chen、Bohai Gu、Siyu Yan、Jingcai Guo、Jie Zhang、Song Guo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32175v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32175v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LoopFit，在预训练扩散 Transformer 上循环复用 block，用 Residual Attention Modulation 依据每个 patch 单轮特征变化调制下一轮注意力输入，并以 Residual Relay Loss 对跨轮持续出错的 patch 加权，配合噪声相关深度调度（高噪声 4 轮、低噪声 1 轮），在视觉拼图任务上以同等成本优于增加采样步数。

**相关性简评：** 逐 patch 的循环细化反馈、持续性误差加权与可变深度调度，可供核查如何迁移到 LVR 的循环 latent 状态更新、空间细节保留与按需分配计算/停止决策，但该文处于扩散生成语境，未涉及多模态推理机制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LoopFit: Retrofitting Pretrained Diffusion Transformers with Recurrent Refinement

**abstract/A1：** Scaling inference computation offers a way to improve diffusion transformers (DiTs), but taking more sampling steps leaves the depth of each denoising prediction unchanged. Recurrently reusing Transformer blocks increases computation within each step, allowing further refinement of hidden representations. Retrofitting pretrained models enables this capability without repeating pretraining, but requires blocks learned for fixed-depth computation to refine states produced by their own repeated application. The challenge is to use each additional pass to correct local errors without disrupting the structure established by earlier passes. We introduce LoopFit, which uses feedback from earlier passes to guide refinement at each image patch. Residual Attention Modulation (RAM) uses each patch's feature change in one pass to scale and shift its input to attention in the next. During training, Residual Relay Loss (RRL) gives greater weight to patches whose prediction errors persist across passes. A noise-dependent depth schedule speeds up sampling by using four passes at high noise and one at lower noise levels. At comparable cost, backbones trained with four passes solve more problems using recurrent depth than extra sampling steps. Across 12 visual puzzle settings, LoopFit solves 89.8% of boards, compared with 87.8% for the strongest baseline evaluated on all 12. Most of the gain comes from tracing long paths on mazes and frozen lakes.

</details>

### 55. [When Exact Token Importance Is Not Enough: Limits of Top-K Selection in LLM Attention](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32324v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32324

**作者：** Irmaan Mirzanejad

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32324v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32324v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究长上下文注意力中「逐位置打分取 Top-K」的局限：即使每个位置的删除效应被精确度量，独立排序也会因注意力重归一化而错失联合最优支持集，并提出同预算的 SwapCert 审计检验可改进位置。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本注意力稀疏化工作，但其「单点重要性不等于联合支持质量」的论证与审计方法，可能可为 LVR 中视觉证据/隐状态筛选及 KV 缓存保留的评价提供核查线索，需确认视觉场景下的可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Exact Token Importance Is Not Enough: Limits of Top-K Selection in LLM Attention

**abstract/A1：** Long-context language models often retain only a limited set of past token positions for an attention query. A common strategy scores positions individually and keeps the highest-ranked K. Yet attention weights are renormalized over the chosen set: two individually important positions need not form the best pair. We ask whether independent ranking suffices even when each importance score measures the exact downstream change in next-token predictions caused by deleting that position alone. It does not. A four-position construction makes the ranked pair incur 133.2 times the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence of the optimal pair, and a parametric family proves that this multiplicative gap is unbounded. An exact exchange identity and preference reversals for every K &gt;= 2 explain the interaction. In exhaustive frozen-model audits of SmolLM2, Gemma, and Qwen, exact-singleton Top-4 leaves at least 10% relative improvement within a fully enumerated 24-position candidate pool in 55/60, 49/60, and 60/60 cases, respectively. SwapCert, a same-budget one-swap audit, detects 157/164 such cases and returns directly checkable improving supports. A KL-margin certificate relates support fidelity to next-token stability; larger-budget, multi-layer cached-decoding experiments measure predictive fidelity at K = 128 and 256. These results establish joint support quality as an essential object of analysis for sparse attention and motivate downstream-aware support selection under inference constraints.

</details>

### 56. [Beyond Hard Tokens: Predictive Memory for Multimodal Protein Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32347v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32347

**作者：** Xiaoliang Shi、Zichen Wang、Zhijian Wei、Zhanpeng Shi、Zhenghong Zhou、Yunpeng Wang、Shuangjia Zheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、q-bio.BM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32347v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32347v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对多模态蛋白质语言模型的迭代掩码解码，提出无需训练的 Predictive Memory：将每步未提交位置的原始 logits 压缩为概率加权 Top-k 期望嵌入，并插值回下一步的掩码输入，作为跨步软锚点，以缓解无外部锚的序列-结构共生成中收敛慢与重复坍缩。

**相关性简评：** 其「跨步携带软信念而非仅硬 token」的自条件递归，可为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的更新与跨步保持提供方法线索，可供核查该记忆是否被后续步骤实际使用、以及能否迁移到视觉-语言推理的中间状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Hard Tokens: Predictive Memory for Multimodal Protein Generation

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal protein language models unify sequence and discrete structural tokens via iterative masked decoding, offering a promising paradigm for joint protein design. However, standard decoders rely on a memoryless mask reset at each iteration: only a sparse subset of newly committed hard tokens is carried forward, while all remaining unresolved sites are reset to an identical \[MASK\] embedding. In open-ended co-generation where neither modality provides a fixed external anchor, this stateless transition limits single-step refinement depth and deprives both tracks of stable cross-step soft anchors, leading to slow convergence or degenerative repetitive collapse. Observing that uncommitted predictions evolve with pronounced temporal coherence rather than erratic noise, we introduce Predictive Memory (PredMem), a training-free self-conditioning recurrence that carries these soft beliefs across steps. At each step, PredMem summarizes raw logits into a probability-weighted Top-$k$ expectation embedding at every residue and affinely interpolates it into eligible masked inputs on the next step at zero extra denoiser cost. Across DPLM-2, DPLM-2.1, and ESM3, PredMem raises unconditional sequence-structure co-generation success by 3.6, 17.7, and 48.7 percentage points, respectively, while improving the quality-diversity trade-off and suppressing repetitive mode collapse. Controlled diagnostics show that these gains stem primarily from early trajectory stabilization in unanchored cross-modal co-evolution rather than extra compute or simple entropy reduction, establishing PredMem as an efficient inference mechanism for multimodal discrete generation.

</details>

### 57. [The Teacher Is Already Inside: Self-Distilling Looped Language Models Beyond Their Last Loop](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32452v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32452

**作者：** Linghua Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32452v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32452v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对循环语言模型的后训练困难，提出 ELPSD：用同一模型的冻结副本把首轮到末轮的下一个 token 分布外推成教师信号，再以精确 reverse KL 在自身 rollout 上蒸馏末轮，无需奖励或外部教师。

**相关性简评：** 该文把「多轮循环中的隐状态更新」与外推式自蒸馏监督直接关联，并分析教师须冻结、目标向基模型首尾轮拉扯的权重，可供核查 LVR 中循环推理状态、轨迹监督与教师稳定性问题；但实验仅在纯文本数学任务上，视觉与 latent 证据处理未涉及。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Teacher Is Already Inside: Self-Distilling Looped Language Models Beyond Their Last Loop

**abstract/A1：** Looped language models apply one shared transformer stack several times per token, and every loop is readable through the shared language-model head. Post-training them is hard. Reward-only reinforcement learning needs a verifier and learns from one sparse signal per response; spreading the reward over loops collapses the entropy of every loop; and cross-loop self-distillation, as in LoopOPD, can only teach intermediate loops, because the last loop cannot learn from its own frozen copy: the loss is zero at initialisation. We observe that a looped model already contains a policy that decodes better than its last loop: the next-token distribution extrapolated from the first loop through the last. ELPSD (Extrapolated-Loop Policy Self-Distillation) turns this distribution into a self-distillation target: a frozen copy of the model computes it, and the model's own last loop is distilled towards it on its own rollouts, using the exact reverse KL at every visited prefix. Teacher and student are the same model, so ELPSD needs no reward, no external teacher and no privileged context, and it leaves rollouts and decoding unchanged. We show that the objective pulls the last loop towards the base model's last loop with weight 1+w and away from the base model's first loop with weight w, and that the teacher must stay frozen, since an idealised teacher recomputed from the current model extrapolates without bound. We evaluate ELPSD on Ouro-1.4B-Thinking across five math benchmarks against the base model, GRPO, RLTT and OPSD. Without any reward, ELPSD raises the average avg@8 from 61.15 to 63.69 and is the best method on all five benchmarks, ahead of GRPO (62.32), which uses a verifier, and the self-distillation method OPSD (61.77), which needs reference solutions.

</details>

### 58. [Sample-Efficient In-Context Adaptation via Sleep](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32802v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32802

**作者：** Sangyun Lee、Zhang Enyan、Michael Xu、Hao Tang、Zinan Lin、Weijia Xu、Chris Quirk、Jianfeng Gao、Giulia Fanti、Xiaodong Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32802v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32802v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文在最多 1.2B 参数、100B token 预训练的 transformer 语言模型中加入「sleep」机制，即对一段上下文做 N 次循环前向以精炼表示，并考察其对少样本上下文适应和分布外损失的影响。

**相关性简评：** 不涉及视觉，但其固定次数循环前向更新上下文表示的做法，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态迭代、动态计算及「适应收益—解码延迟」权衡提供方法线索，N 是否可自适应可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sample-Efficient In-Context Adaptation via Sleep

**abstract/A1：** The ability to learn and generalize from limited experience, or sample efficiency, is a cornerstone of intelligence. How can we build language models that turn a few user interactions, a few snippets of unfamiliar code, or a handful of experimental results provided in context into knowledge that generalizes? Prior work has found that sleep, a process where the model performs $N$ recurrent forward passes to refine its representations of a chunk of context, can improve long-context reasoning (specifically, within SSM-attention hybrid models). We study whether this method also improves in-context adaptation on general, non-synthetic tasks for transformer language models. To this end, we pre-train language models up to 1.2B-parameters on up to 100B tokens with sleep mechanisms. Notably, longer sleep (i.e., using a larger number of recurrent forward passes $N$) enables the model to learn faster in-context on multiple few-shot algorithmic, question-answering tasks, while also achieving lower next-token prediction loss on out-of-distribution evaluations. On held-out code, models with $N=2$ and $N=4$ match the no-sleep baseline's loss using $2.10\\times$ and $2.39\\times$ fewer tokens in-context, respectively. More broadly, we view our work as a step toward building models that have better tradeoffs between in-context adaptation and decoding latency.

</details>

### 59. [Reading Decisions Before Spans: Efficient Generative Verification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32931v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32931

**作者：** Yanbin Gong、Lei Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32931v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32931v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在冻结的 2B span verifier 上研究生成式验证的决策何时形成：判断「有无错误」的分支 token 早于全部定位输出，因此提出 Prefill1 只生成该分支 token，在 2,015 条 code-agent 响应上将常驻服务成本降低 84.84%，F1 基本不变。

**相关性简评：** 「决策先于证据陈述被读出」的设定，可为 LVR 中停止决策、生成多少输出才够判断及验证器成本分摊提供可核查线索；但对象是纯文本代码校验，其对视觉证据的筛选是否可迁移仍待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reading Decisions Before Spans: Efficient Generative Verification

**abstract/A1：** A developer checking an assistant's report may need only an alarm that a claim is unsupported. A generative verifier, however, can continue decoding to quote and classify the errors. We study how much of that output is needed to recover its decision. In a frozen 2B span verifier, the choice between an empty error list and its first object precedes all localization. Native8 stops generation at this branch. The preceding seven syntax tokens are fixed, so Prefill1 supplies them as input and generates only the unrestricted branch token, using the same native instruction. On 2,015 code-agent TEST responses, Prefill1 reduces eager resident service by 84.84% relative to full generation, with released-reference F1 of 83.43 versus 83.41. It saves 31.98% over Native8 even though their logical token totals are identical. Under default compiled execution, the extra saving is 6.74-26.73% on the complete workload, with small decision changes. Controlled evidence interventions and first-location decoding establish what these shorter readouts retain and what requires further generation.

**comment/C1：** 36 pages, 4 figures. Includes appendices

</details>

### 60. [OmniHarness-RSI: Modality-Aware Harness Evolution for Omnimodal Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32951v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32951

**作者：** Shilin Ma、Xingming Shui、Jinglin Chen、Zetong Zhao、Jingqi Tian、Deyi Zhu、Yansong Tang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32951v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32951v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 OmniHarness-RSI，一个面向全模态理解的无参数更新 agent harness 演化框架：将演化空间分解为模态路由协作、模态感知证据定位与模态特定感知三维度，构建含感知专家与音视频检索工具的 agent，并通过模态-能力归因、代码交互修改与验证引导选择来迭代改进 harness。

**相关性简评：** 其「模态感知证据定位」与按能力归因诊断缺陷的思路，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与 LOOK 决策提供可核查借鉴；报告称演化后减少 planner 调用与查看帧数，或与 STOP 及动态计算成本相关，但未涉及内部 latent 状态表示。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OmniHarness-RSI: Modality-Aware Harness Evolution for Omnimodal Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Recent advances in harness-based recursive self-improvement (RSI) have improved video understanding by evolving executable agent workflows without updating foundation model parameters. However, extending this paradigm to omnimodal understanding remains challenging, as the heterogeneous and interdependent nature of multimodal perception and reasoning creates a complex evolution space, making targeted harness optimization difficult. To address these challenges, we propose OmniHarness-RSI, a modality-aware framework for evolving agent harnesses. Specifically, we factorize the evolution space into three capability dimensions: modality routing and collaboration, modality-aware evidence localization, and modality-specific perception. Based on this factorization, we construct a Factorized-Harness Agent integrating specialized perception experts and audio-video retrieval tools. We further introduce modality-guided harness evolution, which identifies deficiencies through structured modality-capability attribution and refines corresponding harness strategies through interactive code revisions and execution feedback. Validation-guided selection and held-out evaluation assess generalization within and across datasets. Experiments on WorldSense, Daily-Omni, and OmniVideoBench demonstrate test accuracy improvements of 8.86, 8.13, and 6.23 percentage points, respectively, consistently outperforming modality-agnostic RSI. The evolved harnesses also demonstrate cross-dataset transfer without adaptation, while reducing planner calls and viewed frames.

</details>

### 61. [Eliciting the Recall Capacity of Linear Attention](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32969v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32969

**作者：** Johan Lindqvist、Antonio Orvieto

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32969v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32969v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文通过自然语言评测、合成回忆任务和训练干预，研究线性注意力相对 softmax 的联想回忆缺陷，考察状态大小与可回忆条目数的关系，并用上下文句子重复和上下文敏感的损失重加权增强回忆监督。

**相关性简评：** 线性注意力的压缩状态容量与「有容量但未被训练利用」的发现，可供核查 LVR 中视觉细节保留、latent 内容是否被答案使用及监督激励设计；其纯文本设定向多模态迁移仍需验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Eliciting the Recall Capacity of Linear Attention

**abstract/A1：** Linear attention models exhibit a disproportionate deficit relative to softmax attention in associative recall (AR) in language modeling. We investigate this gap through natural language evaluations, synthetic recall tasks, and targeted training interventions. Using a synthetic setting, we quantify the role of state-size in how many items can be recalled from memory and find a similar empirical scaling across the tested linear-attention architectures. Testing this relationship reveals that even a single layer at scale can learn to retrieve thousands of associations across long distances. Yet, standard language model training does not reliably teach a linear model to copy from context, whereas a comparable softmax model learns to do so. Considering this, we strengthen recall supervision during training through in-context sentence repetition and context-sensitive loss reweighting. Both methods improve recall-intensive benchmark performance and narrow the long-distance AR gap to the softmax baseline without changing the architecture, token budget, or number of optimization steps, at a slight cost to general language modeling. These targeted changes to training can thus elicit substantial but underutilized retrieval capacity in linear-attention models. These findings suggest that, although linear-attention architectures have substantial capacity for recall, their inductive biases and the demands of language model training make it difficult to develop this capability without dedicated incentives.

**comment/C1：** 32 pages, 10 figures

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其「复制坐标」基线与提示内线索探针，可能可供核查以VLM生成轨迹作监督时答案是否绕过视觉证据；用标签误差预测学生收益的排序做法，也可供检验 latent 推理监督中教师筛选与贡献分配。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Training Lightweight Gaze Models without Target Gaze Annotation: What Makes a Good Teacher?

**abstract/A1：** Model-generated labels offer a scalable route to training lightweight vision models, but what makes a model a good teacher, and can we tell before training a student? We study this in gaze target estimation, where interactive robots need models that are both accurate and efficient. In a controlled comparison of eleven supervision conditions, we vary only the source of gaze-point labels, keeping the student, training protocol and 361k training samples fixed, across three video datasets, two student sizes and three seeds; every student is evaluated against human annotation. Three findings emerge. First, imperfect model-generated labels can replace human annotation: Gaze-LLE, never trained on the target datasets' gaze annotation, trains students that match annotation-trained ones on ViT-Tiny and are significantly more accurate on ViT-Small (average distance error 0.187 vs 0.196), and the ViT-Tiny student runs 32$\\times$ faster than its teacher on a laptop CPU. Second, apparent competence can conceal unreliable supervision: given another person's face centre in the prompt, InternVL3 and Qwen3-VL return it on 93.4% and 81.1% of test samples, and a copy-the-coordinate baseline matches InternVL3's labels and students. Without that coordinate, both models fall far behind the specialist. Third, good teachers can be identified before training: validation label error ranks student test error (Spearman's $ρ= 0.91$), and ten annotated clips single out the two specialist teachers in 95% of draws. These findings give practical principles for assessing supervision, exposing shortcuts and selecting teachers for lightweight models.

**comment/C1：** 17 pages, including supplementary material

</details>

### 63. [A Bias in Disguise: Tiny Gradient Edits Stop a Small Language Model's Thinking Loops and Complement a Frontier Model's Weight Edit](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33133v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.33133

**作者：** Hussamuddin Syed

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33133v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.33133v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文为 Qwen3.5-0.8B 的 thinking 模式难以收束问题补上梯度基线：只微调梯度最大的 140–139,750 个权重，并检验其与 Astra 无梯度权重编辑的组合效果。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯文本模型，但其对 thinking 循环、token 预算下的停止决策及“残差流常量向量”式权重编辑的分析，可能为 VLM 推理中的 STOP 机制与状态控制提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Bias in Disguise: Tiny Gradient Edits Stop a Small Language Model's Thinking Loops and Complement a Frontier Model's Weight Edit

**abstract/A1：** Qwen3.5-0.8B rarely finishes reasoning in thinking mode: at a 4,096-token budget only 1 or 2 of 500 MATH-500 answers close their think block (two seeds), and accuracy is 15.4%. A recent demonstration had GPT-6 Astra edit 131,072 of the model's weights without gradients and reported MATH-500 rising from 7.9% to 48.1% at a 32,768-token budget. We provide the missing gradient baseline, then combine the two edits. Fine-tuning only the 140 to 139,750 weights with the largest gradient, on the model's own correct answers to MATH training problems, raises thinking-mode MATH-500 at 4k tokens to 39.0-45.5% after 2-9 minutes of training on one GPU; 50 training examples suffice, and 1,398 random positions give only 16.3%. The gradient concentrates the edit on the most nearly constant channel of each of the first three layers. Because the model has no bias terms, an edit confined to those channels acts as a constant vector added to the residual stream: adding three fixed vectors to the unedited model matches the accuracy of such an edit. Under the Astra protocol (32k tokens, presence penalty 1.5), the Astra edit scores 52.1% (finished and correct) in our reproduction and our full-strength edits reach 45.6-45.7%, but ours win at every budget up to 16k tokens (39.5% against 6.7% at 4k). The two edits are complementary. The Astra edit plus our 139,750-weight edit at half strength scores 62.2% at 32k, 10 points above the Astra edit alone (p = 3e-9), with half as many tokens; our half-strength edit alone scores 46.7%.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31522

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 GUI agent 在思考期间界面变化导致的失败，提出环境变化、观察可用、决策提交与动作到达四个事件的 EODA 模型，并构建 ChronotopeGym（Paused/Replay/Live）诊断，同时给出保留紧凑交互历史、对挂起动作选择保留／更新／重决的 Chronotope 控制器。

**相关性简评：** 其「动作在不同交互阶段失效」的失败分析与「何时保留、修订或替换待执行动作」的策略，与 LVR 中视觉证据时效、LOOK/STOP 调度和决策提交成本直接相关，可供核查四时钟分解能否迁移到 latent 推理的取证据与停止判断；论文本身不涉及内部 latent 表征。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** One Step, Four Clocks: How GUI Agents Fall Out of Step

**abstract/A1：** GUI agents can choose correct actions yet fail as interfaces change during deliberation. Latency alone cannot explain these failures because actions may become invalid at different interaction stages. We model four events: environment change, observation availability, decision commitment, and action receipt (EODA). We introduce ChronotopeGym to study these failures under Paused, Replay, and Live execution. Across five tasks, agents can fail in Live despite succeeding when responses remain valid, even when actions meet deadlines. On Moving Balloon, updating a pending click raises success from 0% to 100% without changing response time. Our accelerator-resident GUI controller, Chronotope, maintains compact interaction history and selectively keeps, updates, or redecides pending actions. Compared with Agent S3, Chronotope reduces median end-to-end latency by 85.5% for a 27B model, expanding its performance envelope to 100% Live success at an 8-second deadline versus 0%. Chronotope enables real-time GUI control through compact interaction history, knowing when to preserve, revise, or replace actions, and an overall efficient architectural design that obviates verbose reflection, reasoning, and grounding calls.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31714

**作者：** Parsa Madinei、Ziqi Wen、Miguel Eckstein

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文定义并量化了 VLM 的「无据人物归因偏差」：在 25 个 SOTA 模型上，无人场景的生成描述提及人物的频率约为人类书写描述的 4 倍，且人与模型都更偏好避免此类归因的描述；作者据此构建偏好数据集 NOBODY 与评测基准 NOBODY-Bench，并用 DPO 对齐后使模型的人物归因与人类一致度接近或超过人际一致度。

**相关性简评：** 该工作直接诊断了生成内容超出可见视觉证据的失败模式，与「视觉细节是否被保留和正确使用」「视觉证据筛选」这一关切相关，可供核查生成侧的幻觉度量与偏好监督能否用于判断 latent 推理是否真正依据图像；但材料未涉及 latent 状态、推理轨迹或动态计算。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** NOBODY Was There: Bridging the Human-VLM Gap in Unwarranted Person Attribution Bias

**abstract/A1：** Describing an image requires not only recognizing what is visible but deciding what should be inferred. We investigate a systematic gap between humans and VLMs in their tendency to attribute visible actions or events to people who are not present in an image. We term this behavior unwarranted person attribution bias and find that, across 25 SOTA VLMs, captions of person-absent scenes mention a person four times as often as human-written captions of the same images. Through a preference study, we further show that both humans and VLMs prefer captions that avoid such attributions. Motivated by this, we introduce NOBODY, a preference dataset designed to bridge the gap between humans and VLMs in unwarranted person attribution. Through direct preference optimization (DPO), we align open VLMs on NOBODY and show that their agreement with human captions on person attribution reaches or exceeds inter-human agreement, whereas nine existing public preference datasets leave this behavior largely unchanged. Furthermore, we show that human judges preferred the aligned VLM captions significantly more than those of the baseline model. Alongside NOBODY, we release NOBODY-Bench, which evaluates VLMs for unwarranted person attribution bias and their alignment against human captions and preference. Project page: https://pmadinei.github.io/NOBODY/

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32172

**作者：** Ming Ma、Wenhao Hu、Qichao Wang、Yuhao Wang、Junpeng Zhao、Qiyi Wang、Fangrui Zhang、Zhiqian Lai、Shanxin Guan、Haoyi Pei、Hongan Chen、Rui Gong

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文发布 CameraLogBench，一个取材于影视制作实务的多模态基准，测试模型能否在缺少元数据时仅凭画面判断视频的 Log 曲线，并通过去除正确选项、同场景合成帧、供应商规格摘要和无训练公式基线等控制，区分语义先验与真实光度测量。

**相关性简评：** 结果显示模型准确率仅略高于猜最常见曲线、移除正确选项后几乎不弃答，且规格提示对自然图像帮助有限，这种「是否真的测量像素而非走先验」的诊断协议（含强制弃答探针）可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据是否进入内部状态、以及视觉旁路与先验坍缩的评估。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MediaStormBench-CameraLog: Can Multimodal Models Identify a Camera's Log Curve?

**abstract/A1：** MediaStormBench is a multimodal benchmark for real-world film and television production, with each subset drawn from MediaStorm's day-to-day work. We release its first subset, MediaStormBench-CameraLog (CameraLogBench), on a common foundational task in footage ingest and initial color grading: identifying the Log curve of a clip without metadata. Cameras record Log footage by compressing a wide range of scene light into code values with a vendor-defined logarithmic curve, and color can be restored correctly only once that curve is known. The curve, however, is recorded only in file metadata, easily lost in transcoding and team hand-offs. A colorist then has to try candidate curves one by one against a waveform scope, and a wrong choice shifts the tones and colors of the whole clip. Recovering the curve from the image alone is challenging, because vendor curves cluster tightly in code value and are coupled with unknown exposure. CameraLogBench is built on professionally shot footage and tests whether multimodal models can identify the curve, with a probe that removes the correct option to expose guessing from priors. Because every candidate curve is strictly defined by a published vendor formula, we derive four controls from one implementation of these formulas: graded negatives, synthetic frames of identical scenes, in-context specification digests, and a training-free formula baseline, which together decouple semantic priors from photometric measurement. Across 11 models, real-footage accuracy barely exceeds always guessing the most frequent curve; when the correct option is removed, models almost never abstain, revealing heavy reliance on scene and brand priors. Supplying the vendor specification sharply improves recognition on calibrated charts but hardly helps on natural images without a photometric reference, exposing a gap between reading a specification and measuring pixels.

</details>

### 67. [TESS: Query-Guided Temporal Event-Structured Frame Selection for Long-Video Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32410v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32410

**作者：** Qi Lu、Shiyan Tong、Shujie Li、Sen Li、Likun shi、Maofei Que、Xiaolong Jiang、Yao Hu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32410v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32410v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的 TESS 长视频帧选择框架：以查询引导同时选出参考事件与目标事件的帧并保持时序顺序，结合软时序门控、角色感知预算分配与同角色冗余抑制，在固定帧预算下保留互补事件证据。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应 LVR 中「LOOK」阶段的视觉证据筛选与预算成本问题，其角色化预算分配和冗余抑制可供核查：固定视觉预算下证据互补性如何影响时序关系推理，以及选择信号是否真正被下游答案使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TESS: Query-Guided Temporal Event-Structured Frame Selection for Long-Video Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Temporal localization in long videos is challenging because brief, question-relevant events are dispersed among extensive redundant content. Limited visual budgets increase the risk of omitting these events or their temporal context, undermining reliable reasoning. Existing frame selection methods emphasize semantic relevance or temporal coverage, often overlooking the complementary evidence needed to locate related events and establish their temporal relationships. To address this limitation, we propose TESS, a training-free framework for query-guided temporal event-structured frame selection. TESS selects frames that jointly show the reference event and the event asked about, in the required temporal order. Leveraging frozen vision-language representations, TESS integrates soft temporal gating, role-aware budget allocation, and within-role redundancy suppression to preserve complementary event evidence. Extensive experiments across four long-video understanding benchmarks and three multimodal backbones demonstrate that TESS consistently outperforms the strongest compared baseline by 4.0-5.5 percentage points under a fixed frame budget. Further analyses reveal greater improvements on longer videos and robust performance under tighter visual budgets, while independent evidence annotations confirm enhanced event and temporal-relation coverage. These findings establish explicit temporal evidence organization as an effective training-free strategy for preserving event relationships and supporting efficient temporal reasoning over long videos. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TESS\_code.

</details>

**内容简述：** 该文重构地理空间推理分割的任务定义，按类别表达（显式/隐式）与属性性质（感知/推理）两个维度审计 90,708 条现有查询，并借助 OpenStreetMap 属性构建大规模数据集 RSReasoner 与诊断基准 RSReasoner-Bench，用于检验模型是真正推理还是走感知捷径。

**相关性简评：** 其「感知属性和推理属性混杂、显式类别缺失导致知觉捷径」的诊断思路，与 LVR 关注的视觉旁路、证据筛选和推理能力是否被真正使用有具体联系，但其地理分割任务与内部 latent 状态机制相距较远，值得核查其捷径分析与控制变量设计能否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RSReasoner: Reformulating and Auditing Geospatial Reasoning Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Geospatial reasoning segmentation aims to localize geographic targets from language requiring semantic inference beyond direct visual perception. However, existing benchmarks often operationalize reasoning as category omission while overlooking attribute mixing, which neglects explicit-category reasoning, introduces perceptual shortcuts, and fails to precisely evaluate reasoning capability. To diagnose and address these limitations, we first reformulate geospatial reasoning segmentation along category expression (explicit vs. implicit) and attribute nature (perceptual vs. inferential), and audit 90,708 queries across existing benchmarks to reveal that pure explicit-inferential queries account for only 0.61% whereas 31.98% mix both attribute types. We then develop a three-stage pipeline that harnesses OpenStreetMap attributes while mitigating geometric and semantic noise to construct RSReasoner, a large-scale dataset of 106,610 images with 213,220 reasoning queries, and RSReasoner-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 75,400 queries across four canonical types and controlled variants. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RSReasoner-Bench precisely evaluates model capability across multiple dimensions while exposing shortcut behaviors, and fine-tuning on RSReasoner boosts both reasoning and cross-type generalization. Our findings offer key insights for future geospatial reasoning research and benchmark design. Datasets and code will be released at https://github.com/Ricardo-XZ/RSReasoner.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32649v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32649v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ICLWorld 在线基准，构建 30 个电脑与机器人环境、630 段演示视频和 160 个含反直觉规则的任务，评测 agent 能否从文本或视频上下文中学会规则并泛化到新实例与新环境。

**相关性简评：** 其「视频规则与文本规则的对照」及「能答对规则却仅完成少量任务」的落差，可供核查 VLM 是否真正把视觉证据写入可用推理状态，还是依赖文本旁路与表面识别，值得在选题时作为诊断性证据参考。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ICLWorld: Benchmarking In-Context Learning of Agents from Digital to Physical Worlds

**abstract/A1：** In-context learning (ICL) lets agents acquire new rules from context and adapt to user-specific requirements at inference time. The same frontier agents now operate both computers and robots, yet their ICL remains insufficiently assessed: existing benchmarks are largely offline, rely on text or static images, and risk training-data contamination, while robot evaluations are limited to method-level ablations. We present ICLWorld, an online benchmark that evaluates the ICL of agents from digital to physical worlds, covering computer use and robot use, together with UIverse, a unified harness that turns every environment into a user interface. We build 30 environments, record 630 demonstration videos (10+ hours), and design 160 tasks with customized, often counter-intuitive rules that cannot be satisfied without learning from the context. Each task comes with three rule versions, given as text or video, and we test generalization at three levels, from replaying the demonstration to new instances and unseen environments. Across six frontier models, the strongest agents, Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra, succeed on 82% and 76% of computer-use runs but only 27% and 26% of robot-use runs, and a no-rule control reduces success to at most 8%. GPT-6 Astra succeeds under all three rule versions on only 38% of computer-use tasks, half its rate under a single rule, and answers 98% of robot rule questions correctly yet completes only 20% of these tasks. Frontier agents learn rules comparably well from video and from text and transfer them across environments, whereas weaker agents rely on text and lose most of their video-based success once the demonstrated situation is resampled. These findings reveal substantial gaps between the digital and the physical world and between identifying a rule and acting on it.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://iclworld.github.io Code: https://github.com/ICLWorld/ICLWorld Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Aoraku/ICLWorld
