### 70. [Decision-Native Multimodal Clinical Modeling via Anatomical Grounding and Confidence Calibration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32993v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32993

**作者：** Juntao Jiang、Wenqi Zhong、Guangyu Guo、Dexia Chen、Yilong Hu、Yunhao Bai、Zhenyu Yi、Jianwei Xu、Tony C. W. Mok、Muxuan Gao、Ling Zhang、Yong Liu、Jiangning Zhang、Zhongwei Qiu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32993v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32993v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Radev：用冻结 3D 编码器提取器官级特征、按预测解剖范围动态选取 2D 切片特征做视觉压缩，使语言骨干单次前向输出候选概率而非自回归解码，并以反事实器官干预训练校准置信度，同时构建 CT-Verdict 基准。

**相关性简评：** 解剖边界筛选视觉证据、单步候选预测替代 AR 解码、反事实干预惩罚无关区域依赖，与 LVR 关注的视觉证据筛选、生成方式与置信/停止决策有具体联系可供核查，但该方法并非 latent 状态推理，迁移价值需阅读后判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Decision-Native Multimodal Clinical Modeling via Anatomical Grounding and Confidence Calibration

**abstract/A1：** Structured clinical decisions from volumetric computed tomography (CT) require anatomically grounded predictions and calibrated confidence estimates. However, existing 3D medical multimodal models often suffer from uncalibrated autoregressive decoding and shortcut reliance on irrelevant anatomical regions. We introduce Radev, a decision-native multimodal model that integrates anatomy-guided visual compression, direct candidate prediction, and counterfactual confidence supervision. To bridge global context with fine-grained slice details, a frozen 3D encoder extracts reusable organ-level features, which are dynamically selected by the query to attend to 2D slice features within predicted anatomical bounds. The resulting compact visual tokens enable the language backbone to estimate candidate probabilities in a single forward pass without autoregressive decoding. We further propose Counterfactual-Calibrated Training (CCT) to compare predictions under intact and intervened organ representations. CCT encourages confidence to decrease when removing target-organ evidence degrades decision quality, while penalizing excessive confidence drops under unrelated-organ removal. To facilitate rigorous evaluation, we construct CT-Verdict, a comprehensive benchmark spanning binary finding presence, multiple-choice questions, and ordinal severity assessment across both in-distribution and external cohorts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Radev significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both decision accuracy and confidence calibration, while generalizing robustly under distribution shifts. ### 71. [Embodied AI Fails the Mirror Test: How a Simple Mirror Breaks Robot Policies](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33010v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.33010

**作者：** Xuanchen Liu、Hejun Zhang、Boxuan Dong、Ying Wu、Heshuai Li、Wen Gao、Yonghong Tian、Weihao Yu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.RO

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 RoboDojo-Mirror 基准，在无镜、单镜、双镜与镜面桌面条件下比较五类 VLA、世界动作模型和 agentic 策略的操控成功率，并用几何匹配的非反射面板作对照，结合轨迹与接触分析指出失败源于对反射物体的「幽灵瞄准」和真实物体的空间误定位；π0.5 与 FastWAM 真机实验也复现下降。

**相关性简评：** 该工作给出 VLM/VLA 策略在镜面干扰下的失败诊断，可供核查视觉证据筛选与任务必要空间信息在内部表示中是否被反射线索污染；但其关注机器人操控评测，未涉及 latent 状态的生成或使用机制，与 LVR 的联系需阅读原文进一步确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Embodied AI Fails the Mirror Test: How a Simple Mirror Breaks Robot Policies

**abstract/A1：** Can a simple mirror expose the limitations of today's robotic manipulation policies? Inspired by the mirror self-recognition test in animal cognition, we investigate whether robot policies can reliably manipulate physical objects in scenes containing their reflections. We introduce RoboDojo-Mirror, a benchmark built on RoboDojo that preserves task objectives, success criteria, and policy checkpoints while comparing a mirror-free baseline with single-mirror, dual-mirror, and mirrored-tabletop conditions. Across five policies spanning Vision-Language-Action models, World Action Models, and agentic policies, every mirror condition reduces aggregate success rates: averaged over the three conditions, the drop ranges from 10.8 to 56.7 percentage points across policies, and it reaches 62.5 points on the mirrored tabletop. Because a mirror is also a physical obstacle, we compare it against geometrically matched non-reflective panels; 50--88\\% of mirror-specific failures occur without recorded robot--panel contact, so direct collisions alone do not explain the degradation. Trajectory and contact analyses instead reveal recurring behaviors consistent with phantom targeting of reflected objects and spatial mislocalization of real ones. Targeted diagnostics further characterize grasping near reflections, policy-dependent pushing progress, and physical-target interaction under main-camera occlusion. Real-robot experiments with $π\_{0.5}$ and FastWAM also show lower overall success rates under the upright-mirror and mirrored-tabletop conditions. These findings reveal a shared vulnerability to reflective environments across diverse robot policies and motivate reflection-aware evaluation of embodied intelligence. Code is available at https://github.com/iPPLab/robodojo-mirror.

**comment/C1：** Code: https://github.com/iPPLab/robodojo-mirror

</details>

### 72. [Lost on Campus: Evaluating Embodied Spatial Reasoning of Vision-Language Models in the Wild](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33145v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.33145

**作者：** Zehan Zheng、Yanyuan Chen、Deming Li、Yutao Tang、Jianwen Xie、Alan Yuille、Jieneng Chen、Cheng Peng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33145v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.33145v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 Lost on Campus 基准，用 3D Gaussian Splatting 重建大规模真实户外校园环境，将诊断式问答与闭环交互导航统一起来，从动作落地、空间预见、度量感知、目标规划、自他中心定位和时空一致性六个方面评估 VLM 的具身空间推理。

**相关性简评：** 其诊断维度与闭环设定可为核查视觉细节保留、自他中心表示和主动取证式「LOOK」的收益与成本提供线索，但未分析 latent 状态，需阅读原文确认任务接口与失败归因方式。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Lost on Campus: Evaluating Embodied Spatial Reasoning of Vision-Language Models in the Wild

**abstract/A1：** Embodied Spatial Reasoning (ESR) is central to deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in real-world embodied tasks, yet remains inadequately evaluated. Existing benchmarks primarily assess spatial reasoning in static images or synthetic indoor environments, where semantic shortcuts often suffice, making it difficult to faithfully evaluate spatial reasoning capabilities in the wild. In light of this, we present Lost on Campus, a benchmark for evaluating ESR in large-scale real-world outdoor 3D environments reconstructed by 3D Gaussian Splatting. Our benchmark introduces a unified reasoning-action evaluation framework that seamlessly integrates diagnostic QA for isolated reasoning with closed-loop interactive navigation for active reasoning under multimodal instructions. To enable fine-grained diagnosis, we evaluate six capability aspects of ESR: action grounding, spatial foresight, metric awareness, goal-directed planning, ego-allocentric localization, and spatio-temporal consistency. Extensive experiments reveal that: (i) Compared to indoor settings, real-world outdoor environments impose substantially higher demands on spatial reasoning, where existing models exhibit poor performance; (ii) VLMs still struggle with fine-grained visual alignment, with failures in spatial foresight and ego-allocentric localization emerging as primary bottlenecks; (iii) Improving multimodal interaction capabilities and long-term spatial reasoning is crucial for advancing embodied intelligence. These findings highlight that faithful evaluation of ESR demands benchmarks tightly coupling perception, reasoning and action within realistic and continuous environments.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://dyfcalid.github.io/Lost-on-Campus/

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2604.16678

**作者：** Hangke Sui、Yuqing Wang、Minh N Do

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 UniCon 框架，用核方法刻画对比对齐，引入对比相似度权重矩阵 S(γ) 得到闭式全局解，以替代小批量反向传播，并在 RKHS 视角下统一线性/非线性编码器与一对一、多对多对齐，在合成、单模态、多模态和零样本任务上验证效率与性能。

**相关性简评：** 论文本身不涉及 latent 视觉推理，但其核化闭式对齐与「用精确更新替代梯度优化」的思路，可能为 VLM 中视觉—文本表示对齐及训练监督的高效实现提供可核查的借鉴线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** UniCon: Unified Framework for Efficient Contrastive Alignment via Kernels

**abstract/A1：** Contrastive objectives power state-of-the-art multimodal models, but their training remains slow, relying on long stochastic optimization. We propose a Unified Framework for Efficient Contrastive Alignment via Kernels (UniCon), which spans linear and nonlinear encoders as well as one-to-one and many-to-many alignments. At its core, UniCon introduces the contrastive similarity weight matrix $S(γ)$, which enables closed-form global solutions that provably replace minibatch back-propagation with exact updates. Through the lens of reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHS), UniCon provides a kernelized perspective that unifies contrastive alignment and reveals its connection to spectral methods. To validate the theory, we conduct experiments on synthetic, unimodal, multimodal, and zero-shot tasks, demonstrating that UniCon achieves substantial efficiency gains while preserving generality and strong empirical performance.

### 74. [When Can a Rewiring Control Test LLM Weight Readers? C2 and an Eligibility Protocol](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29120v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29120

**作者：** Vaishak Girish Kumar、Sanika Vilas Najan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29120v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29120v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究如何判断 LLM 是否真正从原始权重计算网络输出，而非识别权重空间指纹；提出置换最终线性读出列的反事实 C2 及三项资格协议，并在小型 MLP、公开 CNN 库和构造总体上检验。

**相关性简评：** C2「保持其余参数与谱性质不变、只改变可精确重算函数」的反事实设计及资格协议，可供核查 LVR 中答案是否真正使用 latent 视觉内容而非捷径；但权重读取与视觉推理相距较远，迁移可行性仍需验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Can a Rewiring Control Test LLM Weight Readers? C2 and an Eligibility Protocol

**abstract/A1：** Large language models can predict the outputs of small neural networks from raw weights, but success could reflect recognition of weight-space regularities (fingerprints) rather than computation, and function-preserving controls cannot tell these apart. We propose C2, a counterfactual that permutes the columns of a network's final linear readout: every other parameter, and the readout's singular values, norms and entry multiset, are unchanged, and the function can change in an exactly recomputable way; we verify that each evaluated permutation does. C2 separates fingerprinting from computation only under three conditions, which we state as an eligibility protocol: a strategy restricted to C2-invariant summaries must already predict the target; C2 must change a property specific to the rewiring; and the reader's identity must be attested. No natural setting we tested is eligible. On tiny MLPs a frontier reader route followed the rewired function on all 24 networks, but invariant baselines were near chance and its backend could not be attested. In two public CNN zoos the conditions traded off: weight statistics predicted CIFAR-10 accuracy in-distribution, but C2's effect on accuracy was not specific to the swap, while per-image targets were specific but not predictable from invariant summaries. On a constructed population where a planted fingerprint rule works, all conditions hold and C2 separates a rule-following reader from an executor. A self-hosted Qwen3.8-27B followed the rewired function rather than the shortcut, and showed no evidence of using the weights with thinking disabled. A registered replication on fresh networks confirmed both findings (tracking minus stuck 0.875, 95% interval \[0.750, 1.000\]), and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B also followed the rewiring (tracking minus stuck 0.729 \[0.552, 0.885\]). The transforms, audits and raw records are available from the authors.

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Hidden Clues in WM-811K: Uncovering the Spatial Signals Behind Wafer Map Prediction

**abstract/A1：** WM-811K (also known as LSWMD) is a wafer map dataset first made publicly available in a 2015 paper by Wu et al. Convolutional neural networks have been used to achieve high classification accuracy on this dataset, yet it's not easy to decipher which features of the dataset are driving that performance. This study attempts to answer this specifically for WM-811K: how much of the predictive performance results from the wafer layout, the count of failed dies, their distance from the center and their exact 2-D location. After analyzing duplicate wafer maps, removing same wafer maps with conflicting labels and ensuring that the same manufacturing lot or exact same map doesn't appear in training, validation and test data, we were left with 25,513 defect-labeled wafer maps from eight classes. We then constructed four variations of each wafer map. The Original was the actual wafer map present in the dataset. The Layout-only kept only the layout of the non-background dies. The Global-shuffle kept the count of failed dies while shuffling them around. The Radial-shuffle randomized the locations of failed dies only in their radial bin, which was chosen out of 8 radial bins based on distance from the center. The data split, preprocessing and CNN architecture remained the same for all four of them. Macro-F1 progressed like this: 0.3829 (Layout-only), 0.5803 (Global-shuffle), 0.7439 (Radial-shuffle) and 0.8563 (Original). These results show that WM-811K contains useful information at several levels: wafer layout, number of failures, distribution of failed dies in a given radius, and exact 2-D locations of the failed dies. Therefore, high classification performance on this benchmark does not come only from learning the exact defect configuration.

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MOZAIC: An Audio-Video Deepfake Benchmark for Telling What Is Fake

**abstract/A1：** Audio-video (AV) deepfakes can fake the face, the voice, or both. Most benchmarks only ask whether a clip is real or fake, so they cannot show whether a detector relies on the picture, the voice, or encoding traces. We present MOZAIC, a paired benchmark with a 4-way label in which every source clip is released in all four combinations of real or fake video and real or fake audio so each modality contribution can be measured directly. Fakes cover inner-face swapping, whole-frame video diffusion and voice conversion. MOZAIC has 137,745 clips from 15,014 source pairs and four tasks: T1 AV authenticity, T2 manipulation type, T3 identity verification and T4 explanation. We evaluate 12 AV multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), train four detectors and fine-tune MLLMs with LoRA. Overall, the best MLLM reaches only 35.6% on the four-way T1 and catches far more video-only fakes than voice-only fakes (43.6% vs 7.5%). Trained detectors reach 98.4% on T1, and LoRA fine-tuning raises explanation scores (OmniVinci 4.17 to 7.40, Qwen2.5-Omni 4.42 to 6.98), but the best T1 detector falls to 78.3% when the face-swap generator is held out of training, so generalization and explanation remain open. We release the dataset, the compact MOZAIC-SMALL split, the code and the prompts. https://vectorinstitute.github.io/mozaic/

**内容简述：** 论文在五个 EEG 基础模型、三个任务上，将「读出方式」「中间层是否带来末层之外的预测增益」「深度结构能否跨数据集迁移」三因素分开考察，发现改进末层读出可大幅恢复性能，但冻结提取下中间层仍占优，且源数据集选出的层与任务方向可在目标数据集复用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Layer-Readout Interfaces in EEG Foundation Models: Predictive Accessibility and Cross-Dataset Transfer

**abstract/A1：** Intermediate layers often outperform final layers when foundation models are used as frozen feature extractors, but the source of this advantage is unclear. We study this question in EEG foundation models by separating three factors: how representations are read out, whether intermediate layers provide predictive utility beyond the final-layer interface, and whether useful depth structure transfers across datasets. Across five models and three tasks, improving the final-layer readout consistently recovers substantial predictive performance, yet intermediate layers remain advantageous within frozen extraction. We also find that layers selected on one dataset remain useful on another across five dataset pairs and four task families, and that a compact set of source-derived task directions retains predictive value after transfer in sleep staging. Together, these results show that predictive utility varies across depth, and its usefulness depends on how representations are read out and transferred. More crucially, source-selected layers provide a reusable feature interface across datasets, reducing the need for target-side layer search while outperforming final-layer baselines on target datasets.

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Antares-Smaug: Adversarial Names, Tokens and Attack Rewrites: Sanitisers Miss Unseen Generalisations

**abstract/A1：** Laya is an open decision model: given a text, a question and K named options with descriptions, it returns one probability per option in a single pass, and software may act on the answer unseen. We attack six Laya models with 81 programmatic edits of 566 synthetic items (injected sentences, label leaks, edited descriptions, decoy options, invisible and look-alike characters, floods) and report the share of correctly answered items hijacked or lost, with bootstrap intervals. Attack wordings that no defence was built from win the attacker's option on 59% of items for released Laya and 36% for fine-tune v1 (trained on 109 written injections). An injection works through the option name: a sentence naming an option steers the released model even when negated (32%), while an imperative naming no option does not (5%). Option descriptions barely matter (2%). Character edits alone cost v1 up to 72% of right answers. A sanitiser frozen before any held-out result cuts the attacks it was built from by 72% but held-out sentence attacks by 27%, and an attacker who picks the best of 34 held-out strings per item restores success to 84% (mean string 18%). The same oracle takes the model fine-tuned on the four build families of injected sentences from 5% (mean string) to 58%. Fine-tuning on build families only (against an unchanged-rows control) cuts held-out sentence attacks (three held-out families) from 33% to 3% but character edits only from 25% to 20%. A label-free check that deletes the option names and measures the shift flags held-out sentence attacks (AUROC 0.95) but not character edits (0.46), and thresholds set on dev schemas for 5% false alarms gave 8% to 18% on an unseen schema and other languages. All data are synthetic with LLM labels, on one backbone. Several planned runs (other checkpoints, a second seed, some fine-tunes) were not run.

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GHC:Expanding Residual Interfaces in Hyper-Connections

**abstract/A1：** Hyper-Connections expand residual capacity across parallel streams, yet restrict every branch to narrow read and write interfaces: each branch still reads a single stream mixture and writes scaled copies of one output vector to all streams. To lift this bottleneck, we propose Grouped Hyper-Connections (GHC). By partitioning each branch into parallel groups along attention heads or FFN channels, GHC supplies each group with a distinct stream mixture and aggregates their separate outputs into each stream with learned weights. Extensive experiments across dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models show that GHC consistently improves upon Identity Hyper-Connections (IHC) with negligible parameter and memory-access overhead, increasing training efficiency by 35% over Pre-Norm and 10% over IHC. Moreover, expanding residual interfaces overcomes the diminishing returns of adding streams, allowing wider residual states to yield further gains.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31354v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31354v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文以有毒饮食文化短视频为案例，提出 SPACE 框架，在大型多模态模型的 SAE 特征空间中用相关性门控与可分解线性证据头定位与决策关联的证据，并做政策对齐与紧凑证据选择，在 3711 条 TikTok 视频上评测。

**相关性简评：** 不属于 LVR 主线，但其在 SAE 特征空间中的证据定位、段级监督与稀疏证据筛选，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索；需注意其目标是内容治理证据而非推理状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Detecting Harmful Short Videos in Toxic Diet Culture: A Governance-Ready Evidence Framework with Sparse Autoencoders

**abstract/A1：** Algorithmic content moderation is increasingly important for governing short-form video content, yet harmful-content detection research focuses primarily on prediction or limited explanations. This leaves a governance challenge underexplored: producing decision-linked evidence that supports the review and justification of moderation decisions. Using toxic diet culture as an empirical case, we conceptualize governance-ready evidence as computational traceability, evidence localization, policy grounding, and evidence inspectability. We develop the Sparse Autoencoder-based Policy-Aligned Contrastive Evidence (SPACE) framework in a pretrained SAE feature space derived from a large multimodal model. A global relevance gate and decomposable linear evidence head identify decision-linked evidence; segment supervision and within-video ranking localize this evidence; policy alignment maps it to platform guidelines; and Pareto-efficient selection yields a compact, task-specific evidence vocabulary. On 3,711 labeled TikTok videos, SPACE achieves the highest harmful-category Macro F1 among benchmarks across four families, at 0.8507. Its highest-scoring observation overlaps a ground-truth harmful span for 88.0% of harmful test videos, while its evidence representation retrieves the corresponding policy category for 87.0%. Stakeholder evaluations indicate that the SPACE evidence report is perceived as useful for understanding, reviewing, documenting, and responding to moderation decisions. The study contributes computational design science knowledge for embedding governance-ready evidence within predictive content-moderation systems.

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出「Pixel as Code」的 agentic 视觉创作框架：用学习到的离散视觉 token 表示栅格图像、用显式程序表示结构化产物，并通过共享的生成—渲染接口统一图像、矢量图、网页与文档，同时配套图像 tokenizer、自回归图像生成器和视觉代码模型。

**相关性简评：** 其离散视觉 token 表示与依据视觉反馈进行栅格候选选择、定向修复的闭环，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据保留、候选验证与停止决策提供可供核查的线索，但论文本身面向创作与重建任务，未研究推理期 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation: Pixel as Code for Agentic Visual Creation

**abstract/A1：** Visual creation demands expressive imagery together with precise control over text, layout, and structure. We introduce Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation, an agentic framework that connects these capabilities through Pixel as Code. Raster images are represented by learned discrete visual tokens, while structured artifacts use explicit programs. A shared generation-and-rendering interface connects these representations to visual feedback across images, vector graphics, webpages, and documents. A Nemotron-native harness coordinates planning and raster candidate selection, with targeted repair for editable structured and hybrid artifacts. To support this interface, we develop Nemotron-Labs-Image-Tokenizer, the autoregressive raster generator Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B, and the structured-code model family Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode. On approximately 178K images spanning six visual domains, our tokenizer improves reconstruction PSNR from 26.08 to 29.57 dB over Emu3.5 IBQ. It also provides 7.13x faster encoding and 10.93x faster decoding at batch size one on A100. In standalone evaluation, one Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode variant surpasses Kimi K3.1 Pro on the aggregate across Chart2Code, MMSVG, Design2Code, and Image2Struct. At the system level, the Nemotron-native configuration raises GenEval2 Soft-TIFA GM from 31.71 to 52.56 using the same raster generator. With our best setting, Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation achieves performance competitive with GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro across most benchmarks with available comparisons.

### 82. [Learning What vs. Learning How: Decomposing Task and Interface Competence in Agentic Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31427v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31427

**作者：** Chaeeun Lee、Hossein A. Rahmani、Aryo Pradipta Gema、Kexin Xu、Emine Yilmaz、Pasquale Minervini、T. Ian Simpson、Chen Jin、Amrutha Saseendran

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31427v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31427v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将 agent 能力拆为任务能力（解题所需知识与推理）和接口能力（通过特定 harness 采取行动），在四个推理与 agentic 基准上比较不同 harness 训练、multi-harness 蒸馏、harness rehearsal 的效果，并对比蒸馏与 on-policy RL 的鲁棒性。

**相关性简评：** 「任务知识已具备却无法经特定接口表达」的分解，以及只锻炼接口、几乎不含任务知识的 rehearsal 式监督，可能可供核查 latent 内容是否真被答案通路使用、表示与输出接口的贡献如何分离。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning What vs. Learning How: Decomposing Task and Interface Competence in Agentic Training

**abstract/A1：** LLM agents operate through harnesses that define system prompts, action formats, feedback loops, and resource constraints. A model may possess the knowledge needed to solve a task yet fail to express that knowledge through a particular harness. This raises a basic question: when a policy fails under a given harness, is it missing task knowledge or the competence to operate the interface? We distinguish two components of agentic competence: task competence, the knowledge and reasoning needed to solve a task, and interface competence, the ability to act on that knowledge through a given harness. Across four reasoning and agentic benchmarks, we show that harness-conditioned training yields vastly different outcomes depending on how these interact. Multi-harness distillation aggregates task knowledge from trajectories collected through different harnesses into a shared policy, but this knowledge is realised only when training preserves or improves competence on the inference-time interface. Otherwise, single-harness training can induce interference in interface competence, sometimes catastrophically collapsing performance on a held-out harness despite improvements in underlying task knowledge. To disentangle task and interface supervision, we introduce harness rehearsal: distillation on traces that carry minimal task knowledge while exercising the target interface. Cross-harness task supervision or rehearsal alone yields little gain, but their combination yields gains far larger than either: on BFCL V3 multi-turn with Qwen3-4B, they achieve 8.5% and 32.5% respectively, versus 58.8% together. Finally, on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) is more robust than distillation to single-harness training: it does not substantially degrade performance on other harnesses, and interface competence acquired through multi-harness distillation persists through subsequent RL.

**comment/C1：** Code: https://github.com/chaeeunlee-io/harness-competence Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/chaeeunlee/harness-competence

</details>

### 83. [Transformers with Signatures: Towards Universal In-Context Learning in Path Space](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31439v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31439

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.OC、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31439v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31439v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用路径签名特征搭建 in-context learning 框架，显式构造每层两个注意力头的因果 softmax transformer 来模拟 in-context Lasso，并在稀疏签名近似等条件下给出有限样本预测误差界，实验覆盖稀疏恢复、非线性路径回归与金融收益推断。

**相关性简评：** 路径签名把历史轨迹压缩为有限维特征并交给注意力使用，可能为 LVR 中如何将观察序列累积成紧凑推理状态、以及状态更新与误差界分析提供可核查线索；但该工作不含视觉或多模态证据筛选，迁移价值需读原文判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Transformers with Signatures: Towards Universal In-Context Learning in Path Space

**abstract/A1：** In-context learning (ICL) enables transformers to adapt to new tasks from demonstrations without updating their parameters. However, theoretical guarantees for transformers remain limited in general, and elusive in particular when target responses depend nonlinearly on the evolution of observed paths. We establish an ICL framework for path space, using path signature features. Building on the universal linear approximation property of signatures, we construct explicitly a causal softmax transformer with two attention heads per layer that emulates in-context Lasso. Under sparse signature approximation and suitable moment and concentration conditions, we establish finite-sample prediction error bounds. Our analysis goes beyond the IID data setting in the existing ICL theory, allowing dependence among demonstrations and the query. Experiments on in-context sparse recovery, nonlinear path regression, execution-cost prediction, and financial payoff inference demonstrate robustness to changes in observation grids and adaptation to unseen market environments. Across these prediction tasks, transformers with signatures match or outperform vanilla transformer baselines with substantially fewer trainable parameters, highlighting the effectiveness and efficiency of signature-based ICL.

</details>

### 84. [Small Learned Projections for Semantic-Reversal-Aware Retrieval with Spectral Acceleration: A Four-Domain Empirical Study](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31442v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31442

**作者：** Sayed Amir Karim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.IR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31442v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31442v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对稠密文本检索中的「语义反转陷阱」，训练一个把 E5 嵌入压到 11/32 维的小型学习投影，在法务、医疗、专利、金融四领域的声明案例上把陷阱排除出 top-10，并用边界值求解替代稠密特征分解来加速谱图检索至十万级索引。

**相关性简评：** 以低维学习投影作为文档端存储表示、并刻意对近似改写的干扰文档不敏感，可供核查 LVR 中压缩潜在状态是否损失任务必要细节、以及潜在相似度对细微语义差异的敏感性；但对象是文本检索而非多模态推理，迁移有效性待验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Small Learned Projections for Semantic-Reversal-Aware Retrieval with Spectral Acceleration: A Four-Domain Empirical Study

**abstract/A1：** Dense-embedding retrievers can fail adversarially: when a query is answered by a document A and reversed by a near-copy B that differs from A by a small meaning-changing edit (a "trap"), raw cosine over E5-Large-v2 places B in the top-10 for 82-100% of queries at a pool of 5,000. We study two things. First, a small learned projection W: R^1024 -&gt; R^d (d in {11, 32}), trained by a deterministic recipe on a declared set of cases, that suppresses the trap: for the declared cases, HN@10 = 0.0000 (no trap in the top-10) in all twelve (domain, pool-size) settings across four independent domains (legal, medical, patent, financial) and pools up to 100,000, while the correct paraphrase is retained for 93-99% of cases, under exact nearest-neighbour search. Second, a boundary-conditioned accelerator that serves the projection at that scale: an acceleration of spectral graph retrieval (SpectRAG) that replaces a dense eigendecomposition with a boundary-value solve, holding HN@10 = 0.0000 at n = 100,000 in every domain and retrieving the ~300-query suite in 0.6-1.1 s (~2-4 ms per query on average). Because the lens's output is the stored representation (a few floats per document), a hardened, specialised index per domain or tenant is ~90x smaller and dimension-proportionally faster than the full embedding, making many small declared indexes a practical alternative to one large vector store. The claim is scoped to the declared cases on the measured pools, with no probabilistic bound; the correct-answer rate drops for a reworded query against an unchanged corpus (about 0.79, trap suppression still holding). A projection transfers only partly to other domains, which we report in full. The recipe, lenses, trap sets and evaluation harness are released under AGPL-3.0; the accelerator's implementation is a reserved commercial component, and every HN number is reproducible under exact search.

**comment/C1：** Comments 27 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Code, lenses, trap sets and data: https://github.com/pelloran-inc/pelloran-safety-lens (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24345474)

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文用原子阶段干预分析多个 VLA 架构的空间泛化失败来源，发现瓶颈在目标定位与全局空间路由而非局部操作，进而提出 MFM-VLA：由多模态基础模型提供目标定位和空间引导，VLA 保留精细操作，并用能力路由器决定是否介入。

**相关性简评：** 其分阶段干预定位失败环节、以及按能力选择是否调用外部模块的路由器，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、贡献分配与「何时停止/介入」决策的借鉴，但研究对象是机器人动作策略而非 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Ground, Guide, Act: Improving VLA Spatial Generalization with Multimodal Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models effectively learn action policies from robot demonstrations, but struggle to generalize to changes in object positions and task goals. General multimodal foundation models (MFMs) offer complementary scene understanding and spatial reasoning, but remain slow and unreliable for direct fine-grained control. To understand how MFMs can improve VLA spatial generalization, we conduct a systematic capability analysis across multiple VLA architectures using atomic-stage interventions, revealing that many failures stem from poor target grounding and global spatial routing, while local manipulation skills remain largely usable. Based on these findings, we propose MFM-VLA, a selective collaboration framework in which an MFM provides target grounding and spatial guidance, controllers execute free-space motion, and the VLA retains control over fine-grained manipulation. We fine-tune the VLA with action-chunk-level dense geometric captions and perturbed-state recovery data to improve local guidance following and recovery from unfamiliar handoff states. A development-calibrated capability router selects between direct VLA execution and MFM-assisted execution to avoid unnecessary intervention. Across LIBERO-PRO, ALOHA-Sim-PRO, RoboCasa365, and real-world chemistry tasks, MFM-VLA improves success rates by 14.9, 74.0, 3.6, and 30.9 percentage points, respectively, over the corresponding base VLA. The project page is available at https://tom-zgt.github.io/MFM-VLA

</details>

### 86. [Transferable, Time-Parallel Graph Dynamics via Space-Time Factorization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31479v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31479

**作者：** Wencong Yang、Chaopeng Shen、Abdolmehdi Behroozi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、physics.geo-ph

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31479v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31479v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出「时空分解」：将图动力学模型拆为与图结构无关的局部时间算子加不含图相关可学习参数的空间混合器，使同一组参数可零样本迁移到未见拓扑并支持非循环的时间并行评估，在河网洪水、跨几何 Navier–Stokes 与跨城市交通上验证，并分析三类信息泄漏对迁移的影响。

**相关性简评：** 把状态更新与结构相关的信息混合解耦，并显式控制图相关权重、图特异特征、图相关训练分布这三类泄漏，可供核查 latent 推理中「视觉/结构旁路」如何影响内部状态内容的因果使用及其评测协议；其非循环并行评估也可能提示并行 latent 生成的成本权衡，但迁移需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Transferable, Time-Parallel Graph Dynamics via Space-Time Factorization

**abstract/A1：** Time-parallel neural operators (FNO and successors) have transformed PDE surrogates on regular grids. Mesh-based operators (MeshGraphNets, Transolver) extend operator learning to irregular geometries, but jointly learning across diverse topologies while retaining non-recurrent temporal evaluation remains challenging. We propose space-time factorization: partition the model into local temporal operators (learned, graph-independent) and a spatial mixer that propagates information across nodes without graph-dependent learned parameters. This structural condition lets the same parameters run on unseen graphs; non-recurrent instances also admit time-parallel evaluation. Accurate zero-shot transfer further depends on controlling three information leaks (graph-dependent weights, graph-specific features, and graph-correlated training distributions) and on suitable task physics and training coverage. The protocol applies to two distinct spatial-mixer families, fixed-spectral and learned-attention. We validate the principle in three domains. For floodwave propagation in river networks, a 27K-parameter model trained on the Yangtze transfers zero-shot to the Mississippi with median NSE 0.998 in boundary-conditioned operational evaluation, training 5.5x faster than a stabilized recurrent baseline. On cross-geometry Navier-Stokes, the three-seed SepFNO mean relative vorticity error on five unseen targets falls by about 28% from 5 to 12 training geometries, with a consistent single-run SepTransolver trend. On cross-city traffic forecasting, zero-shot transfer reaches within 12.9% of an oracle trained on the target city. Across settings, cross-geometry error decreases with both the number of training geometries and their relatedness to the test, at a rate depending on the spatial mixer. This opens the path to pooled-data, foundation-style models for graph dynamics on irregular topologies.

</details>

### 87. [CHORD: Learning Latent Spaces for Constrained Stellarator Design](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31486v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31486

**作者：** Santiago A. Cadena、Andrea Merlo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、physics.plasm-ph

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31486v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31486v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CHORD：一种条件 VAE，训练时对解码后的 latent 插值路径施加约束违反惩罚，推理时让条件与解码设计的预测指标保持自洽，用于受物理约束的仿星器设计。

**相关性简评：** 沿 latent 插值施加可行性约束、并要求条件与解码结果自洽的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹训练与「解码答案是否真正使用 latent 内容」的一致性核查提供方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CHORD: Learning Latent Spaces for Constrained Stellarator Design

**abstract/A1：** In high-dimensional, PDE-constrained design, interpolating between known feasible solutions can reveal trade-offs without repeating expensive optimization campaigns. In stellarator design for fusion energy, direct interpolation of plasma boundary parameters can violate physical constraints even when both endpoints are feasible. Learned latent representations can capture nonlinear relationships among design variables, but latent interpolation can still cross infeasible regions, and conditioning on target metrics can become inconsistent with the decoded design. We introduce CHORD, a conditional variational autoencoder that penalizes predicted constraint violations along decoded latent interpolants during training, paired with self-consistent inference that aligns conditioning with the decoded design's predicted metrics. Geometric benchmarks show the benefit of regularizing latent interpolants. In stellarator interpolation between distinct geometry families, CHORD reaches up to 81% simulator-validated mid-segment feasibility, compared with 50% for an unregularized conditional VAE and 28% for direct interpolation of boundary parameters. Ablations show that both ingredients are needed for this gain. Beyond interpolation, latent-space optimization finds simulator-feasible designs, while self-consistent sampling produces more diverse feasible alternatives. On the ConStellaration benchmark, chord-regularized models with linear conditioning reuse data from five optimization campaigns and simulator-labeled rescalings to populate the Pareto front more densely. After low-fidelity screening, 93% of 1.2k generated candidates pass the benchmark's high-fidelity feasibility test. We release code and over 600k designs for stellarator generation, surrogate training, and front-filling evaluation. These results support feasibility-aware latent learning for exploring constrained design trade-offs.

</details>

### 88. [Near-Zero Forgetting Is Not Enough: Out-of-Distribution Robustness in Continual Learning of Pretrained VLAs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31511v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31511

**作者：** Adrià Ruiz、Bartłomiej Twardowski、Tinne Tuytelaars、Sergi Masip

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31511v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31511v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究预训练 VLA 模型 Pi0 在 experience replay 持续学习下对 OOD 域偏移的鲁棒性：LIBERO/LIBERO-Plus 上 ID 遗忘接近零，但旧任务的 OOD 性能迅速崩溃；表征漂移集中于多模态与动作特征，线性探针显示 OOD 特征仍含任务相关信息却难以读出，符合表征错位。

**相关性简评：** 「信息仍在但不可读」的探针诊断可为 LVR 中视觉证据是否被保留却未被下游使用（信息坍缩、表征错位）提供可供核查的探测思路，但其对象是机器人动作持续学习，与推理期 latent 状态生成关系较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Near-Zero Forgetting Is Not Enough: Out-of-Distribution Robustness in Continual Learning of Pretrained VLAs

**abstract/A1：** Recent work shows that pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models exhibit near-zero forgetting in specific continual learning settings with experience replay. However, robustness to domain shift of learned tasks remains unexplored. In this work, we study the robustness of Pi0 fine-tuned with experience replay under out-of-distribution (OOD) data using the LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks. While the in-domain (ID) setup achieves near-zero catastrophic forgetting, OOD performance on previous tasks quickly collapses. Specifically, we show that during the continual learning process, the OOD capabilities of the model degrade, following a shared representational pattern across domain shifts, which is also visible behaviorally in the two simpler suites. Representational analysis shows that drift concentrates in the multimodal and action features. Linear probes indicate that OOD features still retain task-relevant information, but appear unreadable, consistent with representation misalignment. These findings suggest that even when ID stability remains intact, severe OOD forgetting can still occur, accompanied by representational drift during continual learning.

**comment/C1：** Presented at the CoRL 2026 Workshop on Robot Learning at Deployment (Learn@Deploy). Project page: https://adrrp.github.io/vla-ood-robustness

</details>

### 89. [SOTS: Signature-based Optimal Transport Selection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31525v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31525

**作者：** Khalid Akhmouch、Eric Jauer

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.PR、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31525v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31525v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SOTS，一种面向不规则多变量时间序列分类的无监督 coreset 选择框架：用截断路径签名刻画多通道联合几何结构，并通过贪心最小化候选子集与全量数据签名分布间的 Sliced Wasserstein 距离来选样。

**相关性简评：** 其以分布匹配为准则的贪心子集选择，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据/帧的筛选与 LOOK 预算分配提供思路，但研究对象是时间序列训练集选取，与 latent 推理状态无直接关系，需核查是否可迁移到证据选择。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SOTS: Signature-based Optimal Transport Selection

**abstract/A1：** Training data selection for machine learning models is a critical bottleneck in industrial applications where expert annotation is costly and time-consuming. Existing coreset selection methods for time series either ignore temporal structure entirely or cannot handle variable-length, irregularly sampled, multi-channel signals, the setting most common in industrial monitoring and testing. We introduce SOTS (Signature-based Optimal Transport Selection), an unsupervised coreset selection framework for irregular multivariate time series (IMTS) classification. Each sample is mapped to a truncated path signature, capturing the joint geometric structure of its channels, and the coreset is selected by greedily minimizing the Sliced Wasserstein distance between the empirical signature distributions of the candidate subset and the full dataset, a criterion for which we establish a convergence guarantee for random coresets. We validate SOTS on a real-world, highly imbalanced industrial I&amp;C testing dataset, where SOTS-Greedy exceeds 95% of full-dataset accuracy using only 30% of the training data, outperforming standard coreset baselines at most budgets. This advantage generalizes to public UEA regular multivariate time series benchmarks specifically when class-discriminative information is purely geometric.

**comment/C1：** Code available at https://github.com/khalidchdid/SOTS

</details>

### 90. [JevBench: Metamorphic Coherence Testing for Typed Probabilistic Decision Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31533v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31533

**作者：** Chen Feng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31533v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31533v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 JevBench：一个无金标签的变形关系测试基准，用 50 条覆盖表示、批次独立性、概率测度、逻辑顺序与选项集条件五个维度的变形关系，检验带类型概率决策模型在改写、否定、组合、更换选项或换批次时输出概率是否自洽。

**相关性简评：** 其「固定输入、只改问法与批次」的一致性检验协议可供核查 LVR 中 latent 推理状态与最终答案是否随表面改写保持稳定、批次组成是否干扰视觉证据使用，但材料完全不涉及视觉或多模态，迁移需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** JevBench: Metamorphic Coherence Testing for Typed Probabilistic Decision Models

**abstract/A1：** Typed probabilistic decision models return distributions over specified answers, such as yes or no, a set of options or levels on an ordered scale. We ask whether their probabilities remain coherent when questions about the same input are reworded, negated, combined, given different options or placed in different batches. JevBench tests this coherence without gold labels. Its 50 metamorphic relations each test one law of probability or choice across five dimensions: representation, batch independence, probability measure, logical order and choice-set conditioning. Each test changes the question or batch while keeping the input fixed. Every model receives the same requests, fixed in advance. JevBench-240 contains 12,000 tests across 240 synthetic cases in 12 decision domains. A fixed subset of 1,200 tests, JevBench-mini, closely reproduces the full-suite ranking (Spearman 0.983). Across 21 openly released models, coherence scores range from 56.5 to 83.9. Batch independence holds for most models. Additivity fails broadly, particularly for complements, where the probabilities of a proposition and its negation should sum to one. A uniform reference model ignores the input and scores 89.4 at chance accuracy, exceeding every evaluated model's coherence score. Among decoders, accuracy ranges from 82.4% to 89.2%, while coherence ranges from 64.2 to 83.9. These results show why both measures are needed to assess decision models. JevBench is available as an open-source Python package.

**comment/C1：** 31 pages, 5 figures

</details>

### 91. [Agent Evaluation Without Ground Truth: A Null Proportion Perspective](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31539v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31539

**作者：** Brian M. Cho、Michael Lindon、Nathan Kallus

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、math.ST、stat.AP、stat.ME

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31539v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31539v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究无外部 ground truth 时的 agent 质量评估：用 e-values 序列替代标签作为正确性统计证据，将质量定义为轨迹上正确决策的加权和，构造上下界估计与置信集，并在 Claude Opus 与 Haiku 改进 Python 包运行时的案例中演示。

**相关性简评：** 其轨迹级决策质量的统计估计与置信集，可能为 LVR 中缺少标签的推理步评价、停止决策与轨迹贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索，但 e-value 假设能否对应 latent 推理步骤尚需阅读正文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Agent Evaluation Without Ground Truth: A Null Proportion Perspective

**abstract/A1：** The correctness of actions taken by agents is typically evaluated against known, externally verified ground truth labels, such as whether a proof is correct or whether code compiles and passes unit tests. However, as coding and science agents are entrusted with more end-to-end autonomy -- proposing interventions, running experiments, and deciding what to deploy and investigate next -- whether an agent's actions genuinely improve an outcome must be inferred from noisy, often inconclusive experiments. To evaluate agents in this setting, we define agent quality as a weighted sum of correct decisions along its trajectory, using sequences of $e$-values as statistical evidence regarding correctness in place of ground-truth labels. Our framework accommodates arbitrarily dependent decisions, data-dependent trajectory termination, dynamically generated hypotheses, and quality measures defined after the trajectory concludes. We construct upper and lower bound estimators and confidence sets for agent quality with statistical guarantees that hold uniformly over agent trajectory distributions and establish instance-wise sharpness of our estimator class. We demonstrate our methods with a case study comparing the success of Claude Opus and Claude Haiku in improving the runtime of an open-source Python package.

</details>

### 92. [Denoising Diffusion with Progressive Posterior Sampling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31558v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31558

**作者：** Zeyu Luo、Shuai Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31558v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31558v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 progressive posterior sampling（PPS）：在反向扩散中用闭式高斯近似后验，引导局部先验样本朝近似后验均值移动，并投影到球面水平集以贴合噪声图像流形，从而在无需 SVD 与噪声方差先验的条件下求解含噪线性逆问题。

**相关性简评：** 其「闭式后验均值引导 + 局部流形投影」的采样状态更新思路，可供核查能否用于 diffusion 式 latent 推理中约束推理状态与先验几何一致；但论文本身面向图像复原，与 VLM 推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Denoising Diffusion with Progressive Posterior Sampling

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion models provide effective generative priors for solving noisy linear inverse problems. However, existing posterior sampling methods may require singular value decomposition (SVD) of the measurement operator or prior knowledge of the measurement noise variance, while guidance based on local gradients provides only a limited view of posterior geometry. We propose progressive posterior sampling (PPS) with manifold projection, which automatically estimates the measurement noise variance and avoids SVD. During reverse diffusion, PPS constructs a Gaussian approximation to the posterior distribution in closed form and guides a sample drawn from the local prior toward the approximate posterior mean. We then project the guided sample onto a spherical level set that approximates the local noisy image manifold, promoting consistency with the local geometry of the diffusion prior. Experiments on FFHQ and ImageNet across four restoration tasks and three measurement noise levels demonstrate competitive reconstruction accuracy and perceptual quality by PPS.

</details>

### 93. [Safe Autoformalization: Sufficiency and Necessity with Entailment Graphs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31571v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31571

**作者：** Umut A. Acar、Eli Goldweber

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31571v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31571v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究「安全自动形式化」：用 LLM 生成候选公式，按逻辑强度组织成由求解器判定的 Entailment Graph，通过 sufficient 与 necessary 两个前沿把自然语言陈述夹住，并给出歧义残差与 Lean 机检的可靠性证明。

**相关性简评：** 其「充分/必要双侧认证＋逐步局部检查＋sound oracle 保证」的验证结构，可能为 latent 推理状态的证据充分性与停止判据提供可核查的形式化线索，但与视觉或多模态状态生成无直接关联，需人工判断可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Safe Autoformalization: Sufficiency and Necessity with Entailment Graphs

**abstract/A1：** Autoformalization translates a natural-language statement into a formula that captures its intent, which depends on the statement's context: the background that disambiguates it. LLMs make autoformalization practical, but their probabilistic output carries no formal guarantees. We propose techniques for safe autoformalization that certify one-sided logical adequacy: a formula sufficient for the intent is safe to enforce, and a formula necessary for it is safe to rely on. We use LLMs to generate candidate formulas and order them by logical strength in an Entailment Graph (EG), an ordering a solver decides. Each edge carries a residual and a co-residual, the two adjoints of the entailment order, all fixed by the candidate pool alone. In a context, two searches return the sufficient frontier, the weakest candidates that entail the statement, and the necessary frontier, the strongest candidates the statement entails; each step is one local check against an edge's residual or co-residual. The frontiers bracket the statement and yield the ambiguity residue, which holds exactly of the situations the candidates certify neither as satisfying nor as violating it; the statement is ambiguous precisely when the residue is satisfiable. For natural-language statements and contexts, an LLM entailment oracle decides the checks; it is sound if it accepts only checks that hold, and complete if it accepts every check that holds. We prove that a sound oracle makes the search safe regardless of pool quality, and that a complete one makes the frontiers tight. On security-critical AWS properties, EGs are safe in all 20 cases of an expert-adjudicated study, where majority vote over equivalence clusters and Universal Self-Consistency are unsafe in 25% and 10%. An ablation with the same oracle but no graph is unsafe in 25% and rejects every candidate in another 30%. We machine-checked our proofs in Lean.

**comment/C1：** 34 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. The results are machine-checked in Lean 4

</details>

### 94. [Latent Channel Completion for Forecasting in Sensor Networks with Failed Detectors](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31575v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31575

**作者：** Mehran Shabanpour、Sadaf Khademi、Maryam Hosseini、Haiyan Xu、Konstantinos N. Plataniotis、Arash Mohammadi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.HC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31575v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31575v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究传感器网络中检测器失效时的预测退化问题，提出 Latent Channel Completion：在通道轴做联合嵌入预测，训练时掩码部分传感器并从存活通道预测其 latent 表示（stop-gradient 目标），推理时用与预测器共享参数的算子补全失联通道，并与跨通道 ridge 插补比较。

**相关性简评：** 其「在表示空间而非原始数值上补全缺失通道」的掩码预测机制，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据缺失或被筛除时如何从存活输入重建内部视觉状态提供线索，可供核查；与多模态推理本身无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Latent Channel Completion for Forecasting in Sensor Networks with Failed Detectors

**abstract/A1：** Monitoring networks for traffic and utility infrastructure lose sensors routinely, and forecasting models that couple sensors together to gain accuracy also inherit an exposure to those losses. When a detector stops reporting, the substituted value is embedded as though it were a reading and propagates through the shared representation that couples the network, degrading forecasts for sensors that are still healthy. Because these models are selected on benchmarks where every sensor reports, the exposure is absent from the numbers used to choose them. We introduce Latent Channel Completion, a channel-axis joint embedding predictive objective that reconstructs missing sensors' latent representations rather than their values, since a coupling operator consumes embeddings and never sees raw readings. Channels are masked during training and their representations predicted from surviving channels against stop-gradient targets; at inference the operator fills in whichever sensors the monitoring system reports as dark, using parameters shared with the forecaster. On three highway detector networks, after half of each network goes dark, the accuracy advantage of coupling changes by -1.0, -0.5 and +8.8 percentage points, against losses of 10.2 to 50.3 points for the unmodified forecaster, which on one network falls behind an uncoupled reference entirely. Against cross-channel ridge imputation drawing on the same surviving sensors, completing the latent lowers error by a further 13.9% and 28.6%, and on complete inputs, the method matches its backbone. The benefit tracks how much a network gains from coupling when intact, giving operators a criterion evaluable before any outage occurs.

</details>

**title/T1：** Provably Near-Optimal PQ in the Extended Zador Model

**abstract/A1：** This paper investigates Product Quantization (PQ) Optimization with Gaussian data. It offers three key contributions (i) a proof that SVD is the optimal preconditioning rotation for PQ; (ii) a new Extended Zador (EZ) estimator of the $k$-means quantization cost that is accurate in low bit rates and low dimensions; and (iii) a novel segmentation algorithm based on 1-d bin packing of global bit allocations. The result is a simple algorithm (EZPQ) with strong approximation guarantees. It matches OPQ's empirical accuracy while providing a per-instance distortion lower bound certificate under the Gaussian EZ cost model. On typical real embedding spectra, EZPQ with 2 bits per coordinate is often certifiably within 1% of the optimum in this model. It also consistently achieves a lower reconstruction error than all random-rotation-based algorithms such as EDEN, E-RaBitQ, and TurboQuant.

</details>

**内容简述：** 该论文对监督式与自监督 ViT 做频谱分析，发现监督 ViT 的 MLP 层向 patch 表示引入高频扰动、破坏其空间组织，并提出轻量频谱正则 Spec²R 微调 MLP 层，以恢复物体对齐的 patch 表示与注意力图，同时提升对抗鲁棒性并保持分类精度。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Spec$^2$R: Recovering Emergent Properties in Supervised Vision Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Vision Transformers (ViTs) have achieved strong performance across computer vision tasks, but the quality of their learned representations differs drastically depending on the training paradigm. While self-supervised ViTs often demonstrate emergent properties, such as object-aligned patch representations and attention maps, supervised ViTs typically lack these properties, even when trained with strong data augmentations. Understanding the origin of this difference is important for explaining and controlling the object-level structure. To investigate it, we perform a spectral analysis of supervised and self-supervised models, and identify a key distinction: MLP layers in supervised ViTs introduce high-frequency variations into patch representations, disrupting their spatial organization. Motivated by this finding, we propose Spec$^2$R, a lightweight spectral regularization method that fine-tunes the MLP layers of pretrained supervised ViTs. Spec$^2$R recovers object-aligned patch representations and attention maps, while improving adversarial robustness and preserving competitive classification accuracy.

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Adapt, Label, Distill: Foundation-Model Supervision for Efficient Object Detection

**abstract/A1：** Object detectors often transfer poorly to specialized domains, where box annotations are scarce and deployment requires compact, real-time models. Large vision foundation models can provide offline supervision, but their zero-shot predictions may be poorly aligned with the target domain. We present an adapt-label-distill pipeline that uses limited target annotations to specialize a foundation teacher and transfer its supervision to compact detectors. We adapt SAM3 on the labeled subset, generate pseudo-labels for the remaining unlabeled images, and train YOLOv11 students with confidence-guided supervision. Teacher confidence weights pseudo-label losses, while zero-gating retains uncertain hypotheses during assignment without applying their associated training losses. Experiments across six target domains and three student capacities show substantial gains in several domains, while revealing limited or negative transfer in others. Teacher comparisons under a common hard-label training recipe support the choice of SAM3, and comparisons with an EfficientTeacher adaptation provide additional evidence against an online SSOD baseline. With YOLOv11m, our pipeline improves over STAC-style self-training by up to 15.3 AP and reaches 51.6 AP on Garbage, compared with 54.1 under full supervision. On NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, the deployed student achieves 188 FPS versus 2.9 FPS for SAM3, benefiting from foundation-model supervision without incurring the teacher's deployment cost. Code is available at https://github.com/zk2172-columbia/ProjectAdaptLabelDistill\_ObjectDetection.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the 7th Workshop on Real-World Surveillance: Applications and Challenges (RWS), WACV 2027. 12 pages, 6 figures, including supplementary material

### 98. [Noise-Level Adjacency in Diffusion Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31605v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31605

**作者：** T. Y. Tsui、Jiatao Gu、Lingjie Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31605v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31605v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究扩散模型为何在噪声级之间共享网络权重有益，提出共享网络的拟合误差受相邻后验均值距离与网络在相邻嵌入间可变化量的约束，并用高斯混合与 CIFAR-10 实验区分「相邻性」与「方向」，据此给出按距离等分噪声级的划分方式。

**相关性简评：** 其关于共享网络须在相邻条件嵌入间平滑过渡、误差受相邻状态距离限制的论证，可能为循环或多步 latent 推理中跨迭代/深度共享权重及深度、位置嵌入的排序设计提供核查线索，但任务本身是图像扩散训练，与视觉推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Noise-Level Adjacency in Diffusion Training

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion models train one network across all noise levels, although their training objective is pointwise in the noise level. If training on each pair of adjacent levels were an independent problem, separate networks with the same total parameter count would be expected to match one shared network. But in practice, on images, sharing weights across levels gives better results, which hints at an implicit dependence on their order. An order fixes both which levels are adjacent and the direction in which they run. In this paper, we show that, of the two, the benefit of sharing rests on adjacency in the noise-level embedding. The fitting error of a shared network is bounded below by the distances between neighbouring posterior means, minus the change the network can make between neighbouring embeddings. We first distinguish adjacency from direction: on a Gaussian mixture and CIFAR-10, reversing the embeddings keeps every neighbour and leaves the fitting error unchanged, whereas shuffling them raises it. Second, we rule out sharing between distant levels as the source of the benefit: separate networks on contiguous ranges match the shared network at its width, and with the parameters fixed, breaking adjacency at the same places costs less than 40\\% of a full shuffle. Dividing the levels at equal shares of these distances lowers the error of all but the smallest networks. We therefore show that the order of the noise levels enters a diffusion model through adjacency, with its direction being a design choice. Our code is available at https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/Noise-Level-Adjacency-in-Diffusion-Training.

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Monitorable-by-design architectures for a post-Astra world: a compartmentalization-based approach

**abstract/A1：** Frontier models like GPT-6 Astra are increasingly able to do substantial reasoning without a monitorable chain of thought, chains of thought are becoming less legible, and are often monitored asynchronously to reduce cost. With the future of chain of thought monitoring unclear, it may be necessary to design LLMs with monitorability in mind. We propose a modification to existing LLM architectures based on GRAM, SGTM, DEMix, BTS, and similar methods to compartmentalize dangerous capabilities so that their use, especially in combination with dangerous reasoning types that may indicate strategic adversarial use, can be monitored more cheaply than chain of thought in a way that might outlast monitorable chain of thought. We propose several variants of this architecture designed to balance tradeoffs and discuss other benefits, such as capability removal.

### 100. [Multi-agent System for Automatic Discovery of Pareto-optimal Meta-solvers for PDEs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31611v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31611

**作者：** Youngkyu Lee、Shanqing Liu、Jerome Darbon、George EM Karniadakis

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31611v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31611v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作构建多智能体框架，让语言模型智能体提出、批评、实现并评估由 Krylov 方法、预条件子、块分解与神经算子拼装的 PDE 求解器，内部用非支配排序遗传算法演化出六项指标上的 Pareto 前沿，并在多个声散射、弹性与热弹性问题上与单智能体对比。

**相关性简评：** 其「多智能体提议—评估＋多目标 Pareto 演化搜索」的流程或可供核查：是否能用于在精度与计算成本之间搜索 LVR 的推理管线或状态更新配置，但与视觉推理主线距离较远，需较多迁移判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Multi-agent System for Automatic Discovery of Pareto-optimal Meta-solvers for PDEs

**abstract/A1：** Designing linear solvers for discretized partial differential equations requires problem-specific expertise. We present a multi-agent framework, in which language-model agents propose, critique, implement, and evaluate solver configurations assembled from Krylov methods, preconditioners, block factorizations, and neural operators. Inside the proposing agent, a non-dominated sorting genetic evolutionary algorithm evolves the population of meta-solvers toward the Pareto front of six measured quantities, so that one run returns a front of trade-offs rather than a single tuned solver. The system runs on small open-weight language models served on a single laptop, and we compare it with a single agent on four problems. For three-dimensional acoustic scattering and elasticity, it delivers 47 and 48 convergent hybrid solvers out of 60 candidates. Relative to the Jacobi-preconditioned Krylov baselines, the best of the discovered solvers reduce the iteration counts by factors of 4.7 and 60 and the online solve time by factors of 2.3 and 3.0, whereas the single agent produces no executable plan. For coupled dynamic thermoelasticity in two and three dimensions, where the baselines fail, it completes 98 of 100 transient candidates and, compared with the single agent, reaches a given accuracy 15 times faster in two dimensions and a displacement error 20 times lower in three dimensions.

**comment/C1：** 49 pages, 9 figures, 11 tables

</details>

### 101. [Eliciting sandbagged LLM capability via structural interventions on attention-head functional networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31615v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31615

**作者：** Manzi Fabrice Niyigaba、Ishan Verma Prasad、Sansheng Cao、Zheng Huang、Yujun Yan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31615v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31615v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建注意力头激活的功能网络图，发现 sandbagging 时社区内功能连接下降，并据此消融连接变化最大的注意力头以恢复被抑制的能力。

**相关性简评：** 其「注意力头功能连接图＋头级消融」可作为一种考察内部状态中信息承载与因果贡献的工具，或可核查 LVR 中注意力结构对 latent 内容与视觉证据路由的影响，但论文本身不涉及多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Eliciting sandbagged LLM capability via structural interventions on attention-head functional networks

**abstract/A1：** Reliably evaluating the capabilities of advanced AI systems is critical for safe development and deployment, yet such evaluations may be undermined by sandbagging, a situation in which a model strategically suppresses capabilities it possesses. Existing work has developed controlled sandbagging settings and methods for detecting or eliciting hidden capabilities, but comparatively little is known about how a model's internal neural computation changes when its capabilities are suppressed. In this work, we study sandbagging through the lens of internal functional organization. Inspired by network neuroscience, we construct functional graphs from attention-head activations and compare their organization under honest and sandbagging conditions while holding the model architecture and weights fixed. Surprisingly, across model architectures and community detection methods, we find a consistent structural signature in which sandbagging is associated with reduced functional connectivity within detected communities. We further demonstrate that this reorganization can guide capability elicitation. Ablating attention heads that exhibit the largest connectivity changes substantially recovers suppressed performance while largely preserving performance under honest behavior. Moreover, incorporating these structural signals further improves existing inference-level and weight-level elicitation methods. Together, our results show that sandbagging is accompanied by systematic reorganization of internal computation and demonstrate that functional network structure can provide both a mechanistic lens for understanding capability suppression and a practical signal for recovering hidden capabilities.

</details>

### 102. [Wavefront: Low-Rank Drafting with Parallel Causal Refinement for Speculative Decoding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31638v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31638

**作者：** Huy Huu Nguyen、Xin Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31638v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31638v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** Wavefront 针对并行块草稿丢失块内 token 依赖的问题，把完整 lm\_head 换成低秩 base，并让校正头以整段草稿前缀为条件，用少量并行 Jacobi 迭代修正，配合固定迭代预算实现单 CUDA graph 的加速推测解码。

**相关性简评：** 该文属纯文本推理加速，不涉及视觉证据或答案使用，但其固定步数的并行 Jacobi 迭代细化块内状态，可能为并行 latent 状态更新及计算预算与停止设计提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Wavefront: Low-Rank Drafting with Parallel Causal Refinement for Speculative Decoding

**abstract/A1：** Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by letting a cheap drafter propose tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Parallel block drafters such as DFlash and P-EAGLE propose a whole block in one forward pass, but they lose the dependence between tokens in the block; DSpark restores part of it with a lightweight correction head that runs sequentially. Measuring DSpark, we find that this head overrides the base prediction on most slots, so the expensive base readout through the target's full lm\_head mostly provides a seed. We therefore propose Wavefront, which follows a simple principle: shrink the base and strengthen the correction head. Wavefront replaces the full lm\_head with a learned low-rank base, conditions the correction head on the whole drafted prefix within the same block, and resolves it with a few parallel Jacobi passes. A fixed pass budget makes the draft step free of data-dependent control flow, so we capture it as a single CUDA graph in vLLM with fused kernels. On Qwen3-8B, Wavefront improves throughput over xPress, DSpark and DFlash by 2.6%, 10.7% and 23.6% on average across math, code, chat and agentic benchmarks, and by 9.6%, 14.3% and 28.9% on SPEED-Bench long-context prompts. On Qwen3.8-27B it leads DFlash2, DSpark and xPress by 7.6%, 10.6% and 5.0%, and by 7.4%, 5.8% and 6.0% on the same long-context prompts. The gains persist as serving load grows to concurrency 32.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 6 figures

</details>

### 103. [Reward Basis Decomposition for Interpreting Preference Heterogeneity](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31640v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31640

**作者：** Mohamed I. Eldagla、Ifesi Onubogu、Prerana Rane、Harsh Sharma、Rachel Freedman

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31640v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31640v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Reward Basis Decomposition，将各用户的奖励权重拆成群体项与个体项，再用概念对齐和稀疏自编码器分别解释这两部分；在合成对照上验证能恢复植入的个体方向，并在 PRISM、Community Alignment 上发现个体项几乎不能带来超出群体方向的预测收益。

**相关性简评：** 其「共享方向／个体方向」分解加 SAE 解释 latent 表示的思路，可供核查能否用于区分 LVR 内部状态中的任务共享成分与样本特有成分，以及「单一方向主导」是否对应 latent 信息坍缩；但原文无视觉推理实验。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reward Basis Decomposition for Interpreting Preference Heterogeneity

**abstract/A1：** Canonical reward models specify the optimization target for AI policies, so understanding the values they encode is important for ensuring AI alignment. Existing interpretability techniques interpret reward models with a single reward head, which cannot distinguish between the values that a population shares and those that vary among individuals. We introduce Reward Basis Decomposition (RBD), which splits per-user weights into a population term and a per-user term. This yields a shared population direction and individual user directions that are analyzed separately via concept alignment and sparse autoencoder decomposition. We verify that RBD can recover artificially planted per-user directions on a synthetic control, then apply it to two real-world multi-preference datasets, PRISM and Community Alignment. In both, we find no individual-user structure, suggesting that a single direction in the reward embedding space accounts for most preferences. We verify that RBD can recover artificially planted per-user directions on a synthetic control, then apply it to two real-world multi-preference datasets, PRISM and Community Alignment. In both, we find no reliable predictive benefit from the fitted per-user terms beyond the shared population direction under our setup. Code and the synthetic dataset are available at https://github.com/RachelFreedman/RBD.

</details>

### 104. [MSW: a Multi-Scale Sliced Wasserstein Distance Between Image Distributions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31647v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31647

**作者：** Youssef Haouchat、Stanislas Ducotterd、Bassam El Rawas、Michael Unser

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、eess.SP

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31647v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31647v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出像素空间的 MSW 距离：用固定多尺度 DCT 滤波器组卷积图像、池化响应，再以一维 Wasserstein 距离比较图像分布，并配套精确两样本检验；实验称其比 latent 空间度量更敏感、所需样本更少，且仍能反映语义变化。

**相关性简评：** 其免训练、像素空间分布距离与校准检验可供核查作为 LVR 中视觉细节保留及 latent 表征灵敏度的对照评价工具，但与推理状态生成机制无直接关系，迁移有效性需进一步确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MSW: a Multi-Scale Sliced Wasserstein Distance Between Image Distributions

**abstract/A1：** We propose the multi-scale sliced Wasserstein (MSW) distance between image distributions, which operates in pixel space and requires no trained network. MSW convolves images with a fixed bank of discrete cosine filters at several scales, pools the responses over all positions, and compares the resulting one-dimensional distributions using the Wasserstein distance. We pair MSW with an exact two-sample test that gives calibrated p-values. Most metrics compare two image sets in the latent space of a pretrained network. We show that these metrics are insensitive to simple perturbations of the images, because the latent space is nearly invariant to them. In contrast, MSW detects smaller perturbations than latent-space metrics and needs far fewer images to do so. Although it uses no learned features, it still detects semantic changes of the image distribution. Finally, MSW matches or outperforms existing Wasserstein-based metrics in our experiments.

</details>

### 105. [Neural Interoperability Protocols: Specifying Compatibility Before Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31670v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31670

**作者：** Alireza Bagheri

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31670v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31670v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「神经互操作性协议」（NIPs）这一先规范后训练的框架，把跨独立训练模型的中间表示交换定义为公开接口义务：规定交换边界、交换包（packet）的语义与可接受条件，以及接收方必须支持的下游计算；并通过检索、视觉与连续记忆实验，配合能力匹配对照、信息扣留和接口包干预，检验任务成功是否等同于可互操作。

**相关性简评：** 其「共享语义监督使中间状态可被独立接收方直接使用」「任务成功不等于状态可交换」的结论，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真正承载可复用视觉内容、以及答案正确性是否代表 latent 内容被使用，提供训练与评测上的核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Neural Interoperability Protocols: Specifying Compatibility Before Training

**abstract/A1：** Neural networks are increasingly developed as reusable components, yet their intermediate representations remain difficult to exchange across independently trained models. Existing approaches can align representations or encourage compatible features, but successful transfer between particular models does not by itself define what future implementations must satisfy to interoperate. We introduce Neural Interoperability Protocols (NIPs), a specification-first framework that treats neural compatibility as a set of public interface obligations rather than a property inferred solely from model-pair performance. A NIP specifies an exchange boundary, the semantics and admissibility conditions of exchanged packets, and the downstream computations that recipients must support, independently of the architectures and training procedures implementing it. We investigate this distinction through controlled retrieval, vision, and continuous-memory experiments involving independently trained models, differing architectures and objectives, and later training cohorts. Matched-competence controls demonstrate that native task success does not ensure interoperability, while shared semantic supervision enables substantial direct transfer in the evaluated settings. Withheld-information experiments show that recipient models can continue computations requiring information unavailable to donors at exchange time. Partial-contract experiments and packet interventions further establish that observed compatibility is conditional on the semantics, packet populations, and recipient continuations being evaluated. Together, these results support public neural interface specifications as a framework for designing prospective component exchange and distinguishing demonstrated interoperability from stronger conformance claims.

**comment/C1：** 44 pages. Includes experimental evaluations and appendices

</details>

### 106. [Curvature-Equilibrated Policy Optimization for Deep Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31680v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31680

**作者：** Gang Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31680v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31680v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 EQUIP：用轨迹信息构造搜索子空间，以投影 Hessian 建立有界局部度量来平衡正负曲率，并配合梯度混合与曲率筛选调整 actor 更新，集成进 SAC 在 6 个 MuJoCo 连续控制任务上验证样本效率。

**相关性简评：** 其曲率均衡的二阶式策略梯度更新，可能可供核查用于 latent 推理策略的 RL 训练稳定性与更新方向，但原文为连续控制设定，向 VLM 推理迁移的有效性尚未验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Curvature-Equilibrated Policy Optimization for Deep Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Gradient-based actor optimization is central to deep reinforcement learning. However, conventional first-order optimizers do not explicitly exploit the local curvature of neural actor losses. We propose EQUIP (Curvature-Equilibrated Gradients for Policy Search), a novel approach that seeks to balance local contraction and expansion of the actor parameter space by equilibrating positive and negative curvature. EQUIP constructs a trajectory-informed search subspace and uses the projected Hessian of actor loss to build a bounded local metric for curvature equilibration. First-order loss matching preserves the approximated first-order decrease in actor loss. Meanwhile, gradient mixing and curvature-based gradient selection adjust the gradient applied for actor optimization. We establish the geometric properties of curvature equilibration, derive bounds on gradient alignment and magnitude, and identify conditions for improved actor loss reduction and convergence toward stationarity under direct gradient updates. We integrate EQUIP into Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) without modifying its actor loss, critic learning, or replay mechanism. Experiments on 6 MuJoCo continuous control benchmarks show that the resulting EQUIP-SAC algorithm achieves higher mean sample efficiency than SAC and two second-order policy optimization baselines. Ablation studies further highlight the benefits of curvature equilibration and trajectory-informed geometry for policy training.

</details>
