### 107. [GeoMVGen: Joint Appearance-Geometry Modeling for Multi-View Video Generation in Robotic Manipulation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31689v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31689

**作者：** Qiaoqiao Jia、Guile Wu、Dongfeng Bai

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31689v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31689v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GeoMVGen，在视频扩散 transformer 上联合生成机器操作场景的多视角 RGB 与 pointmap 视频，借助模态专属适配模块、跨模态残差连接及带几何监督的跨视角投影机制，实现外观与几何时序一致的可控多视角预测。

**相关性简评：** 不直接研究 VLM 推理，但其 pointmap 一致性监督与跨视角投影对齐可作为「几何与视觉细节如何保留在内部状态」的表示与训练线索，可供核查其 latent 是否真正承载几何信息而非仅像素外观。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GeoMVGen: Joint Appearance-Geometry Modeling for Multi-View Video Generation in Robotic Manipulation

**abstract/A1：** Robotic manipulation requires predicting how robot-object interactions evolve over time, encompassing both visual appearance and scene geometry. In multi-camera settings, such predictions need to capture the evolving 3D scene consistently across viewpoints, while supporting controllable generation under different robot actions and camera configurations. Existing video generation models provide strong priors for visual appearance and motion but typically lack explicit geometric modeling. Meanwhile, recent advances in geometry-aware and multi-view generation have explored joint appearance-geometry modeling and cross-view consistency, yet generating temporally coherent appearance and geometry across multiple viewpoints under robotic manipulation conditions remains challenging. In this work, we propose GeoMVGen, a framework for joint multi-view RGB and pointmap video generation in robotic manipulation. Built on a video diffusion transformer, our framework employs modality-specific adaptation modules to capture the distinct characteristics of appearance and geometry, while using cross-modal residual connections to facilitate information exchange between the two modalities. To establish geometric correspondences across viewpoints, we further introduce a cross-view projection mechanism with complementary geometric supervisions, combining pointmap consistency with geometry foundation model-guided feature alignment. These designs enable controllable generation of temporally evolving multi-view observations with coherent appearance and geometrically consistent scene structures. Extensive experiments on 4D video generation dataset comprising simulated and real-world robotic manipulation scenarios demonstrate that GeoMVGen outperforms state-of-the-art methods in video quality, geometric accuracy, and cross-view consistency.

**comment/C1：** Technical Report

</details>

### 108. [EventSSM: Causal Spatial-State Modelling for Asynchronous Events Event-Depth Estimation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31720v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31720

**作者：** Sadiq O. Macaulay、Dipon Ghosh、Hadfield Simon

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31720v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31720v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 EventSSM：以按时间顺序到达的事件包更新循环记忆，因果地维持空间状态来做事件相机度量深度估计，并用相机位姿几何变换与可微渲染把异步深度预测对齐到参考时刻的监督。

**相关性简评：** 其「持续潜在状态 + 分组增量更新 + 状态/读出分项消融」可为 LVR 中 latent 状态的维护与按证据流更新、以及异步预测与稀疏监督的对齐提供可供核查的线索，但任务本身是稠密深度感知，不涉及语言推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EventSSM: Causal Spatial-State Modelling for Asynchronous Events Event-Depth Estimation

**abstract/A1：** Event cameras report asynchronous brightness changes, yet metric-depth supervision is typically available only at sparsely sampled reference timestamps. Aggregating events into frame-like representations simplifies learning but can obscure the fine-grained temporal structure of the original event stream. We introduce EventSSM, a causal spatial-state framework for event-associated metric-depth estimation using a recurrent memory updated by chronological event packets. To bridge asynchronous predictions and frame-time supervision, predicted event depths are geometrically transported using calibrated camera poses and differentiably rendered at reference timestamps. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate improvements over established event-depth methods across multiple depth-error measures. Controlled ablations further examine cross-modal initialization, temporal recurrence, individual state, readout, and supervision components, and packet subdivision. Together, these findings establish EventSSM as an effective framework for causal event-associated metric-depth estimation, combining persistent spatial context with physically timed state retention.

</details>

### 109. [Tokenization and Architecture Jointly Allocate Component Roles in Time Series Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31730v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31730

**作者：** Mingyu Kim、Doguk Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31730v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31730v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出时间序列 Transformer 的时间探测框架，用 15 个 token 级诊断任务、以子层间线性可解码性增益衡量 attention 与 FFN 各自构造了哪些时间特征，并结合 patch/变量 tokenization 对比、激活替换、knockout 与去 attention 重训进行验证，结论是组件角色由 tokenization 与架构共同分配。

**相关性简评：** 其「逐子层可解码性增益 + activation patching/knockout」的组件归因流程，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 表示由哪一模块构造、以及答案是否真正依赖这些表示；但属时间序列领域，迁移到视觉推理需较多判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Tokenization and Architecture Jointly Allocate Component Roles in Time Series Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Time series transformers have achieved strong forecasting performance, yet it remains unclear which of their components, attention or the feed-forward network (FFN), constructs temporal features, and how tokenization such as patching changes this. We propose a temporal probing framework that uses 15 token-level diagnostic tasks to measure feature construction as the gain in linear decodability of temporal properties from one sub-layer to the next (a matched MLP probe already saturates at the embedding). It targets models whose probed representations are read by a linear forecasting head. Applied to 5 supervised models trained on 8 long-term forecasting benchmarks, it finds that the constructing component is not fixed but allocated by the interaction of tokenization and architecture. Under patch tokenization (PatchTST), the FFN's gain exceeds attention's in probing on all 8 datasets, and its 8-dataset mean is 3.2x attention's. Without attention, the FFN alone reaches nearly the same total gain, both when attention is removed from a trained model and when PatchTST is trained without it, and the retrained model forecasts within a few percent of the full model. In probing, attention dominates under variate tokenization (iTransformer); in CATS, cross-attention is the only input path. In a controlled manipulation of PatchTST, single-scalar tokens (P=1) nearly eliminate the FFN's construction, while one more point per token (P=2) restores it. Our forecasting-side interventions (activation patching, knockout, and training without attention) establish component-level reliance and sufficiency. These results offer a representational reading of prior findings on the gains from patching, the competitiveness of self-attention-free models (TSMixer, PatchMLP), and the distinct role of cross-attention in CATS.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 42 pages, 3 figures. Code: https://github.com/mingyu-11/tokenization-component-roles

</details>

### 110. [Geo-SMILE: Statistical Model-Agnostic Interpretability with Local Explanations for Geospatial Machine Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31731v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31731

**作者：** Shadieh Mohammadi、Koorosh Aslansefat

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31731v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31731v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Geo-SMILE，一个模型无关的事后解释框架，用「实质性特征扰动」与「地理位置迁移」两条互补分支，结合 Wasserstein 距离加权的 Ridge 代理模型，将地理坐标响应从特征贡献中分离出来，并在犯罪、房价与网约车需求数据上评估代理保真度。

**相关性简评：** 其按扰动来源分设分支并对预测贡献做加性归因的思路，可能可供核查用于区分 LVR 中内容证据与位置／坐标因素的贡献分配，但该工作面向表格型地理数据、与 VLM 内部状态无直接关联，迁移可行性需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Geo-SMILE: Statistical Model-Agnostic Interpretability with Local Explanations for Geospatial Machine Learning

**abstract/A1：** Conventional post-hoc explanation methods were developed largely for non-spatial inputs and often provide limited explicit treatment of geographic context. We introduce Geo-SMILE, a model-agnostic framework that distinguishes substantive Feature explanation from geographic-position response through complementary perturbation branches. The Feature branch masks substantive predictors while retaining observed coordinates; the Geo branch relocates geographic units while holding substantive predictors fixed. Following the statistical-distance-weighted surrogate principle of SMILE, input-distribution Wasserstein distances determine coalition locality weights and weighted Ridge surrogates approximate expected black-box predictions. GeoSensitivity, signed in the keep orientation, quantifies fitted-model responses to geographic-player relocation under the specified design. Across crime prediction in Hull, housing-price prediction in Seattle and ride-hailing demand in Chicago, held-out weighted surrogate fidelity ranges from $R\_w^2=0.910$ to $0.989$ in the Feature branch and from $0.842$ to $0.906$ in the Geo branch. The framework makes geographic position an explicit object of post-hoc explanation while requiring separate assessment of interpretation, stability and reference dependence.

**comment/C1：** This manuscript is derived from MSc by Research thesis work in Computer Science at the University of Hull, United Kingdom. Source code is publicly available

</details>

### 111. [BEARING: Who Is Talking to Whom? Grounding Acoustic Direction in Vision for Online Multi-Party Conversation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31735v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31735

**作者：** Nader Lobandi、Lombe Chileshe、Mohammad Mehdi Hosseini、Mohammad H. Mahoor

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL、cs.SD

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31735v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31735v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** BEARING 把麦克风阵列测得的声音方向当作几何信号，在线无标签校准后注册到相机图像，作为视觉提示注入 VLM，并与视觉主动说话人检测做可靠性加权融合，还用方向一致性构造可验证奖励来训练说话人/受话人判断。

**相关性简评：** 几何线索作为提示注入 VLM、以及「可验证奖励替代自评」可供核查视觉证据如何进入判断与监督如何分配，显式 lookahead 参数也对应动态计算与停止决策；但任务是多人对话受话人识别，未涉及 latent 推理状态，迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BEARING: Who Is Talking to Whom? Grounding Acoustic Direction in Vision for Online Multi-Party Conversation

**abstract/A1：** Understanding a group conversation means deciding, from video and audio, who is speaking and to whom. Leading systems treat these tasks offline on single-channel clips and align models with a self-evaluation reward. We propose BEARING, a geometry-first alternative built on one measured signal: the direction from which a microphone array beside the camera hears a sound. A label-free calibration learned from the stream registers this direction into the camera image, and an online registry of faces, voices and directions needs no enrollment. The registered direction serves as (i) a visual prompt for a vision-language model, a marker on the speaker or an arrow toward an off-screen source; (ii) one input of a reliability-weighted fusion with visual active-speaker detection, for speakers in the same direction from the array; and (iii) a verifiable reward for alignment: the named speaker must sit where the sound comes from, the confidence must match that check, and always answering "group" earns nothing. Every decision is online, with the lookahead as an explicit parameter. On 9,498 addressee-labelled utterances from three AMI sites and egocentric EasyCom, the direction prompt raises speaker accuracy from 54% to 74%; addressee accuracy moves by about two points, because telling one addressee from the group depends on the words more than on where people are. For co-located speakers on AVDIAR, visual active-speaker detection holds 95% where direction alone falls to 59%. The verifiable reward beats self-evaluation under GRPO, reward-ranked fine-tuning and DPO; shrinking the lookahead from 5 s to 0.5 s costs 4.5 DER points on AMI, and learning the registration online costs a dip in the first two minutes before the system overtakes vision alone. Code and evaluation protocols will be released.

**comment/C1：** 26 pages, 15 figures, 16 tables. Includes supplementary material. Demo video as an ancillary file

</details>

### 112. [LeanWAM: Learning Latent World Action Models from Frozen Video Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31740v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31740

**作者：** Shaolong Li、Hongze Fu、Joyce Chai、Yinpei Dai

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31740v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31740v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** LeanWAM 研究机器人策略需要何种未来表示，发现互补的未来表示可压缩为少量 token 而基本保留动作解码能力，据此用冻结视频生成器提供先验：第一阶段由 Future Extractor 将观测转移压成 32 个预测 token 并读取生成器隐状态作为世界 token，第二阶段蒸馏进轻量策略，实现毫秒级动作块预测。

**相关性简评：** 其「未来表示可压缩为极少量 token 且不损失下游解码」的探测结论与「冻结生成器隐状态读出＋蒸馏监督」流程，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态的表示压缩、任务必要信息保留与监督信号设计；但属机器人动作策略而非推理型 VLM，迁移可行性尚不确定。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LeanWAM: Learning Latent World Action Models from Frozen Video Models

**abstract/A1：** World action models (WAMs) typically adapt large pretrained video generators to jointly predict future observations and robot actions, incurring substantial training and deployment costs. However, it remains unclear which future representations a policy actually needs and how compactly they can be represented. Our probing study shows that complementary future representations can be compressed into a few tokens while retaining most of their action-decoding performance. Motivated by this finding, we introduce LeanWAM, a latent WAM that transfers video priors from a frozen video generator to a lightweight policy via two-stage training. In the first stage, a Future Extractor compresses observed transitions into 32 predictive tokens. These tokens condition the frozen generator and are jointly shaped by action, RGB, semantic, and geometric supervision, while a compact readout of the generator's hidden states supplies complementary world tokens. The second stage distills both representations into the policy, which learns to predict them from current observations while generating actions. With 1.4B parameters and no large-scale embodied pretraining, LeanWAM outperforms strong vision-language-action (VLA) and WAM baselines on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin~2.0. It predicts an action chunk in 25.1\\,ms on an A100 GPU, 12.3--41.5$\\times$ faster than representative WAMs. These results demonstrate that compact predictive supervision can transfer video priors to robust and efficient control.

**comment/C1：** Project Page: https://shaolonl-16.github.io/leanwam/

</details>

### 113. [FN-Prune: Training-Free Expert Pruning with Finite RMSNorm Perturbations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31747v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31747

**作者：** Zeyan Li、Jianfeng Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31747v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31747v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** FN-Prune 提出无需训练的 MoE 专家剪枝准则：固定原始路由与权重，比较减去单个加权专家贡献前后 RMSNorm 输出的平方差作为重要性分数，按每层统一比例删除低分专家，并在 Qwen3、ERNIE、OLMoE 上报告 50% 剪枝下的困惑度与 GSM8K 提升。

**相关性简评：** 其分数以「移除某专家后归一化输出如何变化」衡量真实贡献而非孤立权重，这种归一化敏感的扰动式归因，可能可供核查 latent 推理中按对后续状态影响归因模块／专家贡献与分配计算预算的做法。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FN-Prune: Training-Free Expert Pruning with Finite RMSNorm Perturbations

**abstract/A1：** Expert pruning reduces the memory footprint of mixture-of-experts language models, but retaining model quality depends on which experts are removed. Frequency- and magnitude-based scores measure the expert in isolation and overlook how normalization consumes its contribution: subtracting one expert changes both the direction of the residual stream and the scale applied to what remains. We propose FN-Prune, a training-free criterion that compares the next RMSNorm outputs before and after subtracting each router-weighted expert contribution, holding original routes and weights fixed. Squared differences are averaged over all calibration tokens in one pass; low-scoring experts are physically deleted at uniform per-layer ratios, and inference reroutes among survivors. At 50% expert removal, FN-Prune achieves lower WikiText-2 perplexity than the best published methods on Qwen3, ERNIE, and OLMoE, including a 32% reduction on OLMoE. At the same budget, GSM8K accuracy improves over the best published methods by 7.5 and 7.0 percentage points on Qwen3 and ERNIE, respectively, while multiple-choice gains remain task-dependent.

</details>

**title/T1：** Verified Proof Refactoring with Codex and Qwen

**abstract/A1：** We refactor existing Lean 4 proofs to reduce source length and checking cost while preserving theorem statements and compatibility across Lean versions. A locally served Qwen model uses the open-source Codex CLI to inspect source, retrieve declarations, and test proof replacements. The host keeps a replacement only if it improves the objective and Lean accepts it on every required version. A deterministic CPU pass then refines the verified proofs. On the 60 problems in Lean Refactor Arena, model search achieves a local mean combined score of 82.07, and cleanup raises it to 82.18. The final proofs pass all 127 required proof--version checks. Our system placed first in the open-source LLM track of Lean Refactor Arena at VeriCodeGen.

### 115. [ReCAP: Sequential Concept Acquisition with Guarantees under Imperfect Concept Predictors](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31776v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31776

**作者：** Md Nahiduzzaman、Steven Korevaar、Alireza Bab-Hadiashar、Ruwan Tennakoon

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31776v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31776v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ReCAP，在概念预测器会出错或弃权的前提下序贯获取概念：用区分不同诊断的标签判别目标替代条件信息增益，证明其自适应单调与子模性从而给出贪心固定预算的 (1-1/e) 保证，并结合弃权感知获取与保留诊断的剪枝，在五个医学影像数据集上以更少概念提升诊断可靠性。

**相关性简评：** 其预算受限的序贯证据获取、弃权处理与带保证的剪枝目标，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选和 LOOK/STOP 决策提供可核查的方法线索，但研究对象是可解释概念分类而非 latent 推理状态，迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ReCAP: Sequential Concept Acquisition with Guarantees under Imperfect Concept Predictors

**abstract/A1：** Sequential concept acquisition enables interpretable diagnosis from a compact set of human-understandable findings. Such explanations are useful only if clinicians can trust them, yet most existing methods treat predicted concepts as correct, so a correct diagnosis can rest on incorrectly predicted evidence. We propose Reliable Concept Acquisition with Pruning (ReCAP), which reasons over what the concept predictor reports, including errors and abstentions, and replaces conditional information gain with a label-discriminating objective that separates cases requiring different diagnoses. We prove this objective adaptively monotone and adaptively submodular, yielding a (1-1/e) guarantee for greedy fixed-budget acquisition that degrades boundedly under learned estimates, and combine it with abstention-aware acquisition and diagnosis-preserving pruning to keep explanations short and reliable. Across five medical imaging datasets, ReCAP reduces the share of correct diagnoses supported by at least one incorrectly predicted concept from 27.1% to 9.6% relative to the strongest baseline, while using fewer than half as many concepts and achieving higher diagnostic accuracy.

</details>

### 116. [VISOR: A Vision-Language Selector for Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31780v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31780

**作者：** Seunghan Lee、Jun Seo、Junhyeok Kang、Jaehoon Lee、Sangjun Han、Sungdong Yoo、Minjae Kim、Tae Yoon Lim、Dongwan Kang、Hwanil Choi、Soonyoung Lee、Wonbin Ahn

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31780v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31780v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 VISOR 用于多模态时间序列预测：先用无文本的随机预测器采样多条候选未来，再由 VLM 把候选绘制成一张图表并结合文本选出其中最合适的一条，并以兼顾逐点误差与路径形状的目标训练该选择器。

**相关性简评：** 其「候选生成＋VLM 以图文联合方式筛选/验证一条假设」的流程，可能与 LVR 中多 latent 假设的视觉证据筛选与选择环节相关；形状感知训练目标可供核查选择器是否真正依赖视觉内容而非先验，但任务属时间序列预测，迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VISOR: A Vision-Language Selector for Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting

**abstract/A1：** Recent time-series foundation models (TSFMs) forecast a distribution over futures, and multimodal time-series (TS) forecasting further exploits other modalities to improve forecasting accuracy. However, existing works have two limitations: 1) TSFMs reduce the predictive distribution to its median or mean, flattening diverse futures into a calm line, and 2) multimodal TS forecasting models incorporate text into the forecaster through TS-language alignment, which is substantially weaker than vision-language alignment. To address these limitations, we propose the VIsion-language SelectOR (VISOR), a multimodal TS forecasting framework that selects one plausible future instead of averaging across candidates, leveraging the alignment capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs) to select the most suitable candidate based on textual information. VISOR consists of two components: 1) a text-free stochastic predictor that samples diverse candidate futures, and 2) a VLM selector that reads the candidates as a single chart image and selects one based on the text. To avoid overly calm forecasting paths, we train the selector with a shape-aware target that evaluates each candidate based on both point-wise error and path shape. Across three benchmarks covering ten datasets, VISOR achieves the best average ranking in both point and volatility errors compared with TSFMs and multimodal TS forecasting models. Code: https://github.com/seunghan96/VISOR.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31790

**作者：** Asadullah Maliyawala、Andrej Lisal

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在相同原始字节、文档顺序和近似相同的每步字节预算下，比较 350M 参数的 MEGABYTE 式字节 patch Transformer（64 字节滑动局部解码器）与 8k BPE 解码器，并报告 bpb 差异、下游任务结果及影响结论的评测陷阱。

**相关性简评：** 其固定 patch 表示与匹配数据孪生对照、以及「bits per token 误报为 bits per byte」、上下文外推等评测陷阱，可供核查视觉 patch 粒度与 latent 表示比较的公平性，但论文本身不涉及多模态推理或推理期 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Byte Patches versus BPE at Matched Data: A Matched-Twin Comparison at 350M Parameters

**abstract/A1：** We compare a MEGABYTE-style byte-patch Transformer with a 64-byte sliding local decoder (local64) to a matched byte-level 8k BPE decoder (BPE-8k) under identical raw bytes, document order, and approximately matched bytes per optimizer step: 350M parameters and 10 billion training bytes. Under matched-span document sliding (identical scored byte ranges), BPE-8k leads with relative gaps of -5.2%, -4.9%, -9.3% and -6.1% in bits per byte (overall, text, code, math; paired bootstrap). Downstream, CharBench equal fine-tuning favors local64 (53.7% vs 40.0%), fact200 favors BPE-8k (16.5% vs 7.0%), and PIQA (raw and length-normalized) and ARC-Easy length-normalized favor BPE-8k after Holm correction at alpha = 0.05; remaining tasks are ties. Evaluation pitfalls that changed conclusions include context-length extrapolation past the BPE training context, bits per token reported as bits per byte, and inconsistent byte denominators. Unlike controlled tokenizer studies that vary the subword tokenizer under a fixed token budget, or FLOP-controlled byte-model scaling studies, we hold the raw bytes, their order and the optimizer recipe fixed and ask whether a fixed-patch byte model can replace the tokenizer at all. Limits: one size, one seed, one 8k vocabulary fixed before the runs, and a known difference in embedding initialization between the twins.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 3 figures. Code, checkpoints and evaluation suites: https://github.com/AsadullahMaliyawala/bytelm-local64

</details>

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** G0.7 是面向机器人控制的世界动作模型，基于 Fast-WAM 把观测上下文扩展到五分钟并大规模预训练于遥操作与人类自我中心视频，使推理时跳过未来帧生成、直接解码动作，从而支持实时闭环控制。

**相关性简评：** 其「训练期用未来帧预测塑形策略表示、推理期省略生成」的设置，可能为 LVR 中轨迹监督如何影响 latent 状态的实际使用、以及省略显式生成后的收益与代价提供核查线索；但任务是动作控制而非视觉推理，需确认其是否有表示层面的分析。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** G0.7: Scaling Up a Fast World Action Model with Long Context

**abstract/A1：** World action models (WAMs) adapt pretrained video generators for robot control by jointly predicting future camera frames and actions, transferring physical priors learned from video into manipulation policies. However, generating future frames before every action makes test-time inference too slow for closed-loop control, while most existing policies remain restricted to short observation histories. Building on Fast-WAM, which showed that video prediction shapes policy representations during training so that future frame synthesis can be skipped at deployment, we present G0.7, a generalist world action model scaled along two axes: extending the context window from a single observation to up to five minutes of history, and scaling pretraining to a large-scale corpus of robot teleoperation and human egocentric (ego) video. Across public simulation suites and real-robot deployments, direct action decoding (Fast mode) matches imagine-then-act (IDM) inference from the same checkpoint while running in 60 ms per 16-step action chunk on a single RTX 5090 (7.6x faster than IDM) and supporting pause-free real-time chunking. Performance scales consistently with pretraining data, with human ego video driving the largest gains in out-of-distribution generalization: G0.7 achieves a 70.8 mean score across five simulation benchmark suites, 48% and 54% zero-shot pick-and-place success on Galaxea R1 Pro and R1 Lite, 96.7% in-distribution and 93.3% out-of-distribution success on video-conditioned in-context learning tasks, and 86.9% mean task progress across seven real-world post-training tasks including multi-minute box folding, drink preparation, and product bagging.

</details>

### 119. [Gaze World Model](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31836v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31836

**作者：** Jiawen Zhang、Houze Yang、Xu Cao、Yifan Shen、Zhongyi Zhou、Steve Wong、Ismini Lourentzou、Inki Kim、James M. Rehg

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31836v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31836v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器上联合训练 latent 场景预测与人条件化的注视监督，用于视频中的注视点估计、注视转移检测以及基于预测场景特征的未来注视预测，并为基准补充事件级注视转移标注。

**相关性简评：** 其「latent 预测目标经消融可同时提升转移检测与注视定位」的辅助训练线索，可供核查 LVR 中预测式辅助目标与视觉证据定位/筛选的关系；但本文研究对象是人类注视而非模型自身的推理状态，与主线仍有距离。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Gaze World Model

**abstract/A1：** Where a person looks indicates their focus of attention, and how their gaze shifts between targets reveals how that attention responds to a changing scene. Existing gaze target estimation methods largely operate frame by frame and do not model these shifts. Gaze shifts are often driven by dynamic changes in the scene, which is the kind of information world models are designed to encode. This relationship is subtle, however, since an event far across the frame may produce only a slight movement of the person's head or eyes. We therefore introduce the Gaze World Model (GWM), which co-trains latent scene prediction with person-conditioned gaze supervision on a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder; in our ablations, the latent prediction objective improves both shift detection and gaze localization. Given a video clip and the person's head box, GWM estimates gaze locations and detects gaze shifts in the observed clip, and forecasts future gaze and shifts from predicted scene features. To train and evaluate these tasks, we augment VideoAttentionTarget and ChildPlay with event-level gaze-shift annotations. GWM achieves state-of-the-art shift detection on these benchmarks, about 10 points higher in four-class AP than the strongest baseline, while remaining comparable to the strongest image-based models in gaze target estimation, and outperforms the compared baselines on future gaze localization and shift forecasting.

**comment/C1：** 25 pages, 8 figures, 15 tables

</details>

### 120. [Two-Stage Post-Training for Flow-Based Embodied Foundation Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31850v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31850

**作者：** Jiaming Zhang、Yao Lyu、Haoning Wang、Yongjun Chen、Liping Zhang、Shengbo Eben Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31850v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31850v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向 flow-based 具身基础模型提出两阶段后训练框架：第一阶段用多教师 on-policy 蒸馏整合专家能力，第二阶段在 RL 中仅对失败轨迹施加按采样噪声加权速度误差的教师蒸馏，以密集指导补足稀疏奖励，实验显示优于联合 SFT 且交互更少。

**相关性简评：** 其「仅对失败轨迹蒸馏、按噪声加权误差」的选择性监督思路，可能为 LVR 轨迹训练中的贡献分配与稀疏反馈下的密集监督提供可核查线索，但该工作在机器人控制域，未涉及视觉 latent 状态表示。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Two-Stage Post-Training for Flow-Based Embodied Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** Large-scale pretraining provides embodied models with general capabilities, but reliable task execution still requires post training. In multitask settings, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) faces distribution mismatch between training and deployment, whereas reinforcement learning (RL) is limited by sparse rewards and uneven learning progress across tasks. Multi-teacher on policy distillation (MOPD) consolidates expert capabilities through dense supervision on the model's own trajectories, but achieving performance beyond the teachers remains challenging. We propose a two-stage post training framework for flow-based embodied models, constructing distillation objectives from the velocity regression formulation of conditional flow matching. Stage 1 efficiently consolidates expert capabilities through MOPD. Stage 2 combines RL with teacher distillation that weights velocity errors according to the sampling noise, where distillation is restricted to failed trajectories to supplement sparse rewards with dense guidance without directly constraining successful behaviors. Experiments across multiple models and benchmarks show that the framework outperforms joint SFT and exceeds the corresponding teachers' aggregate success rates. Sample efficiency comparisons show higher success rates than direct RL with fewer environment interactions.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 5 figures

</details>

### 121. [No Fixed Configuration Is Best: Context- and Cost-Aware Tuning of LLM Pipelines, with an Application to Schema Matching and Mapping](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31864v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31864

**作者：** Gokhan Kirlik、Xiuwen Zheng、Anirudh Sriram

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31864v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31864v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在约 41 个 schema matching/mapping 任务上联合调优多阶段 LLM pipeline 的数值配置以权衡准确率与成本，发现更大的增益来自数值调优触及不到的结构选择，最终并行运行两种设置，并对约 26% 存在分歧的列用 LLM judge 择答。

**相关性简评：** 其逐任务、逐列的配置选择与候选答案裁决，以及成本—准确率联合目标，可能为 LVR 中动态计算分配、何时追加 LOOK 或停止、多假设筛选提供可供核查的线索，但需确认其成本度量在视觉证据场景下的可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** No Fixed Configuration Is Best: Context- and Cost-Aware Tuning of LLM Pipelines, with an Application to Schema Matching and Mapping

**abstract/A1：** The numeric settings of a multi-stage LLM pipeline (a compound AI system) are the usual target of tuning. We tuned all of them for an LLM pipeline for schema matching and mapping, with accuracy and cost as joint objectives, and we show what this buys, what it cannot buy, and where the remaining accuracy is. First, tuning buys cost and a little accuracy. On 35 tasks, with whole groups of tasks held out from tuning, one tuned configuration gains 2.9 points of top-1 accuracy (HR@1) over the default at 18% more cost, and another keeps the accuracy of the default at 32% lower cost. Second, the accuracy depends on a choice that numeric tuning cannot reach. Restricting the search for each source column to one assigned target table changes HR@1 by +30 points on a MIMIC-III to OMOP task and by -52 points on a task built from database views, more than numeric tuning gains on nine of ten test tasks. Neither setting is right for all tasks: on the larger set of 41 tasks used for the remaining results, mean HR@1 is 75.7% with the restriction (the default) and 83.1% without it. Third, choosing the setting per task is not enough either: even an oracle that picks the better setting for each task reaches only 87.8% on the 41 tasks, because the better setting differs between the columns of one task. The pipeline therefore runs both settings, and an LLM judge chooses among their candidate answers on the 26% of columns on which they disagree. This reaches 91.5% HR@1 on the 41 tasks, at 5.9 times the cost of the default, about one cent per column.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages

</details>

### 122. [Subliminal Learning Crosses Modalities](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31870v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31870

**作者：** Saraswathy Amjith、Kimia Hamidieh、Antonio Torralba、Yoon Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31870v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31870v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究文本中习得的偏好经无意义数字序列跨模态迁移到视觉语言模型，进而改变扩散模型的图像生成与图像表征，并分析恒定激活成分的作用，提出从权重中识别隐式特质的 weight lens。

**相关性简评：** 该工作不直接研究视觉推理，但其用恒定激活方向和权重探测定位隐式信息，可能可供核查 LVR 内部状态中的内容是否影响输出，以及用于贡献分配与监督诊断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Subliminal Learning Crosses Modalities

**abstract/A1：** Subliminal learning refers to a surprising phenomenon in language models wherein a prompt given to one model (e.g., preference for cats) can be subliminally distilled to another model via training on data that is ostensibly meaningless (e.g., number sequences). This paper shows that text-based subliminal learning transfers cross-modally, in particular, a topic/preference (e.g., animals) transferred through number sequences across vision-language models also changes how images are generated and represented. First, we show that a diffusion model using the student as its text encoder generates the student's animal more often than with the original model as its text encoder, but not its color or style. We then investigate the mechanism behind this phenomenon and which concepts transfer across modalities. A constant component of the student's change accounts for much of the shift of image representations toward the trait. Adding this component uniformly can change the generated animal, which depends on the whole prompt, but not concepts such as color or style, which are encoded in a single token. Finally, we introduce weight lens as an approach to identify a subliminal trait from the weights of a single trained model, and show that it identifies the trait of nearly every student, including traits that do not surface in generated images.

</details>

### 123. [RELAY: Learning Compatible Representations One Encoder at a Time](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31882v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31882

**作者：** Yu Wang、Chuan Qin、Qiang Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.IR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31882v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31882v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** RELAY 研究增量替换编码器时新旧文档嵌入共存的问题：先冻结原图库、训练带可学习投影的新查询编码器，再冻结二者训练新文档编码器，使同一查询向量在一次回填中同时对齐两版文档；回填后可选地去掉投影做查询微调。在 COCO、Flickr30K 的三次 text-to-image 检索升级中报告了未被回填库上的 Recall@1 提升与回填曲线 AUC 对比。

**相关性简评：** 其分阶段训练加投影以维持新旧表示空间可比、并支持嵌入缓存复用的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中跨层或跨版本 latent 状态比较与缓存复用的可比性问题；但任务本身是检索嵌入兼容而非多模态推理状态生成，与主线的距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RELAY: Learning Compatible Representations One Encoder at a Time

**abstract/A1：** Old and new document embeddings coexist during incremental gallery re-encoding. RELAY trains a new query encoder with a learned projection against the original gallery, then freezes both to train the new document encoder. The same query vector scores both document versions throughout a single re-encoding pass. After backfill, optional query refinement drops the projection and reuses the stored document vectors. Across three text-to-image retrieval upgrades on COCO and Flickr30K, RELAY improves Recall@1 on untouched galleries by 8.66-10.23 percentage points over the original systems. For direct re-encoding, RELAY ranks first in both Qwen-to-Qwen upgrades and second in CLIP-to-Qwen by area under the Recall@1 curve, under both native scoring and matched calibration. With embeddings held fixed, calibrating scores separately for each document version can reduce drops in Recall@1 during backfill and change which method achieves the highest backfill AUC. After query refinement, final Recall@1 is within 0.97 percentage points of conventional joint training in all three upgrades.

### 124. [Cheap Memory Costs Future Compute: Co-Designing Persistent KV and GPU Execution for Efficient Streaming Video Diffusion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31892v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31892

**作者：** Jian Yang、Zhizhuo Kou、Qiyuan Zhu、Han Chen、Sirui Han、Yike Guo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31892v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31892v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对冻结的因果视频 DiT 的持久 KV 缓存更新开销，提出免训练的 SAMR：仅真实刷新部分缓存，其余用 Pre-RoPE 空间去偏后的 in-flight KV 与运动对齐历史 KV 融合重建，并以注意力读出误差代理决定哪些 token 需要 t=0 刷新。

**相关性简评：** 其「陈旧缓存抬高后续计算」与「误差代理触发真实重算」的缓存状态更新策略，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的局部更新、何时重算与证伪提供借鉴；但论文面向视频生成效率，需核查该迁移是否有实质对应。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Cheap Memory Costs Future Compute: Co-Designing Persistent KV and GPU Execution for Efficient Streaming Video Diffusion

**abstract/A1：** Block-causal video diffusion generates long videos block by block, conditioned on a persistent key-value (KV) cache. After each block is denoised, an extra noise-free ($t=0$) forward pass writes its clean KV into the cache; once distillation and speculative early exit make denoising cheap, this clean KV update dominates the runtime. Reusing stale KV shortens the update, but stale memory corrupts the conditioning of later blocks and inflates their denoising steps, so the saved compute reappears downstream. We present SAMR (Step-Aware Memory Reconstruction), a training-free method for frozen causal video DiTs that refreshes only part of the cache and reconstructs the rest without DiT forwards. Our key observation is that, once rotary position phases are removed, motion-aligned historical KV and the in-flight KV a token holds at its exit step are complementary estimates of its clean KV. SAMR debiases in-flight KV with offline-calibrated per-head affine maps in Pre-RoPE space, fuses the two estimates, and reserves true $t=0$ refreshes for tokens flagged by an attention-readout error proxy, all executed by tile-aligned, synchronization-free Triton kernels. On 48-second LongLive-1.3B videos, SAMR reduces DiT latency by 20.9% and principal FLOPs by 30.7% relative to dense KV updates, lowers downstream denoising steps, and improves final-quarter PSNR over token reuse by 1.61 dB (1.14 dB on held-out VidProM-16). The reconstruction also transfers to frozen Self-Forcing-DMD-1.3B: zero-shot, it reduces reuse-induced step inflation ($2.47 \\to 2.30$ steps/token) and improves late PSNR by $+0.33$ dB, and a one-time training-free calibration recovers the diagnostic score that zero-shot transfer lowers ($89.62 \\to 91.10$).

</details>

<a id="paper-125"></a>

### 125. [Loupe: Reinforcing Knowledge-Intensive Video Generation Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31895v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31895

**作者：** Kai Zeng、Ruichuan An、Zhen Fang、Xi Fang、Han Lyu、Moran Li、Yingchen Yu、Yifan Dai、Bohan Zeng、Quanqing Xu、Zhengzhou Zhu、Wentao Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31895v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31895v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** Loupe 是一个面向知识密集型视频生成的 agent，先检索并核验文本与视觉证据，再构建含参考图的时间化提示；作者提出 Rubric-Based Credit（RBC），用提示特定的事实、视觉与时间要求为中间搜索与规划步骤打分，并据此做步骤级重加权的 SFT 与 GRPO，训练时无需渲染视频，同时构建了 Search-VBench。

**相关性简评：** 其「用任务特定标准给中间步骤分配信用、并据此监督」的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 中间状态的贡献分配与视觉证据筛选提供可核查线索；但对象是外部检索与提示构建而非模型内部推理状态，迁移性需进一步判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Loupe: Reinforcing Knowledge-Intensive Video Generation Agents

**abstract/A1：** Knowledge-intensive video generation remains challenging because prompts often omit the facts, appearances, and temporal relationships required for accurate generation. While search-based workflows can retrieve missing evidence, manually designed strategies limit adaptive planning, and conventional training suffers from costly video-level feedback and coarse trajectory-level credit assignment. In this paper, we present Loupe, a video generation agent that retrieves and verifies textual and visual evidence to construct evidence-grounded temporal video prompts with reference images. We further introduce Rubric-Based Credit (RBC), which leverages prompt-specific factual, visual, and temporal requirements to evaluate intermediate search and planning decisions before video rendering. Building on RBC, RBC-SFT reweights assistant-token learning by step quality, while RBC-GRPO incorporates step-level credits alongside a final planning reward, without rendering videos during RL. To address the lack of dedicated search-oriented evaluation, we construct Search-VBench, which contains 150 held-out prompts across seven categories. Experiments show that Loupe improves all four evaluation dimensions across three video generators, raising the overall score of MiniMax-H3 from 32.80 to 70.67 and outperforming an untrained search workflow. Ablation experiments show that full RBC training outperforms standard SFT followed by trajectory-level GRPO by 5.27 points. Human evaluations and results on Sci-VBench and KIVI-Bench further demonstrate improved generation quality, scientific grounding, factual precision, and helpfulness. Our project page is available at https://zengkaiya.github.io/Loupe/.

</details>

### 126. [Beyond Expert Replay: Cross-Instruction Anchoring for Continual Vision-Language-Action Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31903v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31903

**作者：** Ziyang Chen、Dehua Chen、Shaoguang Wang、Xu Yan、Hao Huang、Tao Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31903v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31903v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对 VLA 模型在有限经验回放下出现的「旧指令触发新学竞争目标」失效模式，提出 Cross-Instruction Anchoring：在任务边界冻结旧策略作教师，用当前观测配对旧指令并匹配其响应，从而在不增加专家回放数据的情况下扩展监督。

**相关性简评：** 该工作不研究 latent 视觉推理，但其「指令—目标绑定被覆盖」的诊断与冻结教师响应锚定，可能为 LVR 中任务必要信息在内部状态中的保持、跨指令干扰及监督分配提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Expert Replay: Cross-Instruction Anchoring for Continual Vision-Language-Action Learning

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language-action (VLA) models need to continually acquire new manipulation skills while retaining the ability to follow previously learned instructions. Experience replay (ER) can mitigate catastrophic forgetting, but retaining only a small number of historical expert frames per task leaves many old-instruction responses without direct supervision. Under limited replay, we observe a structured failure mode in which an earlier instruction can trigger a subsequently learned, competing goal. To address this gap, we propose Cross-Instruction Anchoring (XIA), which supplements expert replay with instruction-conditioned response preservation. At each task boundary, XIA freezes the previous policy as a teacher and matches its responses to old instructions paired with current observations. This extends supervision beyond stored historical examples without requiring additional expert replay data. Experiments across multiple VLA architectures and three LIBERO suites demonstrate improved success rates and reduced forgetting compared with ER under identical historical expert-data budgets. Additional RoboCasa and real-world experiments further support the effectiveness of XIA.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 12 figures, 10 tables, including supplementary material

</details>

### 127. [ReJEPA: Bounded Predictive Regulation for Latent World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31910v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31910

**作者：** Fangzhou Lin、Yuping Wang、Shuo Xing、Yang Chen、Yuwen Heng、Xin Li、Wenbin He、Yuhan Yao、Zhengzhong Tu、Liu Ren

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31910v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31910v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ReJEPA，以逐元素 logcosh 损失实现「大误差梯度有界、零附近平滑」的潜空间预测训练，在 Temporal Straightening、LeWorldModel 与 V-JEPA 2.1 上替换 L2/L1 等损失并分析表征与规划代价的对齐。

**相关性简评：** 不直接研究 VLM 推理，但其对多帧潜状态预测中噪声帧与极端误差的梯度调节，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的监督权重和贡献分配提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ReJEPA: Bounded Predictive Regulation for Latent World Models

**abstract/A1：** Latent world models learn representations by predicting future states in an abstract embedding space rather than reconstructing raw pixels. When training across multi-frame sequences, however, not all frames and spatial regions are equally informative or predictable. We argue that forcing a world model to minimize every prediction error may be unnecessary and harmful. Under standard $L\_2$ loss, unbounded gradients force the encoder and predictor to overfit noisy or transient frames at the expense of core physical structure, while amplifying gradient conflict with representation regularizers. Conversely, $L\_1$ loss bounds large gradients, but its constant gradient magnitude near zero disrupts the local smoothness required for planning. We resolve this tension with \\textbf{ReJEPA}, a bounded predictive regulation principle that combines bounded gradients for large errors with smooth quadratic behavior near zero, instantiated simply via the element-wise $\\log\\cosh$ loss. As a drop-in training replacement across Temporal Straightening, LeWorldModel, and V-JEPA~2.1, $\\log\\cosh$ consistently outperforms $L\_2$, a curvature-matched quadratic control, $L\_1$, and Smooth-$L\_1$ baselines without altering architectures or inference procedures. Notably, the gains grow with environmental complexity, scaling from simple navigation to contact-rich manipulation and real-world autonomous driving on NAVSIM. Probing and geometric analyses confirm that relaxing the penalty on extreme errors yields representations that better capture physical states and align with the true planning cost landscape.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 12 figures, 24 tables

</details>

### 128. [TANDEM: Temporal Anchor Densification With Reliability-Aware Memory for Lightweight Sparse Depth Completion in Endoscopic Robotic Navigation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31922v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31922

**作者：** Weikuan Qiu、Jiale Hou、Chongzhao Xu、Jinlian Ma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31922v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31922v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 TANDEM，一个面向内窥镜视频的轻量因果稀疏深度补全框架：用显式记忆把历史测量重投影到当前视角，并按重观测、时效与运动视差三因子为其打分，再经可靠性加权梯度积分与频率门控参考先验重建稠密深度。

**相关性简评：** 其显式记忆对历史证据的可靠性打分、衰减与「不覆盖当前测量」的融合策略，可能为 LVR 中跨步视觉证据筛选与新旧状态权重分配提供可供核查的方法线索，但任务本身并非多模态推理，迁移需另行论证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TANDEM: Temporal Anchor Densification With Reliability-Aware Memory for Lightweight Sparse Depth Completion in Endoscopic Robotic Navigation

**abstract/A1：** For endoscopic robotic surgery, accurate dense depth perception serves as a foundational capability, which enables navigation, instrument localization, and tissue interaction. However, endoscopic video lacks reliable metric depth, while metric measurements obtained via tracking, time-of-flight sensing, or instrument contact only cover a small fraction of pixels in each frame, rendering sparse depth completion an urgent and unsolved challenge. In this work, we propose Temporal Anchor Densification with Reliability-Aware Memory (TANDEM), a causal sparse depth completion framework for endoscopic video. It adopts a lightweight design and leverages the video stream: past measurements re-projected into the current view recover the metric evidence unavailable within a single sparse frame. To keep this evidence interpretable, accurate, and efficient, an explicit memory scores each re-projected measurement with analytic re-observation, age, and motion-parallax factors without overriding current measurements. A compact network then reconstructs depth via reliability-weighted gradient integration and a frequency-gated reference prior. We evaluate TANDEM on the C3VD colonoscopy and StereoMIS laparoscopy datasets. With only 5.58 M parameters, TANDEM reduces the root mean square error by 11.7% and 32.0%, respectively, compared with the strongest baseline, and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy. It also remains accurate under pose errors of the magnitude reported for endoscopic pose estimation. Code will be released at https://github.com/Wk-cpu-art/TANDEM upon acceptance.

**comment/C1：** Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging, 2026. 11 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables

</details>

### 129. [Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Unlearning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31932v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31932

**作者：** Fangzhou Lin、Shuo Xing、Xin Li、Wenbin He、Zhengzhong Tu、Liu Ren

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31932v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31932v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CPSD，一种面向大模型「遗忘」的对比式 on-policy 自蒸馏框架：对 student 自己生成的轨迹，用冻结参考模型分别在含遗忘信息的特权上下文与普通上下文中给出逐 token 分布，将两者差异视为知识相关方向并反向构造反事实遗忘目标，再以序列级抑制作为隐私增强变体。实验在 OpenUnlearning 的 TOFU 与 MUSE-News 上比较 NPO。

**相关性简评：** 其「在自生成轨迹上逐位置构造特权/普通上下文分布差并反向」的密集监督思路，可能为 latent 推理的轨迹训练与贡献分配提供线索：可用带/不带视觉或证据上下文的目标分布差来定位状态中承载的具体信息，但需核查该反事实方向是否真对应可分离的内部状态，目前与视觉推理无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Unlearning

**abstract/A1：** Large language model unlearning aims to remove the influence of designated training data while preserving unrelated model capabilities. Existing likelihood-based methods commonly optimize against fixed forget sequences, providing only negative supervision on what the model should not generate and overlooking the states visited by the evolving unlearned policy. We introduce Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation (CPSD), a new unlearning framework that constructs an explicit knowledge-reduced target distribution and distills it along the model's own trajectories. Given a student rollout, a frozen reference model evaluates each token under a plain context and a privileged context containing the forget information. CPSD treats the resulting distributional shift as a knowledge-associated direction and reverses it to obtain a counterfactual unlearning target. The student is then trained to match this target at every rollout position while retaining its utility on unrelated data. We further introduce a privacy-enhanced variant that combines distributional unlearning with lightweight sequence-level suppression. Experiments under OpenUnlearning show that CPSD improves the forgetting-utility trade-off over NPO across TOFU forget-set sizes and Llama models ranging from 1B to 8B parameters. On MUSE-News, the privacy-enhanced variant improves all reported knowledge, memorization, privacy, and utility metrics over NPO.

**comment/C1：** 12 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables

</details>

### 130. [CAPE: Coordinating Calibration and Search for Tool-Use Policies](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31938v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31938

**作者：** Jiahao Wang、Xiaoxuan Chen、Aijun Yang、Xiaohua Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31938v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31938v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** CAPE 是一个免训练的工具调用策略编译器，针对接收方配置不可见的工具，把「校准候选调用」与「搜索调用组合」放在同一预算内交错进行，始终保持一个可执行策略，只对能改进该策略的调用分配校准，并仅在能提前结束校准时收紧界，在可判定时证明最优。

**相关性简评：** 其「持续维护可用解、按对当前策略的预期改进分配证据获取预算、并在界收敛时停止」的 anytime 调度思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的资源分配与停止判据；但对象是文本工具调用与配置校准，不涉及视觉或多模态内部状态，迁移需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CAPE: Coordinating Calibration and Search for Tool-Use Policies

**abstract/A1：** A tool call can fail even when the operation behind it is correct, because the receiving tool parses delimiters, dates or record layouts under a configuration the agent cannot inspect. Compiling a tool-use policy for such a tool requires both calibration, which evaluates candidate calls on candidate configurations, and search over the evaluated calls. The two share one compilation budget: calibrating everything first postpones any improved policy until the end, while re-solving every partially known model delays the next useful query. A call becomes usable as soon as its effects are known on the configurations that reach it. We present CAPE, a training-free compiler built on this observation. It maintains an executable policy at all times, directs calibration to the calls that can improve this policy, and tightens bounds only where doing so ends calibration early. Returned policies preserve every configuration the initial policy completes, and CAPE certifies optimality when its executable and optimistic values meet. On CSV and JSON workflows built from 64 requests, CAPE reaches the independently computed optimum in 502 of 504 compilations while taking 22.0% less compilation time than eager exact search. On larger CSV families it returns policies with higher completion at similar compilation time, and it raises completion by 15.38 to 34.66 percentage points over an LLM that revises its serialization from error feedback.

</details>

### 131. [DraftKV: Protecting Persistent Worlds through Hierarchical Streaming Retrieval](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31944v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31944

**作者：** Xiaoling Zhou、Haopeng Li、Yufa Zhou、Rui Ding、Yu Li、Jun Lin、Enze Xie、Chunhua Shen、Xuan Shen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31944v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31944v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** DraftKV 针对交互式视频世界模型中长时历史一致性问题，提出免训练框架：先以几何 grounding 与查询条件相关性检索历史 KV 缓存，再结合 CPU offload 与 tile 级流式注意力降低显存占用与推理延迟，并给出检索近似与 Top-K 重合度的误差界。

**相关性简评：** 其按查询相关性对历史状态做 Top-K 检索、以及缓存与注意力结构近似的分析，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选和 latent 缓存/注意力结构对相似度的影响提供核查线索；但论文目标是视频世界模型的时空一致性，并非多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DraftKV: Protecting Persistent Worlds through Hierarchical Streaming Retrieval

**abstract/A1：** Interactive video world models enable action- and camera-controlled exploration, yet struggle to maintain consistent spatial geometry and appearance when revisiting previously explored locations. Historical KV caches help auto-regressive video diffusion models maintain long-term consistency, but their retrieval and attention computation introduce substantial latency as history grows. We propose DraftKV, a training-free framework that retrieves historical KV caches based on geometric grounding and query-conditioned relevance, while combining CPU offloading with tile-wise streaming attention to reduce GPU memory usage and inference latency. Theoretically, we show that draft relevance reproduces the mean branch of full-resolution block relevance exactly, so its deviation is confined to the $β$-weighted max branch, and we bound retrieval utility loss in terms of the measured Top-K selection overlap. We further show that draft relevance cannot distinguish blocks with similar pooled descriptors regardless of camera pose, motivating geometric grounding before refinement. Then, we introduce streaming CG-Attention, which overlaps CPU-to-GPU KV transfers with attention computation through tile-wise streaming, hiding transfer latency while maintaining bounded GPU memory usage. Experiments across diverse model families show that DraftKV achieves superior generation quality and consistency while achieving $3.27\\times$ end-to-end speedup and 42.2% peak GPU memory reduction over other CPU-offloaded KV cache retrieval methods. Notably, DraftKV enables high-quality interactive world generation with historical KV retrieval on a single H100 GPU using SolarWM-33B.

**comment/C1：** Includes supplementary material. Code and project page are available online

</details>

### 132. [Perception Is Enough, at the Right Scale: Scale-Adaptive Token Pruning for Vision-Language-Action Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31954v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31954

**作者：** Yifeng Lin、Liuxiang Qiu、Yunfeng Chen、Tiesong Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31954v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31954v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出免训练的 TauPrune-VLA：用单一 perception temperature 控制保留视觉 token 的语义尺度，依据感知语义变化趋势在线调整该尺度，并利用帧间连续性异步复用保留索引，在多种 VLA 模型和真实平台上取得最高 1.86× 加速。

**相关性简评：** 按语义尺度筛选视觉证据、跨帧复用剪枝索引的做法，可能为 LVR 中的视觉信息保留与计算／缓存分配提供线索；但该工作面向机器人控制效率而非推理期 latent 状态生成，具体联系待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Perception Is Enough, at the Right Scale: Scale-Adaptive Token Pruning for Vision-Language-Action Models

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language-action (VLA) models must process continuous streams of visual observations, and the resulting computational cost limits real-time robotic control. Token pruning reduces this cost, but a fixed semantic scale of perceptual representation can overlook information needed at different stages of manipulation. We show that perceptual semantics can guide effective token selection without relying on internal attention when the selection scale adapts to the scene's evolving semantic structure. Based on this observation, we introduce TauPrune-VLA, a training-free method that controls the scale of the retained perceptual representation through a single perception temperature $τ$. To adapt this scale as manipulation proceeds, TauPrune-VLA updates $τ$ online using trends in perceptual semantics, with robot-state changes and action magnitude regulating the adjustment strength. While these semantics evolve over the course of manipulation, they remain relatively stable between consecutive frames. This continuity allows retention indices computed from the current observation to be applied at the next policy invocation, enabling token selection to run asynchronously with inference and reducing pruning overhead. Evaluated across diverse VLA models and simulation benchmarks, TauPrune-VLA achieves up to a $1.86\\times$ inference speedup while maintaining near-baseline task success rates. We further validate its effectiveness on two real-world robotic platforms.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://lin0e0.github.io/TauPrune-VLA/

</details>

### 133. [SPAR: Self-Referenced World-Model Rewards for Physical Alignment in Video Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31958v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31958

**作者：** Junyi Zhang、Qichao Wang、Wenzhe Qian、Yuanchuan Wang、Min Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31958v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31958v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SPAR：以世界模型的预测误差作为推理期奖励来提升视频生成的物理合理性，并用「重复自身帧构成的静态片段」作为内容匹配参考来抵消场景易预测性带来的偏差，同时对奖励做空间局部化与时序峰值抑制的细化。

**相关性简评：** 其「用内容匹配参考基线校正预测误差」的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中如何把 latent 预测一致性信号与内容难度、信息坍缩造成的伪信号分离；时空细化中「预测变化与观测变化的一致性」也可为 latent 状态更新与证据筛选的度量设计提供线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SPAR: Self-Referenced World-Model Rewards for Physical Alignment in Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Generating videos with physically plausible dynamics remains challenging despite advances in visual quality. Latent world models offer predictive signals for evaluating physical plausibility, but higher agreement between predicted and observed features may reflect easier-to-predict scene content rather than more plausible dynamics. We propose \\textbf{S}elf-Referenced \\textbf{P}hysical \\textbf{A}lignment \\textbf{R}ewards (\\textbf{SPAR}), a framework that uses world-model predictions for inference-time physical alignment. SPAR compares each video's prediction error with that of static clips constructed by repeating its own frames, providing a content-matched reference for evaluating generated dynamics. To account for the uneven spatial and temporal distribution of physical interactions, we introduce a unified \\textbf{spatiotemporal reward refinement} strategy. \\textbf{Spatial refinement} emphasizes localized prediction discrepancies, while \\textbf{temporal refinement} moderates brief error peaks and supplements prediction errors with agreement between predicted and observed feature changes. Evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SPAR improves the physical plausibility of both \\textbf{text-to-video generation} and \\textbf{image-to-video continuation}, bringing generated dynamics into closer alignment with the physical regularities governing real-world events. Additional results and resources are available at https://gavin-jy.github.io/spar-page/

</details>

### 134. [DexOPD: Dual-Extrapolation On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31969v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31969

**作者：** Yunchao Ke、Yanzhe Hu、Yi Yang、Jiachun Jin、Zhihong Liu、Zhijie Deng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31969v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31969v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向文生图扩散模型的多教师 on-policy 蒸馏，在教师外推之外引入滞后历史学生作为参照进行自外推，并把候选样本的任务奖励差转成归一化辅助回归方向，将多个专才合并为统一学生。

**相关性简评：** 用滞后学生作参照的自外推与成对奖励回归，可能可供核查 latent 推理轨迹的训练监督与状态更新设计；但该文面向图像生成，与视觉推理仅有间接方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DexOPD: Dual-Extrapolation On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Models

**abstract/A1：** Flow-based diffusion models have become a mainstream paradigm for text-to-image generation, where task-specific post-training produces specialist models with complementary strengths. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (OPD) offers an efficient way to consolidate these specialists into a single unified student. Recent methods strengthen supervision through teacher extrapolation, constructing stronger proxy teachers that allow distilled students to surpass the original specialists. However, their extrapolation directions remain defined solely by frozen teacher and reference models, leaving the student's own training progress unexploited. To address this limitation, we introduce DexOPD, a dual-extrapolation on-policy distillation method for diffusion models. DexOPD retains extrapolated teacher supervision while leveraging a lagging historical student as the reference for student self-extrapolation. Sampling across multiple self-extrapolation gains from shared initial noise broadens exploration along the student's evolving trajectory, and task rewards convert pairwise differences in candidate quality into a normalized auxiliary regression direction. Empirically, we evaluate DexOPD on GenEval, OCR, and DrawBench. The resulting unified SD3.5-Medium student achieves a GenEval reward of 0.9736, an OCR score of 0.9515, and a DrawBench Aesthetic score of 6.4875, surpassing the corresponding specialist teachers as well as all evaluated OPD and multi-task reinforcement learning baselines across these three benchmarks while preserving standard single-model inference.

</details>

### 135. [Predict Backbone, Graft Dynamics: A Decoupled Paradigm for Time Series Forecasting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31970v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31970

**作者：** Lin Zhang、Zilin Li、Jingmei Zhao、Jiayang Wu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31970v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31970v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「预测骨架、嫁接动态」的解耦范式并实例化为 GRAFT：基础预测器输出稳定轨迹骨架，第二阶段用检索到的历史证据、相位感知释放和通道级控制选择性嫁接局部动态，在七个基准上多数设定优于对应 backbone。

**相关性简评：** 其「稳定骨架＋检索证据＋置信度门控的选择性注入」两阶段结构，可能为 LVR 中如何把证据或细节动态补入稳定 latent 推理状态提供方法线索；但该文属时间序列预测、无视觉或多模态实验，迁移可行性待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Predict Backbone, Graft Dynamics: A Decoupled Paradigm for Time Series Forecasting

**abstract/A1：** Modern long-term forecasters are typically optimized for point-wise accuracy, which rewards dominant low-frequency backbones but often suppresses high-utility local dynamics such as abrupt variations, transient surges, and turning points. We propose Predict Backbone, Graft Dynamics, a decoupled forecasting paradigm that separates stable structural prediction from grounded dynamic restoration. We instantiate it as GRAFT, where a base forecaster predicts the reliable trajectory backbone, and a dedicated grafting path restores historically recurrent dynamics through retrieval-based evidence, phase-aware release, channel-wise control, and restoration-cooperative optimization. Unlike generic post-hoc revision methods that correct residual errors, GRAFT formulates the second stage as grounded dynamic grafting, where historical response evidence is calibrated into transferable dynamics and selectively grafted onto the backbone under phase-, channel-, and confidence-aware constraints. Across the full evaluation grid of seven benchmarks, two metrics, four horizons, and six backbones, GRAFT improves over the corresponding backbone in 87% of all comparisons, with average MSE/MAE reductions of 4.6%/3.9%. Dynamic-window analyses show that GRAFT restores local dynamics while preserving the stable backbone structure. These results suggest a new principle for high-utility forecasting: predict the backbone, then graft the dynamics.

</details>

### 136. [Distill to Loop: Turning Pretrained Diffusion Transformers into Looped Models with Adjustable Depth](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31977v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31977

**作者：** Chenru Wang、Shengwei An

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31977v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31977v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Dooop，把预训练的非循环扩散 Transformer 蒸馏为权重共享的循环学生模型：将蒸馏视为朝教师输出的不动点迭代，每次循环输出都对齐教师，并把每次循环看作深度方向 ODE 的一步；由此同一个模型可在测试时任意设定循环次数而无需重训，还可在深度方向套用高阶 ODE 求解器，并提出在不同循环次数输出之间做 loop guidance。

**相关性简评：** 该工作虽属图像生成，但其「每次迭代都对齐教师」的循环训练监督、测试时可变循环深度与跨循环输出引导，可能为 LVR 的循环 latent 状态训练、动态计算/停止决策及中间状态一致性筛选提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Distill to Loop: Turning Pretrained Diffusion Transformers into Looped Models with Adjustable Depth

**abstract/A1：** Looped transformers reuse one block of shared weights along the depth of the network. Recent looped diffusion transformers are trained from scratch, which repeats the full pretraining cost although strong pretrained non-looped diffusion transformers exist. We propose Distill to Loop (Dooop), which distills a pretrained non-looped diffusion transformer into a looped student whose blocks are initialized from the teacher's. We cast distillation as a fixed-point iteration toward the teacher, in which the output after every loop is trained toward the teacher, and each loop is one step of an ordinary differential equation in depth. As a result, one model runs any number of loops at test time without retraining, and the higher-order ODE solvers of diffusion model sampling can be applied along the depth dimension for better results. Meanwhile, because a looped model produces an output after every loop, we also construct loop guidance between the outputs of different loop counts, which improves the generated samples at little extra compute. On SD3-medium, a looped student with about 37% of the teacher's parameters matches the teacher on average over GenEval, ImageReward, PickScore and HPSv2.1 with two to four loops, and with two loops it uses about 58% of the teacher's compute. And on a four-step SD3-medium, loop guidance raises the average of the four metrics from 88.2 to 99.2.

</details>

### 137. [How Much Dependency Can a Marginal Rule See? Total Correlation in Diffusion LM Parallel Decoding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31990v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31990

**作者：** Dovud Asadov、Rustambek Urokov、Qobiljon Toshnazarov、Abduaziz Kayumov、Mardon Hazratov、Husanboy Mansuraliyev

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31990v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31990v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 masked diffusion 语言模型并行解码中「每步按各自 marginal 独立提交多个 token」所丢失的依赖，用条件 total correlation C 作为损失度量，在四个模型上估计固定候选集合的 C，比较仅凭 marginal 的预测规则与只知上界的基线，并指出读出头 logit 索引约定会显著放大不一致性诊断。

**相关性简评：** 其「按档位独立性提交导致依赖/信息坍缩」的量化方式及 pooled 优于 weakest-position gating 的结论，可能可供核查能否迁移到多模态或 latent 并行推理状态的依赖评估；但工作停留在纯文本 token 层面，且明确不涉及解码收益，迁移需较多判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How Much Dependency Can a Marginal Rule See? Total Correlation in Diffusion LM Parallel Decoding

**abstract/A1：** A masked diffusion language model is fast because it commits several tokens per step. Each token is sampled from its own marginal, so the dependency between the tokens is lost, and the size of that loss is the conditional total correlation C of the committed set. Most decoders choose the set from per-position marginals, which can bound C but cannot determine it. We ask how well they predict it. We estimate C for fixed candidate sets on four masked diffusion LMs from two families. On three of the four, the best marginal-only predictor is off by about one bit (0.74 to 1.17), 1.8 to 3.7 times less than a baseline that knows only the bound, and most of this accuracy comes from the bound itself. On a subset, our estimate ranks sets like the exact KL cost of a parallel commit, but sits a median 0.4 to 1.1 bits below it on prose and when the rest of the text is still masked. Dream-instruct is the exception, mainly on prose, where its conditionals are least self-consistent. Among six common marginal rules, pooling over the set beats gating on its weakest position in all 24 paired comparisons. The measurement needs a validated readout: Dream and LLaDA place a position's prediction at different logit indices, and the wrong index inflates an inconsistency diagnostic 14 to 41 times. We give three checks that measure the convention. Our results concern predicting C for a fixed set, not what a dependency-aware decoder gains.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Diffusion Language Models: Foundations, Efficiency, and Reasoning (DiffuLM). Code: https://github.com/DovudAsadov/dllm-total-correlation

</details>

### 138. [ADE: A Zero-Training Unlearning Method for Latent World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31998v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31998

**作者：** Sirui He、Chi Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31998v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31998v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对 latent world model 中残留的后门触发或过时动力学，提出免训练的闭式遗忘算法 ADE：仅用缓存的预训练统计量恢复保留协方差，并在输入瓶颈、循环隐状态与输出头上级联解析编辑，配合正交切除与白化阻尼抑制 rollout 漂移。

**相关性简评：** 其「闭式编辑循环隐状态、避免梯度更新破坏 latent 流形与逐步误差累积」的线索，可能可供核查 LVR 中定向修改或剔除内部推理状态、以及多步状态更新稳定性的问题；但对象是控制用世界模型，与视觉推理任务距离较远，联系属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ADE: A Zero-Training Unlearning Method for Latent World Models

**abstract/A1：** Latent world models learn compact recurrent dynamics from offline trajectories, yet deployed simulators can retain backdoor triggers or stale transitions from outdated physical regimes. Existing unlearning methods fail in autoregressive physics: gradient updates distort latent manifolds and compound rollout drift, naive output zeroing suppresses valid control responses on trigger onset, and single-step deletion leaves corruption inside recurrent hidden states. We propose Analytical Dynamics Excision (ADE), a deterministic, zero-training closed-form unlearning algorithm for latent world models. Using only cached pretraining moments, ADE recovers retain covariances via single-pass matrix downdating without raw retain data and cascades closed-form edits across the input bottleneck, hidden states, and downstream heads. Pairing orthogonal excision with whitened recurrent damping and mean-preserving affine calibration neutralizes out-of-manifold backdoors and realigns in-manifold shifts without variance collapse. Across four regimes on three MuJoCo benchmarks, ADE outperforms seven tuned baselines on DreamerV1, eliminating HalfCheetah and Hopper velocity-flip triggers $4.4\\times$ faster than fine-tuning, and transfers zero-shot to DreamerV3.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables

</details>

### 139. [TableRouter: Query-Aware Evidence Construction for Long-Table Question Answering](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32006v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32006

**作者：** Anahita Bolourani、Xiaofeng Lin、Tung Sum Thomas Kwok、Guang Cheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32006v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32006v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的 TableRouter：先分析查询，再在「计算路线」（从全表导出问题条件统计量）与「覆盖路线」（检索相关行与列摘要）之间选择，将所选上下文单次送入冻结 LLM；在三个大表基准上优于六种单次调用基线，并用对照实验区分「取得证据」与「使用证据」。

**相关性简评：** 其按查询决定检索还是压缩为统计表示的路由机制，以及「证据可获得不等于被使用」的发现，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与表示形式是否被答案真正使用提供可核查线索；但对象为表格文本、无 latent 推理状态，迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TableRouter: Query-Aware Evidence Construction for Long-Table Question Answering

**abstract/A1：** LLMs can reason over tables, but when tables outgrow the context budget, retrieving relevant rows is only part of the solution. A retrieved subset may omit information required for an exact aggregate; even complete evidence may remain difficult for an LLM to use. We introduce TableRouter, a training-free framework that analyzes each query, then chooses between two routes: a computation route, which derives question-conditioned statistics from the full table, and a coverage route, which retrieves relevant rows and column summaries. The chosen context is passed to a frozen LLM in one call. Across three LLMs and three large-table benchmarks, TableRouter outperforms the strongest of six single-call baselines in all nine settings by 1.2-18.3 accuracy points, using 77-95% fewer estimated FLOPs than truncated-table prompting, with indexing amortized across questions. The gains extend to long tables from databases not used in earlier experiments, where TableRouter achieves 35.8% with Qwen2.5-7B, versus 16.4% for the strongest external baseline. A controlled experiment shows that explicitly providing computed statistics improves accuracy by up to 40.0 points, even when all answer-determining rows are available. These results distinguish evidence access from evidence use: long-table reasoning depends on how information is represented, not only on which rows are retrieved.

**comment/C1：** Submitted to ACL Rolling Review, October 2026

</details>

### 140. [To Critic Or Not To Critic](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32013v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32013

**作者：** Jason Wei、George Pu、Jingxuan Fan、Yuan Emily Xue、Yuan Christy Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32013v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32013v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文在共享 actor 目标下比较带 critic 的 PPO 与无 critic 的 GRPO 的梯度方向偏差-方差权衡，用 batch size、critic 依赖程度和任务复杂度解释两者优劣，并在控制任务、短程数学与长程终端智能体上做了逾 1200 次训练（含 96 次 LLM），同时给出按训练计算量折算的结论。

**相关性简评：** 其关于长程、复杂任务中 credit assignment 与 batch／计算预算如何交互的实证结论，可供核查 LVR 多步推理轨迹训练是否值得引入 critic 做细粒度贡献分配；但内容限于纯文本 RL 训练层面，不涉及视觉证据或 latent 状态生成，联系较弱。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** To Critic Or Not To Critic

**abstract/A1：** As large language models tackle longer and more complex tasks, understanding when a critic improves the efficiency of reinforcement learning (RL) becomes increasingly important. Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) trains a critic to reduce variance and provide fine-grained credit assignment, while Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) drops the critic and avoids the bias of bootstrapping from the critic's value estimates. Although recent critic-based methods have reported strong performance relative to GRPO, it remains unclear when each approach is preferable. We argue that there is no universal answer; instead, the choice depends on several interacting factors, including batch size, critic reliance, and task complexity. We study the bias-variance tradeoff in terms of gradient direction, measuring how closely each method's gradient estimates align with the true policy gradient as batch size grows. Under a shared actor objective, we compare GRPO with PPO in control tasks, short-horizon math, and long-horizon terminal agents. Across more than 1,200 training runs, including 96 with LLMs, we find that PPO generally leads at small batch sizes, while GRPO often overtakes heavily bootstrapped PPO and reaches parity with lightly bootstrapped PPO at larger batches. At longer horizons and in more complex domains, GRPO needs larger batches to catch up to PPO's performance. Accounting for training compute, critics pay off at small budgets, but their returns diminish at larger budgets.

**comment/C1：** 33 pages, 12 figures, 7 tables

</details>
