### 141. [Learning Agent States for Latent Action Modeling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32017v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32017

**作者：** Shaoan Xie、Fan Feng、Peiyuan Zhu、Peter Spirtes、Kun Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32017v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32017v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Agent-State LAM，联合学习紧凑的 agent-state 表示与刻画其转移的 latent action；并引入空间匹配的时间判别目标（SMTD），用冻结局部视觉特征做空间灵活匹配来区分源帧与邻近帧，促使状态保留 agent 演变中的物理状态而非背景与固定外观。

**相关性简评：** 其「用什么训练目标决定 latent 保留哪些内容」这一设计与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、信息坍缩、任务必要信息是否留存的问题直接对应，可供核查；但论文属机器人视频与动作/世界模型建模，无语言推理环节，迁移需较多改造。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Agent States for Latent Action Modeling

**abstract/A1：** Latent action models (LAMs) learn action-like latents from unlabeled video by coupling frame-pair inference with latent-conditioned prediction, enabling policy and world-model pretraining. However, what the latent must explain depends on the representation space used for action inference and transition prediction. When this space entangles the agent's evolving physical state with visual context, such as background and persistent agent appearance, inferred latents can encode information unrelated to the agent's actions. To address this challenge, we propose Agent-State LAM, which jointly learns a compact agent-state representation and latent actions modeling its transitions. The compact state aggregates dense visual features into a shared space for both action inference and forward prediction. To guide what this state retains, we introduce spatially matched temporal discrimination (SMTD), which trains the state to distinguish its source frame from nearby frames through spatially flexible matching with frozen local visual features. Rather than comparing global frame representations, SMTD scores each frame by emphasizing its strongest local feature matches across spatial locations. This scoring allows background and persistent agent appearance to remain matched across frames despite displacement, making these shared cues less informative for identifying the source frame and encouraging the representation to capture the agent's evolving physical state. Extensive experiments on distracting control tasks and six real robot video datasets demonstrate improved action recovery, downstream control, and world-model prediction. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Mid-Push/Agent-State-LAM.

**comment/C1：** 27 pages, 12 figures, 20 tables. Project page: https://agent-state-lam.github.io

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HuluOPD: Unifying Heterogeneous Medical Specialists into One Lightweight Model with Unlabeled Prompts

**abstract/A1：** Specialist medical vision-language models (VLMs) are strong within their specialties but hard to unify: their training data are often private, and independently developed specialists cannot be assumed to share an architecture. Deploying these large models separately is costly. We present HuluOPD, an on-policy distillation recipe that unifies heterogeneous specialists into one lightweight VLM using only unlabeled prompts, without requiring reference answers or the specialists' training data. The lightweight model answers each prompt, and the specialist of the prompt's modality supervises its response; a continuation-aligned cross-tokenizer loss makes this possible even when they differ in architecture and tokenizer. We apply HuluOPD to five specialists, for ultrasound, pathology, optical coherence tomography, fundus photography, and dental imaging. To distill and evaluate them, we build HuluOPDCorpus, 914k unlabeled prompts, and HuluOPDBench, 47k held-out test items, from over 90 public datasets, and score all models under one protocol on 132k test items, including third-party benchmarks. A single model with 10% of the five specialists' combined parameters retains 94% of their question-answering performance, and one with 2% retains 89%. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of unifying heterogeneous medical specialist VLMs without requiring their training data or a shared architecture.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 6 figures, 12 tables

</details>

### 143. [Do Occupancy World Models Really Follow Actions?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32029v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32029

**作者：** Jongseong Bae、Ha Young Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32029v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32029v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文质疑占用式世界模型是否真正按给定自车轨迹预测未来 3D 场景，提出 ReCast：解耦历史编码与未来解码，用相对自车位姿对齐可变形交互，并构建反事实动作忠实性基准（含分布内、尾部和分布外轨迹）。

**相关性简评：** 其反事实动作忠实性评测可用于核查 latent 状态是否真正依赖条件输入而非场景—轨迹相关性，几何对应式状态更新也可能为视觉证据筛选与状态更新的设计提供线索，但属驾驶世界模型，与 VLM 推理的迁移需自行核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Do Occupancy World Models Really Follow Actions?

**abstract/A1：** Occupancy world models predict future 3D scenes conditioned on ego actions, yet their predictions may not faithfully follow the specified trajectory under counterfactual actions. Because driving datasets provide sparse coverage of alternative trajectories for each scene, existing models learn the spatial effect of ego motion implicitly from observed scene--trajectory combinations, which may entangle action effects with scene--trajectory correlations. We propose ReCast, an ego-trajectory-guided transformer that grounds future prediction in action-induced geometric correspondence across ego-centric frames. ReCast decouples historical encoding from future decoding and aligns deformable interactions using relative ego transformations, while retaining flexibility for non-rigid scene evolution. We also introduce a counterfactual action-faithfulness benchmark covering in-distribution, tail, and out-of-distribution trajectories. On Occ3D-nuScenes, ReCast achieves competitive standard forecasting performance while improving counterfactual forecasting, with particularly clear gains under out-of-distribution trajectories.

</details>

### 144. [FlashQLA: Efficient Context Parallelism for Gated DeltaNet](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32039v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32039

**作者：** Xi Lin、Chengruidong Zhang、Huiqiang Jiang、Xiao Li、Zekun Wang、Junda Feng、Yunfei Mao、Siqi Zhang、Siyu Wang、Man Yuan、Rui Men、Bo Zheng、Dayiheng Liu、Bohan Zhuang、Jianwei Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.DC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32039v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32039v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** FlashQLA 提出面向 Gated DeltaNet 的上下文并行执行框架，用 decay-aware 边界状态预处理、跨 GPU 的 Dual CP 摘要共享、负载自适应 Auto CP 与 kernel 协同设计，缓解 chunk 间顺序依赖，在单卡与八卡长上下文下取得明显加速。

**相关性简评：** 其 chunk 边界状态的压缩摘要与跨设备交换机制，可能为循环式 latent 推理状态的并行更新与跨块信息保持提供实现线索，值得核查这种摘要近似对状态保真度的影响。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FlashQLA: Efficient Context Parallelism for Gated DeltaNet

**abstract/A1：** Gated DeltaNet (GDN) achieves linear computational complexity through recurrent state updates, but sequential dependencies between chunks limit parallelism, particularly for long-context workloads with small batch sizes or limited head-level parallelism per GPU. We present FlashQLA, a context-parallel execution framework for GDN that exposes additional sequence-level parallelism while reducing boundary-state preprocessing overhead. FlashQLA reduces boundary-state preprocessing overhead through decay-aware preparation and extends sequence parallelism across GPUs with Dual CP, which shares summary computation across parallelism levels. Workload-adaptive Auto CP and CP-aware kernel co-design further improve execution efficiency. FlashQLA achieves $1.7\\times$-$3.1\\times$ forward speedup and up to $4.4\\times$ backward speedup over Flash Linear Attention (FLA) on a single GPU. On eight GPUs with context lengths up to 1M tokens, Dual CP achieves up to $4.8\\times$ forward speedup and $4.4\\times$ speedup for combined forward and backward execution over FLA KCP.

**comment/C1：** Code is available at https://github.com/QwenLM/FlashQLA

</details>

### 145. [Spec-CoFrGeNet: Reparametrizing Continued Fraction Networks for Stable and Accurate Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32041v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32041

**作者：** Soumyadeep Pal、Amit Dhurandhar、Vijil Chenthamarakshan、Dennis Wei、Karthikeyan Natesan Ramamurthy

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32041v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32041v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对连分数网络替代 FFN 时因极点导致的训练不稳定问题，提出对部分分母的重参数化以约束三对角 Hamiltonian 的谱，从而免去此前的增量训练，在 GPT-2 XL、Llama-MoE、Granite 与 Diffusion Transformer 上保持约 30%–50% 的参数节省并使性能与原 FFN 架构持平。

**相关性简评：** 连分数本质是递归复合的函数类，其极点处理与谱约束的稳定化手段或可供核查循环式或深层 latent 推理模块的数值稳定与深度泛化；但论文本身不涉及视觉证据筛选或 latent 状态的使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Spec-CoFrGeNet: Reparametrizing Continued Fraction Networks for Stable and Accurate Training

**abstract/A1：** Continued fractions have been shown to be a function class capable of constructing expressive yet parameter-efficient neural networks. These neural networks are not only effective for supervised learning, but also for training LLMs. However, the rational form of this function class introduces poles when the denominator approaches zero, which prior work has avoided by enforcing a small positive (non-smooth) lower bound. We show that performance and training stability can be highly sensitive to the choice of this lower bound. In this work, we introduce a novel transformation of the partial denominators, inspired by its connection to the Green's function in physics, that mitigates the above issue elegantly by constraining the spectra of the constructed tridiagonal Hamiltonian. Our approach further eliminates the need for incremental training used by previous works for stability, thus avoiding involved modifications to standard pre-training procedures. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our reparameterization by replacing FFNs with a previously proposed continued fraction architecture for both language and image generative modeling. Across diverse models, such as GPT-2 XL, (nano) Llama-MoE, and Granite, we show that our proposed method achieves performance comparable to the original (FFN-based) architectures while maintaining ~30%-50% parameter savings as before, and in most cases even outperforms the more complicated incremental training baseline. We further demonstrate, for the first time for continued fraction networks, that their effectiveness also carries over to image generative modeling, that utilize diffusion objectives. On a state-of-the-art Diffusion Transformer, we show that our approach again achieves performance comparable to the original FFN-based models with ~30% parameter savings and significantly outperforms the previous incremental training approach.

**comment/C1：** Code is available at https://github.com/IBM/CoFrNets/

</details>

### 146. [SegPFN: Training-Free In-Context Segmentation with Tabular Prior-Data Fitted Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32045v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32045

**作者：** Jiajian Ma、Yihao Qiao、Ke Chen、Kaiyue Feng、Wushuang Rui、Abhishek Jha、Aarti Darji、Yiqiu Shen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32045v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32045v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** SegPFN 将 in-context 分割重构为对冻结视觉特征的 patch 级表格分类：由预训练表格 PFN 以带标注参考 patch 为上下文推断目标图像各 patch 标签，无需分割专用训练，并在 11 个数据集的语义、部件与个性化分割任务上对比现有 ICS 方法。

**相关性简评：** 其用 PFN 的隐式后验实现免训练的上下文证据组合，并显示 hard-negative 参考 patch 能提升细粒度判别，这一「参考视觉证据如何筛选与融合」的做法可能为 LVR 的证据选择与条件化设计提供核查线索，但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理状态或生成过程。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SegPFN: Training-Free In-Context Segmentation with Tabular Prior-Data Fitted Networks

**abstract/A1：** In-context segmentation (ICS) uses one or a few annotated reference images to specify what to segment in a target image. Existing training-free ICS approaches typically rely on manually designed inference procedures, which may limit how flexibly reference information is combined. Learned in-context inference offers an adaptive alternative, but acquiring this capability through segmentation-specific training can compromise generalization to unseen domains. We therefore ask: can a pretrained in-context learner infer what to segment from annotated references without segmentation-specific training? We introduce SegPFN, a training-free framework that reformulates ICS as tabular classification over frozen visual features. A frozen tabular prior-data fitted network (PFN) uses labeled reference patches as context to classify patches in the target image. We comprehensively benchmark SegPFN against major existing ICS methods across 11 datasets spanning semantic, part, and personalized segmentation. SegPFN improves overall mean intersection-over-union (mIoU) by 4.7 points over the strongest overall baseline and achieves the highest average mIoU in four of five task-shot settings. Further analyses show that hard-negative reference patches improve fine-grained target discrimination, while joint conditioning enables SegPFN to use multiple references effectively. These results show that SegPFN offers a simple and effective paradigm for training-free in-context segmentation.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, including 8 pages of supplementary material

</details>

### 147. [EffectWAM: Learning Action-Grounded Effects for Robot Manipulation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32053v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32053

**作者：** Yuan Zhang、Hao Cui、Jingfei Ni、Meiyi Wang、Xin Nie、Chi Liu、Wenjie Xu、Lin Gao、Hao Li、Xianhe Zhang、Jiajia Wu、Diyuan Liu、Jia Pan、Chao Ji

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32053v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32053v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 EffectWAM 世界-动作模型：以「Effect」表示相对当前观测锚点的视觉变化，配合相机位姿编码与动作接地训练，用 flow matching 共享生成专家同时预测视觉变化和可执行动作块，使控制器无需等待视频合成即可动作。

**相关性简评：** 其用动作接地监督让视觉表示保留末端位姿变化、并以 EMA 编码器提供目标，可供核查 LVR 中「latent 是否承载任务必要视觉变化」及动作预测与视觉生成的解耦；但属机器人策略工作，与 VLM 推理状态生成关系需进一步判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EffectWAM: Learning Action-Grounded Effects for Robot Manipulation

**abstract/A1：** World-action models connect visual prediction with executable robot control. We present EffectWAM, which develops this connection through three complementary components: Effect, camera positional encoding (CaPE), and Action Grounding. Effect represents visual change as the difference between independently encoded future observations and a shared current-observation anchor. CaPE conditions endpoint pooling on relative camera pose when reliable extrinsics are available, while sharing the same learned parameters with pose-free pooling for uncalibrated trajectories. Action Grounding trains the visual representation to retain measured changes in end-effector pose and gripper state. An exponential moving average of the observation encoder supplies Effect targets. A shared generation expert learns to jointly predict Effect and an executable action chunk through flow matching, and reuses the sampled pair to generate future video on demand. This allows the controller to execute actions without waiting for video synthesis. We train on more than 20,000 hours of heterogeneous embodied data, excluding unused chain-of-thought data, and accommodate dataset-specific joint, end-effector, and hand-pose representations. Our evaluation uses the Small (8B) configuration on all five benchmarks and additionally evaluates the Large (26B) configuration on RoboDojo. Experiments examine closed-loop manipulation across complementary benchmarks, and comparisons across multiple baseline policies show consistent improvements from Action Grounding.

</details>

### 148. [Fix How It Acts, Not How It Thinks: Surgical Fine-Tuning of Frontier LLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32064v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32064

**作者：** Sandeep Singh Sandha、Prann Bansal、Arvind Sundararajan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32064v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32064v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 merge-aware 微调：在训练每步即把基座权重与 LoRA 更新之和按发布格式（BF16 与 NVFP4，沿用厂商量化尺度）取整，使损失直接看到最终服务权重，从而让智能体编码的「动作层」修正不被合并量化吞掉，并在 Nemotron-3.5 上报告 Terminal-Bench 提升。

**相关性简评：** 其「只优化动作、让推理贴近基座」的分离式监督，以及训练-服务数值对齐（直通取整）的做法，可能为 latent 轨迹的贡献分配与量化、缓存下的内部状态保真提供可供核查的训练线索，但论文本身面向工程部署而非视觉推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Fix How It Acts, Not How It Thinks: Surgical Fine-Tuning of Frontier LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Open-weight LLMs are competent software engineers, but they sometimes fail at tasks they are otherwise able to do. Often it is not a failure of reasoning. It is a few small missteps over a long trajectory (repeating a step that has already failed, or declaring the task done while a requirement is still unmet) that make the difference. Correcting this calls for a surgical weight update that steers the model toward the right actions without interfering with its reasoning. Such updates, typically learned with LoRA adapters, are often too small to survive merging into a released checkpoint. In our BF16 release, the median weight change is only 1.5% of a single rounding step, and merging loses roughly two thirds of the update's norm. When the same adapter is merged into the mixed FP8/NVFP4 release of the same model, 93% of the update disappears. Instead of increasing the size of the update, we directly train on the surviving part. We introduce merge-aware fine-tuning. Standard LoRA rounds the merged weights to the storage format only at export, so the loss never sees the rounded weights. We instead round the sum of base weights and adapter update to the release format at every training step, keeping the vendor's quantization scales, and compute the loss on these weights. The forward pass matches the serving engine numerics, and the gradient passes straight through the rounding, so the model we train is the model we ship. The loss optimizes only the model's actions and keeps its reasoning close to the base model. Applied to Nemotron-3.5, the recipe improves agentic coding in both the BF16 and the NVFP4 release, by up to 8.4 points on Terminal-Bench 2.1, and we publicly release both models.

**comment/C1：** 30 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Models released at https://huggingface.co/abacusai/Smaug-Nemotron-3.5 and https://huggingface.co/abacusai/Smaug-Nemotron-3.5-NVFP4

</details>

### 149. [LoopDVR: Looped Transformer for Efficient Dense Visual Recognition](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32067v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32067

**作者：** Sirui Liang、Xuanlong Yu、Longfei Liu、Xiaodong Cun、Xi Shen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32067v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32067v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 LoopDVR，将预训练的 ViT 主干与 Transformer 解码器按层间表示差异分组共享参数、改造成循环网络，并以分组末层权重初始化、逐层独立 Loop Adapter 和表示蒸馏来保持深度特异变换，从而在密集视觉识别任务上降低参数量。

**相关性简评：** 其循环复用同一组 Transformer 块可视为对内部表示的多次迭代更新，基于层间表示不相似度选择共享分组、用 adapter 保留每轮差异的做法，可能为 latent 推理中重复状态更新如何避免迭代间信息坍缩提供可核查线索；但论文目标是参数效率与识别精度，未涉及推理期 latent 决策或动态停止。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LoopDVR: Looped Transformer for Efficient Dense Visual Recognition

**abstract/A1：** We propose LoopDVR, a framework for converting pretrained Transformer-based dense visual recognition models into parameter-efficient looped networks. Rather than reducing the network width or depth directly, LoopDVR reuses Transformer blocks across layers in both the ViT backbone and Transformer decoder, reducing the number of parameters while retaining the original computational structure. However, naively sharing parameters can disrupt the distinct transformations learned at different depths. To address this challenge, we identify suitable sharing groups based on inter-layer representation dissimilarity and keep the final backbone block independent for multi-scale feature construction. We then initialize each shared backbone block with the pretrained weights of its group's terminal layer to better preserve the learned representations. An independent Loop Adapter at each layer further helps retain depth-specific transformations within shared blocks. Subsequently, we distill visual representations into the looped backbone and integrate it with a looped decoder for task-specific training. Experiments demonstrate that LoopDVR achieves the best accuracy--parameter trade-offs across dense recognition tasks. Compared with the reference models, it reduces parameters by approximately 28% while maintaining competitive accuracy. Notably, LoopDet-S achieves 50.9 box AP with only 7.0M parameters, highlighting its effectiveness in compact models.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://siruuui.github.io/LoopDVR/ ; Github Repo: https://github.com/Intellindust-AI-Lab/LoopDVR

</details>

### 150. [Not the Scalar, but Its Evolution: Robust Source Attribution for Generated Images](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32074v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32074

**作者：** Chao Wang、Zijin Yang、Yaofei Wang、Yuang Qi、Weiming Zhang、Kejiang Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32074v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32074v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文面向生成图像的来源归因：指出以往方法把重建响应压成单一标量会丢失通道—频率结构，转而刻画同一重建算子重复作用时残差能量的频率分辨演化（称为 Spectral Contraction），并据此构建仅依赖目标模型 VAE 的 SpCon 框架，在多种参考条件与平台上评估归因性能。

**相关性简评：** 其「多次重建下频率分辨残差变化」可视为一种探查 VAE 潜表示中保留了哪些视觉细节的探针，或可供核查用于诊断 LVR 内部状态的信息坍缩与视觉证据保留；但论文本身不涉及推理过程。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Not the Scalar, but Its Evolution: Robust Source Attribution for Generated Images

**abstract/A1：** The widespread deployment of latent generative models (LGMs) makes generated image source attribution essential for copyright auditing and data governance, yet practical attribution should remain reliable under common post-processing and platform-induced processing. Existing reconstruction-based attribution methods summarize an image's reconstruction response to a single global scalar, such as the reconstruction error or the ratio of two consecutive errors. These summaries discard channel-frequency structure, allowing image content and post-processing variation to obscure source evidence and making attribution after spreading difficult. We instead uncover a more stable source-discriminative cue under post-processing: the frequency-resolved evolution of residual energy across repeated applications of the same reconstruction operator. Motivated by this insight, we characterize a phenomenon we term Spectral Contraction and use it to build SpCon, a source-attribution framework that accesses only the target model's VAE. SpCon obtains adjacent residuals through two deterministic reconstructions, builds a spectral-contraction representation from their frequency-resolved relative energy change, and aggregates Student-t response densities for each source-condition pair over a finite set of fitted reference components. The same representation supports three settings according to non-belonging reference availability: none (Target-Only, TO; belonging references only), external out-of-domain sources (External-Reference, ER), or known in-domain competitors (Known-Reference, KR). Across seven LGMs, TO, ER, and KR attain average AUROC/AP of 0.8786/0.6344, 0.9404/0.7886, and 0.9652/0.8626 over the 35 conditions, all outperforming the strongest baseline (0.8154/0.5277), and achieve 0.8581/0.5507, 0.9369/0.7549, and 0.9734/0.8773 on the three social platforms.

</details>

### 151. [ExpGuard: Guarding Long-Horizon LLM Agents against Corrupted Experience](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32085v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32085

**作者：** Yuzhou Chen、Licheng Pan、Zhixuan Chu、Yunsheng Lu、Yichen Sun、Han Zheng、Yan Wang、Bingyu Zhu、Haiwen Hong、Longtao Huang、Kui Ren

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32085v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32085v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对长程 LLM agent 把历史轨迹蒸馏为可复用经验时可能被错误或对抗信息污染的问题，ExpGuard 用任务条件下的异构图结合来源与执行依赖预测风险，并通过匹配的反事实重放生成风险标签，在检索时修复高风险经验。

**相关性简评：** 其“反事实重放差分标注”和“检索时风险门控与修复后再进入上下文”的机制，可能为 latent/视觉证据注入的因果贡献分配与筛选提供借鉴，但需核查是否可迁移到单次 VLM 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ExpGuard: Guarding Long-Horizon LLM Agents against Corrupted Experience

**abstract/A1：** Long-horizon large language model (LLM) agents distill past trajectories into reusable experiences. Misleading or adversarial guidance in source trajectories can corrupt these experiences, allowing harmful instructions to persist across tasks and influence future agent actions. Assessing the risks of potentially corrupted experiences poses three challenges: (1) modeling provenance and execution dependencies before experience reuse, (2) learning task-conditioned risk from trajectory outcomes, and (3) repairing risky experiences at online inference. To address these challenges, we present ExpGuard, a framework for retrieval-triggered experience risk assessment and online repair. Specifically, to tackle challenge (1), ExpGuard integrates experience semantics with provenance and execution dependencies in a task-conditioned heterogeneous graph to predict attack and task-failure risks before experience reuse. To enable task-conditioned risk supervision and tackle challenge (2), we conduct matched counterfactual replays of each original experience and its minimally neutralized counterpart from the same task and environment checkpoint, deriving separate risk labels from differences in attack success and legitimate task completion. To tackle challenge (3) at inference time, ExpGuard repairs candidate experiences flagged as high-risk by the graph-based predictor at retrieval and re-predicts their risks before they enter the agent's active experience context. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of ExpGuard in identifying risky experiences and defending agents against experience corruption.

</details>

### 152. [From Memory Access to Evidence Sufficiency: Diagnosing and Addressing Demand--Evidence Misalignment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32088v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32088

**作者：** Shiyao Liu、Yixing Fan、Ruqing Zhang、Xiaohui Yan、Jiafeng Guo、Xueqi Cheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32088v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32088v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出干预式诊断框架 MemPath，把长时记忆问答的失败分解为记忆访问、需求覆盖与证据利用三层，并提出 BiDE-Mem，将问题表示为类型化需求以指导检索与证据组织。

**相关性简评：** 其「访问—覆盖—利用」的失败分解和需求—证据充分性判据，可能可供核查是否适用于诊断视觉证据筛选与答案是否真正使用证据，但该工作属文本记忆检索，迁移到 LVR 尚需确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Memory Access to Evidence Sufficiency: Diagnosing and Addressing Demand--Evidence Misalignment

**abstract/A1：** Long-term memory retrieval often returns query-relevant records, but relevance does not guarantee sufficient evidence: answering requires a set of records that jointly satisfies a question's factual, relational, temporal, and state constraints. We study this demand--evidence misalignment through MemPath, an interventional framework that diagnoses failures in memory access, demand coverage, and evidence utilization. Guided by this diagnosis, we propose BiDE-Mem, which represents questions as typed demands and uses them to guide retrieval and evidence organization. We formalize demand--evidence support; in the evaluated compact path, it is conveyed through provenance-aware evidence organization and Reader guidance rather than a separate generative four-state verification step. On LoCoMo, BiDE-Mem improves accuracy by 6.23 percentage points over Mnemis; on LongMemEval, it achieves 91.80%, with strong multi-hop and temporal performance. Supplementary Qwen-Reader evaluations place it first among seven systems on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S under two judging protocols. Ablations and evidence-level analyses show that demand representation, retrieval, and evidence presentation each contribute to answer quality.

</details>

### 153. [GUI-PRISM: Efficient Action Decoding for GUI Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32097v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GUI-PRISM，用混合动作解码器替代纯文本自回归输出：以字段特定查询从共享多模态特征库中抽取语义与空间信息，并通过条件查询建模动作类型与参数间的依赖，结合门控残差交叉注意力直接预测结构化动作，而开放式文本仍由语言生成完成。

**相关性简评：** 该工作面向 GUI 动作解码效率而非 latent 推理，但其「以查询从多模态特征中并行预测结构化动作组件、并用条件依赖建模」的解码结构，可供核查能否用于非自回归地生成结构化中间状态或并行推理轨迹。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GUI-PRISM: Efficient Action Decoding for GUI Agents

**abstract/A1：** Graphical user interface (GUI) agents translate screenshots and user instructions into executable actions. Most existing approaches rely on vision-language models to generate actions as text, often leading to substantial inference latency due to autoregressive decoding. To address this inefficiency, we propose GUI-PRISM, a hybrid action decoder that directly predicts action types and structured arguments while retaining language generation for open-ended text. Unlike existing spatial decoding methods that primarily focus on target localization, GUI-PRISM extends direct prediction to action types and their associated arguments, enabling complete GUI action prediction. Specifically, GUI-PRISM employs field-specific queries to extract action-relevant semantic and spatial information from a shared multimodal feature bank. It further models dependencies among action components through conditional queries. Gated residual cross-attention refines these predictions using fine-grained multimodal information. GUI-PRISM achieves 95.1\\% accuracy on ScreenSpot-v2, outperforming the strongest head-based spatial decoding method by 2.0 percentage points while delivering a 3.8$\\times$ inference speedup over the baseline. On AndroidControl-v2 and MM-Mind2Web-v2, it improves complete-action accuracy by 4.8 and 0.7 percentage points while achieving 2.7$\\times$ and 3.9$\\times$ inference speedups over the baseline, respectively. Our code is available on our project page.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32113

**作者：** Yicheng Huang、Feng Ke、Linhan Chen、Ziyi Jiang、Xiu Yin Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV、eess.SP

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32113v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32113v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 将LLM改造为毫米波雷达世界模型：用流形解耦的JEPA在连续电磁状态空间做「去噪→推演」两步EMA预测未来3秒物理状态，另设stop-gradient对齐头把冻结的隐状态映射到文本超球面，以避免对比损失破坏状态流形并提升雷达-文本检索。

**相关性简评：** 其「隐空间状态预测与跨模态语言对齐解耦、用stop-gradient头保护连续状态流形」的思路，可能为LVR中latent状态在文本对齐后信息坍缩、视觉旁路被稀释的问题提供可供核查的训练侧线索，但雷达模态与VLM推理场景差异较大。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PhysRF-WorldJEPA: Transforming Heterogeneous Large Language Models into Manifold-Decoupled Millimeter-Wave Radar World Models

**abstract/A1：** Adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar enables privacy-preserving, all-weather physical scene understanding across darkness, smoke, and walls. However, standard instruction tuning treats continuous radar streams as static text-like tokens, causing near-random global radar-to-text retrieval and severe physical drift under sensor blackouts. Conversely, coupling pairwise contrastive losses (e.g., SigLIP) directly into the shared backbone improves retrieval but injects $O(B^2)$ repulsive gradients that fracture continuous coordinate manifolds ($R^2 &lt; 0$). We present PhysRF-WorldJEPA, a manifold-decoupled Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) that separates continuous electromagnetic state prediction from cross-modal language alignment. An unattenuated 1.0x clock anchor and parallel dual-scale RF encoder feed a lean ~3% LoRA LLM trained with two-step state-space EMA-JEPA (Denoise -&gt; Rollout) and sample-axis Batch-VICReg to predict +3.0 s physical states; a stop-gradient alignment head then maps frozen prompt states onto the text hypersphere with false-negative masking. On a 4,541-window tri-domain suite (77/60.25/60 GHz) against 10 baselines, freezing the physical backbone and training only the decoupled head lifts R-&gt;T R@10 from 5.95% to 15.01% and improves MedRank from 107.0 to 60.0 while preserving identical physical readout: 3.37 deg ($R^2=+0.961$) blackout +3.0 s torso tilt, 1.89 m ($R^2=+0.679$; 1.19 m/+0.863 at the RF front-end) cluttered UAV altitude, 2.04 m ($R^2=+0.461$) behind-wall NLOS range, 0.9976 virtual-RIS invariance, and 100% fall recall. Across five 0.5B-1.8B LLM families (15 zero-overhead models), World-JEPA improves retrieval and 75%-drop completion in 10/10 runs and blackout tilt in 4/5 (Span-Euc), 2/5 (Scatter), and 5/5 (per-family best) over SFT.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables

</details>

### 155. [An Automated Framework Integrating Deep Learning and Anatomical Reasoning for Cardiac Phenotyping From CCTA](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32114v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32114

**作者：** Hien Minh Tran、Thi-Thu-Hien Pham、Le Duy Tan、Hieu Xuan Nguyen、Tuong-Anh Mai-Phan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32114v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32114v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出结合深度学习与解剖规则的心脏 CCTA 表型分析框架，用图几何、分支身份与周边结构定义血管特异的 PCAT/EAT 采样区域，并据此自动生成无需专家心包轮廓的训练目标，同时量化冠脉钙化。

**相关性简评：** 其显式解剖/几何约束与规则式替代监督，可能为 LVR 中如何把几何与实体关系先验注入内部表示、以及在缺少标注时构造训练信号提供可供核查的线索，但迁移到多模态推理状态的效果尚不明确。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** An Automated Framework Integrating Deep Learning and Anatomical Reasoning for Cardiac Phenotyping From CCTA

**abstract/A1：** Coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) depicts coronary anatomy and cardiac fat, but segmentation alone does not ensure anatomically consistent measurements. We propose an automated framework that combines deep learning with anatomical reasoning for quantitative cardiac phenotyping. Its anatomical measurement module uses graph geometry, branch identity, and surrounding structures to define vessel-specific pericoronary adipose tissue (PCAT) sampling and a surrogate epicardial adipose tissue (EAT) compartment. The latter also generates training targets without requiring expert pericardium contours. A companion module quantifies coronary calcium on non-contrast CT. Component-wise benchmarking was conducted on five public datasets: ImageCAS, ImageCAS-X, COCA, Visual Lab, and MultiD4CAD. On ImageCAS-X Test-160, lumen segmentation with validation-selected post-processing achieved a Dice score of 0.9133 and a clDice score of 0.940, exceeding the corresponding published CAS-Net point estimates. In the four-split ImageCAS evaluation, the four-member ensemble outperformed the single ResEnc-L model. Analysis of 800 paired scans showed that PCAT attenuation measurements differed between whole-vessel and lumen references. External EAT evaluation showed strong volume correlation and good spatial overlap. Explicit anatomical rules make the resulting measurements interpretable and inspectable. In practice, the framework provides a standardized pipeline for processing cardiac CT cohorts and quantifying coronary calcium, PCAT, and EAT for population-level analysis and comparison across studies. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/HarryTRAN207/CardiacCT-Research

### 156. [The Old Scene Lives in the Cache: Diagnosing and Shedding Stale History in Streaming Video Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32116v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32116

**作者：** Hao Zhou、Ziyang Xu、Chenhan Jin、Hao Qin、Shengze Xu、Tieyong Zeng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32116v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32116v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对流式视频生成中切换场景时缓存历史既维持主体又保留旧场景物体的问题，通过干预文本条件、去噪步、局部窗口与 attention sink 定位陈旧内容的来源，并提出免训练的 Molt Forcing：用目标场景冷启动历史，仅从原缓存中保留主体 token。

**相关性简评：** 其对 KV 缓存、attention sink 与 token 级保留/丢弃的受控干预与「选择性保留主体 token」设计，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选及缓存内容对 latent 状态的影响提供可核查的诊断与操作线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Old Scene Lives in the Cache: Diagnosing and Shedding Stale History in Streaming Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Switching scenes while preserving the original subject in streaming video generation exposes a conflict: cached history helps maintain the subject but also sustains old-scene objects that should disappear. Through controlled interventions on text conditioning, denoising steps, the local window, and the attention sink, we identify how cached visual history keeps this obsolete content. When the original frames remain in the cache, KV flush and sink recomputation still leave old-scene objects in the generated videos. Replacing this history with target-scene history largely removes those objects, but also changes the subject, reducing face similarity to the pre-switch subject. We then propose Molt Forcing, a training-free method that rebuilds scene history from a cold-start target scene while selectively retaining subject tokens from the original cache. Across 16 scene families, Molt Forcing removes old-scene objects at least as reliably as an Echo-Forcing hard cut while keeping the subject much closer to its pre-switch appearance.

</details>

### 157. [Monte Carlo Tree Search for Classifier Chains](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32118v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32118

**作者：** Romain Poggi、Jesse Read

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32118v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32118v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 TSCC，用蒙特卡洛树搜索改进步进式概率分类器链的推断，在标签空间探索与高潜标签集预测之间取得平衡，以更好估计联合概率与精确匹配下的不确定性，并在预测与计算性能上给出初步结果。

**相关性简评：** 其用 MCTS 在逐标签的结构化输出序列上平衡探索与利用、并据此估计不确定性，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理轨迹的搜索、候选择优与停止决策提供可核查的方法线索，但任务本身是多标签分类，不涉及视觉状态分析。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Monte Carlo Tree Search for Classifier Chains

**abstract/A1：** Multi-label classification continues to be relevant to a variety of modern tasks. Among other challenges, modern data sets are increasingly large with respect to the number of labels, and these labels may be noisy or missing in the training sets. Label-wise scores and ranking-based metrics have been popular, but optimising exact multi-label evaluation (where a predicted set of labels should match the true set exactly) is particularly relevant for many domains, e.g., in medicine; alongside some measure of confidence. This requires an estimation of joint probability across labels (a model of label dependence; conditioned on each input instance). A family of methods known as probabilistic classifier chains provides such inference. However, these existing varieties either do not scale to a large number of labels or do so by approximating joint via marginal distributions in a way that compromises the estimation of uncertainty for exact match accuracy. We overcome this issue by proposing TSCC; leveraging a Monte Carlo Tree Search methodology to enhance chain inference via an efficient balance between the exploration of label space and the exploration of promising label-set predictions. Results are promising both in terms of predictive and computational performance.

</details>

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** EditText 提出细粒度图像文字编辑框架：以掩码图与源文字风格双条件输入，通过 Attention Transport（源权重与空间聚合核）实现选择性的视觉细节搬运，并用字形结构损失多阶段训练，同时发布 TBench 基准。

**相关性简评：** 其「保持总注意力权重、仅重分配空间注意力以搬运源图细节」的机制，可能为 LVR 中按空间位置筛选并保留视觉证据的 latent 状态更新提供方法线索，需核查其是否强依赖扩散生成结构与像素级监督。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EditText: Structure-Aware Generation and Selective Visual Transport for Fine-Grained Text Editing

**abstract/A1：** Fine-grained text editing aims to accurately replace text in a specified region while preserving the source text's font, color, and texture, as well as visual consistency in unedited regions. We present EditText, a unified framework for fine-grained text editing that combines target character generation with visual transport from the source image. The model uses dual-condition Fill inputs: a masked image and a source text style reference, both sharing a spatial reference with the target image. The masked image hides the original text and retains unedited content as a source canvas; the style reference supplies appearance cues that guide new character generation together with the target text. We introduce an Attention Transport framework in which Source Weight describes the attention allocated to a condition and the Spatial Aggregation Kernel describes its internal spatial attention distribution. Accurate transfer of source details depends on attention strength, the retention of details in condition features, and spatially accurate aggregation. For selected non-edit queries, we therefore preserve the total attention weight assigned to the masked image while redistributing its attention toward spatially corresponding neighborhoods, enabling selective visual transport. Multi-stage training, combined with a Glyph-aware Structural Loss on local target character structure, teaches the model to generate accurate text, preserve source text appearance, and retain unedited details. We also introduce TBench, a fine-grained text editing benchmark covering Alphabetic, Logographic, and Arabic numerals, to evaluate character updates, appearance preservation, and the preservation of unedited details. On TBench, EditText achieves state-of-the-art non-edit-region SSIM (0.9769) and full-image LPIPS (0.0460).

</details>

### 159. [Interpretable Orthogonal Latent Diffusion with Scale-Selective Uncertainty for Medical Image Super-Resolution](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32135v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32135

**作者：** Onkar Jadhav、Tim French

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32135v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32135v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Med-PODiff，在脑部 MRI 超分辨率中用分块的 proper orthogonal decomposition 系数空间做扩散生成，将预测不确定性拆成粗结构、细细节与总不确定性，并据此定义逐像素的幻觉风险分数 H\_p 来定位细尺度误差。

**相关性简评：** 其按尺度分解不确定性并以 H\_p 定位细细节误差的做法，可能为 LVR 中判断 latent 保留的视觉细节是否可信、何时需要重新看图（LOOK）提供线索，但属图像重建任务，迁移可行性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Interpretable Orthogonal Latent Diffusion with Scale-Selective Uncertainty for Medical Image Super-Resolution

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion models are increasingly used for medical image reconstruction and super-resolution, but their samples may contain plausible fine-scale hallucinations that are difficult to identify from the reconstructed image alone. We propose Med-PODiff, a patch-wise proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) diffusion framework for brain MRI super-resolution that performs generative reconstruction in compact and interpretable local coefficient spaces. Unlike pixel-space or learned-latent diffusion models, Med-PODiff uses the POD structure to separate low-rank anatomical variation from fine-detail residual variation, enabling predictive uncertainty to be decomposed into total, coarse, and fine components. Building on this decomposition, we define a pixel-wise hallucination-risk score, $H\_p$, that emphasizes regions where fine-detail uncertainty dominates coarse structural uncertainty. On brain MRI, Med-PODiff outperforms representative diffusion baselines in reconstruction quality while producing well-calibrated predictive intervals, with total uncertainty detecting high-error regions at AUROC 0.954. More importantly, the decomposed uncertainty is scale-selective: coarse and fine uncertainty preferentially predict errors at the corresponding scales, with $H\_p$ localizing fine error at AUROC $0.906$. Controlled injections and retrospective Cartesian $k$-space undersampling further support fine-detail localization and degradation robustness. The discarded POD tail is only $3.8\\%$ of the retained fine-error magnitude, and Med-PODiff improves downstream segmentation consistency while requiring substantially less inference time than pixel-space diffusion.

</details>

### 160. [LiteSTAR: Low-Rank Channel Modulation for Temporally Consistent CVD Video Compensation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32140v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32140

**作者：** Peiyang Lin、Sichen Lin、Yipeng Liao、Liqun Lin、Xu Wang、Tiesong Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32140v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32140v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LiteSTAR，以可插拔的轻量通道自适应解码器 LiCaD 在低秩状态空间中做时序滤波并调制特征通道，实现色觉缺陷（CVD）视频重着色的一致性与低参数量。

**相关性简评：** 其用学习到的过程／观测不确定性在低秩空间更新隐状态、再据此调制特征的做法，可能为 LVR 中跨步 latent 状态维护与更新提供可核查线索；但任务是辅助性视频重着色，不涉及多模态推理本身。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LiteSTAR: Low-Rank Channel Modulation for Temporally Consistent CVD Video Compensation

**abstract/A1：** Color Vision Deficiency (CVD) affects a large population worldwide, yet practical recoloring must run continuously on-device. Frame-wise video recoloring produces color flickering, while existing methods rely on costly cross-frame alignment in pixel or feature space. We observe that color flickering correlates with variations in channel-wise responses, with color-sensitive variations concentrated in a low-rank subspace. Based on this observation, we propose Lightweight Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Recoloring (LiteSTAR), built around LiCaD, a plug-and-play Lightweight Channel-Adaptive Decoder. LiCaD performs temporal filtering in a low-rank state space with learned process and observation uncertainties. It then modulates feature channels to achieve temporal consistency without explicit spatial alignment. LiteSTAR further employs adaptive patch routing to improve color discrimination for CVD users while avoiding unnecessary over-enhancement. We also introduce EgoCVDSet, the first egocentric video benchmark for CVD recoloring. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that LiteSTAR achieves superior performance with only 0.05M parameters. LiCaD further demonstrates strong generalization across different tasks and network architectures. The code, models, and dataset will be released after review.

</details>

### 161. [ARS-VLM: Visually Aligned Augmented Random Search for Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32147v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32147

**作者：** Xiangwei Wang、Jianyuan Lin、Peng Wang、Saman Halgamuge

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32147v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32147v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 VLM 多模态推理的仅前向训练，提出 ARS-VLM：从跨网格成对视图提取对比视觉基、对浅层视觉融合层施加软子空间先验，并按成对视图筛选扰动，以缓解 patch 网格过拟合和灾难性遗忘。

**相关性简评：** 其跨网格视图筛选与浅层视觉表示约束，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节保留、证据筛选及训练期状态约束提供可核查线索，但未直接涉及 latent 推理状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ARS-VLM: Visually Aligned Augmented Random Search for Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** First-order reinforcement learning, such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), is widely used to post-train Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for multimodal reasoning. However, it incurs heavy memory and system overhead from backpropagation, optimizer states, and a reference model. Forward-only zeroth-order (ZO) methods, such as Evolution Strategies (ES) and its top-k variant Augmented Random Search (ARS), avoid these overheads via reward-guided weight perturbations, yet remain unexplored for VLM reasoning. We find that directly applying standard ES or vanilla ARS to VLMs suffers from two fundamental failure modes: (i) patch-grid overfitting, fitting fragile grid-specific visual token artifacts while ignoring spatial invariants, and (ii) catastrophic forgetting, degrading general perception and out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks due to unbounded high-rank parameter and policy drift. We propose ARS-VLM, a visually aligned Augmented Random Search framework for forward-only VLM post-training. First, ARS-VLM extracts a contrastive visual basis from bilinearly paired cross-grid views, concentrating perturbations on shared visual signals while suppressing patch-shift artifacts. Second, ARS-VLM anchors shallow visual-fusion layers with a soft subspace prior while freeing deep reasoning layers, restraining policy drift without a reference model. Third, ARS-VLM scores perturbations on paired views to discard view-fragile directions during top-k selection. We evaluate ARS-VLM on Qwen3-VL-4B and Qwen3-VL-8B on multimodal reasoning tasks. On 8B, ARS-VLM reaches 61.0% validation accuracy in 20 steps versus 150 for GRPO (7.5x fewer optimization steps) and avoids the late OOD collapse of vanilla ARS and ES. Moreover, ARS-VLM achieves 75.41% single-view micro accuracy across seven OOD vision reasoning benchmarks, compared with 75.31% for full-parameter GRPO, using forward-only post-training.

</details>

### 162. [RetraQ: Manifold-Constrained Critic Guidance for Flow Policies in RL](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32148v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32148

**作者：** Xuanzhuo Liu、Wu Chen、Ruixiang Wu、Shuai Yuan、Chuankang Li、Tongxin Li、Maoqing Yao、Guanghui Ren

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32148v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32148v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RetraQ：用冻结 flow 速度场的雅可比过滤 critic 梯度，并以该去噪映射回缩校正动作，使引导落在数据支撑的流形上，用于测试时引导、策略蒸馏与离线到在线 RL，在 LIBERO、OGBench 及真实插销任务上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「雅可比切向过滤 + 流形回缩」约束更新方向与落点的做法，可能为 latent 推理状态更新中加入表示支撑域约束、抑制向训练分布外的外推提供可核查的方法线索；但论文本身属机器人 RL，与视觉推理无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RetraQ: Manifold-Constrained Critic Guidance for Flow Policies in RL

**abstract/A1：** A learned critic can improve a pretrained flow-matching policy by steering sampled actions toward higher predicted value. However, even a critic that fits the behavior data well can provide misleading action gradients. Gradient components pointing away from the data-supported region are weakly constrained by behavior data and can lead guidance to exploit critic extrapolation errors. We introduce RetraQ (Retraction-based Q-guidance), which uses geometry encoded by the pretrained flow to constrain both the direction and the destination of critic guidance. A single velocity evaluation of the frozen flow defines a denoising map. RetraQ filters the critic gradient with the map's Jacobian and applies the map itself to correct the updated action. Our analysis characterizes when these operations approximate tangent filtering and retraction onto the behavior manifold. The same update guides actions at test time and provides targets for policy distillation and online reinforcement learning. In controlled studies, RetraQ improves true return while keeping refined actions close to the data-supported region, and its distillation targets remain more stable than those of raw critic ascent. In offline-to-online training on LIBERO and OGBench, RetraQ achieves higher mean final success than the evaluated critic-guidance baselines. On a real-world plug-insertion task, test-time RetraQ improves the success rate of a behavior-cloned $π\_{0.5}$ policy from 55.0% to 76.7%. Online training further increases success to 98.3% in only 30 minutes and 100% within one hour. Project page: https://2027ICLR.github.io/retraq/

**comment/C1：** 32 pages, 11 figures, including appendix

</details>

### 163. [RoboProbe: Benchmarking Physical Plausibility of Robot World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32152v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32152

**作者：** Zhuoying Yang、Jiachen Ni、Yichen Guo、Xiaoshan Wu、Mengyu Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32152v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32152v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文面向机器人世界模型生成的视频，提出五个「物理规律专项」指标（接触真实性、客体持续性、固体性、机器人形变、客体形变），把分割、跟踪、3D 几何与外观对比得到的时空证据与 VLM 推理结合，并构建由 agentic 框架协调指标执行、通过受限动作选择性精化的评测流程，同时发布含人工标注的 RP-Bench。

**相关性简评：** 其「先采集时空证据再定向调用 VLM 推理、并按需受限精化」的评测框架，可供核查多模态推理中的视觉证据筛选与 LOOK/STOP 成本收益，但论文本身研究视频物理可信度评测，并非 latent 推理机制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RoboProbe: Benchmarking Physical Plausibility of Robot World Models

**abstract/A1：** Evaluating the physical plausibility of generated videos is critical for reliable robotic planning with world models. These videos inform action proposal and assessment before real-world execution, so undetected physical violations can lead to erroneous assessments of action feasibility and safety. Yet current video generators often produce physically implausible interactions. Detecting such violations directly with vision-language models (VLMs) remains challenging as physical verification requires evidence-grounded spatiotemporal reasoning beyond high-level semantic understanding. We develop five law-specific metrics for evaluating physical plausibility by combining spatiotemporal evidence from segmentation, tracking, 3D geometry, or appearance comparisons with targeted VLM reasoning: Contact fidelity, Object persistence, Solidity, Robot deformation, and Object deformation. Building on this metric suite, we introduce RoboProbe, an agentic evaluation framework that coordinates metric execution and selectively refines evaluations through constrained actions. To evaluate the physical plausibility of robot world models, we further introduce RP-Bench, with 761 human-labeled generated videos and 130 real demonstrations of 239 manipulation tasks from 12 robot datasets. On RP-Bench, all five metrics achieve AUROCs above 0.85 and outperform the evaluated learned judges, prior evaluators, and a frames-only Gemini baseline. Applying these metrics to five video generators reveals distinct patterns of physical violations across models, in both violation types and frequencies.

**comment/C1：** 42 pages, including supplementary material

</details>

### 164. [SoccerNarrate: Event-Grounded Streaming Soccer Commentary with Macro-Window Preference Alignment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32153v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32153

**作者：** Zihan Jia、Zhilin Dai、Zhengming Zhang、Min Yang、Zhenpeng Huang、Jiaqi Li、Caixia Sun、Xi Chen、Liang Li、Junlan Feng、Gangshan Wu、Limin Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32153v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32153v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文面向整场足球视频的流式解说，构建时间锚定数据集与事件中心评测基准，并提出宏窗口偏好对齐：在同一流式前缀下比较多步因果 rollout，使输出更贴合完整事件语义。

**相关性简评：** 其基于共享前缀的多步 rollout 偏好对齐与事件错配反事实负例，可能为 LVR 中推理轨迹的贡献分配和事件级监督提供训练线索，但需核查该信号是否依赖外部事件标注而非模型内部状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SoccerNarrate: Event-Grounded Streaming Soccer Commentary with Macro-Window Preference Alignment

**abstract/A1：** Existing clip-based soccer commentary models often produce delayed, repeated, or poorly synchronized narration on untrimmed full-match videos. Recent streaming video-language models make low-latency full-match narration feasible, but they often favor general descriptions rather than professional, event-grounded soccer commentary. They may describe nearby actions while failing to mention key events such as goals, cards, substitutions, and offsides correctly and on time. In this paper, we present SoccerNarrate to bridge low-latency streaming narration with event-grounded professional soccer commentary across data, training, and evaluation. First, we construct SoccerNarrate-Data, a large-scale time-anchored dataset with word-level ASR alignment, quality filtering, and entity calibration. Second, we perform macro-window preference alignment (MWPA), which aligns the model with complete event-level commentary semantics by comparing causal multi-step rollouts from the same streaming prefix while keeping second-level inference unchanged. We further use event-mismatched human commentaries as counterfactual negatives to emphasize event semantics over commentary style. Third, we introduce SoccerNarrate-Eval, an event-centric benchmark based on temporally constrained event entailment. Full-match experiments show that SoccerNarrate improves event coverage and event-aligned precision over strong offline and streaming baselines. Code and models are released at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/SoccerNarrate.

</details>

### 165. [Multi-view Random-set Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32170v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32170

**作者：** Mengchi Zuo、Tianyang Wang、Cai Xu、Ziyu Guan、Wei Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32170v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32170v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出多视图随机集学习（MRSL），针对单视图只含部分判别信息、无法独立定类的问题，用类重叠度筛选紧凑的候选类集合并保留集合级支持，再在跨视图融合时对集合交集赋联合支持，最后才转换为概率。

**相关性简评：** 其「集合值证据+交集融合」的做法可能为 LVR 中建模未解析的视觉证据、跨来源证据筛选与避免过早坍缩到单一答案提供方法线索，但原论文属多视图分类，是否可迁移到视觉—语言 latent 状态仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Multi-view Random-set Learning

**abstract/A1：** Trusted multi-view learning aims to integrate heterogeneous views for accurate and reliable predictions. However, multi-view data often exhibit the view degradation phenomenon: individual views contain only partial discriminative information and cannot independently determine the instance-level label. Requiring such views to produce unambiguous class evidence can distort evidence learning and mislead subsequent fusion. Existing methods addressing this problem have at least one of the following drawbacks: (1) assigning evidence to individual classes without explicitly representing unresolved class groups; (2) projecting composite beliefs onto individual classes before fusion, preventing direct refinement of candidate groups through cross-view set intersections. To address these limitations, we propose a new Multi-view Random-Set Learning (MRSL) paradigm, which preserves view-specific support for candidate class sets and refines candidate classes through cross-view fusion. Specifically, we quantify class overlap to select a compact collection of sets for each view, avoiding the exponential cost of modeling all class subsets. We then perform set-level fusion by assigning joint support to set intersections, allowing complementary views to narrow the candidate classes before probability conversion. Experiments on synthetic and eight real-world datasets validate the proposed overlap measure and demonstrate that MRSL achieves the highest accuracy on all eight datasets. Compared with the strongest baselines, MRSL improves average accuracy by 4.71% and reduces average expected calibration error by 6.33%. All datasets and code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, including supplementary material. Corresponding author: Cai Xu

</details>

### 166. [Mind the Band: The Hidden Frequency Variable in Geometric RoPE](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32171v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32171

**作者：** Seonghyun Jin、Youngmin Kim、Jong Chul Ye

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32171v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32171v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文诊断几何 RoPE 中被默认继承、少有讨论的频率带宽设置，指出带宽选择可改变多视图新视角合成与双视图深度估计的基准排名，并分析超宽带宽下前向平滑而梯度未衰减的「前向—反向不对称」。

**相关性简评：** 几何位置编码的频带与 head 维度耦合可能影响 VLM 内部空间对应信息的保留方式，其「带宽需按图像坐标设定」「前向平滑不等于反向稳定」的结论可供核查多视图推理中的位置编码与训练监督设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Mind the Band: The Hidden Frequency Variable in Geometric RoPE

**abstract/A1：** Geometric rotary position encodings (RoPE) incorporate 3D camera geometry into multi-view attention by rotating token features according to viewing rays, depths, and reprojected image coordinates. Each coordinate is rotated across a progression of frequencies--its frequency band--yet existing implementations leave this band to inherited defaults, either retaining standard 2D RoPE's top frequency or letting the frequency span grow exponentially with the attention head dimension. We show that this unstandardized setting can reverse benchmark rankings. In novel view synthesis on RealEstate10K, RayRoPE matches the strongest baseline in the 47M model (144-channel heads), yet trails by 1.2 dB in the 25M model (48-channel heads), and exhibits the same reversal when varying head size alone at fixed model width. Populating a 243x range with four frequencies instead of the 3x default at 48 channels recovers 0.9 dB of that gap. Across view synthesis and two-view depth estimation, overly narrow bands consistently blur correspondence, whereas all three projection-based encodings perform reliably when their top frequency lies within 0.3--3 rotations per 8-pixel patch (10--90 rotations across 256x256 RealEstate10K). At the opposite extreme, overly wide bands degrade RayRoPE through a forward-backward asymmetry: averaging rotations over a predicted depth interval damps high frequencies in the forward pass, yet leaves their gradients with respect to predicted depth undamped. Blocking only those high-frequency depth gradients recovers 90--93% of the lost PSNR, showing that forward smoothing does not guarantee backward stability. Guided by this analysis, we distill practical guidelines--setting bands in image coordinates, populating spans in small heads, and avoiding unconditional same-view damping--and advocate reporting and matching frequency bands in future multi-view benchmarks.

**comment/C1：** 33 pages, 15 figures, 23 tables. Project page: https://bispl-wm.github.io/MindTheBand/

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出 RecastAgent，在冻结权重下用经验引导的 agent 框架做源条件视频重铸：规划器依据视觉批判选择编辑提示与输入视频状态，可基于部分进展继续或回溯以保留原事件结构，并把完成的轨迹蒸馏为带证据链接的条件性原则，另构建 67 个源视频、134 个配对任务的基准。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What to Change, What to Keep: Experience-Evolving Agents for Video Recasting

**abstract/A1：** Video recasting aims to transform the entities and environments of existing videos into new visual worlds while preserving their essential actions and interactions. However, achieving coherent transformations remains challenging, as coordinated edits can disrupt the original event structure. In this paper, we introduce RecastAgent, an experience-guided agentic framework for source-conditioned video recasting that operates under frozen model weights. Our framework employs an Experience-Guided Planner to choose edit prompts and input video states under qualitative visual critique, allowing the agent to build upon partial progress or backtrack to preserve source structure. Across tasks, an Experience Accumulation module distills completed trajectories into conditional, evidence-linked principles that record both an editing strategy and its scope of validity. We additionally construct a benchmark of 67 source videos with 134 paired-specification tasks across six creative categories for evaluation. Experiments demonstrate that RecastAgent outperforms single-pass and agentic rewriting baselines across Bernini and Ditto. Furthermore, accumulated experience improves performance on held-out test videos and transfers zero-shot to external benchmarks like FiVE-Bench and VE-Bench.

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** MoGe-4D 提出前馈框架，用成对的 all-centric 与 ego-centric 动态点图有序查询统一几何与运动预测，并让高容量编码器只缓存一次全局时空特征、由轻量查询解码器按需稠密解码，另构建 RigIDTrack 合成数据与轨迹压缩监督。

**相关性简评：** 其「重编码器一次性缓存粗粒度时空特征、轻量查询解码器灵活分辨率稠密读取」的结构，可能可迁移为 LVR 中视觉证据缓存与按需读取、动态计算的组织方式，但原论文面向 4D 重建与跟踪，未涉及推理状态或答案生成，需核查其对应性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MoGe-4D: Efficient, Flexible, and Unified Dense 4D Reconstruction and Tracking

**abstract/A1：** Reconstructing dynamic scenes from RGB video requires reasoning about both 3D geometry and motion across viewpoints, yet existing methods either split reconstruction and tracking into fragmented pipelines or face prohibitive dense spatiotemporal decoding costs. We introduce MoGe-4D, a feed-forward framework that unifies geometry and motion prediction via ordered queries of paired allocentric and egocentric dynamic point maps. Each query maps source pixels to a target time simultaneously in both camera frames, resolving relative camera pose in closed form while flexibly serving depth, dynamic registration, and dense 3D tracking. For efficient dense querying, MoGe-4D decouples scene modeling from query decoding: a high-capacity context encoder caches coarse global spatiotemporal features once, while a lightweight query encoder rapidly decodes dense point maps at flexible resolutions. Furthermore, as supervising dense 4D queries demands continuous 3D correspondences whose raw trajectory storage is prohibitive, we introduce RigIDTrack, a synthetic data pipeline and dataset that compresses surface dynamics into rigidity-regularized affine bodies, recovering exact arbitrary-frame 3D trajectories with $\\sim15\\%$ storage overhead over RGB-D video. Across diverse benchmarks, MoGe-4D achieves state-of-the-art dense 3D tracking, matches dedicated 3D foundation models in reconstruction, and runs substantially faster than prior 4D baselines.

### 169. [Steerable by Design: Conditional Pretraining for Robust Control of Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32199v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32199

**作者：** Henry Castillo、Yanchen Liu、Claudio Mayrink Verdun、Dylan Hadfield-Menell

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32199v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32199v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出一种条件预训练方法与架构，将高层语义控制信号与数据 token 流从预训练开始就分离：编码器提取控制特征，经 cross-attention 注入且禁止 token 流回写，训练出 Mancelle-3B 与 400M 版本，验证其引导强度与抗对抗反引导能力。

**相关性简评：** 其「单向注入、不可回写」的控制通道可能为 LVR 中视觉或 latent 证据如何被生成流使用、如何避免信息坍缩提供可供核查的架构线索，但该工作为纯文本控制，未涉及视觉推理，迁移性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Steerable by Design: Conditional Pretraining for Robust Control of Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Our goal is to build language models that are steerable by design. Today's language models are pretrained with next-token prediction, which relegates alignment and control to the final 1% of training tokens or inference-time interventions. These models repurpose a single input channel for both instructions and data, leading to common failure modes where the model mistakenly treats data as instructions such as intentional jailbreaks and unintentional in-context alignment drift. To correct this, we propose a pretraining method and architecture that separates the two from the very start, producing Mancelle-3B. An encoder processes high-level semantic features of upcoming text with cross-attention that prevents the token stream from writing back into this control channel. During pretraining, the model learns to rely on these features to predict the next token, turning the channel into an effective handle for steering the model. Mancelle-3B steers more strongly than prompt- and activation-based methods on comparable open models while maintaining fluency, and it withstands adversarial black-box and soft-prompt counter-steering that defeats those baselines. We reproduce this against a more controlled baseline with Mancelle-400M. Our results show that robust control can be built into language models if we do so early and intentionally.

</details>

### 170. [SplatTok: Data-Driven Compression of 3D Gaussian Splats with Scene-Level Tokens](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32202v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32202

**作者：** Sai Karthikey Pentapati、Shashank Nelamangala Sridhara、Birendra Kathariya、Peng Yin、Guandao Yang、Alan C. Bovik

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.GR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32202v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32202v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SplatTok，一个学习式场景重合成编解码器：用 transformer 把 3D Gaussian splat 编码为空间锚定的紧凑 latent token，共享解码器直接合成新原语，并以渲染而非原语重建作为监督；压缩时冻结网络，仅用量化感知的 latent 搜索细化场景码。

**相关性简评：** 其「冻结解码器、只搜索 latent，且仅以渲染结果监督」的设定，可能为 LVR 中推理期 latent 状态如何细化、以及输出监督能否真正塑造内部视觉表示提供可核查的方法线索，但论文本身不涉及多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SplatTok: Data-Driven Compression of 3D Gaussian Splats with Scene-Level Tokens

**abstract/A1：** 3D Gaussian splats enable real-time rendering but require substantial storage. Existing compression methods either encode the primitives of a given splat or optimize a compact representation independently for each scene. Yet a Gaussian splat is only one realization of a scene: different arrangements of primitives can produce nearly identical rendered views. We exploit this freedom on the decoding side with SplatTok, a learned scene-resynthesis codec. Trained across thousands of real-world scenes, a transformer encodes an existing splat into compact, spatially anchored latent tokens, and a shared decoder synthesizes a new set of standard Gaussian primitives without preserving correspondence to the input. The representation is learned through rendering supervision rather than primitive reconstruction. At compression time, a quantization-aware latent search refines only the scene code, keeping the networks frozen, and closes most of the encoder's remaining error. On standard benchmarks, using only renders of the input splat for the latent search, without the original training images, SplatTok matches the PSNR of the feed-forward codec FCGS with 4 to 6.5 times smaller files, compressing input splats about 75 to 110 times. With the training images, it exceeds the PSNR of the per-scene method HAC++ with 13 to 41% smaller files. A single model trained on DL3DV generalizes to unseen scenes with millions of Gaussians and supports multiple target rates without retraining.

</details>

### 171. [XMind: Thinking Twice via Cross-Memory Reasoning for LLM-Based Autonomous Driving](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32209v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32209

**作者：** Zuyi Guo、Xianjie Dai、Lei Yang、Xiaocong Zhao、Jingguang Li、Kitae Jang、Heye Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32209v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32209v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** XMind 是一个免训练的 LLM 自动驾驶框架，结合近期交通状态的工作记忆与关键风险事件的情景记忆：先给出初始决策，再与检索到的历史经验交叉核验，冲突时依据经验做第二次决策；情景记忆由扰动条件下的反事实 rollout 验证后存成结构化风险胶囊，并按空间风险模式与场景语义联合检索。

**相关性简评：** 其「反事实 rollout 验证备选动作 + 按风险模式检索结构化经验 + 冲突后二次决策」可供核查是否迁移为 latent 假设的生成、证据筛选与再推理/停止机制，但该框架面向驾驶决策且不涉及视觉 latent 状态，联系仍属方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** XMind: Thinking Twice via Cross-Memory Reasoning for LLM-Based Autonomous Driving

**abstract/A1：** Memory-augmented large language model (LLM) driving agents can reuse past experience, yet previously learned corrections often fail to transfer when traffic conditions change. A key limitation is that existing memories mainly record observed outcomes, providing little evidence about alternative actions. We introduce XMind, a training-free framework that enables LLM-based driving to "Think Twice" through cross-memory reasoning. XMind integrates working memory of recent traffic states with episodic memory of critical risk events. The agent first makes an initial decision from the current context and then cross-checks it against retrieved historical experience. If a conflict arises, it makes a second decision guided by the retrieved evidence. To construct reliable episodic memory, XMind evaluates alternative actions through counterfactual rollouts under perturbed traffic conditions and stores the verified outcomes as structured risk capsules. These capsules are retrieved by jointly matching spatial risk patterns and scenario semantics. Across closed-loop highway simulations, XMind achieves success rates of 83.3-93.3%, exceeding the strong baseline by 6.6 percentage points on average. Evaluation on K-Risk further demonstrates lower decision risk on unseen real-world high-risk interactions. Ablation studies confirm the complementary benefits of working memory, risk-text retrieval, and counterfactual verification. Code is available at https://github.com/xiangxiangliuwo/XMind

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 3 figures

</details>

### 172. [NativeDrive: Native Multimodal Foundations for Autonomous Driving](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32216v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32216

**作者：** Zehua Fan、Qi Jiang、Wei Li、Kai Tang、Yue Jiang、Yujian Li、Bailin Li、Feng Gao、Yan Wang、Kun Zhan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32216v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32216v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 NativeDrive，一个无编码器的原生多模态驾驶框架：在统一理解与生成的骨干上，复用理解专家的 token 预测接口输出离散策略、改造生成专家输出连续策略，并在训练期借生成专家的编辑能力提供密集场景结构监督，推理时只运行所选规划策略。

**相关性简评：** 其「训练期用生成分支做密集监督、推理期只跑策略」的解耦方式，可供核查 LVR 中辅助监督与推理成本、贡献分配的关系；但对象是驾驶动作而非 latent 视觉推理状态，线索较间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** NativeDrive: Native Multimodal Foundations for Autonomous Driving

**abstract/A1：** Autonomous driving requires semantic understanding and fine-grained scene perception for precise action prediction. Vision-language-action models (VLAs) inherit semantic priors, but low-dimensional action labels provide limited structural supervision. Some studies extend VLAs with visual generation tasks or adopt video-based world-action models (WAMs), but both approaches introduce appearance-reconstruction overhead, which is less relevant to planning. Native multimodal models offer an alternative to unify understanding and generation within one backbone. On this basis, we propose NativeDrive, a native encoder-free multimodal driving framework adapting the unified backbone for policy learning and introduce a dense supervision task tailored to driving. The Native Action Interface reuses the understanding expert's token-prediction interface for the discrete policy and adapts the generation expert for continuous policy. Driving Semantic Editing reuses the generation expert's editing capability for dense scene-structure supervision during training, while inference runs only the selected planning policy. NativeDrive achieves competitive planning performance among unified understanding-and-generation models on NAVSIM v1 and v2, with ablations validating its components' effectiveness. Code will be released.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables, including supplementary material

</details>

### 173. [PoseVLN: Learning Geometric State Evolution for Vision-Language Navigation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32218v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32218

**作者：** Pengyu Hou、Mingfei Han、Haihong Hao、Xiaolong Wu、Bo Dong、Xiaojun Chang、Salman Khan、Bin Shi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32218v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32218v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PoseVLN：以相机位姿作为几何状态表示，将视觉记忆与当前观测放入 episode 相对坐标系，联合预测未来 K 步动作及同时间跨度的局部 ΔPose，并把 ΔPose 与当前轨迹位姿复合后递归传播，形成从过去记忆到未来运动的连续几何状态演化，在 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE Val-Unseen 上以单目 RGB 输入提升成功率。

**相关性简评：** 「预测增量状态再与当前状态复合、递归传播」为 latent 状态更新与轨迹级监督提供了可供核查的方法线索，可能启发 LVR 中推理状态如何随时间累积与预测；但任务为具身导航，未研究 latent 视觉证据的筛选与使用，需确认其状态是否真的承载视觉内容。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PoseVLN: Learning Geometric State Evolution for Vision-Language Navigation

**abstract/A1：** Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to relate past experience, current spatial state, and future motion while following natural-language instructions. Recent approaches improve these capabilities through long-horizon memory, state-aware reasoning, and future prediction, yet these components are often modeled separately, leaving navigation state evolution insufficiently connected across time. We argue that camera pose provides a natural geometric representation for bridging past, present, and future states. Based on this insight, we propose PoseVLN, a pose-aware VLN framework that jointly learns navigation decisions and geometric state evolution. PoseVLN organizes visual memory and the current observation in an episode-relative coordinate frame, and jointly predicts the next K navigation actions together with a local $Δ$Pose over the same horizon. The predicted $Δ$Pose is composed with the current trajectory-level pose to obtain the future pose state, which is recursively propagated throughout navigation, forming a continuous geometric state evolution from past memory to future motion. Experiments on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE Val-Unseen splits demonstrate the effectiveness of explicitly modeling geometric state evolution, with PoseVLN outperforming the strongest compared baselines by 2.6 and 2.9 percentage points in success rate, respectively, using only single RGB observations.

**comment/C1：** 26 pages, 6 figures, including appendix. Project page: https://houpengyu123.github.io/PoseVLN/

</details>

### 174. [Relation Before Action: Explicit Relation Modeling for Latent Action Pretraining](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32226v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32226

**作者：** Boning Zhang、Junyu Gao、Changsheng Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32226v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32226v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RELACT 框架，将「转变关系建模」与「动作抽象」显式分离：先构造刻画视觉元素及其交互随观测演变的结构化关系表示 R，再推断紧凑、状态条件的随机隐动作 U，并通过动作条件的隐动力学学习其预测效果，用于规划与下游策略监督。

**相关性简评：** 「先显式建模关系、再压缩为紧凑 latent」的两段式设计，可能为 LVR 中视觉关系细节保留与信息坍缩之间的取舍提供核查线索，其以隐动力学预测作监督的思路也可作为 latent 状态训练信号参考；但原文目标是具身隐动作而非推理状态，迁移性需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Relation Before Action: Explicit Relation Modeling for Latent Action Pretraining

**abstract/A1：** Learning latent actions from unlabeled video sequences offers a promising way to acquire reusable action representations without relying on embodiment-specific control annotations. However, existing latent-action pretraining approaches commonly couple the modeling of visual transitions with action inference, directly mapping paired observations or derived transition cues into latent action codes. This formulation leaves two distinct tasks entangled: characterizing the relational structure of an observed transition and abstracting it into a compact action representation. We propose RELACT, a relation-first framework that explicitly separates transition relation modeling from predictive action abstraction. RELACT first constructs a structured relation representation $R$ that captures how visual elements and their interactions evolve across observations. It then infers a compact, state-conditioned stochastic latent action $U$, whose predictive effects are learned through action-conditioned latent dynamics. The resulting action representation can be grounded in native control spaces for model-based planning or used to supervise downstream embodied policies. Extensive experiments across in-domain and out-of-domain image-goal navigation, goal-conditioned manipulation, and downstream policy adaptation demonstrate improved predictive action representations and consistent gains in planning and control, supporting the effectiveness and generality of relation-first latent action pretraining.

</details>
