### 175. [CoMNO: Commutator Memory Neural Operators for Long-Horizon PDE Prediction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32274v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32274

**作者：** Han Xiao、Xin Zhang、Yuhan Zou、Zhenzhong Wang、Donglin Cao、Dazhen Lin、Min Jiang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32274v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32274v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Commutator Memory Neural Operator，用「先降采样再 rollout」与「先 rollout 再降采样」两种操作之间的差距来识别被降采样丢弃的细尺度动力学细节，并用记忆模块沿轨迹存储、在推理时检索以生成空间自适应修正，从而提升 PDE 长时预测的精度与稳定性。

**相关性简评：** 其「交换差距」可作为诊断降采样/压缩丢失细粒度信息的手段，记忆修正机制也可能供核查 LVR 多步 latent rollout 中的视觉细节流失与漂移累积，但需判断能否迁移到多模态推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CoMNO: Commutator Memory Neural Operators for Long-Horizon PDE Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Solving nonlinear partial differential equations (PDEs) over long time horizons is computationally expensive using traditional numerical methods. While neural operators provide an efficient alternative, they suffer from the accumulation of approximation errors along the predicted trajectory, typically caused by the failure to capture fine-scale details. In this work, we design a Commutator Memory Neural Operator that identifies fine-scale dynamical details by commuting two operations and leverages these details to enhance the neural operator's capability in capturing fine-scale features over long time horizons. Specifically, we identify a performance gap between two operations: downsampling the high-resolution field before rollout prediction versus performing rollout prediction before downsampling. We observe that fine-scale dynamical details are often encoded in this gap. By commuting these two operations, the fine-scale details removed during downsampling can be captured. Furthermore, we employ a memory module to store these fine-scale features along the trajectory and retrieve them during rollout, generating spatially adaptive corrections that enhance long-horizon fidelity. Empirical results across five systems demonstrate that CoMNO improves prediction accuracy and long-horizon rollout stability.

**comment/C1：** In preparing an earlier version of this manuscript under time pressure, we did not adequately verify all reported experimental results. In this preprint, we correct the numerical reporting errors we identified and update the affected analyses

</details>

### 176. [DAiSy: Online Data Selection by Adaptive Utility Estimation for LLM Pretraining](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32294v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32294

**作者：** Simin Fan、Martin Jaggi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32294v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32294v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DAiSy：在冻结文档嵌入上训练一个轻量线性辅助模型，随主语言模型在线更新，用以预测原本需前向-反向计算得到的基于梯度的数据效用分数，从而省去逐候选文档的完整评分开销，并在英文与多语言预训练及后续指令微调中验证效果。

**相关性简评：** 其核心线索是用冻结表示上的廉价线性代理近似昂贵的高成本信号（梯度效用），可能可供核查 LVR 中贡献分配、视觉证据筛选或验证器打分的低成本近似方案，但论文本身面向纯文本预训练数据选择，与推理期 latent 状态无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DAiSy: Online Data Selection by Adaptive Utility Estimation for LLM Pretraining

**abstract/A1：** Model-aware online data selection prioritizes the training documents that contribute the most given the model's current state. Existing online selectors rank candidates upon gradient-based data utility scores, which requires the full forward-backward pass of the main model on every candidate document. Scoring each document therefore pays as much as training on it, yet only a small fraction is used for the real model update. We introduce DAiSy, a lightweight linear auxiliary model that learns to predict data utility scores from frozen document embeddings, which eliminates the computation overhead and infrastructure burdens. The linear estimator is updated alongside the main language model, fitting to the exact gradient-based utility scores obtained from the backward pass of regular training steps. Consequently, scoring a candidate requires only a linear transformation, bypassing the costly gradient-alignment computation. We demonstrate its effectiveness and efficiency for LLM pretraining in English and multilingual scenarios, with various steering target designs. The improvements from DAiSy can consistently survive the instruction-tuning phase.

</details>

### 177. [MaskedVGGT: Masked Multi-View Transformers Are Scalable 3D Learners](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32297v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32297

**作者：** Zichen Zou、Xiaosong Jia、Wen-Ming Chen、Zuxuan Wu、Yu-Gang Jiang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32297v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32297v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** MaskedVGGT 冻结预训练 2D 编码器，只预训练新增的多视角 Transformer：用完整锚视图加高度遮蔽的其余视图作学生输入，由 EMA 教师基于未遮蔽输入提供目标，做无标注遮蔽自蒸馏；在至多 1B 参数下优于同数据的监督 VGGT-Ω 及 CroCo、MuM、Muskie、E-RayZer。

**相关性简评：** 冻结视觉编码器、仅训练跨视图交互模块并以 EMA 教师做遮蔽自蒸馏，可能为「无标注监督 latent 交互状态」及「固定视觉编码器是否导致视觉旁路或信息坍缩」提供可供核查的训练线索，但本文属 3D 几何预训练，与 VLM 推理无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MaskedVGGT: Masked Multi-View Transformers Are Scalable 3D Learners

**abstract/A1：** Multi-view feed-forward models show strong scalability, but their reliance on costly geometric annotations limits data scaling. Existing 3D self-supervised approaches reduce this reliance through cross-view completion (e.g., CroCo, MuM, Muskie) or novel-view synthesis (e.g., RayZer, E-RayZer), typically learning image representations and cross-view interactions jointly. We argue that learning single image representations from scratch is unnecessary for 3D pretraining methods, as doing so fails to benefit from the continuing advances in 2D foundation models (e.g., DINO, CLIP, frontier VLMs). We introduce MaskedVGGT, which freezes a strong pretrained 2D encoder and pretrains only an added, randomly initialized multi-view transformer, focusing on learning interactions across views. MaskedVGGT pretrains the multi-view transformer through masked self-distillation without annotations: a student predicts targets at masked locations based on complete anchor views and heavily masked remaining views, while an exponential-moving-average teacher provides prediction targets based on unmasked inputs. In experiments across model sizes up to 1B parameters, MaskedVGGT pretraining followed by fine-tuning outperforms single-stage supervised VGGT-$Ω$ training with the same training data, model architecture, and total number of optimization updates. MaskedVGGT also outperforms E-RayZer, CroCo, MuM, and Muskie, providing evidence for the effectiveness of building multi-view pretraining on strong 2D representations. Finally, extending pretraining with additional unlabeled videos further improves generalization, and the learned representations transfer to diverse downstream tasks. These results demonstrate an effective division of learning: reuse strong image representations from 2D pretraining and learn cross-view interactions from unlabeled multi-view data without relying on geometric annotations.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables. Code is available at https://github.com/zzctmd/MaskedVGGT

</details>

### 178. [Sparse Poison, Strong Hijack: Efficient Trajectory-Level Backdoors in Vision-Language-Action Models with Only 1\\% Poisoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32304v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32304

**作者：** Simin Huang、Jiawei Chen、Shaolong Zhu、Qiwei Liang、Zhaoxia Yin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32304v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32304v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对 VLA 模型轨迹级后门攻击，提出两阶段协同优化框架：先冻结策略并以可微渲染与多模态监督优化 3D 触发器，再用源选择式双 LoRA 解耦干净与后门更新，在 1% 投毒率下实现多步闭环任务劫持。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 无直接关系，但其「双 LoRA 解耦干净/后门更新方向」及 3D 触发器对视觉输入的极小扰动即可改写多步轨迹，可供核查是否为分离任务相关视觉通路与干扰贡献、以及视觉证据因果作用的可借鉴线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sparse Poison, Strong Hijack: Efficient Trajectory-Level Backdoors in Vision-Language-Action Models with Only 1\\% Poisoning

**abstract/A1：** Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models advance robotic manipulation, but their reliance on demonstrations exposes them to backdoor threats. Among these threats, trajectory-level targeted backdoors are particularly challenging and may pose greater safety risks than behavior-disrupting attacks: rather than merely causing task failures or local action deviations, they must sustain closed-loop redirection to complete an attacker-specified multi-step task. To reliably induce such behaviors, existing methods typically rely on high poisoning rates to obtain sufficient target-trajectory supervision. However, high poisoning rates may compromise clean-task performance, whereas low rates leave target-trajectory supervision scarce and backdoor learning vulnerable to interference from dominant clean-task updates. To resolve this trade-off at low poisoning rates, we propose a two-stage co-optimization framework guided by vision, language, and action. Stage I freezes the policy and uses differentiable rendering and multimodal supervision to optimize a 3D trigger's texture, translation, and scale, strengthening trigger-target associations from limited poisoned demonstrations. Building on the optimized trigger, Stage II applies source-selective dual-LoRA adaptation to decouple clean and backdoor updates and mitigate their interference, followed by learned column-wise calibration and analytic fusion into a unified policy. Experiments on OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, $π\_0$, and $π\_{0.5}$ across four LIBERO suites show consistent gains over all evaluated attack baselines. With only 1% poisoned data, our method achieves 86.4% target success and 95.2% clean-task success on OpenVLA-OFT in LIBERO-Spatial. Real-robot trials also demonstrate trajectory-level hijacking.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 7 figures, including supplementary material. Simin Huang and Jiawei Chen contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/vla-attack/Sparse\_Poison\_Strong\_Hijack

</details>

### 179. [CREDIT: Compositional Reliability Learning for Noisy Composed Image Retrieval](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32310v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32310

**作者：** Tiancai Zhou、Yongxiang Li、Suimei Liu、Zhong Yuan、Dezhong Peng、Xi Peng、Xu Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32310v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32310v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对组合图像检索中「参考图—修改文本—目标图」三元组对应关系被噪声破坏（NTC）的问题，提出 CREDIT 框架：用证据学习显式估计对应关系的不确定性以抑制噪声监督，并用文本条件扩散精化参考表示。

**相关性简评：** 其用证据不确定性把监督可靠性从二值判定变为连续权重，可供核查是否能迁移到 latent 推理轨迹的贡献分配与视觉证据筛选，但任务为检索而非推理，联系较间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CREDIT: Compositional Reliability Learning for Noisy Composed Image Retrieval

**abstract/A1：** Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image that satisfies user intent based on a multimodal query consisting of a reference image and a modification text. However, real-world training data are often corrupted by Noisy Triplet Correspondence (NTC), where the semantic correspondence among the reference image, modification text, and target image becomes unreliable. Existing methods implicitly assume that the correctness of triplet correspondence can be determined by fixed decision rules. However, under NTC, the authenticity of semantic correspondence is difficult to determine accurately, and different triplets exhibit varying degrees of semantic reliability rather than binary correctness. Consequently, deterministic confidence is insufficient to faithfully characterize correspondence reliability, often leading to overconfident supervision for unreliable triplets and progressively reinforcing noisy semantics during compositional representation learning. To address this challenge, we propose a Compositional Reliability learning framework with Evidential uncertainty and DiffusIon-guided refinemenT (CREDIT), which explicitly quantifies the uncertainty of triplet correspondence to estimate its reliability and suppress the propagation of noisy supervision. CREDIT consists of two complementary components: The Evidential Compositional Uncertainty Learning (ECUL) module explicitly models correspondence uncertainty via evidential learning, enabling uncertaintyaware reliability estimation to suppress noisy supervision. Building upon the reliable supervision provided by ECUL, the Diffusion-enhanced Reference Refinement (DRR) module further refines reference representations through textconditioned diffusion, producing more robust compositional query features. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CREDIT consistently outperforms existing methods under various settings.

**comment/C1：** Submitted to CVPR 2027

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

**内容简述：** 该工作提出两种免梯度适配小型 GUI agent 的方案：4B 模型根据轨迹反馈对一个靠后 MLP 做带保护约束的闭式权重编辑（仅改动单张量约 0.535% 参数），2B 模型则在冻结权重下由助手迭代生成并精炼流程性技能，在 OSWorld 子集上分别取得 48.02% 与 45.47% 的聚合分数。

**相关性简评：** 其「用轨迹成败反馈定位并改写局部参数、同时保留成功状态作为约束」的做法，可能与 LVR 中轨迹监督与贡献分配问题相关，可供核查是否能用于 latent 推理状态的训练信号；但原文面向 GUI 动作可靠性，未涉及视觉细节保留或推理期 latent 生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GUI-WEdit and GUI-SkillEvo: Gradient-Free Adaptation of Small GUI Agents

**abstract/A1：** Small graphical user interface (GUI) agents can execute desktop workflows, but repeated local errors and fragile procedural decisions limit their reliability. We present GUI-WEdit-4B and GUI-SkillEvo-2B, two gradient-free adaptations of GUI-Owl-1.5 backbones. For the 4B model, we use trajectory feedback to construct guarded, closed-form updates to a late multilayer perceptron (MLP), retaining successful states as protection constraints. The final checkpoint changes 23,739,095 parameter values, or 0.535\\% of the 4,437,815,808-parameter backbone, within one weight tensor. For the 2B model, an assistant iteratively proposes and refines procedural skills while the model weights remain fixed. On the 361-task OSWorld subset excluding Google Drive tasks, the frozen systems obtain final aggregate scores of 48.02\\% and 45.47\\%, respectively.

</details>

### 181. [Get the Next Moment Right: Short-Term Event Planning for Physically Plausible Video Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32337v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32337

**作者：** Hao Liu、Xiang Tang、Ruotong Li、Xiaopeng Fan、Yujiu Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32337v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32337v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向视频生成的物理合理性，提出无需训练的闭环框架 STEP：按短片段逐轮推进，先从已生成帧中定位场景状态，再预测下一物理事件并渲染为控制片段，在控制下做 latent 引导生成，最后验证事件是否发生、不成立则重采样。

**相关性简评：** 「基于实际生成帧重新接地状态 + 验证失败即重采样」的短程闭环，可能为 LVR 的潜状态更新、视觉证据筛选与继续/重做决策提供可核查的方法线索；但其对象是视频像素生成，与 VLM 推理中的 latent 推理状态是否同构尚待确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Get the Next Moment Right: Short-Term Event Planning for Physically Plausible Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Video generation models synthesize realistic imagery yet still struggle to produce physically plausible evolution. Existing methods guide generation with a motion trajectory predicted for the entire clip in advance, so prediction errors accumulate and degrade later frames. We propose STEP(Short-Term Event Planning), a training-free closed-loop framework that guides generation one short clip at a time. Each round consists of four steps: grounding measures the scene state from the latest frames, event planning predicts the next physical event and renders it into a control clip, latent-guided generation produces the next short clip under this control, and verification checks whether the event occurs and resamples the clip if it does not. Because each round is grounded in the frames actually generated, control relies only on reliable short-range predictions. STEP improves the physical plausibility of three frozen generators on Physics-IQ Verified and PhyGenBench, and can be applied to new generators without training.

</details>

### 182. [Part-Set Prototypes for Explainable Mountain Gazelles Sex Classification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32343v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32343

**作者：** Tali Boneh Shitrit、Amir Kedem、Ilan Shimshoni、Anna Zamansky

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32343v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32343v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出「集合原型」架构，在冻结的 DINOv3 token 网格上通过截断 Sinkhorn 联合匹配，从数据中同时挖掘部件数量与无约束空间布局，并允许无支撑部件弃权，用于相机陷阱影像中的山瞪羚性别分类与可解释定位。

**相关性简评：** 其「原型匹配＋部件弃权」机制或可供核查作为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与支持组合的外部线索，但该工作仅做单图细粒度分类、不涉及推理状态或答案使用，迁移需较多判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Part-Set Prototypes for Explainable Mountain Gazelles Sex Classification

**abstract/A1：** Self-explainable visual models for fine-grained recognition are often hindered by rigid geometric constraints that cannot capture diverse semantic shapes in unconstrained "in-the-wild" imagery. Real-world camera-trap data introduces challenges, including non-optimal poses, lighting variations, occlusions, animal camouflage, and environmental shortcuts. To address this, we introduce set prototypes, a general architecture where both part cardinality and unconstrained spatial layouts are mined directly from data. Our joint-matching formulation places parts simultaneously on a frozen DINOv3 token grid via truncated Sinkhorn competition, allowing unsupported parts to abstain without spatial collapse. We evaluate our approach on Mountain Gazelle sex classification, a camera-trap benchmark, where our model achieves 0.878 macro-F1--outperforming prior architectures and at par with an unconstrained linear probe. The strongest prototypes localize to distinctive biological areas such as horns, neck and body, allowing ecologists to visually verify decisions before trusting the metric. This formulation generalizes naturally to diverse ecological monitoring challenges beyond a single species.

</details>

### 183. [LRQ-Cache: Compressing Feature Caches in Video Diffusion via Low-Rank Approximation and Quantization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32345v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32345

**作者：** Ruizhe Yao、Zhen Huang、Songpan Gao、Danyi Liu、Zijian Cao、Weijie Zheng、Haohuan Fu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32345v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32345v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对视频扩散 Transformer 时间缓存中特征张量占用过大的问题，提出免训练的 LRQ-Cache，用低秩分解加量化压缩缓存特征，复用时再重建，从而降低显存占用并提速。

**相关性简评：** 低秩加量化的压缩—重建思路可供核查是否能用于压缩跨推理步复用的 latent 状态；但研究对象是视频生成去噪缓存，与 VLM 推理证据使用无直接关联，迁移性待验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LRQ-Cache: Compressing Feature Caches in Video Diffusion via Low-Rank Approximation and Quantization

**abstract/A1：** Video diffusion transformers (DiTs) achieve high-fidelity generation, but inference is expensive because every denoising step evaluates a large transformer over all spatiotemporal tokens of the video. Temporal caching accelerates them by reusing intermediate features across denoising steps. However, retaining dense feature tensors introduces a persistent storage cost that grows with video length, resolution, and cache coverage, reaching 109-346 GiB per video for the predictive caches we evaluate. Such states exceed the memory of a single GPU, so native caches must either be offloaded to the CPU, which slows generation, or be sharded across several GPUs, e.g., with sequence parallelism, so that the cache rather than the compute sets the number of GPUs. We instead shrink the cached state itself, exploiting its redundancy: a few channel patterns shared across tokens capture much of the energy of each cached feature. Based on this observation, we propose LRQ-Cache, a training-free method that combines low-rank approximation and quantization for feature-cache compression. LRQ-Cache represents each cached feature with a small set of factors, quantizes them before storage, and reconstructs the feature at reuse time, leaving cache mechanisms unchanged. Across three caching mechanisms on HunyuanVideo and Wan2.1, LRQ-Cache reduces the persistent state of predictive caches by 42-71x, to 2.3-4.9 GiB per video. VBench stays within 0.25 pp of the native cache for TeaCache, and the larger drops of the Wan2.1 predictive caches, up to 3.5 pp, shrink at higher ranks. As a result, predictive caches that exceed the memory of a single 80 GB H100 GPU fit on it with LRQ-Cache, making generation 2.7-5.9x faster than with CPU-offloaded native caches.

</details>

<a id="paper-184"></a>

### 184. [CriticJEPA: World Models Are Better Critics Than Optimizers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32357v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32357

**作者：** Xvyuan Liu、Jianjie Fang、Honglin Zhang、Zhaolu Wang、Xin Zhang、Wei Wu、Fengli Xu、Chen Gao、Yong Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32357v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32357v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CriticJEPA：在冻结的分层视觉世界模型上，用无奖励轨迹学习目标条件 flow 提议，并在每一层用冻结 rollout 对候选排序选择，配合短程锚定更新替代长程梯度优化，用于视觉导航与操作。

**相关性简评：** 其「生成多个候选、再用冻结预测器作 critic 排序、并以短程更新替代持续优化」的路线，可能与 LVR 中 latent 假设的提议—验证以及 THINK/STOP 的过度优化与停止决策问题相通，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CriticJEPA: World Models Are Better Critics Than Optimizers

**abstract/A1：** Visual world models enable goal-directed planning by predicting action outcomes. Gradient-based planners optimize actions to lower predicted goal cost, but continued optimization can exploit prediction errors after execution stops improving. Comparing plans requires informative relative scores; improving them also requires reliable update directions. Exact-state execution reveals that a frozen hierarchical world model ranks goal-conditioned proposals even when its rankings among outputs of prolonged gradient search are uninformative. Effective planning pairs goal-directed candidates with predictions that distinguish their outcomes. We introduce CriticJEPA, which learns goal-conditioned flow proposals from reward-free trajectories and uses frozen rollouts to select among them at every hierarchy level. Forward selection forms a complete planner; short anchored updates refine candidates before selection. Across visual navigation and manipulation, CriticJEPA increases success at a fraction of the planning compute, transferring shared settings across independently trained models, hierarchy depths, and unseen tasks while keeping every world-model weight fixed.

</details>

### 185. [Sub-Riemannian structure for Oriented Point Clouds](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32361v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32361

**作者：** Thomas Besnier、Stefan Sommer

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32361v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32361v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文主张在位置-朝向空间 R³×S² 上引入 sub-Riemannian contact 度量，使「邻近」受法向约束的水平分布限制，并导出一个局部近似距离的显式 score，作为 PointNet++ 聚合中的替换项用于分割与对应，同时用于模拟有向点上的热扩散。

**相关性简评：** 其核心线索是「空间接近但几何上不同不应交换信息」，这与 LVR 中 latent 相似度需区分内容、位置与几何结构、以及视觉细节保留和跨边界信息泄漏的问题可能相关，可供核查邻域或度量定义是否影响内部状态的几何保真。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sub-Riemannian structure for Oriented Point Clouds

**abstract/A1：** Many frameworks dealing with 3D (oriented) point clouds define locality in the ambient Euclidean space: $k$-nearest-neighbor graphs and radius balls in $\\mathbb{R}^3$ are critical to define which points are "close to one another" and should exchange information. This can unintentionally merge sampled surfaces that are close in space but geometrically distinct such as the two faces of a thin leaf. Then, features are more prone to leak across boundaries which hinder performance. To address this, we propose to define a sub-Riemannian contact metric on position-orientation space $\\mathbb{M}=\\mathbb{R}^3\\times \\mathbb{S}^2$: points are lifted to $(x,n)$ with $n$ a surface normal, and "motion" is constrained to a non-holonomic horizontal distribution in which spatial velocity must stay in the plane orthogonal to the normal which can reorient at a cost. From this, we derive an explicit score, which locally approximate the distance, to compare oriented points for downstream tasks. We report improved segmentation and correspondence accuracy near contact when using the score as a drop-in change inside PointNet++ aggregation mechanism as well as reduced leakage when using it to simulate heat diffusion on oriented points.

</details>

### 186. [The Control-Flow Tax: Specialized Decision Routing for LLM Agent Workflows](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32365v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32365

**作者：** Zhikai Cheng、Shuanghu Wang、Li Jiang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32365v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32365v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文量化文档型 agent 工作流中「控制流开销」的占比，并提出由专用小型决策模型 Jev 负责有限动作路由、由 Sol 负责生成的异构架构，在四个软件任务上比较成本与耗时。

**相关性简评：** 其将廉价决策与昂贵生成解耦、并把决策步骤开销单独计费的做法，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的停止策略与动态计算成本核算提供方法线索，但任务为纯文本工作流，需核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Control-Flow Tax: Specialized Decision Routing for LLM Agent Workflows

**abstract/A1：** An agent can spend almost as much deciding what to do as doing it. In our documentation workflow, control-flow routing accounts for 42.5% of baseline reference cost on the initial task. Lower token prices alone do not solve this control-flow tax: inexpensive general-purpose routers can trigger additional calls to the expensive generator. We evaluate a heterogeneous architecture in which Jev, a specialized System 1 decision model, controls finite actions while Sol generates documents. Across four software tasks, 480 valid runs comprise 470 completions and ten request-limit endpoints. Jev full routing achieves the lowest mean cost and elapsed time on every task, completing all 40 specialist-controlled runs along the shortest trajectory. On the initial task, mean cost falls by 49.6% (95% paired-bootstrap interval: 42.9% to 56.3%) and elapsed time by 33.2% (19.6% to 46.7%). Across three further tasks, cost reductions are 40.5% to 42.9% and concurrent elapsed-time reductions are 12.9% to 14.4%. Existence-only specialization saves just 1.8% on the initial task. Separately, Sol and Jev each select accepted actions on 100/100 reviewed retail states, with Jev using 97.88% less reference cost and 72.30% less mean request time. The results identify two requirements for efficient agent control: inexpensive decisions and trajectories that preserve those savings.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Shuanghu Wang and Li Jiang share second authorship

</details>

### 187. [Metamorphic Testing of Learned Spatial Surrogates for Transit Accessibility](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32373v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32373

**作者：** Till Zacher、Markus Lienkamp

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32373v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32373v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文训练神经代理模型预测候选公交网络带来的可达性空间变化，并在留出区域对比路由计算目标，同时用受控输入扰动下的定性关系（metamorphic 测试）检验模型行为；发现预测精度尚可的模型仍会通不过基本连通性检验。

**相关性简评：** 其「预测一致性与受控行为测试分开报告」的评估协议可供核查：或可迁移为对 latent 推理模型的诊断，检验内部状态在视觉或结构扰动下是否仍满足任务必要的关系约束，而非只看答案平均误差。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Metamorphic Testing of Learned Spatial Surrogates for Transit Accessibility

**abstract/A1：** Transit-network design requires evaluating many candidates, but detailed accessibility calculations are too slow to repeat inside an optimization loop. We therefore train a neural surrogate to approximate them. Given a candidate bus network and fixed information about rail service and nearby opportunities, it predicts the calculated spatial change in accessibility. We compare its predictions with routing-derived targets in geographically held-out regions and test specified qualitative relations under controlled input changes. Reference calculations on constructed networks assess the applicability of relations that have a routing-level counterpart. Models with positive predictive skill can still fail basic connectivity tests. One targeted intervention substantially increases pass rates for two connectivity relations while predictive skill also improves. Average prediction error is therefore insufficient when a learned model becomes an optimization objective. Predictive agreement and controlled behavioral tests should be reported separately.

</details>

### 188. [The Activity Geometry of Discrete Generative Sampling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32380v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32380

**作者：** Xinlong Guo、Jie Zhang、Lingyou Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32380v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32380v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「activity geometry」，用期望转移代价刻画离散采样中相邻状态间的有限步耦合，将其分解为边际传输所需最小值与耦合多余项，并提出 MAFTC 在不重训、不增加模型评估的情况下以最小 activity 实现预设边际；语言生成实验显示细化采样器随评估次数增加会累积轨迹 activity，而多样性收益有限。

**相关性简评：** 其把「每步状态改写量」量化为 activity 并区分必要改动与耦合多余项，可能为离散扩散式 latent 推理中状态更新的贡献分配、额外细化步数与停止决策的收益—成本核算提供可核查的度量线索；该文仅涉及纯离散文本生成，迁移到多模态 LVR 尚待验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Activity Geometry of Discrete Generative Sampling

**abstract/A1：** Iterative refinement is a key capability of diffusion-based generation and has motivated growing efforts to bring similar behavior to discrete diffusion and flow models. A growing line of work enables such refinement by allowing previously generated tokens to be revised during sampling, thereby shaping the coupling between successive sampling states. Despite its growing role in sampler design, this coupling freedom remains insufficiently characterized. We introduce Activity Geometry to study these finite-step couplings through expected transition cost, which we call activity. We show that activity decomposes into the minimum required by the induced marginal transport and an excess term arising from the coupling. Using this minimum as a reference, we propose Minimal-Activity Finite-Time Coupling (MAFTC) to realize prescribed marginals with minimum activity without retraining or additional model evaluations. In the continuous-time limit, the minimum activity per unit time converges to the minimum expected jump rate compatible with the prescribed path. For metric-induced Gibbs paths, we further show that the activity of the kinetic-optimal flux admits a geometric decomposition. We find that total activity alone can obscure coupling excess: a sampler may approach the minimum activity required by the prescribed marginal transport while still retaining substantial coupling excess. In language generation, as the number of model evaluations increases, refinement-based samplers accumulate additional trajectory activity with limited diversity gains, whereas MAFTC reduces trajectory activity while maintaining comparable generation quality and higher lexical diversity.

**comment/C1：** 39 pages, 7 figures

</details>

### 189. [Can AI Design a Better nnU-Net? A Hypothesis-Driven Architecture Discovery Loop from Failures to Design Rules](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32384v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32384

**作者：** Songtao Jiang、Yuan Wang、Fucheng Niu、Hualiang Wang、Jian Wu、Zuozhu Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32384v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32384v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出由 LLM agent 驱动的假设式架构发现循环：分析结构化误差、提出可证伪假设、在冻结的 nnU-Net 上做反事实对照，再把验证过的机制蒸馏成可执行的 trigger-to-action 规则，用于 3D 医学分割并得到 LeanNeXt/LeanNeXt+。

**相关性简评：** 其以失败误差驱动假设、用反事实对照分配贡献并沉淀为条件触发规则的做法，可能为 VLM 推理的轨迹监督、贡献分配以及「何时触发某步计算」的决策提供可核查线索，但研究对象是分割架构而非多模态推理状态，需核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Can AI Design a Better nnU-Net? A Hypothesis-Driven Architecture Discovery Loop from Failures to Design Rules

**abstract/A1：** Neural architecture search and LLM-driven evolution often reduce evaluation to a scalar fitness score, discarding failures that could explain why designs succeed or fail. We present a hypothesis-driven architecture discovery loop in which LLM agents diagnose structured error patterns, formulate falsifiable hypotheses, test counterfactual controls under a frozen nnU-Net pipeline, and distill validated mechanisms into executable trigger-to-action rules. Across eight search waves, the loop identifies two principles for 3D medical image segmentation. First, reallocating computation from high-resolution decoders to the mid-encoder preserves thin-anatomy boundaries while reducing cost. Second, support-confined region contrast addresses errors between nested anatomical compartments, with anatomy-dependent triggers selecting when the rule applies. These principles produce LeanNeXt (0.78 MACs and 0.92 training-step time relative to nnU-Net; +1.63 Dice points on four-fold KiTS23 cross-validation) and trigger-routed LeanNeXt+. The latter improves all 15 evaluated CT/MRI settings over nnU-Net and exceeds the 3.3 larger ResEnc-M on 12 of 15 benchmarks at 0.30 its parameter count. Relative to random sampling, one-shot LLM generation, and score-selected agent search, the loop shows how failure analysis can yield reusable design rules across modalities.

**comment/C1：** 15 Pages; 10 figures

</details>

### 190. [Evolve to Learn: Gradient-aligned experience evolution for model self-improvement](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32390v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32390

**作者：** Haoyuan Li、Gangyi Zhang、Dong Wang、Yang Liu、Daoxuan Liu、Jiancan Wu、Shiu-hong Kao、Wu Liu、Yicong Li、Yongdong Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32390v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32390v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文指出现有 on-policy 自蒸馏默认「测试时有效的经验就值得学习」，通过多任务、多反思模型的系统性分析发现梯度对齐度比即时测试表现更能预测蒸馏收益，并提出 E2L 框架按估计的训练效用来生成、筛选并蒸馏经验。

**相关性简评：** 其「以梯度对齐而非表面表现筛选待内化轨迹」的思路，可能为 LVR 中哪些 latent 推理轨迹值得训练、如何做贡献分配与监督筛选提供可核查的方法线索；但纯文本设定，与视觉证据保留无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Evolve to Learn: Gradient-aligned experience evolution for model self-improvement

**abstract/A1：** Self-evolving language models can continuously acquire useful experience through test-time interaction, reflection, and prompt optimization, yet turning such experience into model itself to ensure self improvement remains challenging. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides a natural mechanism for internalizing test-time information into model parameters, yet it largely assumes that the gener- ated experience is worth learning. We show that this assumption does not always hold: experiences that improve test-time performance may provide limited or even harmful training signals. To better characterize which experience should be inter- nalized, we systematically analyze diverse mutated experiences across multiple tasks and reflection models, and find that gradient-based alignment is a more reli- able indicator of downstream distillation gains than immediate test-time improve- ment. Based on this finding, we propose E2L, a self-evolution framework that iteratively generates, evaluates, and distills experiences according to their esti- mated training utility. E2L closes the loop between experience generation and parameter learning, enabling agents to autonomously produce experience suitable for self-improvement.

</details>

### 191. [PRC4D: Physical Relation-Constrained Persistent 4D Reconstruction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32396v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32396

**作者：** Junho Kim、Hyunyoung Choi、Jiseok Kim、Seongwon Lee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32396v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32396v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** PRC4D 提出物理关系约束的持久 4D 重建框架：结合 3D 接触与相对运动一致性，并用序列级验证区分持久刚体耦合与瞬时交互，据此构建关系图来精化观测位姿并在遮挡时把运动传播到不可见部件。

**相关性简评：** 其「序列级验证持久耦合 vs. 瞬时接触」并用关系图约束状态传播的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中跨时刻维持实体关系状态、筛除误导性视觉证据的问题，但该方法属几何重建管线，可迁移性需读原文判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PRC4D: Physical Relation-Constrained Persistent 4D Reconstruction

**abstract/A1：** A faithful 4D reconstruction should capture both the shape and motion of objects, even when they disappear from view. Existing methods preserve previously observed geometry and extend motion through occlusion using local spatial and motion associations. However, treating short-term contact or shared motion as sufficient evidence of persistent rigidity can introduce incorrect motion constraints and distort overall reconstruction. To address this limitation, we present PRC4D, a physical relation-constrained framework that identifies reliable rigid relations and uses them to maintain spatial consistency through occlusion. PRC4D combines 3D contact and relative motion consistency with sequence-level verification to distinguish persistent couplings from transient interactions. The resulting graph guides observed-pose refinement and motion propagation from visible to occluded components without altering reconstructed geometry. Experiments on diverse real-world multi-object sequences and controlled occlusion simulations demonstrate improved reconstruction accuracy, reduced relative pose errors, and more consistent object configurations under changing visibility.

</details>

### 192. [Not All Pairs Align: Caption-Guided Audio-Visual Contrastive Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32399v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32399

**作者：** Omar Emara、Nan Lu、Dima Damen、Hazel Doughty

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32399v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32399v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对音视频共现数据中配对并非真正语义对齐（如画外音）的问题，提出模型无关的 CGAAL 损失：用各模态 caption 估计音频与视频的语义一致度，据此加权正样本对，并以 warm-up 与渐进阈值引入该信号，在三个对比学习基线上提升检索表现。

**相关性简评：** 该文不涉及 VLM 推理或 latent 状态，但其「用 caption 估计配对信息一致度并据此加权监督」的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与训练贡献分配的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Not All Pairs Align: Caption-Guided Audio-Visual Contrastive Learning

**abstract/A1：** We address the problem of learning audio-visual representations from co-occurring modalities. Multimodal contrastive learning typically assumes that paired observations provide shared views of the same underlying information. While this may be true for datasets collected in constrained environments, it does not always hold. For instance, co-occurring audio and visual signals can differ substantially in their content due to off-screen sounds. Nevertheless, standard contrastive objectives treat all paired samples as equally aligned. In this work, we propose Caption Guided Alignment Aware Loss (CGAAL), a model-agnostic objective that leverages modality-specific captions to estimate semantic agreement between audio and video. CGAAL uses these agreement scores to weight the contribution of each positive pair. A warm-up period and gradual thresholding strategy progressively introduce this alignment-aware training signal. We demonstrate the generality of CGAAL by applying it to three contrastive baselines, consistently improving their performance on audio-visual retrieval.

</details>

### 193. [BEACON: Learning Observation-Conditioned Starting Points for Guided Conditional Flow Matching in Microscopy](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32406v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32406

**作者：** Anirban Ray、Florian Jug

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32406v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32406v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文面向荧光显微图像去雾与计算超分辨，指出 guided conditional flow matching 将干净目标与独立高斯噪声配对会使速度场难以学习，提出 BEACON：用轻量条件噪声模型基于退化观测生成 K 个候选起点，以流动匹配损失最小的候选监督两个网络，并用 KL 项约束贴近高斯先验；推理时只需一次采样，在十个数据集上与 13 类基线比较感知—失真综合排序。

**相关性简评：** 其「由观测条件化的初始分布 + best-of-K 轨迹监督」线索或可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态的初始化与轨迹训练监督选择问题，但该工作是图像复原而非多模态推理，迁移性需进一步判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BEACON: Learning Observation-Conditioned Starting Points for Guided Conditional Flow Matching in Microscopy

**abstract/A1：** Fluorescence microscopy drives much of modern life science, but accessible imaging setups often yield images degraded by out-of-focus light, limited resolution, and strong signal-dependent noise. Computational restoration can recover high-quality images from such data, enabling cheaper and faster imaging at lower light dose, provided biologically meaningful structures are preserved. Guided conditional flow matching has recently shown strong results for microscopy dehazing and computational super-resolution by learning distributions of plausible restorations. However, it pairs each clean target with an independent standard Gaussian sample, so the starting point of every training path does not leverage the degraded observation. This arbitrary noise--target coupling can produce conflicting velocity targets and makes the conditional velocity field harder to learn. We present BEACON, a $BE$st-of-$K$ $A$daptive learned coupling for guided $CON$ditional flow matching, which learns an observation-conditioned base distribution. During training, a lightweight conditional noise model proposes $K$ starting points for each degraded input, and the candidate with the lowest flow-matching loss supervises both networks, while a KL term keeps the proposal close to the Gaussian prior. At inference, a single draw from the learned proposal is transported along the velocity field, requiring neither candidate selection nor the target. We evaluate BEACON on ten datasets spanning microscopy dehazing and computational super-resolution against 13 baseline families. BEACON achieves the best median perception--distortion rank for every pairing of a fidelity metric (PSNR, MicroMS-SSIM) with a perceptual metric (LPIPS, FID). Code and pretrained models will be released under a permissive license.

**comment/C1：** 30 pages, 25 figures, 2 tables; main paper (10 pages) followed by supplementary material

</details>

### 194. [Every Edit Its Own Budget: Per-Instruction Token Freezing for Training-Free Acceleration of Multi-Edit Image Editing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32407v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32407

**作者：** Jyotirmoy Nath、Neeraj Kumar、Brejesh Lall

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32407v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32407v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 TIDE，用于多指令图像编辑的无训练加速：借注意力上的非平衡最优传输定位每条指令区域，按“相对自身部分的 drift”冻结 token 并沿直线路径外推，再由稀疏引擎只计算剩余 token，并给出分部分阈值策略的理论刻画。

**相关性简评：** 按指令划分计算预算、以 drift 相对量决定冻结/停止，以及用注意力归因证据区域，可能为 LVR 的 STOP 决策、贡献分配与视觉证据筛选提供方法线索；但该文面向图像编辑加速、无推理状态，迁移性可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Every Edit Its Own Budget: Per-Instruction Token Freezing for Training-Free Acceleration of Multi-Edit Image Editing

**abstract/A1：** Accelerating instruction-based image editing when one instruction requests several edits is challenging. Many training-free accelerators for flow-matching image editors skip tokens whose prediction has stopped changing, but decide this with a single threshold for the whole image. With several edits, such a threshold, tuned for speed, freezes small and slowly settling edits first, and requested edits disappear. We propose TIDE (Training-free Instruction-aware Drift-based Editing), which gives every instruction part its own compute budget. First, TIDE finds the region of each part in the editor's own attention by unbalanced optimal transport, without masks or external models. Second, it freezes a token once its drift is small relative to its own part and moves it along the straight path to its endpoint estimate. Third, a sparse engine computes only the remaining tokens. We prove that part-agnostic rules cannot guarantee per-part error budgets, characterize the optimal per-part threshold policy up to one tie class per part, and derive when our rule attains it. On FLUX.2 Klein, one global threshold breaks at least one edit's budget in 89% of MICE-Bench images, and TIDE drops up to 77% fewer edits at matched or higher speed (48% on MICE-Bench), a gap human raters confirm. On the many-step Klein Base, TIDE is the fastest compared method on six benchmarks (4.81-4.89x) and needs 5.3x fewer TFLOPs than vanilla, the largest saving we measure. With the same settings, it is also the fastest compared method on Qwen-Image-Edit-2511, a second model family (3.46-3.52x), and drops the fewest edits on all six benchmarks. Code will be made publicly available.

</details>

### 195. [Factorized Context Attention: From Emulated to Native Grid Probing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32423v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32423

**作者：** Mohamed Eltahir、Manar Eyad、Yara Alzahrani、Fatimah Albesher、Duaa M. Tahir、Tanveer Hussain、Naeemullah Khan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32423v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32423v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将网格探测解释为一种从模型外部用提示模拟的注意力模式，并提出免训练的块稀疏注意力 FCA：一次性编码 KV cache，用掩码批处理当地与跨步片段，配合阶梯式位置安排，在长视频、长文本和图像定位上以更低成本达到网格探测的准确率与覆盖范围。

**相关性简评：** 其“把外部多片段探测内化为原生掩码注意力”及 KV cache 复用方式，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、片段级注意力结构和缓存/位置因素提供可核查线索，但论文并未研究 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Factorized Context Attention: From Emulated to Native Grid Probing

**abstract/A1：** Models read a book, an hour of video, or an image in one forward pass. As the context grows, this pass slows down, loses accuracy, and stops at the context window. Sparse attention is efficient, but keeps the other two limitations. Grid probing, a recent training-free method, recovers the accuracy and extends the reach by asking a frozen model the same question about short local and strided spans of the input, but every question repeats the whole computation, since each span is encoded again. Our insight is that grid probing is emulated attention, an attention pattern reproduced from outside the model through prompts, since each probe only restricts which part of the input the question can see. We introduce Factorized Context Attention (FCA), a training-free block-sparse attention that runs the same pattern natively, as the attention of the model itself. FCA encodes the input once into a KV cache, reads all spans as masked sequences in one batched forward, and uses a stair position schedule to keep every span inside the trained position range. Across long video understanding, long-context text inference and image grounding, FCA matches the accuracy and the reach of grid probing at a fraction of its cost. It gains about 10 points over the single pass on long video and 9 to 14 points on long novels, finds needles in videos of over a thousand frames and in texts four times the length of the window, and answers a later question about the same input in as little as a tenth of the time of grid probing. Native attention thus keeps what emulated attention gains without its cost, all with existing frozen language and vision-language models.

**comment/C1：** Code: https://github.com/mohammad2012191/FCA

</details>

### 196. [One Subspace Is Not Enough: LocalSubspaceAD for Training-Free Few-Shot Anomaly Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32424v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32424

**作者：** Daniel Pröll、Sebastian Hegenbart

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32424v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32424v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LocalSubspaceAD，在无训练的少样本工业异常检测中，把 SubspaceAD 的单一主成分子空间扩展为子空间混合：用 k-means 对 patch 特征分区、逐簇拟合子空间，再以所有子空间上的最小重投影残差为每个 patch 打分，并在 MVTec AD、VisA、Real-IAD 上验证优于单子空间。

**相关性简评：** 其按局部语义聚类并逐簇建模特征流形、以最小残差判定的思路，可能可供核查能否作为探测 VLM 内部视觉特征是否保留局部细节与区域异质性的诊断手段；但研究对象是工业缺陷检测，与 LVR 的推理生成流程无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** One Subspace Is Not Enough: LocalSubspaceAD for Training-Free Few-Shot Anomaly Detection

**abstract/A1：** Defect-free industrial samples can vary considerably in appearance, texture, and geometry. In few-shot anomaly detection, this variability has to be modeled from only a handful of images. SubspaceAD showed that a single principal subspace of foundation-model patch features is a strong training-free model of nominal appearance. However, a single subspace has to cover all of the nominal data's variability, so a deviation that is anomalous for one semantic region can be within the nominal variability of another. We propose LocalSubspaceAD, which extends SubspaceAD from a single subspace to a mixture of subspaces, assigning each group of patches with similar features its own subspace. The set of patch-features is partitioned using k-means, one subspace is fit per cluster, and each patch is scored by the minimum of re-projection residuals over all subspaces. The proposed method requires no training and no EM refinement. On MVTec AD, VisA and Real-IAD with 1, 2 and 4 shots, it improves over a single subspace (SubspaceAD) on both evaluated backbones: by 1.2 to 1.8 points image AUROC on DINOv2, and by 1.4 to 4.4 points in image AUROC, pixel AUPR and AUPRO on DINOv3. The gains are most pronounced on objects with heterogeneous nominal appearance, such as multi-instance categories and PCBs. Ablations show that the gains stem from a finer-grained model of variability through locally oriented subspaces, rather than from the subspace offsets (cluster means). We further show that the gains do not stem from added capacity alone: the local subspaces appear to capture the structure of coherent clusters in feature space, and the model does not merely act as a compressed memory bank.

</details>

### 197. [See the Answer, Learn to Embed: Learning Universal Multimodal Embeddings from Hindsight](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32439v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32439

**作者：** Yoonki Cho、Youngju Na、Taegeun Yang、Jinhwan Seo、Sung-Eui Yoon

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CV、cs.IR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32439v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32439v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究通用多模态嵌入：训练时让模型看到匹配候选这一「后见」上下文，通过带后见注意力掩码、错配候选条件和查询对齐的 teacher，把后见表示与相似度分布蒸馏给学生；推理时学生独立编码，不需候选条件或额外推理计算。

**相关性简评：** 其用特权上下文 teacher 加蒸馏、并以错配和掩码约束防止查询表示坍缩到候选嵌入的设计，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态被答案式捷径信息坍缩及训练监督分配提供可核查线索，但论文本身不研究视觉推理状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** See the Answer, Learn to Embed: Learning Universal Multimodal Embeddings from Hindsight

**abstract/A1：** Universal Multimodal Embedding (UME) models map heterogeneous multimodal inputs into a shared embedding space, where pairwise similarity supports diverse downstream tasks. Recent reasoning-driven UME approaches use intermediate reasoning to generate additional context for embedding, but often incur extra computation at inference. In this paper, we explore the matched candidate (i.e., the paired target) as an alternative source of context, asking whether a model can "see the answer" during training and "learn to embed" without it at inference. However, direct conditioning on this privileged context can introduce candidate-specific information unavailable from the query alone or cause the candidate-conditioned query representation to collapse toward the candidate embedding. To address this, we introduce Hindsight-Enhanced Multimodal Embeddings (HEME), which learns query-grounded hindsight representations from such candidate context. HEME first trains a hindsight teacher with a hindsight attention mask, mismatched-candidate conditioning, and query-token alignment to limit excessive reliance on the candidate. It then freezes the teacher and distills its hindsight representation and similarity distribution into a standalone student embedder. At inference, the student independently encodes queries and candidates without candidate conditioning or the hindsight teacher. Experiments on MMEB-V2 and the agent and text tasks of MMEB-V3 demonstrate the effectiveness of HEME and show that it enables more efficient inference than explicit reasoning-driven methods.

</details>

### 198. [ObsBridge: Observation-Grounded Conditioning for Ego Trajectory Prediction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32447v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32447

**作者：** Zhenhao Wang、Shaofeng Liang、Jiemin Wu、Sijia Chen、Keni Shi、Nan Li、Wenshuo Chen、Bowen Tian、Runwei Guan、Yutao Yue

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32447v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32447v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对 ego 视角行人轨迹预测中历史运动被遮挡与跟踪误差污染的问题，提出 ObsBridge：用冻结估计器恢复历史状态，以 agent 级课程逐步用估计历史替换干净历史，并用残差几何适配器融合原始观测证据来条件化 flow 轨迹生成器。

**相关性简评：** 其「恢复的隐状态与原始观测证据并行融合」及渐进替换训练课程，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态与视觉证据如何并存、如何避免信息坍缩与部署时的误差敏感，但论文不做多模态推理，迁移性需验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ObsBridge: Observation-Grounded Conditioning for Ego Trajectory Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Pedestrian forecasting from ego-view observations is challenging because occlusion, limited visibility, and tracking errors corrupt observed motion histories. Such errors are particularly consequential for autonomous robot navigation. Existing paradigms typically either impute noisy history positions before forecasting or jointly train an auxiliary history reconstruction branch. However, predictors trained on clean histories may be sensitive to residual errors in recovered histories at deployment. Meanwhile, auxiliary reconstruction still computes inter-agent interactions over raw, corrupted coordinates. We investigate conditioning future prediction on both recovered historical states and raw observation evidence, with progressive training to accommodate imperfect recovery. Building on this insight, we propose ObsBridge, a flow-based trajectory forecasting framework with observation-grounded historical bridging. Specifically, ObsBridge first employs a frozen estimator to recover historical motion from agent-relative and ego-relative positions, image-plane locations, and visibility states. During training, we introduce an agent-wise curriculum that gradually replaces clean teacher histories with complete estimated histories before context encoding. This progressively exposes the predictor to estimated histories during training. Furthermore, we design a residual geometry adapter to fuse the encoded motion with original observation evidence. We aggregate the resulting representations through social attention to condition the flow-based trajectory generator. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that ObsBridge outperforms state-of-the-art methods. On EgoTraj-TBD, it reduces minADE@20 by 6.5\\% and minFDE@20 by 8.7\\%. The code will be provided at https://github.com/shawnliang420/ObsBridge.

</details>

### 199. [Which Parameters to Update? An Instance-Specific Adaptation Framework for Real-World Pansharpening](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32450v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32450

**作者：** Jin-Liang Xiao、Liang-Jian Deng、Yu-Xuan Zhang、Hua Meng、Zhengchun Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32450v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32450v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对真实场景 pansharpening 中训练与测试分布偏移导致的性能退化，提出实例级测试时自适应框架：借助跨图像块的 cross-scoring 挑选预训练网络中值得更新的参数组，再用结合光谱一致性与新设计的空间一致性项的损失更新这些组。

**相关性简评：** 其「按实例筛选参数子集、仅以一致性目标做测试时更新」的做法，可能为 LVR 中测试时状态/参数适配及「哪些更新真正贡献输出」的贡献分配提供可供核查的线索，但论文本身不涉及多模态推理或 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Which Parameters to Update? An Instance-Specific Adaptation Framework for Real-World Pansharpening

**abstract/A1：** Pansharpening aims to fuse a single observed image pair, comprising a low-resolution multispectral (LRMS) image and a panchromatic (PAN) image, to obtain a high-resolution multispectral (HRMS) image. Recently, deep learning-based methods have achieved significant performance due to their strong capability of extracting nonlinear features. However, distribution shifts between training data and test images can degrade the performance of pretrained pansharpening networks, limiting their generalization in real-world scenarios. In this work, we propose an instance-specific test-time adaptation framework that uses the observed PAN-LRMS pair to select and update only a subset of the pretrained network's parameters. Specifically, the framework uses cross-scoring to identify parameter groups whose updates improve reconstruction across image patches. It then updates the selected groups by minimizing a loss that combines a spectral consistency term with a newly designed spatial consistency term. Experiments show that the adapted networks perform better than their pretrained counterparts and outperform representative state-of-the-art pansharpening methods on GaoFen-2, QuickBird, and WorldView series datasets.

</details>

### 200. [Progressive Reliable Supervision for Black-Box Universal Domain Adaptation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32474v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32474

**作者：** Jing Li、Zhe Zhang、Huateng Sun、Yuhui Yang、Wanli Xue、Xu Cheng、Fan Shi、Jianhua Zhang、Qinghua Hu、Shengyong Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32474v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32474v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PReS，用于源数据与源模型参数均不可访问的黑盒通用域适应：借助扩散扰动下的语义一致性、黑盒源模型与 CLIP 的跨模型共识筛出可靠已知样本，再按样本级预测可靠度融合两路预测构造伪标签，并以闭环方式迭代精化伪标签与已知/未知划分。

**相关性简评：** 其样本级可靠度估计、跨模型一致性筛选与不对称监督构造，可能为 LVR 训练中的视觉证据筛选和监督贡献分配提供可核查线索，但该工作不涉及 latent 推理状态生成，迁移价值需进一步判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Progressive Reliable Supervision for Black-Box Universal Domain Adaptation

**abstract/A1：** Black-Box Universal Domain Adaptation (B$^2$-UniDA) aims to adapt a target model to an unlabeled target domain under arbitrary label-space relationships, while neither source data nor source-model parameters are accessible during adaptation. Under such restrictive information access, reliable target supervision is unavailable, while predictions from the black-box source model can be unreliable due to source bias and domain shifts. To address this challenge, we propose Progressive Reliable Supervision (PReS), which progressively establishes and refines reliable target supervision by coordinating complementary knowledge from the black-box source model, foundation models, and the evolving target model. PReS first identifies reliable known samples by exploiting semantic consistency under diffusion-based perturbations and cross-model consensus between the black-box source model and CLIP. It then estimates the sample-wise reliability of the two predictors and adaptively integrates their complementary predictions to construct reliable pseudo labels. The resulting supervision is exploited asymmetrically to encourage confident and discriminative predictions for reliable known samples while maintaining uncertain yet locally consistent predictions for potential unknown samples. As adaptation proceeds, the emerging target-domain knowledge is further leveraged to refine both the pseudo labels and the known/unknown sample partition, forming a closed-loop process in which supervision construction and target adaptation mutually reinforce each other. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets under diverse label-space relationships demonstrate that PReS achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance under the restrictive B$^2$-UniDA setting.

**comment/C1：** Under Review

</details>

### 201. [VISE: Verifier-Independent Skill Self-Evolution with Feedback from Tool Implementations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32480v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32480

**作者：** Yuxuan Liu、Chongyang Du、Yuhao Zhang、Jiahe Guo、Kawai Chung、Wenbin Hu、Huihao Jing、Hongyu Luo、Qing Zong、Haochen Shi、Haoran Li、Yangqiu Song

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32480v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32480v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 VISE：在没有任务专用验证器时，从工具源码中抽取能力、输入要求、使用条件与输出格式，结合任务请求和执行轨迹找出技能文档中缺失或冲突的步骤，并给出带依据的具体修订建议，在 SkillsBench 与 SkillLearnBench 上作为额外修订阶段提升任务成功率。

**相关性简评：** 该工作用工具实现的语义而非结果验证器来定位轨迹中缺失或冲突的步骤，可供核查其是否能为 LVR 的轨迹监督与贡献分配提供无验证器的反馈信号；但研究对象是文本技能文档，与 latent 状态生成无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VISE: Verifier-Independent Skill Self-Evolution with Feedback from Tool Implementations

**abstract/A1：** Agent skills provide reusable workflows that guide LLM agents in using tools. Refining these workflows requires feedback on missing or incorrect instructions, but task-specific verifiers are not always available. We propose VISE (Verifier-Independent Skill Evolution), a scripts-first approach that uses tool implementations to guide skill revision. It extracts tool capabilities, input requirements, usage conditions, and output formats from source code. Using the task request and execution trace, it compares this information with current workflow instructions to identify missing or conflicting steps. It then recommends specific edits to SKILL.md, linking each change to the relevant implementation and usage conditions. We evaluate VISE as an additional revision stage for four evolution methods on SkillsBench and SkillLearnBench. Compared with the corresponding No-verifier conditions, it improves overall average task success by 9.14-13.35 percentage points. The proportion of tasks solved in all three runs increases by 12.36-18.29 points. A case study shows how revised instructions connect tool outputs to later steps. These results support tool implementations as a practical feedback source for skill self-evolution.

</details>

### 202. [COHERE4D: Training-Free Dense Surface Alignment for Coherent Metric 4D Human-Scene Reconstruction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32482v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32482

**作者：** Zhumei Wang、Shaofei Wang、Xiang An、Mingtao Pei、Siyuan Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32482v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32482v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练框架 COHERE4D，将独立预训练的人体模型与场景基础模型所预测的同一人体表面直接配准，用像素级稠密 3D 对应加跨帧 RANSAC 共识抑制遮挡与深度噪声离群点，求解序列级共享尺度与逐帧人体平移，得到度量一致的 4D 人体—场景重建。

**相关性简评：** 其「稠密对应 + 跨帧共识剔除离群」的鲁棒对齐机制，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与 latent 对齐可信度校验提供可核查的方法线索；论文本身聚焦几何重建，与 VLM 推理状态生成无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** COHERE4D: Training-Free Dense Surface Alignment for Coherent Metric 4D Human-Scene Reconstruction

**abstract/A1：** Human and scene foundation models offer complementary strengths for monocular 4D reconstruction: human models recover metric-scale body meshes but lack scene grounding, whereas scene models estimate globally consistent 3D geometry and camera motion without reliable metric scale. Crucially, both models reconstruct the same foreground human surface. Yet existing methods do not directly exploit this shared surface: lacking reliable foreground human geometry in scene reconstructions, earlier approaches either resort to sparse contact constraints or learn data-driven alignment modules that generalize poorly to out-of-distribution scenes. We present COHERE4D, a training-free framework that directly registers the human surfaces predicted by independently pretrained human and scene foundation models to reconstruct a coherent, metric 4D world. COHERE4D establishes dense, pixel-aligned 3D correspondences over the visible human surface and employs RANSAC with cross-frame consensus to suppress outliers from occlusion, background contamination, and depth noise. This formulation solves for two complementary geometric quantities: a sequence-level shared scale that calibrates scene geometry and camera motion to metric human size, and per-frame human translations that align camera-space human meshes with the scaled scene geometry to enforce spatial and temporal consistency. Across diverse backbones and benchmarks, COHERE4D substantially outperforms prior methods in human--scene alignment, metric scene and camera pose reconstruction, and global human motion estimation, adding only 4,ms/frame, enabling overall inference at up to 14 FPS.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://wangzhumei.github.io/cohere4D/

</details>

### 203. [CalibTrack: Exploring Learned Heteroscedastic Covariance for Robust Multi-Camera Pedestrian Tracking](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32500v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32500

**作者：** Jack Roberts、Aditya Iyer、Nora Ayanian

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32500v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32500v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究多相机行人跟踪中测量协方差的估计方式，提出检测端的 CalibTrack，为每个检测输出异方差协方差，替代统一协方差，并在 WildTrack、MultiviewX 上配合多种解析跟踪器（GM-PHD、JIPDA、delta-GLMB）检验标定质量与恶劣天气、噪声、掉线等条件下的鲁棒性。

**相关性简评：** 其逐检测学习不确定性并考察标定与使用效果的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据的可靠性加权与筛选提供可核查的线索；但任务为多相机跟踪，与推理状态生成无直接联系，迁移价值需读原文判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CalibTrack: Exploring Learned Heteroscedastic Covariance for Robust Multi-Camera Pedestrian Tracking

**abstract/A1：** Analytical multi-view multi-object tracking (MV-MOT) systems rely on measurement covariance estimates to guide association, fusion, and state estimation. These covariance estimates are typically heuristic, requiring hand-tuning to the specific deployment scenario. We investigate how learned heteroscedastic measurement covariance affects calibration and robustness in analytical multi-camera tracking. To support this analysis, we introduce CalibTrack, a detector-side predictor that replaces uniform measurement covariance with per-detection covariance. We evaluate CalibTrack on the WildTrack and MultiviewX pedestrian tracking datasets with multiple analytical tracker cores, including an identity-informed GM-PHD, JIPDA, and pruned delta-GLMB filter. We additionally evaluate robustness by simulating adverse weather conditions with stable diffusion, Gaussian noise, camera browning, and camera dropout. CalibTrack improves average adverse tracking performance over confidence-scaled covariance, while producing better calibrated predictions, indicating the value of heteroscedastic covariance within analytical tracking. Comparisons with stronger heuristic covariance methods show that the benefits of learned covariance remain bounded by the quality of available observations and the downstream tracker choice. Together, these findings provide a principled exploration of learned covariance estimation and its potential for uncertainty-aware analytical tracking.

</details>

### 204. [Déjà-VAE: Training-Free Consistent Editing with Pseudo-Invertible Encoders and Latent Back-Projection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32501v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32501

**作者：** Ron Libman、Yamit Ehrlich、Ohad Fried、Assaf Shocher

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32501v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32501v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Déjà-VAE：无需训练地把预训练 VAE 改为伪可逆编码器—解码器对，使 latent 往返与重复重建在数值精度内稳定；并用自适应小波反投影，把编辑结果投影为在与上一 latent 未显著变化的系数上保持一致、且 ℓ2 最近的 latent，以抑制多轮编辑漂移。

**相关性简评：** 其「在约束下把更新后的 latent 投影回与旧状态一致」的训练无关机制，可能可供核查 LVR 多步推理中如何抑制视觉证据随状态更新而漂移或坍缩；但原文面向图像编辑而非推理，迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Déjà-VAE: Training-Free Consistent Editing with Pseudo-Invertible Encoders and Latent Back-Projection

**abstract/A1：** Consistency is essential to generative workflows: repeated processing should preserve information beyond the changes explicitly requested. In latent diffusion models, this requires stability both when moving between latent and pixel spaces and when applying successive edits. Autoencoding errors and unintended changes from the editing model can accumulate across these operations, progressively altering image structure, texture, and color. We introduce Déjà-VAE, a framework that combines exact autoencoding consistency with calibrated editing stabilization, without training or fine-tuning. Its autoencoding component converts a pretrained variational autoencoder into a surjective pseudo-invertible neural network, with a fixed gain balancing deviations from the pretrained encoder and decoder. The modified decoder $D'$ is an explicit nonlinear right inverse of the encoder $E'$, satisfying $E'(D'(z))=z$ by construction. Consequently, $D'$ is a reflexive generalized inverse: latent round trips preserve their input, up to numerical precision, and repeated image reconstruction is idempotent. To suppress editing drift, adaptive wavelet back-projection finds the closest latent to the editor's output in $\\ell\_2$, subject to matching the previous latent on wavelet coefficients whose changes fall below calibrated thresholds. This correction is applied once per turn, with no additional network evaluations after calibration. Together, these components support workflows that remain in latent space or interleave generation with pixel-space operations and constraints. Tests across models and editing benchmarks show less drift than stock pipelines and dedicated consistency methods.

</details>

<a id="paper-205"></a>

### 205. [InducedTFMs: A Family of Sub-Quadratic Tabular Foundation Models Using Induced Attention](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32504v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32504

**作者：** Salome Gobbi、Nicolas Atienza、Nicola Cancedda、Michael Arbel

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32504v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32504v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 InducedTFM，用 Set Transformer 的 induced attention 替换表格基础模型的两级注意力，在保留 cell 级表示的同时把样本与特征维度上的开销降为线性，并在 TabArena 等基准上与全注意力模型精度相当、推理更快。

**相关性简评：** 其诱导点压缩上下文、以线性代价维持细粒度表示的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态与视觉证据的压缩、以及长上下文的计算成本提供可供核查的架构线索，但论文本身不涉及多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** InducedTFMs: A Family of Sub-Quadratic Tabular Foundation Models Using Induced Attention

**abstract/A1：** Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have emerged as a serious competitor to gradient-boosted trees, predicting on a new table in a single forward pass by in-context learning. However, their attention is quadratic in the number of samples and features, which caps pretraining at small synthetic tables and forces inference on large ones to rely on chunking or subsampling. Row-compression models reduce the feature-wise cost, but only by discarding the cell-level representation, and remain quadratic in the number of samples. We introduce InducedTFM, which replaces both attention stages of a bidimensional TFM with the induced attention of the Set Transformer, preserving cell-level representations while making its cost linear in both samples and features. Under a training budget matched to a full-attention TabICLv2 reimplementation, InducedTFM matches its accuracy on TabArena and on a benchmark of larger datasets, and clearly outperforms a kernel linear-attention baseline of the same asymptotic cost. It overtakes TabICLv2 in inference time on narrow tables, reaching a 30x speed-up at 640K rows, although row compression remains preferable on wide tables.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables

</details>

### 206. [DiffAnchor: Anchor-Space Diffusion for Monocular 3D Hand Pose Estimation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32513v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32513

**作者：** Changlong Jiang、Youci Tang、Haohong Kuang、Hang Xu、Jinghong Zheng、Ran Wang、Zhenghong Yu、Chen Feng、Xiaofeng Yue、Yang Xiao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32513v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32513v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DiffAnchor，在单目 3D 手部姿态估计中把扩散过程放在中间 anchor 空间而非最终关节坐标上，由固定上下文锚点与动态锚点迭代细化，再经 anchor-to-joint 偏移预测和加权聚合输出精确关节，辅以重要性引导的锚点筛选与补充，实现少步去噪、单假设的高效预测。

**相关性简评：** 「随机搜索不直接作用于最终输出、而在中间表示上完成再由读出模块精确化」这一思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 工作区的状态更新、少步迭代与计算分配提供可核查的方法线索，但本文任务为纯视觉姿态估计，与多模态推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DiffAnchor: Anchor-Space Diffusion for Monocular 3D Hand Pose Estimation

**abstract/A1：** Accurate and efficient monocular 3D hand pose estimation is an important perception capability for embodied human interaction and dexterous manipulation. Recent diffusion-based methods model pose uncertainty by iteratively denoising 3D joint coordinates. However, directly diffusing the final joints requires the generative process to simultaneously explore plausible poses and recover precise coordinates, often relying on additional denoising steps or multiple hypotheses and consequently increasing inference cost. In this work, we propose DiffAnchor, a few-step anchor-space diffusion framework that diffuses anchors rather than joints. Our key insight is that stochastic exploration does not need to operate directly on the final output. Instead, diffusion searches for informative intermediate anchors that serve as local 3D regressors, while anchor-to-joint offset prediction and weighted aggregation complete precise joint localization. Specifically, fixed context anchors provide stable global references, whereas noisy dynamic anchors are iteratively refined toward informative joint regions. An importance-guided anchor selection and replenishment mechanism further retains useful anchors, removes ineffective ones, and explores insufficiently covered regions. This design reduces the precision burden of the diffusion process and enables accurate prediction using only a few denoising steps and a single hypothesis. Extensive experiments on HO-3D V2, NYU, ICVL, and InterHand2.6M demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on the first three benchmarks and competitive performance on challenging interacting-hand estimation, while maintaining inference efficiency comparable to deterministic regression baselines.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Embodied AI

</details>

### 207. [Branch and Consolidate: A Unified Recipe for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32515v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32515

**作者：** Zihan Liang、Zikun Qu、Ben Chen、Fan Yang、Wenwu Ou、Min Zhang、Zhongxiang Dai、Xinchao Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32515v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32515v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究多教师 on-policy 蒸馏（MOPD）如何把从共享 checkpoint 分叉出的多个多模态专家合并回单一学生模型，提出涵盖初始化、数据选择、跨教师均衡监督与既有能力保持的统一配方，并增加针对性精炼阶段，在工业六专家与开放五领域设定下验证。

**相关性简评：** 论文不涉及 latent 推理状态，但其跨教师均衡监督、能力保持与「合并不完全」诊断思路，可能为 LVR 训练中的多源推理行为监督与能力保留提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Branch and Consolidate: A Unified Recipe for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation

**abstract/A1：** Specialists post-trained from a shared checkpoint acquire complementary capabilities, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) can consolidate them into a single model. However, we find that existing consolidation methods, from weight merging to MOPD, fall short when specialists diverge substantially from the shared checkpoint, whereas prior studies mostly examine specialists that remain close to it. We present a unified recipe for multimodal MOPD that consolidates such specialists back into the single student they branched from. The recipe specifies initialization, data selection, balanced supervision across teachers, and preservation of existing capabilities for consolidation, together with a targeted refinement stage for capabilities that still lag behind their specialists. In an industrial setting with six specialists, the student closely approaches each specialist in its own domain and surpasses the perception specialist. It recovers 97.0% of their average gain, compared with 79.8% for IM-MOPD. In the fully open five-domain setting with Qwen3-4B, our method recovers 95.7% of the specialists' average gain after consolidation and 97.5% after refinement, compared with 94.1% for IM-MOPD. We further analyze the full pipeline through mechanism ablations and training dynamics, providing practical guidance for diagnosing incomplete consolidation. Code will be released.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables

</details>

### 208. [Align or Fail: The Hidden Gap in Cross-Domain Panoptic Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32542v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32542

**作者：** Huy Hoang Nguyen、Oliver Zendel、Tobias Glueck、Minh Nhat Vu、Andreas Kugi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32542v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32542v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文以扩散式 OVPS 模型 ODISE 为测试床，将其视觉提取器替换为 DINOv2、ConvNeXt 或 DINOv3，诊断跨域全景分割中密集区域特征与 CLIP 文本嵌入之间的「分组—识别错配」，并对比文本侧适配、conformal mask retention 与 2.7M 参数视觉侧 LoRA 等修复手段，区分出可修复的视觉—CLIP 接口缺口与词表边界限制两类失败。

**相关性简评：** 其「语义信息仍在但与文本嵌入空间几何不兼容」的诊断及视觉侧 LoRA 修复，可能为 LVR 中 latent 视觉状态能否被语言侧读出、跨域时视觉证据是否真的保留提供可供核查的线索，但任务本身是分割而非多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Align or Fail: The Hidden Gap in Cross-Domain Panoptic Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Vision foundation backbones are often treated as drop-in upgrades for improving region proposals in open-vocabulary panoptic segmentation (OVPS). Yet, improvements in backbones often fail to translate well into downstream cross-domain performance. Using ODISE, a diffusion-based OVPS model with a CLIP-based recognition branch, as a testbed, we replace its diffusion visual extractor with DINOv2, ConvNeXt, or DINOv3, and find that backbone upgrades can introduce a grouping-recognition mismatch: an alignment gap between dense-region features and CLIP text embeddings. Across source and near-domain, the newer DINOv3 variant improves source-domain performance but collapses on several cross-domain targets, whereas other baselines, interestingly, show the opposite. Stage-wise diagnostics, linear probes, and region-text alignment analyses indicate that DINOv3 embeddings retain semantic information but are geometrically incompatible with CLIP. We test adaptations, including text-side adapters, conformal mask retention (CMR), and a lean 2.7M-parameter visual-side LoRA, and find that text-side adaptation is more sensitive to vocabulary overlap. CMR provides only limited and target-specific gains, indicating that retention alone cannot resolve the full cross-domain failure. To understand why ADE20K resists improvement across all interventions, we evaluate OVSeg, CAT-Seg, and MaskCLIP. This separates two failure axes: a recoverable visual-to-CLIP interface gap that visual-side LoRA largely repairs, and a vocabulary-boundary limitation shared by the evaluated CLIP-based recognition systems that requires different remedies.

**comment/C1：** 17 pages, 4 figures, Accepted at ACCV 2026 Workshop MLCSA

</details>
