### 209. [MinPair: Measured Minimal Pairs for Fine-Grained Control in Text-to-Motion Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32549v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32549

**作者：** Lennart Schiweck、Cristóbal Curio

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32549v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32549v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MinPair：从规则化 3D 运动描述符生成带时序部位信息的高细粒度 caption，并构造只改一个属性的「测量最小对」，配合对比式 pair loss 要求扩散去噪器用真 caption 比用改动副本更准确地重建动作，在 22 个目标任务与单词编辑上评估细粒度控制。

**相关性简评：** 最小对构造加对比损失可用来迫使模型依赖单一条件词，其「只有该词能区分才需使用该词」的监督思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与贡献分配的训练设计；但任务为动作生成，与内部推理状态无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MinPair: Measured Minimal Pairs for Fine-Grained Control in Text-to-Motion Generation

**abstract/A1：** Text-to-motion generation has made great progress in capturing what action to perform, yet it remains limited in controlling how that action is executed. For example, when only the height word of a kick request changes, none of the tested state-of-the-art methods reaches all three of knee, waist and head height. The other words of a caption usually imply an attribute such as height, so neither the training loss nor the standard metrics require a model to use the word that states it. A model has to use this word only when it alone separates two otherwise identical captions. We introduce MinPair, which creates such caption pairs from real motion clips. It starts from rule-based motion descriptors that measure the 3D body motion of each clip. From these descriptors a language model writes MinPair captions, timed body-part captions that say how each body part moves. The same descriptors show in which attributes two clips of the same action differ. A measured minimal pair joins the true caption of one clip with an altered copy in which only one attribute takes the value measured in the other clip. A contrastive pair loss then requires a diffusion denoiser to reconstruct the clip more accurately from its true caption than from the altered copy. Training needs no synthetic motion and inference stays unchanged. Control is tested on 22 target tasks and on caption edits that each change one attribute. MinPair captions alone help motions reach their targets and improve the standard metrics M2M, R@3 and FID, yet a model trained on them still ignores most single-word edits. The pair loss raises the share of followed template edits from 11% to 60%, while the standard metrics do not improve further. With body-part captions, MinPair reaches more targets than state-of-the-art methods that were trained on up to 99 times more motion data.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables

</details>

### 210. [FewRef-5: Fixed-Reference Test-Time Adaptation for Virtual Staining](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32591v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32591

**作者：** Wenxuan Wang、Liwen Wang、Mingmin Wu、Xingbo Dong、Zhe Jin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32591v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32591v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 FewRef-5，一种面向 H&amp;E 到 MAS 虚拟染色的参考辅助测试时适配方法：从五个真实染色patch提取组织掩膜下的光密度均值与标准差并平均为固定染色目标，通过调度统计匹配损失与边缘/Gram 一致性约束，在冻结生成器上逐查询优化视觉提示。

**相关性简评：** 其「固定参考目标 + 测试时逐查询优化、避免递归依赖自生成输出」的做法，可能为 latent 推理中状态更新与误差累积/漂移控制提供可核查线索，但任务本身是图像翻译，无推理状态与证据使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FewRef-5: Fixed-Reference Test-Time Adaptation for Virtual Staining

**abstract/A1：** Virtual staining synthesizes special-stain images from routine hematoxylin and eosin (H&amp;E), extending the information available from an existing digital slide. However, a fixed inference rule can leave available real target-stain references unused, limiting query-specific correction of stain appearance at deployment. Test-time adaptation (TTA) provides a mechanism for this reference-guided, query-specific refinement without retraining the generator. We therefore propose FewRef-5, a reference-assisted TTA method for virtual staining built on StainPromptInversion. We extract tissue-masked optical-density means and standard deviations from five real Masson's trichrome (MAS) training patches and average them into a fixed stain target. A scheduled statistic-matching loss introduces this target into per-query visual-prompt optimization alongside our edge/Gram consistency penalties and the inherited reconstruction objectives. The target remains unchanged across queries, avoiding recursive dependence on earlier generated outputs while the pretrained generator stays fixed. On recorded H&amp;E-to-MAS outputs for 1,989 queries, FewRef-5 reduces target-set FID from 183.201 to 166.904 and increases source-referenced SSIM from 0.92787 to 0.94996 relative to our Edge+Gram variant. Source PSNR and MS-SSIM decrease, showing an endpoint trade-off rather than uniformly better reconstruction.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 5 figures

</details>

### 211. [Gated Concept Adapters: Layer-Wise Concept Bottlenecks for Auditable Text Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32600v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32600

**作者：** Niloofar Ranjbar、Saeedeh Momtazi、Mohammad Mehdi Homayounpoor

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32600v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32600v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Gated Concept Adapters：在预训练 Transformer 若干层输出上挂接带门控的低维概念读出适配器，将 token 表示映射为概念激活、门控过滤并池化为层级概念摘要，再交给预测头，配合概念命名与定向干预做可审计的文本理解。

**相关性简评：** 其门控低维概念瓶颈与逐层摘要可能为 LVR 中视觉或任务必要信息是否被保留、以及瓶颈监督与概念干预提供核查线索；但对象为纯文本分类，与视觉推理状态生成无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Gated Concept Adapters: Layer-Wise Concept Bottlenecks for Auditable Text Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Human-facing text understanding systems are used to infer affect, moderate harmful content, and support socially sensitive decisions. However, Transformer predictions are difficult to audit because they are produced from high-dimensional hidden states that do not provide a compact, inspectable interface for human analysis or intervention. We introduce Gated Concept Adapters (GCA), a layer-wise concept bottleneck framework that attaches gated, low-dimensional concept-producing readout adapters to selected outputs of pretrained Transformers. Token representations are mapped into concept activations, filtered by learned gates, pooled into layer-level summaries, and exposed to the prediction head as a concept-mediated interface. The dimensions can be inspected through usage statistics, signature n-grams, post-hoc concept names, and targeted concept interventions. We evaluate GCA on fine-grained emotion classification, toxicity detection, topic classification, and a controlled verb-cloze stress test. In the affective and safety-relevant classification settings, GCA learns comparatively low-redundancy and intervention-sensitive concept representations while retaining useful predictive performance. On toxicity detection, it remains close to an unconstrained ModernBERT baseline while enabling concept-level inspection, targeted intervention, and lightweight post-hoc control. On GoEmotions, the end-to-end concept model incurs a macro-F1 cost relative to unconstrained RoBERTa, while a task-initialized frozen variant substantially reduces this gap. On AG News, GCA remains competitive with recent concept-based baselines, and the Qwen verb-cloze experiment clarifies the limits of concept-mediated full-vocabulary prediction. Overall, GCA provides a neural concept interface for auditable text understanding, prioritizing transparency, diagnosis, and intervention over unconstrained accuracy maximization.

**comment/C1：** Preprint. Includes supplementary appendices

</details>

### 212. [ST-GNN-AAAS: Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks for Anytime Automatic Algorithm Selection in the Traveling Salesman Problem](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32602v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32602

**作者：** Zeyu Zhang、Mustafa Misir

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32602v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32602v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ST-GNN-AAAS，用时空图神经网络为 TSP 的 anytime 求解器选择建模：将当前巡回路径编码为时变节点特征，结合短窗口内的求解器表现历史，预测较长未来时间跨度上的求解器选择。

**相关性简评：** 其「用短历史执行轨迹预测更长时域收益并据此分配计算」的思路，可供核查 LVR 中动态计算预算分配与停止决策的设计，但对象是组合优化求解器而非视觉推理，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ST-GNN-AAAS: Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks for Anytime Automatic Algorithm Selection in the Traveling Salesman Problem

**abstract/A1：** Anytime Automatic Algorithm Selection (AAAS) aims to make solver choices under varying time budgets. The existing AAAS approaches largely rely on static instance characteristics and make limited use of temporal information revealed during solver execution. We propose ST-GNN-AAAS, a Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Network framework for AAAS in the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). The framework represents evolving incumbent tours using time-varying node features, including distances from each node to its neighbors in the current tour, and combines these features with solver performance observations over a short history window. Given this short history, ST-GNN-AAAS predicts solver selections over a longer future horizon. We evaluate the method on a subset of diverse TSP benchmarks from NATIONAL, TNM, TSPLIB, and VLSI, releasing the corresponding solver execution data to support reproducibility. Our model achieves a selection accuracy of 76.59% and closes 46.05% of the average rank gap between the single best solver (SBS) and the virtual best solver (VBS).

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems: From Forecasting to World Modeling (FMTS)

### 213. [HazeFlux: Few-Step Generative Priors for Real-World Image Dehazing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32632v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32632

**作者：** Yunong Liu、Danna Xue、Javier Vazquez-Corral

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32632v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32632v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出两阶段少步流匹配框架做真实图像去雾：第一阶段用 LoRA 结合流匹配与像素级监督微调 latent backbone，第二阶段向 VAE 解码器注入结构保持跳连以绕过潜空间压缩造成的细节损失。

**相关性简评：** 其「潜空间压缩丢失细粒度结构，需用像素级监督和旁路跳连补偿」的处理方式，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节是否保留在内部状态、以及 latent 表示如何被监督提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HazeFlux: Few-Step Generative Priors for Real-World Image Dehazing

**abstract/A1：** Real-world single-image dehazing suffers from severe domain shifts, as paired real data is scarce and models trained on synthetic haze generalize poorly to real-world haze. While pre-trained generative editing models offer powerful image priors to bridge this generalization gap, applying them to image dehazing poses two major challenges: standard generative models prioritize distribution alignment over strict pixel-level fidelity, and operating in compressed latent spaces inherently discards fine-grained structural details. In this paper, we propose a novel two-stage framework that adapts the generative prior of a few-step flow-matching backbone to real-world dehazing. In the first stage, we fine-tune the latent backbone using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), supervised not only on a flow-matching objective, but also on pixel-level supervision, thus enabling direct hazy-to-clear translation. In the second stage, we introduce structure-preserving skip connections directly to the VAE decoder, bypassing latent compression artifacts to recover precise spatial edges. Experiments on four realworld benchmarks demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing dehazing methods in real conditions.

</details>

### 214. [TeamFlowRL: Online Policy Optimization of Decentralized Flow Policies for Multi-Agent Coordination](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32645v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32645

**作者：** Guowei Zou、Beiwen Zhang、Haitao Wang、Hong Hong、Zhiquan Chen、Hejun Wu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.MA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32645v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32645v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出两阶段框架 TeamFlowRL：先离线预训练去中心化的多智能体 flow 策略，再在完整去噪轨迹层面构造策略优化目标，用共享团队优势加权各智能体的轨迹比例并分别裁剪，从而绕开难以计算的动作似然；在七组仿真、51 个配对配置上均有提升，双臂任务中探索噪声下成功率高于高斯策略微调。

**相关性简评：** 其「在整条去噪轨迹上做免似然的比例优化并以共享优势加权各智能体」可能为 latent 推理轨迹的训练监督与跨步骤贡献分配提供线索，但论文本身属多智能体机器人控制，与视觉推理仅在方法层面相关，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TeamFlowRL: Online Policy Optimization of Decentralized Flow Policies for Multi-Agent Coordination

**abstract/A1：** Complex cooperative tasks require coordinated multi-agent behavior. Offline generative policies learn expressive cooperative behaviors from trajectories but remain limited by fixed datasets. Online reinforcement learning can improve them through environment interaction. However, fine-tuning flow policies is difficult because action likelihoods are hard to compute. We propose TeamFlowRL, a two-stage framework that pretrains multi-agent flow policies offline and fine-tunes them online. We formulate team policy optimization over the complete denoising trajectories of decentralized flow policies, avoiding intractable action likelihoods. The resulting objective weights each agent's trajectory ratio with a shared team advantage and clips each ratio separately, aligning local policy updates with the common team return. Across 51 paired configurations in seven simulation groups, TeamFlowRL improves every offline initialization, with a 47.3% average gain in normalized score. It also achieves 33.1% higher average success under exploration noise than Gaussian-policy fine-tuning across 6 bimanual tasks.

### 215. [TokenMatte: Unlocking T2V Diffusion Priors for Pixel-Native Video Matting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32675v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32675

**作者：** Zanyi Wang、Dengyang Jiang、Fengfei Yu、Shilong Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32675v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32675v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 将预训练视频 T2V DiT 改造为单次、无额外辅助输入的高分辨率视频抠像器，用共享线性读出把每个时空 token 直接映射为对应的 alpha 像素块，省去 VAE 解码与卷积上采样。

**相关性简评：** 原文指出经 RGB 训练的 VAE latent 会削弱细节，并改用 token 直出像素的读出方式，这可为 LVR 中「内部状态是否保留视觉细节」及如何从 latent 读出细粒度视觉内容提供可供核查的线索；但任务属视频抠像，迁移性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TokenMatte: Unlocking T2V Diffusion Priors for Pixel-Native Video Matting

**abstract/A1：** High-resolution video matting requires accurate recovery of continuous alpha values, including fine hair, soft boundaries, and motion blur, yet dense alpha supervision remains scarce. Pretrained text-to-video diffusion transformers (DiTs) offer rich spatio-temporal priors, whereas existing generative video matting approaches typically route alpha predictions through RGB-trained VAE latents, which can attenuate fine details and introduce additional decoding overhead. We present TokenMatte, which adapts a pretrained video DiT into a single-pass, auxiliary-free RGB-to-alpha predictor with a pixel-native output interface. At its core is a single shared linear readout that maps each spatio-temporal token directly to its corresponding ($t \\times p \\times p$) block of alpha pixels, predicting spatial details and temporal variations within the same local video block. Tiling these blocks produces the full-resolution alpha sequence without a convolutional decoder or learned upsampling. The predicted alpha is supervised directly in pixel space, while the ground-truth alpha never enters the VAE, eliminating target-side alpha encoding and output-side VAE decoding. Leveraging the pretrained video prior, TokenMatte is trained using only existing public matting datasets, without additional data curation or auxiliary inputs at inference. Compared with a matched latent-output baseline, our pixel-native interface improves matting accuracy while achieving a 1.51$\\times$ inference speedup. TokenMatte establishes a new auxiliary-free state of the art on VideoMatte, YouTubeMatte, and V-HIM60.

**comment/C1：** 13 pages, 11 figures, 9 tables

</details>

### 216. [Load Balancing Neurons: Firing-Rate Control Sustains Plasticity in Continual Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32691v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32691

**作者：** Jan Robine、Marc Höftmann、Stefan Harmeling

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.NE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32691v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32691v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文以 ReLU 单元的 firing rate（正预激活比例）作为诊断指标，区分死单元与常开线性化单元，并提出一种轻量级负载均衡机制，按神经元调整阈值使 firing rate 维持在目标区间，在持续学习基准上维持可塑性，并迁移到 Rainbow DQN。

**相关性简评：** 其「死单元／常开单元」诊断与逐神经元阈值调控可供核查 latent reasoning 中状态坍缩、视觉信息被旁路和容量利用率问题，但属训练期辅助机制，非推理期 latent 状态生成，联系需进一步验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Load Balancing Neurons: Firing-Rate Control Sustains Plasticity in Continual Learning

**abstract/A1：** Neural networks in continual learning often lose plasticity: some neurons become inactive, while others fire almost constantly. This limits adaptation to shifting data and wastes capacity. Prior work mitigates this by periodically reinitializing low-utility units, but such resets can destroy previously learned features and do not proactively prevent low utility. We study a simple diagnostic measure: the firing rate of ReLU units, defined as the fraction of positive pre-activations. Low rates identify dead units, while very high rates indicate linearized, always-on units. Based on this view, we introduce a lightweight load-balancing mechanism that adjusts per-neuron thresholds to keep firing rates within a target range. Across continual ImageNet and class-incremental CIFAR-100, firing-rate distributions explain differences in plasticity across a range of approaches, including well-known techniques such as L2 regularization and non-affine normalization, and load balancing matches or exceeds reset-based methods on both benchmarks. The same mechanism carries over to reinforcement learning, improving Rainbow DQN on Atari over a LayerNorm baseline.

</details>

### 217. [Diving Deeper into Dense Keypoint Localization in Object Pose Estimation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32728v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32728

**作者：** Jiahong Chen、Jinghao Wang、Yueneng Yang、Banglei Guan、Zi Wang、Dewen Hu、Qifeng Yu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32728v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32728v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 GHLAPose，用混合 Gray-binary 编码缓解二值编码的不连续性与量化误差以完成全局关键点定位，再由局部感知精化模块估计不确定性并修正定位，构成由粗到细的 6D 物体位姿估计框架。

**相关性简评：** 其「离散编码量化误差 + 不确定性驱动局部精化」可供核查是否能类比 LVR 中紧凑 latent 表示的信息坍缩与后续证据补充，但任务本身为位姿估计，与多模态推理距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Diving Deeper into Dense Keypoint Localization in Object Pose Estimation

**abstract/A1：** 6D pose estimation of rigid objects is a fundamental and challenging task in computer vision. Recent dense semantic keypoint-based methods employ binary encoding for efficient global keypoint localization, delivering strong performance in object pose estimation. Nevertheless, the discontinuous nature of binary encoding hinders effective training at high resolutions, while its inherent discrete and quantization errors lead to significant localization uncertainty. We propose GHLAPose, a global-to-local framework that synergizes hybrid Gray-binary (HGB) encoding with local-aware refinement (LAR). Specifically, HGB encoding first alleviates discontinuity to achieve accurate initial global keypoint localization. To further address intrinsic encoding errors, the LAR module estimates uncertainty and refines keypoint localization. This synergy enables a precise global-to-local strategy by aggregating global and local features. Extensive experiments on LM, LM-O, YCB-V, and TUD-L datasets demonstrate that GHLAPose surpasses state-of-the-art methods, particularly on fine-grained metrics. On LM-O, it outperforms the second-best method by 1.4% and 1.9% on ADD(-S) 0.02d and 0.05d respectively, and on YCB-V by 1% on ADD(-S) 0.1d. The code will be available at GHLAPose.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages, 14 figures. Accepted by TCSVT 2026

</details>

### 218. [AnyPrune: Optimization-Free Pruning for Any Feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting Pipeline](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32735v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32735

**作者：** Nicola Leonetti、Federico Stella、Aoxiang Fan、Saqib Javed、Pascal Fua、Luigi Di Stefano

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32735v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32735v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 AnyPrune，一个在冻结的前馈 3DGS 管线之上用少量单卡训练学到的 transformer 剪枝模块，用于去除渲染不需要的高斯，从而在无需再优化的情况下降低内存与存储开销，并可在 5 秒内剪掉 1.6M 高斯。

**相关性简评：** 其「在冻结主干上学习冗余模式、按内容删除表示元素」的做法，可供核查是否能迁移到 LVR 中 latent 状态或视觉 token 的冗余判定与动态预算控制，但场景是 3D 重建而非多模态推理，联系较弱。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AnyPrune: Optimization-Free Pruning for Any Feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting Pipeline

**abstract/A1：** Feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pipelines reconstruct a scene from images in a single forward pass, representing it as real-time-renderable 3D Gaussians. However, the resulting representations contain far more Gaussians than are needed to render the scene faithfully, especially when there are many input views. This drastically increases memory and storage requirements. Existing pruning methods either require costly re-optimization, which defeats the purpose of a single forward pass, or rely on simple strategies that do not exploit all the available information. We present AnyPrune, a transformer-based, optimization-free pruning module designed to work on top of any feedforward 3DGS pipeline. To remove unnecessary Gaussians, AnyPrune learns and exploits pipeline-specific redundancy patterns through a short single-GPU training on the frozen target feedforward pipeline. AnyPrune achieves better rendering quality than existing optimization-free pruning methods in most settings and generalizes to unseen datasets, as shown through extensive experiments across multiple feedforward pipelines, datasets, and input view counts. It prunes a 1.6M-Gaussian field in about $5\\,\\mathrm{s}$ on a consumer GPU, faster than every method that merges Gaussians or re-optimizes the field. It can also be combined with the pruning built into feedforward pipelines, pruning further at moderate ratios while preserving or improving rendering quality. Finally, it can even suggest a scene-specific pruning ratio that retains most of the quality.

</details>

### 219. [MemAnchorWorld: A Sparse World Model with Horizon-Conditioned Memory Retrieval for Autonomous Driving](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32745v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32745

**作者：** Xinyang Jia、Yuqi Zhang、Jiakai Wang、Yahu Yang、Guandong Pan、Chao Tong、Xianglong Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32745v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32745v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MemAnchorWorld，一个面向自动驾驶 4D 语义占用预测的稀疏世界模型：以少量演化 query 表示场景，并引入受预测时刻条件控制的双路径记忆锚点检索与点级残差适配器，显式取回历史几何与语义证据以缓解长时程误差累积。

**相关性简评：** 其「用检索到的历史证据修正少量 query 状态、并按预测时刻门控修正量」的机制，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、latent 状态更新与随推理深度调节计算提供可核查的结构线索，但该工作本身不做多模态语言推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MemAnchorWorld: A Sparse World Model with Horizon-Conditioned Memory Retrieval for Autonomous Driving

**abstract/A1：** Sparse world models for 4D semantic occupancy forecasting represent scenes with a small set of evolving queries to efficiently predict future geometry and semantics for autonomous driving. However, existing sparse world models face a bottleneck in using historical temporal evidence for long-horizon forecasting. They rely on scene states to carry historical information implicitly, allowing errors to propagate and accumulate across successive forecasting steps and causing geometric and semantic deviations. To address this limitation, we present MemAnchorWorld, a sparse occupancy world model that explicitly retrieves relevant historical geometric and semantic evidence for 4D semantic occupancy forecasting. Inspired by the von Restorff effect, we introduce a forecast-time-conditioned hierarchical dual-path memory-anchor retrieval mechanism. Guided by the effective age and semantic compatibility of historical information, it combines query-level candidate selection with point-level memory-anchor retrieval to provide historical evidence for sparse points at different forecast times. To better use memory anchors and existing features, a point-level residual adapter jointly gated by the task and forecast time separately controls residual corrections to semantics, occupancy confidence, and spatial positions. On Occ3D-nuScenes, MemAnchorWorld achieves an average mIoU of 13.55% and an average IoU of 22.84% across the 1-3 s forecasting horizons, attaining state-of-the-art performance on both metrics.Project page: https://memanchorworld.github.io/

### 220. [RubikSQL-HB: Agentic Text-to-SQL with Knowledge in the Loop](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32772v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32772

**作者：** Haorui Jia、Zihan Qu、Yundi Dong、Ziyang Mei、Chi Zhang、Zezhi Zheng、Dousheng Zhao、Jiahao Zhang、Zui Chen、Han Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32772v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32772v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RubikSQL-HB，在 HeavenBase 上为每个数据库构建可查询的知识工作区，让候选 agent 交替进行知识检索、SQL 构造与执行，并由 Judge 复用同一接口核查候选分歧；在 BIRD Mini-Dev 500 题上达到 75.2% 执行准确率。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本 Text-to-SQL，无视觉与 latent 状态，但「候选生成 + 带工具的证据式裁决」这一搜索与验证结构可供核查是否能类比 LVR 中 latent 候选的筛选、证据获取与停止决策。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RubikSQL-HB: Agentic Text-to-SQL with Knowledge in the Loop

**abstract/A1：** Database agents need more than schema structure: business meanings, stored values and reference queries supply knowledge that becomes relevant at different points in reasoning. We introduce RubikSQL-HB, which exposes these materials through queryable, database-specific knowledge workspaces built on the HeavenBase platform. Its knowledge interface remains available as an agent constructs and investigates an answer. Candidate agents interleave knowledge access with SQL construction and execution; a downstream Judge can reuse the same interfaces to investigate disagreements. A two-stage example interface separates discovering a reference question from expanding its SQL. On a 500-question BIRD Mini-Dev evaluation, the full pipeline reaches 75.2% execution accuracy, against 71.2% for first-candidate selection and 70.4% for execution-majority voting, with a correct candidate available on 79.0% of questions. The raw-knowledge condition, which also regenerates candidates without the built workspace, is 3.0 points lower, and adjudication with tools and revision accounts for most of the gain over selection baselines. A recorded execution probe shows how continued investigation resolves a candidate disagreement. Separate archived runs show semantic revision recovering answers absent from their original candidate pools. A versioned development study further illustrates how recurring corrections become reusable execution checks. The system and results connect knowledge-interface design to agent decision quality: queryable knowledge supports the construction of useful alternatives, and evidence-aware adjudication connects those alternatives to a final answer. Keeping knowledge in the loop lets agents acquire relevant observations as their reasoning develops.

</details>

### 221. [Learning World Models through Contrastive Identification of Actions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32776v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32776

**作者：** Hayeong Lee、Youngjun Suh. Byung-Jun Lee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32776v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32776v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Contrastive Identification of Actions（CIA），在带有行为提议的世界模型中让模型从同一历史下采样的候选动作中辨识实际执行动作，以对比式逆动力学替代平方误差回归，从而激励下一时刻 latent 携带历史之外的动作信息，并在五个视觉控制基准上验证规划成功率提升。

**相关性简评：** 其核心是「用对比目标筛选 latent 中应保留哪些信息」，与 LVR 中状态内容选择、训练监督和贡献分配问题可能相关，可供核查该辨识式监督是否也适用于推理期 latent 轨迹的有效性判别。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning World Models through Contrastive Identification of Actions

**abstract/A1：** Latent world models enable goal-directed planning from offline visual data, but prediction alone does not specify which action-related distinctions their representations should preserve. Inverse dynamics provides auxiliary supervision, yet squared-error action regression rewards additional information only through changes in the conditional action mean. We propose Contrastive Identification of Actions (CIA), which identifies the executed action among alternatives sampled from a history-conditioned behavior proposal. Comparing actions plausible in the same context targets information supplied by the next latent beyond history. Under exact behavior matching, we show that CIA can reward action information that leaves optimal inverse-regression error unchanged, and verify this distinction through a controlled learning example. CIA achieves higher planner-averaged mean success than the base world model and a regression inverse-dynamics baseline across five visual control benchmarks, without modifying the planner.

</details>

**作者：** Hang Yin、Jiepan Li、Hongruixuan Chen、Guangyi Yang、Wei He

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32777v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32777v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LAMIA-IBDA 视觉语言框架，用可靠性感知注意力将多种损伤描述与双时相影像特征对齐，并以动态实例原型完成建筑级损伤分级。

**相关性简评：** 可靠性感知注意力监督与实例自适应原型或可供核查视觉证据筛选和语义锚定的做法，但任务属遥感判别式分类、无 latent 推理状态生成，与 LVR 主线距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Static Semantics: Instance-Adaptive Vision-Language Alignment for Building Damage Assessment

**abstract/A1：** Instance-level building damage assessment (IBDA) from bi-temporal remote sensing imagery remains challenging, as the same damage grade may exhibit diverse visual manifestations across individual buildings. Natural language offers explicit descriptions of physical damage, providing complementary semantic cues beyond discrete category labels. However, existing vision--language approaches have not fully addressed how damage semantics should adapt to local bi-temporal evidence and subsequently serve as instance-specific references for severity discrimination. To bridge this gap, we propose LAMIA-IBDA, a unified vision--language framework that progressively grounds shared damage semantics in local observations and individual buildings. Specifically, Adaptive Text-Visual Alignment (ATVA) enables evidence-adaptive semantic interaction by jointly contextualizing multiple damage descriptions and bi-temporal visual features under reliability-aware attention supervision. Dynamic Instance-Prototype Grounding (DIPG) further associates these contextualized semantics with individual building regions to construct instance-adaptive prototypes for fine-grained damage classification. Instance-level description preferences additionally supervise fusion-stage attention, linking semantic adaptation with instance discrimination. Extensive experiments on xBD and BRIGHT demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across optical--optical and optical--SAR settings. The source code is publicly available https://github.com/Cutensil/LAMIA-IBDA.

</details>

**作者：** Daehee Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32782v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32782v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 对 58 个开源 LLM 每层 FFN 下投影输入的激活做 PCA，以固定余弦相似度重构所需的主成分数作为内在维度，发现「中层高、两端低」的稳定剖面，并用该信号在等参数预算下指导宽度剪枝，优于均匀宽度分配。

**相关性简评：** 这种逐层内在维度的 PCA 度量可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态的表示容量与几何分布，中层高维剖面也可能与预测工作区类假设相关；但论文是纯文本 LLM 分析与结构剪枝，与视觉证据或多模态推理状态尚无直接联系，其度量能否迁移到跨模态激活仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Measuring Layer-wise Intrinsic Dimensionality of FFNs in LLMs via PCA

**abstract/A1：** Modern large language models (LLMs) keep the feed-forward network (FFN) intermediate width identical across every layer, a convention inherited from the original Transformer. Yet mechanistic work suggests layers at different depths do qualitatively different work, raising a natural question: are their capacity demands also non-uniform, and if so, can a fixed parameter budget be allocated more wisely than uniformly? To probe this, we apply principal component analysis (PCA) to the input of each FFN down-projection and measure, for every layer, its intrinsic dimensionality as the smallest number of principal components needed to reconstruct the activation up to a fixed cosine similarity. Scanning 58 open-weight LLMs spanning 14 families and 70M to 72B parameters, we find a recurring middle-heavy profile in which middle layers carry higher intrinsic dimensionality than edge layers; the profile is robust to the calibration corpus, even across English and Chinese, and is largely preserved through post-training fine-tuning. As a direct test that this signal is structurally meaningful, we use it to guide width pruning in a knowledge-distilled student under a matched parameter budget: the PCA-guided allocation outperforms the uniform-width convention by +2.3 points on Qwen3-8B and +2.5 on Qwen2.5-3B, while lower-dispersion teachers show smaller gaps (+0.9 on Gemma-3-4B, +0.5 on LLaMA-3-8B), and a budget-matched inverted control does worst on all four teachers. Across these four teachers, the size of the gap tracks how unevenly the teacher's intrinsic dimensionality is distributed across layers (a single-number summary we call $σ\_{99}$), and the advantage persists through downstream supervised fine-tuning. Code is available at https://github.com/naver-ai/lidf.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 20 pages, 7 figures, 11 tables

</details>

### 224. [Back to Raw Motion: Latent-Free Diffusion Transformers for Text-to-Motion and Exact Conditional Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32793v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32793

**作者：** Yun Chen、Jeonghyeok Do、Munchurl Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32793v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32793v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究 text-to-motion 生成，提出在原始运动空间而非学习到的 codec 隐空间中进行扩散，用 Motion Diffusion Transformer 建模局部骨架与整体动力学，并设计高噪声阶段的文本对齐损失 HiNCE，使单一条件模型可完成多种运动条件任务并精确保留给定条件。

**相关性简评：** 其「绕过 codec 隐空间以避免细节损失」与「不经中间解码、在高噪声阶段直接做条件对齐监督」的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 工作区是否保留任务必要视觉细节、以及直接对隐状态施加条件监督提供可核查线索，但任务与多模态推理相距较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Back to Raw Motion: Latent-Free Diffusion Transformers for Text-to-Motion and Exact Conditional Generation

**abstract/A1：** As generative models tackle larger and more complex datasets, learned codecs enable efficient generation through compact latent representations, but may lose details and cannot guarantee exact preservation of given conditions. Generating directly in the original data space avoids errors introduced by the codec. Recent advances in image generation demonstrate that pixel diffusion can produce high-quality samples at practical computational costs. Inspired by these advances, we conduct a preliminary study of pixel diffusion, demonstrating its potential for adaptation to motion generation. Building on these findings, we present RawMo, a framework that brings text-to-motion generation to raw motion space. Our Motion Diffusion Transformer (MiT) models local skeletal structures and whole-body dynamics, while refining motion across frames to improve temporal consistency. Working directly in raw motion space further allows our high-noise text-motion alignment loss (HiNCE) to improve text consistency without intermediate motion decoding. RawMo supports multiple motion-conditioning tasks with a single conditional model while preserving given motion conditions exactly. Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML show the best text alignment among compared methods and competitive motion quality, with ablations confirming the benefits of MiT and HiNCE.

**comment/C1：** The first two authors contributed equally to this work (equal contribution). Please visit our project page at https://kaist-viclab.github.io/RawMo\_site

</details>

### 225. [Scaling Laws of Ensemble Uncertainty in Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32801v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32801

**作者：** Siamak Ravanbakhsh、David Nitchi、Khang Ngo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.NE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32801v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32801v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文讨论 LLM 的认知不确定性估计，指出受限于固定模型族的贝叶斯方法无法刻画容量误差，并给出三条幂律：损失随模型规模下降、集成内部分歧随规模下降（衰减更慢），以及成员共享训练比例增大导致集成多样性损失的规律。

**相关性简评：** 其「集成分歧作为不确定性信号」及共享训练导致多样性衰减的定量刻画，可供核查于 LVR 中多 latent 假设的多样性度量、基于不确定性的 STOP 决策与验证成本预测；但实验为纯文本规模律，向多模态视觉证据筛选的迁移尚待验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Scaling Laws of Ensemble Uncertainty in Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Many use cases for large language models (LLMs)---from AI safety to exploration and human interaction---can benefit from epistemic uncertainty estimates. We argue that existing Bayesian Deep Learning solutions, which are often restricted to a fixed model family, fail to capture the full epistemic uncertainty at practical LLM scales. This is because the error due to the bounded capacity of the model family remains invisible to disagreement among models supported by the prior. We relate this error to the well-known power-law scaling of LLM loss with model size. We then show that a second power law quantifies the shrinking disagreement within ensembles as model size increases. Its slower decay relative to the capacity law above suggests that ensembles capture a growing share of epistemic uncertainty and become more competitive as an axis for scaling, compared to a single larger model. Finally, a third power law quantifies the loss of ensemble diversity as members share a larger fraction of training before branching, and therefore identifies a further limitation, beyond the capacity error, for LoRA ensembles and optimization-based or second-order methods that approximate uncertainty around a single training solution. At a high level, these findings suggest diverse ensembles can be a promising axis, both for scaling and uncertainty quantification at larger scales.

</details>

### 226. [EPRO: Robust Policy Optimization Through an Imperfect Execution-Policy Predictor](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32810v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32810

**作者：** Yibo Wang、Changyi Yang、Yuanxin Liu、Zhaoran Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32810v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32810v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对 LLM 强化学习中 rollout 生成与训练所用策略不一致的问题，把训练时无法直接观测的「执行策略」视为需通过不完美预测器优化的对象，提出 EPRO：用训练策略变化构造可微预测器并给出 Transported Score Centering，同时以 Policy Shift 作为预测风险代理，用软裁剪衰减高风险更新，在多个 Qwen3 设置与数学推理基准上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「无法直接观测的状态只能由不完美预测器近似、并需按预测风险限制更新幅度」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态估计的可信度加权与训练信号贡献分配提供可核查的借鉴线索，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EPRO: Robust Policy Optimization Through an Imperfect Execution-Policy Predictor

**abstract/A1：** RL for LLMs often separates rollout generation from policy training. Although the two numerical engines share model parameters, they can induce different policies. This creates a challenge beyond correcting a known training-inference mismatch: during learner updates, the execution policy corresponding to the current parameters cannot be directly observed. We view this as optimizing an unobserved execution policy through an imperfect predictor of its evolution. This perspective raises two fundamental questions: how can we estimate the execution policy's response to learner updates, and how much should we trust that estimate when optimizing the actual execution policy? We introduce Execution-Policy Robust Optimization (EPRO) to address these challenges. Starting from the observed rollout-time execution policy, we use training-policy changes to construct a differentiable predictor of the current execution policy, whose score yields Transported Score Centering (TSC). Our robust-improvement analysis reveals how prediction error limits the magnitude of reliably justified updates. For practical implementation, we introduce Policy Shift as an observable proxy for prediction risk and use Shift-Aware Soft Clipping (SSC) to attenuate risky updates. Across four Qwen3 model settings, EPRO achieves the highest average held-out accuracy among the compared methods on seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks.

</details>

### 227. [Beyond Image-Text Pairs: Aligning Semantic Changes for Fine-Grained Visual Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32817v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32817

**作者：** Yujie Sun、Zeqing Wang、Shuang Liang、Zhenlin Zhao、Kunyu Zhang、Xiaowu Sun

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32817v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32817v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出一种后训练方法，用受控的图像与文本变体构造跨模态语义变化对应关系，通过 Semantic Difference Alignment 损失对齐两侧表示变化的方向，并结合 pairwise sigmoid matching 联合训练，同时构建 VarFamily-40K 数据集。

**相关性简评：** 以「表示变化方向」而非静态配对作为监督信号，可能为核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否随视觉证据发生一致的语义位移提供训练或诊断思路，但其本身不涉及推理期状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Image-Text Pairs: Aligning Semantic Changes for Fine-Grained Visual Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Image-text alignment serves as a foundation for modern vision-language models (VLMs), yet prevailing training paradigms provide limited supervision for learning how semantic changes correspond across modalities. To address this limitation, we propose a post-training method that learns cross-modal semantic change correspondences through controlled visual and textual variations. Specifically, we introduce a Semantic Difference Alignment (SDA) loss which can align the directions of corresponding visual and textual representation changes. We combine our proposed SDA with pairwise sigmoid matching to jointly learn image-text correspondences and cross-modal semantic changes, encouraging more fine-grained and discriminative visual representations. To support this learning, we construct VarFamily-40K, a dataset of image-text pairs with controlled cross-modal semantic variations. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in compositional understanding and downstream classification performance, alongside further gains on multimodal tasks when the adapted visual encoder is integrated into VLMs.

</details>

### 228. [PhysMend: Verification-Guided Program Refinement for Physics-Aware Video Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32821v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32821

**作者：** Meilong Xu、Ziyi Zhao、Bhagyashree Puranik、Shayda Moezzi、Yixiao Zhang、Kushan Thakkar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32821v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32821v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出免训练的 PhysMend，把目标物理事件表示为可编辑的物理程序，在仿真 rollout 和作为生成条件的 depth control 上做混合验证（事件语义、物理合理性、求解器稳定性、可见性），定位失败字段并有界地调整参数，验证通过后才送入视频生成器。

**相关性简评：** 其「验证—定位失败字段—有界修正—通过才继续」的循环与证据筛选、贡献分配和停止决策有形式相通之处，且把 VLM 判断限制在语义层面、不许覆盖物理测量的设计，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态核验与 VLM 证据可靠性加权提供可核查线索；但研究对象是物理视频生成而非 VLM 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PhysMend: Verification-Guided Program Refinement for Physics-Aware Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Video generative models synthesize realistic scenes, yet their interactions often violate physics. A ball dropped onto sand should displace grains and settle into a crater, whereas a generated video may show it passing through the surface or leaving the sand flat. Post-hoc methods typically score generated videos with a vision-language model (VLM), but such scores offer limited guidance on which object or parameter to modify, and each correction costs another synthesis. Simulation-based pipelines instead run fixed stages before synthesis, so simulation errors reach the video. To address these limitations, we present PhysMend, a training-free framework for verification-guided program refinement. PhysMend describes the target event as an editable physical program of grounded objects, events, and required relations, paired with tunable execution parameters. Our key insight is to verify and repair the event on its simulated rollout and on the depth video that conditions the generator (depth control) rather than on generated videos, enabling quantitative violation measurement, targeted editing, and fast re-verification before synthesis. A hybrid verifier evaluates semantic event consistency, physical plausibility, solver stability, and visibility in the depth control. VLM judgments are confined to event semantics and cannot override failed physical measurements, which limits the impact of VLM hallucinations. Each failed check localizes the program fields eligible for repair, and its measured violation scales a bounded update of their parameters. Only accepted depth control reaches the generator, which runs once per input. Experiments on the commonly used benchmarks Physics-IQ, PhyGenBench, and VBench-2.0 demonstrate substantial gains across different generator backbones; for example, PhysMend raises the overall Physics-IQ score of Wan-VACE from 27.33 to 39.40.

**comment/C1：** 22 pages, 7 figures, 11 tables, including supplementary material

</details>

### 229. [Reliable and grounded reporting of any computed tomography scan with FORA](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32823v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32823

**作者：** Sezgin Er、Utku Turkbey、Alperen Gur、Omer Faruk Durugol、Suprosanna Shit、Murong Xu、Julia Wolleb、Jiayi Wang、Xiaoliang Wang、Hadrien Reynaud、Teodora Spasojevic、Dong Yang、Andriy Myronenko、Pengfei Guo、Yufan He、Can Zhao、Marc Edgar、Andreas Maier、Michael Moor、Mehmet Kemal Ozdemir、Daguang Xu、Bernhard Kainz、Bjoern Menze、Ibrahim Ethem Hamamci

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32823v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32823v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出通用 CT 模型 FORA，利用 30 万余例报告监督数据，以多示例学习和可解释概念瓶颈识别并空间定位 1,028 个放射概念，同时生成覆盖多种协议的报告。

**相关性简评：** 其概念瓶颈显式连接空间证据、发现与报告生成，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选及输出是否真正使用 latent 内容提供方法线索，但该工作本身不涉及 latent 推理或动态计算，需核查其定位证据的因果作用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reliable and grounded reporting of any computed tomography scan with FORA

**abstract/A1：** Artificial intelligence systems for computed tomography (CT) remain largely restricted to specific anatomical regions, examination types or predefined abnormalities, limiting their ability to provide comprehensive and spatially grounded interpretations. Here we present FORA, a general-purpose CT model that recognizes and spatially localizes 1,028 hierarchically organized radiological concepts and generates reports across the 28 CT protocols represented in our cohort. Trained on 304,962 routine CT examinations supervised by their accompanying reports, FORA learns to localize abnormalities without manually annotated lesions. Its architecture combines multiple-instance learning with an interpretable concept bottleneck that connects spatial evidence, radiological findings and report generation. We first developed and benchmarked the architecture on chest radiographs, achieving state-of-the-art performance, before training a separate model on three-dimensional CT examinations. On 36,619 held-out CT examinations, FORA achieved a macro area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.918 for radiological concept recognition, exceeding the strongest of 18 existing CT models by 0.21. FORA also ranked first on three public benchmarks, outperforming Merlin on its own test set without training on that institution's data (AUROC 0.907 versus 0.826). On independent localization benchmarks for pulmonary emboli, renal masses and rib fractures, FORA's strongest spatial evidence fell within annotated lesions at rates up to 348 times greater than chance. FORA achieved more than threefold higher macro-averaged finding recall than the strongest existing report generator. These results show that a single model can combine broad abnormality recognition, spatial localization and report generation across 12 CT examination types, using routine reports without lesion-level supervision.

**comment/C1：** 58 pages, 5 figures, 7 Extended Data figures, 17 Supplementary figures. Code and models: https://github.com/forithmus/FORA

### 230. [SAVERA: Bridging Frozen Vision and Language Models via Sparse Alignment and Visual Evidence Reuse](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32828v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32828

**作者：** Jiajun Shen、Chuancheng Shi、Jiayi Lyu、Yanpeng Sun、Fei Shen、Tat-Seng Chua

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32828v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32828v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 SAVERA，在冻结的视觉与语言模型之间用稀疏共享空间做双向对齐，并用 prompt 引导的门控注意力残差把原始视觉特征与适配后特征融合，在图像描述与 VQA 上取得有竞争力结果并降低物体幻觉。

**相关性简评：** 其「保留语言适配前后视觉信息」的残差复用与稀疏对齐，可供核查 LVR 中视觉旁路、证据保留与适配后视觉细节坍缩的问题，但未涉及 latent 推理状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SAVERA: Bridging Frozen Vision and Language Models via Sparse Alignment and Visual Evidence Reuse

**abstract/A1：** Independently pretrained vision and language models may learn shared structures of the same underlying world, providing a foundation for combining them to build multimodal capabilities. However, a key challenge remains in aligning cross-modal feature representations while preserving access to visual information before and after language adaptation. To this end, we propose sparse alignment with visual evidence-guided residual adaptation (SAVERA), a framework that combines frozen vision and language models through bidirectional alignment in a shared sparse space and prompt-guided residual fusion. Specifically, we first present shared-space projection, activation reconstruction and encoding (SPARE), which represents original visual, adapted visual, and textual features through shared soft-gated sparse encoding, with branch-specific reconstruction to preserve their respective information. Second, we devise bridge--text embedding and activation matching (BEAM), a bidirectional cross-modal alignment module that aligns adapted visual and textual features at both the sample and neuron levels, establishing fine-grained cross-modal correspondence. Finally, we introduce prompt-conditioned residual integration of vision and adapted features (PRIVA), a prompt-guided residual fusion module that models vision--language interactions through gating and attention and integrates complementary information from original and adapted representations through residual fusion. Extensive experiments show that SAVERA achieves competitive performance on image captioning and visual question answering while reducing object hallucination.

</details>

### 231. [MemHand: Memory-Enhanced World-Space Hand Motion Reconstruction from Egocentric Videos](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32876v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32876

**作者：** Junyi Ma、Zhangshuo Qi、Erhang Zhang、Mingjie Li、Hesheng Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32876v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32876v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MemHand，从第一人称视频重建双手连续的世界坐标运动：用短期事件记忆保存遮挡或手离开视野前后的上下文，并以长期尺度记忆在有界状态内保存最可靠的观测作为尺度锚点。

**相关性简评：** 其「有界记忆状态＋可靠观测筛选＋证据缺失时补全上下文」的设计，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据保留、筛选与工作区状态更新提供方法线索，可供核查写入与更新规则能否迁移到 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MemHand: Memory-Enhanced World-Space Hand Motion Reconstruction from Egocentric Videos

**abstract/A1：** Recovering the continuous world-space motion of both hands from egocentric video is essential for applications such as human-to-robot policy transfer and augmented reality. Achieving this goes beyond reconstructing the hands from each individual frame, as the context that a frame needs is often spread over time, especially around occlusions or when a hand moves out of sight. Recent works have explored how to exploit temporal context, yet they mostly draw it from fixed-length windows. Such windows cannot guarantee that every frame has the context required to reconstruct the hands in world space with accurate poses and metric scale. To address this limitation, we introduce MemHand, a memory-enhanced framework for world-space hand motion reconstruction. MemHand maintains two complementary forms of memory. The Short-Term Event Memory keeps the context of the well-observed hand around each occlusion or out-of-sight event and supplies it to frames with weak or missing visual evidence. In addition, since the metric scale holds over the whole recording, the Long-Term Scale Memory retains the most reliable observations across the video as scale anchors within a bounded state. Across benchmarks featuring severe occlusions and frequent out-of-sight intervals, MemHand achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and generalizes well to unseen domains. Benefiting from the synergy of both memories, it cuts W-MPJPE by 57\\% on ARCTIC and 70\\% on HOT3D relative to StableHand, delivering continuous and metrically accurate world-space hand poses and trajectories. We will release our code and models at the project page: https://irmvlab.github.io/memhand.github.io

</details>

### 232. [Label leakage through file headers: geometry and batch confounds in public mammography datasets, and a pre-training acceptance gate](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32899v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32899

**作者：** Achraf Toufah、Rana Saad、Moulay Youssef El Hafidi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG、eess.IV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32899v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32899v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文对六个公共乳腺摄影数据集施加只可见图像几何、全局纹理、子集标识或单一协变量的预训练对照，以 AUC 0.60 为停止阈值，发现多处非诊断信息即可预测诊断标签（如 KAU-BCMD 几何单独达 1.0000），并据此提出预训练准入闸门。

**相关性简评：** 其「用非诊断通道探针检验标签泄漏」的审计协议可能可供核查 VLM 推理中视觉证据是否被几何、子集等旁路捷径替代，属可借鉴线索；但该文本身不涉及 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Label leakage through file headers: geometry and batch confounds in public mammography datasets, and a pre-training acceptance gate

**abstract/A1：** A dataset whose diagnostic label can be recovered from non-diagnostic information yields high, reproducible and uninformative model performance. We applied pre-training controls that see only image geometry, global texture, a sub-collection identifier or one covariate to six public mammography datasets, against a stop threshold of AUC 0.60. In KAU-BCMD, geometry alone predicted the BI-RADS class at AUC 1.0000 in a local copy and at a mean of 0.979 in a public Kaggle archive; after resizing, texture alone gave 0.847. In CMMD, the sub-collection prefix predicted malignancy at 0.7753; the restricted sub-collection passed geometry (0.5000) and texture (0.5810) but failed an identifier-order control added post hoc (test AUC 0.9926). CBIS-DDSM exceeded the stop on geometry (pooled mean 0.654 over 20 splits), a verdict statistic chosen post hoc; its official mass and calcification splits did not. M-SYNTH, INbreast and a partial VinDr-Mammo copy passed the few controls run. We release the code and derived tables. There is no quantum component in the inference path.

**comment/C1：** 27 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Under review at DMLR. Code and derived tables: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24372683

</details>

### 233. [Motion Conditioned World Modeling for Embodied Visual Tracking](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32900v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32900

**作者：** Jiahao Zhang、Xuan Yao、Junyu Gao、Changsheng Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32900v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32900v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出运动条件化的世界模型：将对目标运动分布的预测与机器人自运动注入 latent 状态转移，用几何—进度模块联合建模路径与单步位移，并以未来视觉特征重建、运动似然和专家动作联合训练跟踪策略。

**相关性简评：** 其不确定性条件化的 latent 转移与「以未来视觉特征重建监督运动预测」的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中预测状态更新、视觉证据保留与训练信号分配，但任务为具身跟踪策略，与多模态推理的联系较间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Motion Conditioned World Modeling for Embodied Visual Tracking

**abstract/A1：** World models support embodied decision-making by predicting future environment states. In embodied visual tracking, uncertain target motion and robot-induced viewpoint changes jointly affect visual observations, making future-state prediction challenging. We propose Motion-Conditioned World Modeling, which incorporates predicted target-motion distributions and robot ego-motion into latent state transitions. A Geometry--Progress module jointly models geometric paths and single-step travel distances through shared motion modes and path-conditioned progress distributions. This formulation captures uncertainty in route selection and motion progress while preserving their dependence. Action-induced coordinate transformations express predicted paths in the next robot frame, providing geometrically grounded conditions for future visual-state prediction. Future visual feature reconstruction supervises the motion predictor through the conditioned transition branch, linking explicit motion representations to subsequent observations. The model is jointly optimized with motion likelihood, feature reconstruction, and expert-action supervision, enabling the tracking policy to combine visual context with predictive motion cues.Experiments on three embodied tracking benchmarks demonstrate improved tracking performance and cross-environment generalization with a lightweight $0.5$B backbone.

</details>

### 234. [InstructReplay: Replaying Assistant Turns to Preserve General Behavior During Factual Fine-Tuning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32918v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32918

**作者：** Xiaofeng Shi、Qian Kou、Hua Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32918v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32918v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文发现用新事实微调指令模型会显著损害通用能力，且这种退化与回答长度骤减同步出现；提出 InstructReplay，先在通用指令上采集初始模型自身的回答，再在微调时约束模型靠近这些回答，从而兼顾新事实学习与能力保持。

**相关性简评：** 其「回放自身回答＋对初始模型做正则」的思路可能为 LVR 微调中保留推理轨迹形态、抑制推理长度与行为坍缩提供可核查的借鉴；但论文为纯文本事实微调，未涉及视觉或多模态 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** InstructReplay: Replaying Assistant Turns to Preserve General Behavior During Factual Fine-Tuning

**abstract/A1：** Fine-tuning an instruction-tuned language model on new facts often erodes its general abilities. We find that standard fine-tuning lowers instruction-following, reasoning and coding benchmarks by 35 points on average, and that these losses track a collapse in answer length: fine-tuned models at least halve their responses, and the further a response drifts from the initial model's length, the more often it fails. We propose InstructReplay: the initial model answers a set of general instructions once, and during fine-tuning the model is kept close to the initial model on these answers. Across three model families and two domains, InstructReplay reduces the average decline on five general benchmarks from 28.1 to 2.4 points and keeps answer length close to the initial model's, while learning the new facts as well as standard fine-tuning. It balances learning and retention better than seven adaptation methods in all six settings. Controlled comparisons attribute the gain to replaying the model's own answers to general instructions rather than to the form of the loss.

**comment/C1：** Project page at https://xiaofengshi.github.io/InstructReplay/ and code at https://github.com/xiaofengShi/InstructReplay

</details>

### 235. [ProX-MAD: Aggregating Spatial Context into Representative Proxies for Few-shot Medical Anomaly Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32941v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32941

**作者：** Seunghyun Oh、Seongsu Lee、Seunghye Chae、Youngmin Ro

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32941v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32941v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ProX-MAD，用可学习的、按状态区分的 proxy token 通过跨注意力从参考图像块特征中聚合空间上下文，并以 proxy 级掩码保留高置信对应，实现统一的少样本医学异常检测。

**相关性简评：** 其「少量可学习 proxy 压缩空间证据 + 掩码抑制 proxy 坍缩」的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 槽位如何筛选视觉证据、避免表示同质化提供可供核查的线索；但该文本身面向检测而非推理状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ProX-MAD: Aggregating Spatial Context into Representative Proxies for Few-shot Medical Anomaly Detection

**abstract/A1：** Few-shot medical anomaly detection (MAD) has largely followed a dataset-specific "one-for-one" paradigm, leaving unified "one-for-many" modeling underexplored. Naively extending existing methods to this setting causes substantial performance degradation, especially at the pixel level. We attribute this to their detection mechanisms: a shared decision boundary becomes unreliable across heterogeneous lesion definitions, whereas a normal-only memory bank cannot adequately cover diverse normal distributions with few references. We propose ProX-MAD, a proxy-based framework that aggregates spatial context into compact, learnable, state-specific proxies for unified few-shot MAD. Its Masked Proxy Infusion Attention (MPIA) module cross-attends proxy tokens to reference patch features and applies proxy-wise masking to retain high-confidence correspondences, mitigating proxy collapse and encouraging diverse proxies that summarize both normal and abnormal references. Across six medical datasets, ProX-MAD exhibits only a marginal performance drop from one-for-one to one-for-many training. Despite being trained only once as a unified model, it also outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods on average even when they use their more favorable one-for-one protocol, demonstrating the practicality of unified multi-dataset MAD.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to ACCV 2026

</details>

### 236. [Beyond Expected Value: PPO with Distributional Critics for Systematic Conservation Planning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32948v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32948

**作者：** Ana Maria Quintero Ossa、Daniele Silvestro、James Rudd-Jones、Maria Perez-Ortiz

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32948v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32948v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 将系统性保护规划建模为序贯强化学习，用 Plackett-Luce 处理不可微动作空间并接入 PPO，以 IQN 分布 critic 替代标量 critic，兼顾风险敏感目标与训练效率。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但其分布 critic 的回报分布建模和逐步 credit assignment 线索，可能可供核查 LVR 中轨迹贡献分配与风险/成本敏感停止决策。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Expected Value: PPO with Distributional Critics for Systematic Conservation Planning

**abstract/A1：** Systematic conservation planning must allocate limited protection budgets sequentially under ecological and climatic uncertainty. Static tools cannot adapt as conditions change, and policies optimised only for expected outcomes can fail on the worst-case trajectories climate change makes increasingly likely. CAPTAIN was the first framework to cast this as sequential reinforcement learning, but its gradient-free Evolution Strategies (ES) optimiser lacks per-timestep credit assignment. We replace ES with Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) via a Plackett-Luce solution to CAPTAIN's non-differentiable action space, and replace its scalar critic with an Implicit Quantile Network (IQN) modelling the full return distribution. A matched-granularity comparison shows decision granularity, not the optimiser, drives most of the ecological gain, so the real contribution is training efficiency and extensibility to risk-sensitive objectives. On a New Zealand marine dataset, it matches or exceeds ES's outcomes at a fraction of the training cost, offering a template for future work ES's black-box design could not support

</details>

### 237. [VidForce: Predicting Force-Aware Articulation by Observing Humans](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32967v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32967

**作者：** Rafay Mohiuddin、Jiaqi Chen、Marc Pollefeys、Hermann Blum

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32967v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32967v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** VidForce 从第三人称 RGB 视频估计人与物体的交互轨迹与力剖面：以少量仪器化抓取测量训练共享力水平的「物理原型」作为先验，由视觉与语义线索决定其权重，再用联合条件流同时精化轨迹与力剖面，并在 Spot 机器人上验证可驱动关节物体操作。

**相关性简评：** 用原型先验按视觉／语义线索加权调制观测、并以条件流联合精化状态与不可见物理量的做法，可能可供核查 latent 状态估计与物理证据融合的线索；但论文面向机器人操作，未涉及 VLM 推理或 latent 生成，借鉴需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VidForce: Predicting Force-Aware Articulation by Observing Humans

**abstract/A1：** People can anticipate how an object moves and the effort an interaction may require by watching others. How can embodied agents acquire this understanding from video? Force measurements provide direct sensory supervision, but require specialized equipment and remain limited in quantity. We introduce VidForce, which estimates an interaction trajectory together with a force profile from a third-person RGB video; 2D contact clicks and textual object-action prompts are optional. Our approach makes limited instrumented measurements useful for interpreting human interactions through learned physical prototypes as a prior. The prototypes share learned force levels and temporal profiles across interactions of comparable effort, with visual and semantic cues determining their contribution to each observation. Geometric and vision-language features adapt this prior to the observed interaction, while a joint conditional flow refines an initial tracked trajectory together with the force profile. Paired human and instrumented-gripper recordings provide measured force references for supervising human video, and a separately trained torque model demonstrates that the formulation extends to other sensory quantities. We evaluate trajectory recovery and force estimation through baseline comparisons and controlled ablations on held-out interactions from the Hoi! dataset. On this evaluation subset, VidForce achieves 6.6 cm ATE, peak-force MAE and RMSE of 4.81 N and 5.92 N, respectively, and force-profile RMSE of 5.52 N. On real-world videos, VidForce infers motion and force reliably and consistently despite the variability in human execution. We further deploy VidForce on a Spot robot, where trajectories and force profiles estimated from human demonstrations drive real-world articulated-object manipulation, and report success rates across repeated trials. Project page: https://rafaymhddn.github.io/vidforce

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://rafaymhddn.github.io/vidforce

</details>

### 238. [FocusAnchor: Zero-Shot Metric Depth by Anchoring a Depth Foundation Prior to Focus Cues](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32970v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32970

**作者：** Ashkan Ganj、Hang Su、Tian Guo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32970v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32970v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** FocusAnchor 提出一个循环深度模型，用 focus-volume 查询反复把冻结深度基础模型的相对深度先验对齐到当前估计，形成反馈细化回路，并借助随机相机参数的栈合成、逐切片独立噪声和可变切片数训练提升 zero-shot 跨相机表现。

**相关性简评：** 其「冻结先验—当前估计」的循环对齐回路与可变输入切片数训练，可能为 LVR 中迭代式 latent 状态更新、以及焦点线索薄弱时的视觉证据筛选与先验引导提供方法线索，可供核查状态在迭代中的演化方式。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FocusAnchor: Zero-Shot Metric Depth by Anchoring a Depth Foundation Prior to Focus Cues

**abstract/A1：** Existing depth-from-focus methods can struggle with weak focus cues, new cameras, or fewer focal slices. We present FocusAnchor, a recurrent model that uses focus-volume lookups to refine metric depth and repeatedly aligns a relative depth prior from a frozen foundation model to the current depth estimate. The aligned prior guides subsequent refinement in a feedback loop, carrying metric scale recovered from textured regions into regions where focus cues are weak while preserving scene structure. To support transfer across cameras, we synthesize training stacks with randomized camera parameters and focus distances. However, stack synthesis blurs existing image noise differently across slices, creating artificial depth cues even on textureless surfaces. We add independent per-slice noise to suppress these cues. We also introduce variable-stack training to improve robustness with fewer focal slices and support more practical mobile capture. Compared with FOSSA ViT-B, FocusAnchor reduces AbsRel by 36% on NYU Depth V2 and by 9% on DDFF-12 after fine-tuning. In zero-shot evaluation, FocusAnchor and its variable-stack variant, FocusAnchor-flex, achieve the two lowest AbsRel values on all five benchmarks. On ZEDD test, FocusAnchor achieves 9% lower AbsRel than the best competing method, FOSSA ViT-B, while FocusAnchor-flex achieves lower AbsRel with 40% fewer focal slices on ZEDD validation.

</details>

### 239. [Teaching Time Without Losing General Retrieval: Adapting Multimodal Embeddings for Time-Sensitive Video Retrieval](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32971v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32971

**作者：** Toya Oyama、Rainer Lienhart、Shin'ichi Satoh

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32971v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32971v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究时间敏感文本-视频检索中微调导致通用检索能力下降的问题，提出保持输出嵌入不偏离基座的 keep loss、沿文本方向拉大视频及其反向副本间距的 pair loss，以及只在帧融合所在的中层训练 LoRA 三个组件。

**相关性简评：** 其用「输出嵌入漂移」而非权重变化衡量能力保留，并定位中层为时间信息峰值所在，可能为 LVR 训练中保留视觉细节、避免表示坍缩及选择 latent 更新层提供可核查线索，但需先判断是否能迁移到推理期状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Teaching Time Without Losing General Retrieval: Adapting Multimodal Embeddings for Time-Sensitive Video Retrieval

**abstract/A1：** In text-to-video retrieval, MLLM-based embedding models do well when the text describes the scene (general retrieval), but poorly when it describes actions and their direction (time-sensitive retrieval). TARA, a pioneering work, fine-tunes such a model on text triplets with temporal hard negatives; it improves time-sensitive retrieval but lowers general retrieval (mean R@1 over six benchmarks in our rerun on Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B: 58.4-&gt;44.8), and its released model keeps general retrieval only when ensembled with Qwen3-VL-Embedding. Our goal is strong general and time-sensitive retrieval with one model and one vector per clip. Three findings lead to three simple components. Keep loss: general retrieval follows how far the output embeddings drift from the base model, not how far the weights move; we therefore keep them near the base model, which keeps most general retrieval even without general-domain data. Pair loss: the text embeddings of an action description and its reversed-direction version are well separated, but the video embeddings of a clip and its reversed copy are close; we therefore widen the gap between the video embeddings of each clip and its reversed copy, in the direction of the difference between their two text embeddings. Middle-layer LoRA: frames are combined in the middle layers, and temporal information peaks in or just after them; we therefore train LoRA only on these layers, which nearly matches training all weights on most time-sensitive benchmarks with 0.15% of the parameters and keeps general retrieval better. General R@1 stays at 58.4, while R@1 with each clip's reversed copy in the gallery rises from 55.5 to 63.2; the gains carry over to unseen benchmarks and InternVL2-8B-RA. The keep loss is also a remedy for the TARA recipe (general R@1: 44.8-&gt;57.8), and ensembling TARA with Ours gives the highest scores on RTime and unseen CiA among the compared models.

**comment/C1：** 24 pages, 11 figures, 14 tables

</details>

### 240. [AVQ-Attention-2: Adaptive Vector-Quantized Attention with Exact Local Blocks and Linear-Cost Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32989v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32989

**作者：** Winfried van den Dool、Patrick Forré、Amir Habibian、Yuki M. Asano、Max Welling

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32989v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32989v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 AVQ-Attention-2：将向量量化注意力与精确局部注意力合并，改为对每个簇内键的均值做注意力，并把训练成本从 O(N²) 降至 O(NM)，且可不经微调直接替换预训练 transformer 的注意力层。

**相关性简评：** 高效注意力近似或可为长视觉 token 序列与 latent 状态的注意力计算、缓存提供低成本替代，其「局部精确块＋按注意力质量分配码本分辨率」的设计可供核查是否影响视觉细节保留与证据筛选；但原文不涉及多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AVQ-Attention-2: Adaptive Vector-Quantized Attention with Exact Local Blocks and Linear-Cost Training

**abstract/A1：** Attention costs $\\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ in the number of tokens. Vector-quantized attention reduces this to $\\mathcal{O}(NM)$ by clustering the $N$ keys, attending to the $M$ codewords instead, and its adaptive form, AVQ-attention, concentrates codebook resolution where a query's attention mass actually falls. We present AVQ-Attention-2, a better design that merges it with exact local attention and attends to the mean of each cluster's keys rather than to a codeword. We show three improvements: consistently better quality at comparable cost; training that now also costs $\\mathcal{O}(NM)$ rather than $\\mathcal{O}(N^2)$; and an approximation accurate enough that the layer can be dropped into a pretrained transformer without fine-tuning. Across a variety of sequence lengths the result is competitive not merely with other approximate attention but with exact dense attention, running faster than FlashAttention at little to no loss in quality.

</details>

### 241. [On Potentiality and Actuality Of Foundation Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32991v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32991

**作者：** Fabian Gröger、Shuo Wen、Maria Brbić

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32991v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32991v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将 LoRA 与全参数微调等适配引起的更新分解为「所有输入共享的常数分量」与「随输入变化的残差」，发现共享分量已能解释大部分适配增益，且用每层一个与输入无关的常数向量（shift adapter）即可复现原适配行为，据此提出基础模型的「潜在性—现实性」原则。

**相关性简评：** 其「输入无关常数偏移 vs 输入相关残差」的分解思路可供核查：latent/推理状态的训练增益究竟是整层漂移还是样例特异计算，可能为 LVR 的贡献分配与监督设计提供分析工具。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** On Potentiality and Actuality Of Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** Foundation models are built through large-scale pretraining, often followed by post-training, and are then adapted to specific tasks and behaviors. But, does the adaptation add truly new capabilities, or the base model already holds it? We decompose the update induced by different adaptations into a component shared across all inputs and a residual that varies with the input. We find that the shared component suffices for most of the adaptation gain and can be learned directly: a shift adapter that learns a constant vector per layer, identical for every input, reproduces the behavior of LoRA and full fine-tuning. We call this the potentiality principle of foundation models: the base model already contains the capacity needed for task-specific expertise. To adapt to a new task, the model just needs to be actualized, i.e., pushed in a certain direction via a constant, input-independent shift. We show the implications of this principle on parameter-efficient adaptation, steering, and convergence across models, and how it explains the neural thickets phenomenon.

</details>

### 242. [PAVE: Preference-Aligned Visual Egocentric Learning for the Blind and Low-Vision Users](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32996v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32996

**作者：** Nan Li、Shaofeng Liang、Shiyun Zhao、Keni Shi、Zhencheng Huang、Bowen Tian、Jiemin Wu、Wenshuo Chen、Kaishen Yuan、Runwei Guan、Yutao Yue

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32996v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32996v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 基于 EgoBlind 真实视频与盲人/low-vision 用户查询构建偏好对齐数据集 PA-EgoQA，并提出 PAVE 框架：结构化答案策略微调、按问题确定性路由，以及结合正确性-质量分层奖励与候选组对比筛选的 Filter-GRPO，在三个 VLM 骨干上提升事实准确率与辅助回答质量。

**相关性简评：** 其对比式候选筛选与分层奖励机制可能为 LVR 中训练信号提取、答案贡献分配提供核查线索，但优化目标是回答的表面形式与偏好而非内部推理状态，需确认是否触及 latent 内容的使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PAVE: Preference-Aligned Visual Egocentric Learning for the Blind and Low-Vision Users

**abstract/A1：** Egocentric video question answering enables blind and low-vision (BLV) users to query their immediate surroundings through natural language. However, existing benchmarks and models primarily optimize for semantic agreement with reference answers, reducing visual assistance to a purely factual matching task. In real-world scenarios, a factually correct response remains practically unhelpful if it lacks the spatial orientation, actionable detail, or conciseness required by the immediate task of the user. Drawing upon real BLV egocentric videos and authentic user queries from EgoBlind, we construct the PA-EgoQA, a preference-aligned dataset that reconstructs reference answers according to empirical BLV communication criteria. Based on this dataset, we introduce Preference-Aligned Visual Egocentric Learning (PAVE), a unified learning and inference framework that couples structured answer-policy fine-tuning with deterministic question-conditioned routing to adapt response formulation directly to the surface form of the query at inference time. We further align the model via Filter-GRPO, which pairs a hierarchical correctness-quality reward with contrast-based candidate-group filtering to extract learning signals from both factual accuracy contrasts and fine-grained quality variations among correct answers. Extensive experiments across three vision-language backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in factual accuracy alongside substantial gains in assistive response quality. These results establish a concrete paradigm for translating human-centered response requirements into egocentric supervision, generation policies, and post-training objectives. Code will be provided at https://github.com/shawnliang420/PAVE.

</details>
