### 243. [LEGOSpec: A Composable and Efficient Framework for Speculative Draft Design and Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33004v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.33004

**作者：** Hanzhen Wang、Jiaming Xu、Guohao Dai

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33004v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.33004v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 LEGOSpec，将投机解码的 draft 模型拆成 Context、Backbone、Proposal、Objective 四个可组合组件并在统一训练框架下做匹配条件的对照实验，据此给出面向负载的配置建议和组合式 draft 模型 DFlux，同时优化训练调度与离线监督准备效率。

**相关性简评：** 论文本身面向 LLM 解码加速而非视觉推理，但其「一次预测多 token 并由主模型校验」的块内依赖建模、Residual Corrector 与按接受长度设计的层级监督，可供核查是否能迁移到 latent 推理状态的逐步提议与更新。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LEGOSpec: A Composable and Efficient Framework for Speculative Draft Design and Training

**abstract/A1：** Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) generation using a lightweight draft. Existing methods evaluate complete recipes under different training configurations, leaving component effects, interactions, and composition benefits unclear. Therefore, we present LEGOSpec, a composable framework for speculative draft design and training. LEGOSpec decomposes draft models into Context, Backbone, Proposal, and Objective components that share a unified training infrastructure. Using LEGOSpec, we systematically vary components and evaluate selected combinations under matched training conditions to isolate their effects and interactions. These experiments reveal three findings: (1) Different workloads favor different backbones, depending on context length and memory budget, with within-block dependency modeling particularly important for long contexts. (2) Proposal design must balance acceptance and latency. (3) The training objective should match token distributions locally and optimize acceptance length across the block. These findings guide workload-aware configurations and DFlux, a balanced general-purpose draft combining a convolution-equipped SWA--GQA hybrid backbone, Residual Corrector, and hierarchical supervision. Across Qwen and Gemma models, DFlux improves acceptance length over the strongest baseline by up to 13.7% on regular benchmarks and 34.7% on long-context workloads. To support efficient training, LEGOSpec integrates metadata-aware scheduling and asynchronous execution, increasing training throughput by up to 79% and accelerating offline supervision preparation by up to $3.11\\times$ over SpecForge.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages. Code and weights are available at the URL in the paper

</details>

### 244. [Train What You Run: Probabilistic Convolutions for Learning Token Compaction in State Space Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33009v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.33009

**作者：** Piotr Kubaty、Mikhail Saladkou、Jacek Tabor、Łukasz Struski

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33009v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.33009v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ProbConv：在独立保留概率假设下，精确计算被保留位置在激活前的期望卷积，使 token 保留决策可微；在图像、视觉-语言和视频骨干上验证强压缩时优势随删减比例增大。

**相关性简评：** 可微保留概率与「删 token 后邻域改变」的建模，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与动态计算预算提供训练线索，但其目标是推理效率而非 latent 推理状态，实际对推理行为的影响仍待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Train What You Run: Probabilistic Convolutions for Learning Token Compaction in State Space Models

**abstract/A1：** Visual token compaction reduces inference cost by passing only selected image patches or video tokens to later layers. In sequence models with local convolutions, each removal changes which tokens are neighbors. Learning which tokens to keep therefore requires a training signal that accounts for the new neighborhoods. We introduce ProbConv, which computes the exact expected convolution before activation at a kept position under independent keep decisions. The operator is differentiable in the keep probabilities. With binary decisions, ProbConv and step gating reproduce the compacted Mamba block. Across image, vision--language and video backbones, ProbConv is strongest under strong compaction: its advantage over matched training controls grows as more tokens are removed. In Cobra, it also outperforms adaptations of published vision--language pruning methods at matched inference budgets. ProbConv also improves over matched zero-mask training in video frame selection and speech frame dropping. Our code is available at: https://github.com/gmum/probconv

</details>

### 245. [MESSI: Multi-Expert Soccer Skill Integration for Physics-Based Character Control](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33011v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.33011

**作者：** Xiaogang Peng、Jiaqi Zou、Lei Zhong、Sirui Xu、Huaizu Jiang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.GR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33011v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.33011v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作面向物理仿真足球角色控制，先把八个技能专家蒸馏为统一的技能条件 Transformer，再在冻结学生策略上训练共享的低秩适配器，仅在技能切换时激活以应对陌生进入状态，并由学习到的退出机制决定何时交还控制权。

**相关性简评：** 其「切换时临时启用适配器、由学习到的退出机制关闭、以构造方式保留原策略」可供核查作为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的模式门控与停止决策类比，可能启发在进入姿态异常时短程修正而不损伤基础推理能力。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MESSI: Multi-Expert Soccer Skill Integration for Physics-Based Character Control

**abstract/A1：** Physics-based soccer characters must perform diverse motor skills and transition smoothly between them, such as dribbling into a shot. However, skills that perform well in isolation may fail when executed sequentially, as preceding behaviors can leave the character and ball in unfamiliar states. We present MESSI (Multi-Expert Soccer Skill Integration), a framework that enables multiple soccer skill transitions through shared adaptation while preserving the original skill policy outside transitions. MESSI first trains eight task-competent experts using motion priors and task rewards, then distills them into a unified, skill-conditioned Transformer. Rather than retraining individual experts for different transitions, we train a shared, context-conditioned low-rank adapter on the frozen student through online reinforcement learning. Activated upon skill switching, the adapter helps the target skill handle unfamiliar entry states, while a learned exit mechanism determines when to return control to the original student. By disabling the adapter during native skill execution, MESSI preserves the original student policy by construction. Experiments across individual skills, skill transitions, and continuous skill chains demonstrate substantial improvements over direct switching, including an increase in dribbling-to-shooting success from 19.8% to 61.8%.

**comment/C1：** Website: https://neu-3dvi.github.io/MESSI/

</details>

### 246. [Can LLM Judges Catch Unsafe Clinical Actions? A Fault-Injection Study](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33012v1>)

**作者：** Neda Ghafouri

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33012v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.33012v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在 MedAgentBench 中注入受控临床错误（416 条故障轨迹、8 类错误、6 个开源 LLM 评判者），用故障轨迹与其正确版本配对比较，检验 LLM 评判者能否真正识别不安全动作，并考察 EHR 证据、轨迹与推理文本等输入条件的影响。

**相关性简评：** 其「配对故障注入＋逐级增加证据」的诊断协议可供核查 LVR 中答案是否真正依赖视觉证据、以及验证器对证据的敏感度，但对象是纯文本 EHR 智能体，迁移可行性仍需判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Can LLM Judges Catch Unsafe Clinical Actions? A Fault-Injection Study

**abstract/A1：** As clinical AI agents begin to interact with electronic health records (EHRs), large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate their actions. But how reliably can these judges recognize clinically dangerous mistakes, especially when an agent appears to have completed its task successfully? We investigate this question using MedAgentBench by introducing controlled clinical errors into verified agent trajectories. The experiments include 416 faulty trajectories, eight error categories, and six open-weight LLM judges. By comparing each faulty trajectory with its correct counterpart, we measure whether judges genuinely recognize errors rather than simply flagging more actions as unsafe. The findings show that access to clinical evidence significantly improves judge reliability. When shown only the final answer, judges cannot distinguish errors that leave it unchanged, while flagging 56% of correct trajectories. With full trajectory information, the ability to distinguish unsafe actions from correct ones reaches a score of 0.75, and providing actual EHR responses improves discrimination by 0.39. Surprisingly, including the agent's reasoning does not improve overall performance and reduces detection of incorrectly reported clinical values by 0.18, which remain the hardest errors to detect. MedGemma performed worse than the general-purpose model and was the only judge to miss potentially dangerous medication overdoses. We also find that the benchmark's original grader accepts all 38 trajectories with an intentionally skipped laboratory check, while combining LLM judges with a rule-based checker informed by the full EHR record detects 97% of injected faults.

</details>

**作者：** Dayeon Kim、Jeonghyeok Do、Munchurl Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33016v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.33016v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RePix-VFI 多帧视频插帧框架：先用光流渲染整体草稿，再由预训练视频扩散模型一步前向精修，并通过「生成回读」把相邻关键帧的 RGB 像素重新渲染后与生成外观融合。

**相关性简评：** 其「扩散生成结果 + 在 VAE 之外回读原始像素」的旁路融合思路，可能为核查生成过程中视觉细节保留与 VAE 信息坍缩提供方法线索，但任务本身并非 VLM 推理，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RePix-VFI: Re-rendering Observed Pixels for Video Frame Interpolation with Generative Priors from One-Step Diffusion

**abstract/A1：** Multi-frame video frame interpolation (VFI) aims to reconstruct dense video from sparse keyframes, requiring accurate intermediate motion and faithful appearance. As temporal gaps grow, flow-based methods can retain observed textures but misplace them under ambiguous motion, whereas iterative latent-diffusion models can synthesize plausible content but incur substantial sampling costs and may alter details during reconstruction with a variational autoencoder (VAE). We present RePix-VFI, named for Re-rendering observed Pixels, a multi-frame VFI framework that couples draft-conditioned one-step video diffusion with reconstruction from observed keyframes. A pretrained video diffusion model refines a flow-rendered draft of the whole window in a single forward pass. For each target frame, our generative readback matches its two bounding keyframes to the generated prediction using an optical-flow estimator. The resulting correspondences guide re-rendering of original keyframe RGB pixels outside the VAE. A lightweight appearance fusion head combines these renderings with generated appearance. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate significant improvements in reconstruction and perceptual quality. On SNU-FILM at $\\times$8 and $\\times$16, RePix-VFI achieves the highest PSNR and the lowest LPIPS, FloLPIPS, and tOF among the compared methods, exceeding the best evaluated diffusion-based baseline by 1.71 and 1.48dB in PSNR, respectively. It also runs 32--42$\\times$ faster than the state-of-the-art multi-frame VFI diffusion model.

**相关性简评：** 「把历史记忆转成稀疏 prompt 并与交互输入共享解码通路」可能为 LVR 中 latent 记忆与视觉证据如何注入推理状态、以及输入退化时证据筛选提供可供核查的接口设计，但其任务是分割传播而非多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** E-MAPS: Event-Based Promptable Video Segmentation with Memory-as-Prompt

**abstract/A1：** RGB-based video object segmentation (VOS) remains brittle under fast motion and adverse illumination. Event cameras preserve signal under blur and challenging exposure, but provide little evidence when motion slows. Interaction can restore object state for subsequent propagation, yet promptable event methods merely address single windows. We formalize event-based Promptable Video Segmentation (ePVS), where prompts at arbitrary windows initialize, correct, or introduce objects and predictions. We present Event Memory-As-Prompt Segmentation (E-MAPS), which transfers a pretrained promptable segmenter to event streams and learns propagation and correction. Event-to-Token (E2T) aligns recurrent event features with pretrained representations while preserving prompt-conditioning priors. Memory-Aware Prompting (MAP) converts object-conditioned history into sparse prompts, allowing memory and user inputs to share one decoder pathway efficiently. We construct Event-View Masklets (EViM) from 206K aligned RGB-event pairs and 620K masks for two-stage representation transfer and native event-video learning, and establish three training-disjoint benchmarks. E-MAPS leads prompt-once and interactive ePVS across all three benchmarks while being more efficient. It further demonstrates strong performance on zero-shot object tracking benchmarks. Project page: https://github.com/adonaydem/emaps-wacv

</details>

**内容简述：** RecordRoute 研究失败 agent 执行轨迹的审计，用词级与字符级特征在单条轨迹内做比较式排序，定位责任角色与最早决定性步骤，再以选中记录的文本和元数据预测错误模式。

**相关性简评：** 其步骤级定位与「先定位、再基于该步做诊断」的耦合思路，可能为 LVR 轨迹中的贡献分配、证据筛选与停止位置判断提供借鉴，但对象是纯文本 agent 日志、不涉及视觉或 latent 状态，迁移性有待核查。

**title/T1：** RecordRoute: Auditing Agent Failures with Localization-Guided Diagnosis

**abstract/A1：** Auditing failed agent executions requires identifying the responsible actor, the earliest decisive step, and the error mode. Representative supervised methods either focus on step localization or predict multiple attribution targets from shared trajectory representations. These methods do not use the localization result to select the text for mode diagnosis. To address this limitation, we propose RecordRoute, which couples comparative localization with local diagnosis. Specifically, it represents each record with word and character features and learns to rank records through comparisons within each trajectory. The selected record supplies the actor and step, while its text and metadata drive mode prediction. On controlled-injection Who&amp;When Pro, RecordRoute outperforms StepFinder and ASCon on all four official metrics. With actor and step predictions fixed, local diagnosis reaches 77.47% pooled joint accuracy versus 69.28% for full-trace diagnosis. On natural failures from TraceElephant and CatchBench POST, it outperforms these baselines and three open LLMs in localization.

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Latent Merger: Latent-Space Composition of Hypernetwork-Generated LoRAs

**abstract/A1：** Recent work proposes hypernetworks that convert a document into a low-rank parameter update (LoRA) in a single forward pass, enabling fast injection of new knowledge into a frozen LLM. However, storing separate LoRA adapters for each document can be unsustainable in streaming settings. In this paper, we study the problem of composing hypernetwork-generated LoRAs using two representative systems, Doc-to-LoRA and SHINE. We show that hypernetwork-generated LoRAs have a geometry sharply different from directly fine-tuned LoRAs. They exhibit greater spectral concentration and stronger cross-document alignment than next-token prediction and QA fine-tuned adapters, which are diffuse and nearly orthogonal across documents. Guided by this observation, we propose latent-space LoRA merging. We compose the intermediate hypernetwork latents and then decode the merged latent through the frozen LoRA-generation head. We show that latent-space merging techniques consistently improve over weight-space and factor-space baselines while preserving a single fixed-rank adapter. These results support latent-space composition as a promising mechanism for combining hypernetwork-generated LoRAs under a fixed output-rank budget.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 251. [SUPRA: Synthesizing Amyloid PET from MRI and Plasma Biomarkers with an Explicit Regional SUVR Prior](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33061v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.33061

**作者：** Hanwen Li、Fadi Deek、Zhi Wei、Ruixiang Tang、Feng Liu、Bharat Biswal、Michal Schnaider Beeri、Auriel Willette、Chenxi Yuan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33061v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.33061v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SUPRA，用血液标志物回归出区域性 SUVR 并涂到 MRI 分割图上作为显式先验，再由 3D 网络做残差修正，从 MRI 与血浆指标生成绝对 SUVR 的合成 amyloid PET，并在 ADNI 与另一队列上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「低维证据先验注入 + 网络残差精修」的分工及消融（血浆供信息、网络供质量）可供核查 LVR 中视觉/任务证据如何写入并修正 latent 状态、以及贡献分配问题，但属医学图像合成，与推理状态生成距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SUPRA: Synthesizing Amyloid PET from MRI and Plasma Biomarkers with an Explicit Regional SUVR Prior

**abstract/A1：** Amyloid positron emission tomography (PET) quantifies brain amyloid-$β$ as a standardized uptake value ratio (SUVR), but is costly and not widely available. Structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is routine, and plasma biomarkers such as phosphorylated tau 217 (p-tau217) are becoming practical. Synthesizing amyloid PET from MRI alone is ill-posed, because brain anatomy reveals little about amyloid burden. We present SUPRA (SUVR prior-guided amyloid synthesis), which divides this task between MRI and plasma biomarkers. A regression maps the plasma panel to regional SUVR levels, painted onto the subject's MRI segmentation as an explicit prior. A 3D network then adds a residual correction guided by MRI. The output is in absolute SUVR, and the model also runs on p-tau217 alone. On the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) cohort (111 test pairs), SUPRA reaches a peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 23.4 dB, against at most 20.7 dB for four published models, and rank correlations of 0.56 to 0.67 with true SUVR in the composite cortex, an early-accumulation region and the striatum, against at most 0.24. In a second, cognitively unimpaired cohort with other plasma platforms (143 test pairs), it reaches 22.8 dB and 0.32 to 0.61, against at most 21.4 dB and 0.20. Its area under the curve for amyloid positivity is 0.91 and 0.82, against at most 0.63. Ablations show that plasma supplies the amyloid information and the network the image quality. Combining MRI with a blood test yields synthetic amyloid PET that is realistic and tracks burden across regions.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables

</details>

### 252. [Understanding Clipping In Zeroth-Order Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33062v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.33062

**作者：** Saket Gollapudi、Elisa Bertino、Sewoong Oh

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33062v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.33062v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 系统考察零阶优化中 per-sample clipping 的作用，发现最优学习率与裁剪阈值满足 ηc 为常数、裁剪会把优化引向测试精度更高的不同解，且该效应只在 per-sample 裁剪的零阶优化中出现，并归因于对难拟合样本的隐式降权。

**相关性简评：** 其「裁剪隐式降低难拟合样本权重、提升鲁棒性」的训练信号塑形线索，可能可供核查 LVR 轨迹训练中对困难步骤或样本的加权与贡献分配；但论文不涉及视觉或多模态推理，也无 latent 状态设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Understanding Clipping In Zeroth-Order Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Zeroth-order optimization has emerged as a resource-efficient alternative to Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) when fine-tuning LLMs, thanks to the inherent low dimensionality of the loss landscape. It relies on a two-point estimate of the gradient that only accesses the function value and not the gradient, bypassing the resource-heavy backpropagation. Recently, it was accidentally discovered that per-sample clipping can improve the performance of the trained model, while running a differentially private version of zeroth-order optimization \\cite{zhang2024dpzero} with a very large privacy parameter $ε$ (corresponding to very little privacy). In this paper, we systematically investigate this phenomenon and demonstrate that ($i$) the optimal choice of learning rate $η$ is inversely proportional to the clipping threshold $c$, satisfying $ηc =$ constant; ($ii$) clipping drives the zeroth-order optimization to a different solution with higher test accuracy; and ($iii$) this phenomenon is only observed with per-sample clipped zeroth-order optimization and not other zeroth-order alternatives that also provide robust estimates of the gradient. Further analyses with artificially injected label noise reveals that clipping leads to more robust predictions, which stems from the implicit down weighting of hard-to-fit training examples. Our code is available at https://github.com/SewoongLab/ClipZero

</details>

### 253. [U-Statistics-Powered LLM Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33064v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.33064

**作者：** Shijin Gong、Kai Ye、Victor Chernozhukov、Xinyu Zhang、Chengchun Shi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33064v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.33064v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文把 GRPO 策略梯度的 U 统计量结构用于组大小这一超参数的选择，将其转化为方差比估计问题，并提出对分母不确定性保守的比值估计器，在合成任务与数学、代码基准上自适应选择组大小以降低策略梯度 MSE。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本 RL 训练优化，与视觉推理主线不直接相关；但其按估计不确定性自适应分配采样预算/组规模的思路，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 类的计算预算与停止决策、以及奖励贡献分配提供可核查的统计线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** U-Statistics-Powered LLM Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Since its introduction by DeepSeek, group relative policy optimization (GRPO) has been widely adopted for training large reasoning models and agents, spurring a proliferation of its variants. Yet the group size, a crucial hyperparameter in these GRPO-type algorithms, remains largely chosen by trial and error. Exploiting the U-statistic structure of GRPO's policy gradient, we recast the selection of the group size as a classical statistical problem of variance ratio estimation. This problem is particularly challenging when the denominator of the ratio is small, rendering naive plug-in estimators unstable. To address this challenge, we propose a pessimistic ratio estimator that accounts for the denominator's estimation uncertainty. We characterise the statistical properties of this estimator across three sample-size regimes. Empirically, using %a jackknife-based pessimistic rule on synthetic tasks from Reasoning Gym and real-world benchmarks covering both mathematical reasoning and code generation, we show that our adaptive group size selection reduces the mean squared error of the resulting policy gradient and improves policy optimisation over fixed-group-size baselines, with modest additional computational cost.

**comment/C1：** 89 pages, 10 figures

</details>

### 254. [Auditing the Judge: Human-Derived Bias Discovery, Quantification, and Mitigation in LLM Judges](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33065v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.33065

**作者：** Hamin Koo、Chanjoo Jung、Fangzhao Wu、Jaehyung Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33065v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.33065v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 HUB-J 框架，利用人与 LLM 判决不一致的样本自动发现可解释的偏差因子，用一致样本经受控输入扰动量化偏差强度，并以免训练回归方式估计各因子影响、在决策时去除其效应来缓解 LLM-as-a-Judge 偏差。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 的「贡献分配与监督」及以 judge 作验证器的评测环节相关；其「受控扰动＋回归估计因子对判决影响并可去除」的做法，可能可供核查用于量化视觉证据或潜在状态对答案的因果贡献，以及诊断 judge 偏差对推理训练信号的污染。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Auditing the Judge: Human-Derived Bias Discovery, Quantification, and Mitigation in LLM Judges

**abstract/A1：** While Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as automated evaluators in evaluation and training pipelines, their judgements are often affected by systematic biases that conflict with human preferences. Although prior work has identified various biases and proposed methods for detecting and mitigating them, less attention has been paid to using human preferences to inform bias identification and mitigation. Moreover, these approaches rely heavily on pre-discovered bias lists, overlook bias strength, and depend on costly interventions. In this work, we propose HUB-J, an integrated framework based on human-derived bias factors that detects, quantifies, and mitigates biases in LLM-as-a-Judge systems. Our approach leverages human-LLM judgement disagreement cases to automatically discover interpretable bias factors, and utilizes agreement cases to quantify bias strength through controlled input modifications and resulting shifts in model decisions. Finally, building on these quantified biases, we introduce a lightweight, training-free regression-based mitigation strategy that estimates the influence of each bias factor on model judgments and corrects bias-influenced decisions by removing its estimated effect. Empirical results show that HUB-J uncovers both known and novel bias factors, reveals meaningful differences in model susceptibility, and consistently reduces bias-driven decision flips while generalizing across models.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 255. [Reinforcement Learning Can Be Recovered From Its Own Rollouts](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33102v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.33102

**作者：** Jiayi Sheng、Jingwen Gu、Guanning Zeng、Zhaoyi Zhou、Stefano Viel、Qianqian Wang、Fahim Tajwar、Andrea Zanette

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33102v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.33102v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文考察在线 RL 后训练所获知识有多少保留在 rollout 中：直接重放原 RL 算法会导致崩塌，而按生成顺序对归档 rollout 做极大似然（且不区分正确与错误回答）即可复现在线 RL 的学习曲线，甚至最终性能。

**相关性简评：** 其「RL 算力主要花在发现更好的采样分布而非从样本学习」的解释，可供核查 LVR 中自生成推理轨迹的监督问题，即 latent 轨迹训练是否可用离线极大似然替代在线 RL；但属纯文本结果，迁移需验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reinforcement Learning Can Be Recovered From Its Own Rollouts

**abstract/A1：** Broadly speaking, reinforcement learning (RL) post-training converts compute into model capabilities by training on model-generated data. Typically, the rollouts are discarded after each update, and the knowledge acquired during RL resides in the model weights. In this work, we investigate how much of this knowledge is retained in the rollouts themselves. A natural first attempt is to replay the original RL algorithm on archived rather than freshly generated rollouts, but this leads to catastrophic collapse. We provide a simple explanation for this phenomenon, which in turn suggests a remedy: maximum likelihood on the archived rollouts. Surprisingly, starting from the same base model and replaying the rollouts in the order in which they were generated, without any distinction between correct and incorrect responses, is sufficient to recover the performance of online RL. In fact, a single maximum likelihood update per rollout batch closely tracks the entire learning curve of online RL. Furthermore, maximum likelihood on the rollouts of the last few RL steps often suffices to recover the final model's performance. This suggests that much of the compute invested in RL goes into discovering an improved sampling distribution rather than learning it from samples.

**comment/C1：** Preprint. 25 pages, 20 figures, 7 tables

</details>

### 256. [Temporal Conditioning for Human Behavioral Cloning in Chess](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33106v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.33106

**作者：** Victor Dziwniel、Tianxiang Lu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.HC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33106v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.33106v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出时间感知 transformer：在 Chessformer 风格架构中加入学习的时间条件 token（编码棋钟状态、时限与近期节奏）以及思考时间、认输两个行为预测头，在大规模在线棋局数据上训练，并与忽略时间的基线及 SOTA 比较；结果显示总体准确率提升有限，但时间压力下增益明显，且能更好复现人类棋力退化。

**相关性简评：** 用条件 token 把剩余时间/预算注入状态表示，并对思考时长与认输建模，可能为 LVR 中「计算预算条件化」和 STOP 决策提供方法线索；但棋类行为克隆与视觉推理差距较大，其可迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Temporal Conditioning for Human Behavioral Cloning in Chess

**abstract/A1：** Behavioral cloning models in chess typically predict human moves from board states while ignoring temporal inputs such as the remaining clock. However, time pressure is a major determinant of human decision-making quality, and temporal state is a missing dimension of human behavioral modeling. This paper introduces a time-aware transformer that extends a Chessformer-style architecture with learned temporal conditioning tokens encoding player clock state, time control, and recent tempo, together with behavioral heads for thinking time and resignation. The model is trained on large-scale online chess data and evaluated against time-agnostic baselines and the state of the art. Results show that temporal conditioning yields modest overall accuracy improvements but substantially stronger gains under time pressure. Beyond move choice, it also produces more accurate thinking-time and resignation predictions. More importantly, the model better matches human move-quality degradation in critical time regimes, reducing the systematic over-strength observed in time-agnostic behavioral cloning models. These results suggest that temporal state is a previously underutilized but important signal for human behavioral cloning in chess.

**comment/C1：** 6 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted manuscript of the paper published at the 2026 IEEE Gaming, Entertainment, and Media Conference (GEM). Code: https://github.com/Prof-it/temporal-chess-model; weights: https://huggingface.co/holymolyyy/temporal-chess-model

### 257. [RenGen: Generating Images with as Many Tokens as the Scene Needs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33109v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.33109

**作者：** Savya Khosla、Jay Mahajan、Akin Tuna Sakalli、Derek Hoiem、David Forsyth、Alex Schwing

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33109v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.33109v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** RenGen 是一个 latent diffusion 图像生成模型，用区域 token 取代固定网格 patch token：每个 token 锚定一个随机采样点，由生成器推断该区域的位置、形状、大小与内容，采样时以锚点数量控制场景复杂度与计算量的取舍。

**相关性简评：** 其内容自适应的 token 数量，以及「单 token 同时编码内容与空间范围」的表示方式，可能为 VLM 中按视觉复杂度或证据需求分配视觉 token 预算、权衡动态计算与细节保留提供方法线索，是否可迁移到推理状态尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RenGen: Generating Images with as Many Tokens as the Scene Needs

**abstract/A1：** We present RenGen, a latent diffusion model that generates simple scenes from a few tokens and busy scenes from many, saving time and compute on simple scenes without losing realism. Most latent generators represent every image as a fixed grid of patch tokens, so a simple image costs as much to generate as a complex one. Prior methods that vary the token count through content-adaptive tokenization lose image quality as the count shrinks. RenGen instead trades scene complexity, rather than image quality, for fewer tokens. It does so by generating in the latent space of a pretrained region encoder, where each token represents one region of the image, and a decoder renders these region tokens back into pixels. Unlike patch tokens, region tokens cover areas of varying shape and position, so each token must capture both what its region contains and where it lies on the image canvas. We encode this spatial extent by adding positional embeddings to the encoder features before pooling, and we generate it by anchoring each token to a single randomly sampled point, from which the generator infers the region's shape, size, and content. At sampling time, the number of anchor points sets the trade-off between scene complexity and compute. On ImageNet $256{\\times}256$, RenGen reaches a gFID of 1.34 with 88 tokens per image on average, the best among methods that vary their token count. It approaches the quality of RAEv2, a state-of-the-art patch-based model, at $2.5{\\times}$ lower latency, advancing the Pareto frontier of generation quality versus compute. RenGen's gFID stays flat across scene complexity while latency varies by $2.4{\\times}$ between simplest and busiest scenes, and its autoencoder reconstructs nearly as well as RAEv2 (rFID 0.32 vs. 0.30) with $2.9{\\times}$ fewer tokens.

</details>

### 258. [Draft Calibration for Speculative Decoding: Accelerating LLM Serving by Matching Draft and Target Distributions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33111v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.33111

**作者：** Yuxing Liu、Wei Zuo、Walid Krichene、Tong Zhang、Li Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33111v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.33111v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究 speculative decoding 中 draft 模型相对 target 模型普遍欠自信的分布失配问题，尝试温度缩放与按 token 校准等事后校准方法，发现简单温度缩放可将接受长度提升约 10% 且几乎不增开销。

**相关性简评：** 其关于「提案—验证」中接受率与 draft/target 分布差异的分析，可能可供核查 LVR 多步 latent 提案的验证成本、提议器校准与停止决策，但论文本身面向文本服务加速，与视觉状态推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Draft Calibration for Speculative Decoding: Accelerating LLM Serving by Matching Draft and Target Distributions

**abstract/A1：** Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by employing a lightweight draft model to propose draft tokens and allowing the target model to verify the new tokens in parallel to improve inference-time compute utilization. The speedup relies on the acceptance probability of draft tokens in target verification, which is directly related to the gap $\\\|p-q\\\|\_1$ between the target distribution $p$ and the draft distribution $q$. In this paper, we study draft calibration of speculative decoding to improve the speedup of speculative decoding, where we employ post-hoc methods to calibrate the draft distribution to mitigate the distribution gap. We observe that though current community open-source draft models may learn the top candidate token correctly, they are generally underconfident compared to the target model, suggesting a consistent distribution mismatch. To mitigate the effect of this mismatch on the acceptance rate of the draft models, we try various post-hoc calibration methods, including standard temperature scaling and token-wise calibration. Our results suggest that a standard temperature scaling applied to the draft distribution improves the acceptance length by up to approximately 10\\% with almost no additional cost across different tasks. Throughput analysis further verifies that this improvement in serving efficiency. Analysis of more general calibration methods reveals further potential room for improvement.

</details>

### 259. [BriConstrain: Geometrically Constrained Decoding for Autoregressive Brick Assembly Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33135v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.33135

**作者：** Nadav Magar、Amir Hertz、Ariel Shamir、Or Patashnik

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33135v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.33135v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 BriConstrain：在采样前用预计算几何 oracle 动态检验 LEGO 放置的合法性，只约束「如何连接」而非「连接谁」来压缩组合空间，并将下一 token 分布偏向剩余合法候选，减少碰撞与悬空零件。

**相关性简评：** 其「依赖非预定状态的动态约束解码、以关系约束缩小候选空间、把外部检验器结果回注到下一 token 概率」的做法，可能为 LVR 中依视觉证据动态筛选候选、抑制不可行推理状态的解码机制提供核查线索，但任务本身与视觉推理相距较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BriConstrain: Geometrically Constrained Decoding for Autoregressive Brick Assembly Generation

**abstract/A1：** Language models can generate LEGO$^\\circledR$ assemblies from text, but their builds often contain parts that collide or attach to nothing. The usual approach of rejecting and resampling invalid placements discards decoded tokens without guaranteeing a valid build. We present BriConstrain, a constrained decoding method that restricts a pretrained language model's next-token probabilities before sampling, steering it towards valid placements. Because the validity of a brick placement depends on the non-predetermined build state, it cannot be compiled into a fixed grammar and must be checked dynamically. However, checking the validity of a brick before sampling is challenging as the space of valid placements is combinatorially large and cannot be enumerated exhaustively. Our key idea is to narrow the search space by constraining how parts attach rather than which parts attach to each other. Concretely, given the model's predictions of the currently placed part, and the previously placed parent it wants to connect to, we constrain the model's choice of how they attach. This allows us to span the space of part attachments, using a precomputed geometric oracle, and to effectively filter out colliding options. With valid attachment candidates in hand, we bias the model's next-token distribution towards the remaining valid candidates. We evaluate our method on two LEGO$^\\circledR$ formats and models: BrickNet, which annotates connectivity explicitly, and our proposed Implicit Connectivity LDraw Format (ICLF), which uses numeric values for placements and leaves connectivity implicit. Our method raises collision-free builds from 31% to 91% on BrickNet and from 15% to 65% on ICLF, and outperforms rejection sampling on both formats at about 60% of its decoding cost.

**comment/C1：** Project Page: https://nadmag.github.io/BriConstrain/

</details>

### 260. [Local subspace encoding for spectral prediction: from TabPFN to operator-adaptive calibration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31245v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31245

**作者：** Gregory Beurier、Robin Reiter、Denis Cornet、Lauriane Rouan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、eess.SP、stat.CO、stat.ME、stat.ML

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 nirs4all 光谱数据集上复核 GCU 与 LVSE 两种表示对 TabPFN 预测及 PLS、Ridge 校准的影响，并测试把 LVSE 候选接入 operator-adaptive 模型的可行性。

**相关性简评：** 光谱校准与 LVR 无直接关联，但其「原始输入 vs 局部子空间编码」的可比设定及收益随任务强烈异质的结果，可能为核查视觉证据进入推理前应保留何种表示、以及如何在原始与结构化表示间选择提供线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Local subspace encoding for spectral prediction: from TabPFN to operator-adaptive calibration

**abstract/A1：** TabPFN has already shown useful predictive performance on near-infrared spectra. RamanPFN subsequently proposed two spectral representations for tabular inference: Global Compositional Unmixing (GCU) and Local Vibrational Subspace Encoding (LVSE). We assess whether these representations also help on datasets assembled through the nirs4all ecosystem, and whether their value extends to classical calibration. We reanalyse completed experiments from a public spectral dataset catalogue. On a post-hoc subset of 61 matched numerical prediction tasks, after excluding ten class-code, metadata or semantically ambiguous targets, LVSE reduces RMSE relative to raw-spectrum TabPFN by 10.22%, 12.80% and 14.52% on average for checkpoints 2.5, 3 and 3.5, respectively, with median reductions of 4.99%, 4.74% and 7.82%. Across 76 classification datasets, weighted F1 increases by 2.22, 2.56 and 3.81 percentage points. The 2.5 classification procedure uses output coding on 15 datasets exceeding the checkpoint's native class limit. GCU alone is less reliable in this implementation. LVSE also improves PLS and Ridge in many cases, with median RMSE reductions of 4.75% and 1.89%. Adding LVSE candidates to an operator-adaptive model is feasible, but a separate 35-task panel derived from the public AOM benchmark shows only small median gains. These results motivate evaluating LVSE alongside existing representation choices. They do not establish that a selector choosing between raw and LVSE inputs will improve every task.

### 261. [Flagging Batch Shift in Flow Cytometry using Jeffreys Divergence between Gaussian Mixtures](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31321v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31321

**作者：** Jonathan Legrand、Aguirre Mimoun、Audrey Bidet、Pierre-Yves Dumas、Christ{è}le Etchegaray、Baudouin Denis de Senneville

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31321v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31321v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出模型无关的预测可靠性判据：将每个病人样本表示为高斯混合模型，用蒙特卡洛估计其与训练集参考分布的 Jeffreys 散度，并校准拒绝阈值以标记不可靠预测，在急性髓系白血病队列上验证。

**相关性简评：** 以输入分布散度作为弃权或停止信号，可能为 LVR 中「证据是否充足、是否继续获取视觉证据或终止推理」的门控设计提供借鉴线索，可供核查其阈值校准思路能否迁移到多步推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Flagging Batch Shift in Flow Cytometry using Jeffreys Divergence between Gaussian Mixtures

**abstract/A1：** Machine learning models for clinical flow cytometry are usually evaluated on data drawn from their training distribution. In routine practice, however, acquisition conditions and reagents may change, potentially making predictions unreliable without warning. We propose a model agnostic criterion for prediction reliability based on a notion of distance from the training distribution: each patient sample is represented by a Gaussian mixture model, and its Jeffreys divergence to a reference fitted on the training data is estimated using Monte Carlo integration. We illustrate our approach on real-life shifted cohorts of acute myeloid leukaemia patients, using a classifier trained to predict NPM1 mutation status. First, we show graphically and statistically that pairwise divergences capture acquisition cohort structure. We then calibrate a rejection threshold on a subset of shifted cohort samples and evaluate it on held-out subjects. Across 20 runs, the misclassification rate of rejected samples was 2.5 times larger than for retained samples. These results suggest that input divergence can help identify unreliable predictions, providing a strong candidate component for abstention frameworks, along with quality control measures and classifier confidence.

</details>

### 262. [Conservative Overlap Fuzzy Rough Sets for Incomplete Data](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31329v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31329

**作者：** Trung Hieu Vuong、Van Thien Nguyen、Nhu Son Nguyen、Thanh Dai Tran

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31329v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31329v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Conservative Overlap Fuzzy Rough Set（COFRS），针对不完整信息系统，用仅在共同出现属性上计算的加权重叠相似度（分母固定为 \|A\|，使缺失被整体惩罚）定义基于加权粒度一致性的软依赖度，并以贪心后向消减搜索约简，在 11 个 UCI 缺失数据基准上比较约简规模与 kNN、RBF-SVM 预测表现。

**相关性简评：** 其「缺失即惩罚」的部分观测相似度与按属性子集评估信息量的软依赖度，可能为证据不全时潜在状态相似度度量与视觉证据筛选提供远领域线索，但联系较间接，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Conservative Overlap Fuzzy Rough Sets for Incomplete Data

**abstract/A1：** Attribute reduction in incomplete information systems is difficult because missing values break the equivalence-class structure of rough set theory. We propose the Conservative Overlap Fuzzy Rough Set (COFRS) model. Each object is described by its set of present attributes. The similarity of two objects is a weighted overlap on the attributes present in both, divided by the fixed number of attributes \|A\| instead of the size of their union, so missing values are penalised globally and are not matched as wildcards. From this similarity we define a soft dependency degree based on weighted granule consistency, and we search for reducts by greedy backward elimination in O(\|U\|^2 \|A\|^2) time. We show that the relation is symmetric and non-reflexive, that the dependency degree is not monotone, and we give a sufficient condition under which monotonicity holds. On 11 UCI benchmarks with missing rates from 0.15% to 20.46%, COFRS gives the smallest reducts on average (4.1 attributes, against 5.0-11.2 for Tolerance-RS, a range-threshold variant Tol-RS\_tau, Zhou-RS and the min-aggregation variant COFRS-min). The difference is significant against Tol-RS\_tau, Zhou-RS and COFRS-min (Holm-adjusted Wilcoxon p&lt;0.01) but not against Tolerance-RS (p=0.56), and it is small against the Jensen-Shen selector (adjusted p=0.084). At equal reduct size, COFRS selects more informative attributes than random subsets. With a kNN classifier the methods do not differ significantly in accuracy, F1 or G-mean; with an RBF-SVM they do, and COFRS ranks last. The gain is therefore compactness, not predictive accuracy.

</details>

### 263. [Fusion Gains Depend on the Implementation and the Calibration Target: An 18-Task Study of Prediction Intervals with a Single-Source Fallback](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31333v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31333

**作者：** Liwei Deng、Lu Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31333v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31333v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 18 个回归任务上比较四种融合实现与其匹配的单源学习器，考察 group-wise 与 pointwise 两种校准目标下的预测区间表现，并检验带单源回退的开发集选择器在留出任务上的平均增益与失败频率。

**相关性简评：** 其「匹配候选对比＋留出集选择＋同时报告选择器落后频率」的评估协议，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 推理相对基线的增益是否稳健、以及校准口径如何改变结论。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Fusion Gains Depend on the Implementation and the Calibration Target: An 18-Task Study of Prediction Intervals with a Single-Source Fallback

**abstract/A1：** A fused model can benefit from an extra learning stage as well as from a second data source. We compare four fusion implementations with matched single-source learners on 18 regression tasks with prediction intervals. Across ten refits under group-wise calibration, linear stacking improved the interval score by 6.0% against a source model without a second stage and by 0.1% against its matched single source. The four implementations agreed on 3 of 18 tasks and gave opposite clear verdicts on 12, including 8 of the 10 tasks with naturally distinct sources. With pointwise calibration, they agreed on 5 tasks and gave opposite clear verdicts on 9. A development-set selector with a matched single-source fallback improved ten-refit task-averaged scores by 2.2--6.3% in every implementation under both calibrations. Adding fused arms to the pool of single-source candidates improved the mean relative score by about 5 percentage points. Under group-wise calibration, the gradient-boosted selector met the criterion frozen before evaluation on eight held-out tasks. In post-opening refits, selectors lost to the matched single source in 4.4--6.1% of task-level runs under group-wise calibration. Under signed pointwise calibration, three implementations lost in 19--23% of runs. Fusion evaluations should compare matched candidates on held-out data and report how often the selector loses alongside its average gain.

**comment/C1：** 4 figures; supplementary material included as an ancillary file

</details>

### 264. [What People Choose Not to Say: A Multimodal Benchmark for Fine-Grained Information Manipulation in Conversations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31346v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31346

**作者：** Yuhan Bian、Zhaokai Liang、Jia Wang、Haoyu Liu、Yu Chen、Jianfeng Qu、Zhixu Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31346v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31346v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 InfoCon，一个面向对话中细粒度信息操纵的多模态基准，划分六类策略并由事实与互动关系导出粗粒度一致性标签，借助证据驱动的多智能体标注构建标签并评测代表性多模态模型。

**相关性简评：** 其对参与者知识状态与事实证据的建模可能为 LVR 中的信念状态跟踪和证据筛选评价提供启发，但任务偏社会行为分类，与视觉 latent 推理状态的直接联系仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What People Choose Not to Say: A Multimodal Benchmark for Fine-Grained Information Manipulation in Conversations

**abstract/A1：** Recent advances in MLLMs have improved social understanding, enabling models to recognize emotions and distinguish truthful from deceptive behaviors. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on coarse-grained emotion recognition or binary truth-deception detection, overlooking the diverse ways people manipulate information in conversations, such as withholding, leakage, fabrication, evasion, and defensive counterclaim. Understanding these behaviors requires reasoning about underlying facts, participant knowledge, and conversational context, making them difficult to evaluate reliably. To address this gap, we introduce InfoCon, a multimodal benchmark for fine-grained information manipulation in conversations. InfoCon identifies six fine-grained strategies and derives a coarse consistency label from their factual and interactional relations. We develop an evidence-grounded multi-agent annotation framework to construct and verify reliable labels from rich contextual evidence. We benchmark representative multimodal models and systematically analyze their fine-grained information manipulation understanding, providing a testbed beyond binary truth-deception judgments.

**comment/C1：** ACM WSDM 2027 (Main Track), Our benchmark dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/xilinghuiye/RoomReader-Full

### 265. [ContextLure: Exploiting Benign Conversation History for Indirect Prompt Injection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31424v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31424

**作者：** Yi Han、Zhen Sun、Zhijie Deng、Yini Huang、Yangyang Zheng、Dongyi Zhang、Xinlei He

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31424v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31424v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ContextLure 红队框架：攻击者观察未污染的良性对话历史、按用户/系统偏好与三种策略挑选证据，再用紧迫性/优先级矩阵改写为注入请求，并在 AgentDojo 与 InjecAgent 上报告攻击成功率。

**相关性简评：** 其「按维度筛选证据并度量其对下游行为影响」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与信息价值评估提供问题表述参考；但属安全攻击场景，与多模态推理无直接联系，可迁移性待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ContextLure: Exploiting Benign Conversation History for Indirect Prompt Injection

**abstract/A1：** As LLMs become more capable, agents can perform more complex tasks with tools and maintain longer interactions with users. These benign conversations contain evidence on task results, user concerns, and operational constraints. The risk is that attackers who can observe benign conversations (evidence) may construct stronger indirect prompt injections without increasing the attackers' control over prior turns or the later injection. However, we still lack a clear study of how effectively attackers can select and use this evidence. To address this gap, we introduce ContextLure, a red-teaming framework in which an attacker silently observes an existing benign conversation, extracts evidence, and constructs an injection. The challenges are twofold: (a) selecting useful evidence and (b) presenting it as reasons for an unauthorized action, without changing the prior benign conversation. To efficiently exploit (a) the effect of evidence on attack success, our framework selects evidence across 2 dimensions: User/System Preferences with 3 selection policies. And to enhance (b) the process of turning the selected information into the malicious request, we introduce an Urgency/Priority matrix with 4 rewriting strategies. Across the evaluated conditions, we reach 67.4% ASR on AgentDojo and 87.3% on InjecAgent. These results show that attackers can use benign interaction evidence in later attacks without first poisoning the benign conversation.

**comment/C1：** 17 pages, 8 figures

</details>

### 266. [CaLA: Causal Latent Adjustment for World Models under Adaptive Policies](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31431v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31431

**作者：** Robert Ness、Sofiane Ennadir、Oleg Smirnov

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究自适应策略下世界模型 imagined rollout 中的处理—结果混杂问题，在 Match-3 难度调整场景构建含序贯机制与配对真实干预的 SCM 基准，并提出 DAG 约束的变分潜在表征模型 CaLA，从干预前历史推断玩家技能以改进人群级干预估计。

**相关性简评：** 其「潜在状态应服务下游因果决策而非仅预测拟合」，以及残差修正提升拟合却损害决策质量的发现，可能为 LVR 中判断 latent 内容是否被真正使用、以及贡献分配与评测指标选择提供类比线索；但工作无视觉或多模态成分，迁移需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CaLA: Causal Latent Adjustment for World Models under Adaptive Policies

**abstract/A1：** World models is answering \`\`imagine" answers to \`\`what-if'' questions via imagined rollouts. But rollouts collected by adaptive policies induce treatment-outcome confounding in imagined rollouts. We study this problem in Match-3 difficulty adjustment, where latent player skill influences both assigned difficulty and churn. We build a fully specified Match-3 SCM with sequential mechanics, adaptive assignment, and paired ground-truth interventions, on which unadjusted models fit to the logged trajectories select difficulty settings that raise churn. We then introduce Causal Latent Adjustment (CaLA), a DAG-constrained world model that infers a variational player representation from pretreatment history. Across our evaluations, CaLA provides the most reliable population-level intervention estimates and competitive individualized decisions, although rich handcrafted histories can remain advantageous for individual-level adjustment. We further find that residual correction can degrade causal decision quality despite improving predictive fit, highlighting the need to distinguish predictive accuracy, confounding adjustment and the behavior of downstream causal estimators.

</details>

### 267. [Which Ellipses Are Outlines of a Given Ellipsoid? A Ratio Test with Unknown Focal Length](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31437v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31437

**作者：** Michael Werman

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、math.MG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31437v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31437v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究给定椭球的图像椭圆能否成为其轮廓：在方像素、零倾斜、主点已知的相机模型下，提出由两个特征值构成的锥比 κ(f)，并证明 κ(f)≤a/c 即为可行条件；焦距未知时可行区间由最小锥比与显式四次方程决定，并以仿真和土星卫星图像验证。

**相关性简评：** 该判定给出「单个图像椭圆作为几何证据可排除过圆椭球、却无法排除过扁椭球」的明确可行性与不可判定边界，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、几何假设一致性检验及证据不足时的停止判断提供可核查的形式化参照，但与 latent 状态生成无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Which Ellipses Are Outlines of a Given Ellipsoid? A Ratio Test with Unknown Focal Length

**abstract/A1：** When is an image ellipse the outline of a given ellipsoid with semi-axes $a &lt;= b &lt;= c? For a camera with square pixels, zero skew and known principal point, we show that it is an outline at focal length $f$ exactly when a cone ratio kappa(f), computed from two eigenvalues, is at most a/c; the middle semi-axis b plays no role. With f unknown, the admissible focal lengths form an interval; whether it is empty is decided by the smallest cone ratio over $f$, which, when attained, is obtained from an explicit quartic. The interval is bounded above only when the principal point is closer to the long axis of the ellipse than to its short axis. Thus one ellipse can rule out ellipsoids that are too round, never ones that are too elongated, and none if the principal point is unknown. Simulations and 45 Cassini images of Saturn's moons support the test.

**comment/C1：** 36 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables; supplementary material included as an ancillary file. Submitted to SIAM Journal on Imaging Sciences. Code: https://github.com/michael-werman/realizability-code

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31457v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31457v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该技术报告介绍 Taxi，一个面向大规模 agent 轨迹的调试、聚类与监控系统：用聚类为步骤生成分类法以获得结构化概览，并开放 SQL 供工程师或自动化 agent 查询，二者由编码 agent 串成混合流程；还实验性集成了把状态与有界问题直接映射为带类型概率决策的决策模型，用于低成本语义路由与评估。

**相关性简评：** 其按步骤聚类加查询的轨迹分析管线、以及「状态→有界问题的概率决策」建模，可能为考察 latent 推理轨迹的结构、停止决策与贡献分配提供诊断与评估工具线索，但论文本身并非研究视觉推理，需核查其分析粒度能否覆盖内部状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Taxi: Analyzing Agents at (Real) Scale

**abstract/A1：** In this technical report, we present Taxi -- a system for debugging, clustering, and monitoring agents at scale. Taxi scales to millions of steps efficiently. This is made possible by a combination of scalable analysis methods. Taxi relies primarily on clustering to generate a taxonomy over steps for a structured overview of the data, and provides full SQL access for engineers and automated agents to ask complex questions. Clustering and querying are best used together in a hybrid pipeline guided by a coding agent. Taxi also includes an experimental integration of Jev-style decision models: models that map state and bounded questions directly to typed, probabilistic decisions. They add low-cost semantic routing and evaluation where embeddings or literal queries alone are insufficient. In addition, Taxi provides an extensible ecosystem, including built-in evaluators and daily reports. To accommodate growth, Taxi is designed to be modular, hackable, and easy to plug-and-play for individuals and teams.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31465

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 构建 PMC-PaIR：沿引用关系从 5.6 万篇 PMC 病例报告中挖掘出 8.6 万对「临床相似」图像对，用 LLM 按「模态—诊断—征象」的层级问答匹配图注来判定相似性，并微调 BiomedCLIP 验证检索提升。

**相关性简评：** 其层级问答式的证据筛选（从模态到征象逐级比对）可能为 LVR 中视觉证据的分级筛选与「看什么」提供线索，且相似图像对可供核查内部状态是否保留临床关键细节；但任务本身是医学图像检索，与 latent 推理生成相距较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A dataset of clinically similar image pairs from citation-linked case reports for medical image retrieval

**abstract/A1：** Retrieving images of patients clinically similar to a given patient can support diagnosis, teaching and research. Training and evaluating retrieval systems requires knowing which images of different patients show the same finding, and existing datasets are small or narrow in scope. We construct PMC-PaIR, a dataset of 86,144 pairs of clinically similar images from 56,013 open-access PubMed Central case reports, which often document rare or challenging presentations. We develop an approach that follows citations, which often link case reports of similar patients. To determine what two linked cases share clinically, it prompts large language models to generate and answer hierarchical questions, from modality to diagnosis and findings, and to match images by caption using the answers. Experts find the pairs highly accurate, and this question-guided approach finds twice as many correct pairs as direct matching. Fine-tuning BiomedCLIP on PMC-PaIR improves retrieval in all modality, anatomy and diagnosis categories tested, for image-only queries and image queries with a short text naming the finding. We release the dataset and the automated pipeline, which can extend PMC-PaIR as new case reports are published.

</details>

### 270. [AdProducer: Towards Agentic Advertising Video Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31466v1>)

**作者：** Kunyang Li、Chaoyang Wang、Mubarak Shah、Yuzhang Shang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 AdProducer，一个端到端 agentic 广告视频生成框架：多模态 agent 通过网络与图像检索调研产品，生成卖点驱动的分镜脚本以驱动冻结的视频生成器，并用 SFT 加强化学习（分镜级与视频级联合奖励）训练，同时发布 AdCreation-Bench 基准。

**相关性简评：** 其「先检索产品证据、再决定分镜呈现」的主动信息获取流程，以及为中间分镜表示单独设置奖励的分层监督，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与中间状态贡献分配提供启发线索，尚需核查中间表示是否真正承载并影响最终输出，故相关性较间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AdProducer: Towards Agentic Advertising Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Recent advances in video generation have made automated advertising production increasingly feasible. However, an effective advertisement must faithfully represent the product and communicate its selling points through compelling visual storytelling, which requires more than visual synthesis: it calls for deeper product understanding and strategic decisions about how to present product value. Crucially, product research and creative design are closely intertwined, as the information gathered about a product determines which features can be faithfully demonstrated and how they should be presented. In this paper, we introduce AdProducer, the first end-to-end agentic framework for advertising video creation, transforming concise creative briefs into finished advertisements. Our multimodal agent autonomously researches products through web and image search and translates its findings into selling-point-driven storyboards that guide a frozen video generator. To achieve this, we develop a dedicated data construction pipeline that yields two training datasets, AdProducer-SFT and AdProducer-RL, and train the agent through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning with joint optimization of storyboard- and video-level rewards. We further introduce AdCreation-Bench, comprising 305 advertising briefs across eight domains, with two complementary metrics: PG-Score for product correctness and creative execution, and Ad-Score for overall advertising effectiveness assessed by an independent judge. Experiments demonstrate that AdProducer improves the PG-Score of MiniMax H3 from 17.3 to 51.3 and generalizes to Veo 3.1 without additional training, improving its score from 28.0 to 35.9, with consistent gains in Ad-Score, VideoScore2, and human evaluations. Code, models, and data are released.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://lky-ang.github.io/AdProducer-page/ Code: https://github.com/lky-ang/AdProducer

</details>

### 271. [PromptSMC: Enabling Particle Exploration in Flow Matching via LLM-Based Prompt Rejuvenation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31471v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31471

**作者：** Wenyi Lian、Zheng Zhao、Thomas B. Schön

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31471v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31471v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文面向 text-to-image flow matching 的推理期提示—图像对齐，提出 PromptSMC：用序贯蒙特卡洛从共享中间 latent 状态复制粒子，借助预训练 LLM 在语义保持约束下改写各粒子提示以产生不同速度场，再用奖励模型打分并重采样优选轨迹，无需训练或奖励梯度。

**相关性简评：** 虽属图像生成，但其「保留中间 latent、分叉多假设粒子、按奖励重采样」的机制可能为 LVR 的多 latent 假设维护、证据筛选与停止决策提供可供核查的思路。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PromptSMC: Enabling Particle Exploration in Flow Matching via LLM-Based Prompt Rejuvenation

**abstract/A1：** This paper is concerned with prompt-image alignment at inference time through exploration of generative trajectories and dynamical prompt rejuvenation. We leverage sequential Monte Carlo (SMC), to offer a gradient-free and principled framework for this purpose through reward-guided trajectory selection. More specifically, we introduce LLM-based prompt rejuvenation, allowing for efficient particle exploration in SMC samplers along the diffusion time in flow matching models. The proposed method, PromptSMC, retains the selected latent states and uses a pretrained LLM to dynamically revise the prompts of duplicated particles under semantic-preservation constraints. These revised prompts induce alternative conditional velocity fields, allowing particles to explore different continuations from a shared intermediate state. The method further uses a reward model to evaluate each particle's alignment with the original prompt, and the resulting scores guide particles through resampling. PromptSMC thus integrates prompt-based exploration with reward-guided sampling, achieving faithful prompt-image alignment without additional noise injection, model training, or reward gradients. Our experiments and ablation studies across multiple benchmarks and backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of the method for text-to-image flow matching. Code is available at https://github.com/shermanlian/PromptSMC.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages

</details>

### 272. [Which Way Is Up? Rotated Photos Silently Hurt Multi-View 3D Foundation Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31478v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31478

**作者：** Yukun Shi、Minglun Gong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31478v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31478v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文测量旋转照片（EXIF 方向标签被忽略、丢失或出错）对五个多视图 3D 基础模型在三个数据集上的相机位姿精度影响，发现少量旋转图片即造成精度下降，而模型置信度无法可靠报警，所测修复手段只能解决部分问题。

**相关性简评：** 「视觉输入被静默损坏而置信度不反映」这一发现，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与「何时不应采信视觉输入」的可靠性判断提供旁证，其与推理期证据筛选的具体联系可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Which Way Is Up? Rotated Photos Silently Hurt Multi-View 3D Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** Multi-view 3D foundation models estimate camera poses and 3D points from a set of photos in one forward pass. Many cameras store a portrait shot sideways, with an orientation tag telling viewers how to turn it, and this tag can be ignored, lost or wrong. We measure how rotated photos affect five such models on three datasets. A few rotated photos lower camera pose accuracy for every model, and the sideways photos already in a standard benchmark do the same. Even the most robust model still loses accuracy. The failure is also silent: the models' confidence does not reliably flag it, and most official image loaders ignore the tag. The fixes we test each correct only part of the problem. These findings call for orientation checks in reconstruction pipelines and benchmarks.

</details>

### 273. [Trust-Region Optimization for Performative Prediction without Response Modeling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31492v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31492

**作者：** Siqi Du、Miaolan Xie、Roy Dong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31492v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31492v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PTRO，在不对总体响应建模的前提下优化 performative risk：从当前分布采样估计已知损失，仅用额外部署估计总体响应效应，并以信任域机制自适应决定局部近似可信的范围，给出高概率收敛到 ε-稳定点的迭代与样本复杂度。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理主线无直接联系，但其「信任域半径自适应、局部信息可信范围决定更新幅度」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态更新的步长控制与停止决策提供概念启发，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Trust-Region Optimization for Performative Prediction without Response Modeling

**abstract/A1：** Performative prediction studies learning problems in which deployed decisions change the distribution of future data. Existing methods often impose structure on the population response, which limits their applicability when a fixed model class poorly captures that response. Generic black-box optimization avoids response modeling but does not exploit the known loss function. We introduce Performative Trust-Region Optimization (PTRO), which bridges these two approaches by optimizing performative risk without specifying or fitting a response model while still exploiting the known loss. The key idea is sampling from the current population to evaluate the known loss at nearby decisions, and use additional deployments only to estimate the effect of population response. This gives a local approximation of performative risk without committing to a model of how the population responds. PTRO then uses a trust-region mechanism to determine and adapt how far this local information can be trusted. Under moment-bounded losses and suitable smoothness and estimator-accuracy conditions, we establish high-probability convergence to an $ε$-stationary point of the performative risk in $O(ε^{-2})$ iterations, with $O(d^{3}ε^{-4})$ samples per iteration, where $d$ is the decision dimension and $q\\geq2$ is the loss-moment order. Experiments illustrate methods built around a specified response model can be more sample-efficient when their structural assumptions are accurate, whereas PTRO remains effective as the population response is poorly captured by a fixed model class. Ablations further show that both exploiting the known loss and adaptive trust-region updates are important for controlling the accuracy and efficiency.

</details>

### 274. [XRL4T1D: A Post-hoc Explainability Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Type 1 Diabetes Management](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31498v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31498

**作者：** Malay Phadke、Chirath Hettiarachchi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31498v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31498v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 XRL4T1D 事后可解释框架，用 SHAP/TimeSHAP 分析预训练胰岛素给药策略对 CGM 与胰岛素历史的依赖，并用定向输入替换检验归因是否对应策略输出的真实敏感度。

**相关性简评：** 其「归因—替换敏感度」一致性检验与时间窗排名复现性，可能为 LVR 中判断 latent 内容是否真正参与答案生成、以及证据筛选的贡献分配提供可核查的评测思路，但领域距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** XRL4T1D: A Post-hoc Explainability Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Type 1 Diabetes Management

**abstract/A1：** Type 1 diabetes (T1D) requires lifelong insulin therapy, and reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promise for automated dosing in the UVA/Padova simulator. However, the decisions of RL controllers remain difficult to interpret. We present XRL4T1D, a post-hoc explainability framework for evaluating pretrained insulin-dosing policies without retraining. Each policy uses 60 minutes of continuous glucose monitor (CGM) and administered-insulin history, sampled every 5 minutes, to recommend insulin. We use SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to compare the importance of CGM and insulin-history inputs and summarize insulin-history attributions over three 20-minute windows motivated by insulin-on-board. We assess whether these attributions correspond to policy-output sensitivity through targeted input replacement and compare temporal rankings with TimeSHAP. In all 80 patient-policy-mask-size cases, replacing the highest-attribution inputs changes the normalized insulin recommendation more than replacing the lowest-attribution or random inputs. The highest-attribution insulin-history window is also the most output-sensitive in 115 of 120 patient-policy-scenario configurations, and KernelSHAP and TimeSHAP select the same top window in 111 of 120. Applying XRL4T1D to PPO and G2P2C across 20 virtual patients, we find that both controllers rely predominantly on CGM history, especially G2P2C. However, the distribution of insulin-history importance across recent, middle, and older windows varies by cohort, explainer, and analysis settings, without a consistent separation between controllers. Global feature-attribution rankings remain stable under the tested observation corruptions. These results show why attribution fidelity, temporal reproducibility, and controller-comparison robustness should be assessed separately.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages, 7 figures. GenAI for Health Workshop at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其核心问题「廉价候选效用度量能否在重新训练前预测样本价值、质量指标为何与任务收益脱节」可能启发对 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、监督与贡献分配以及 latent 代理指标有效性的核查。

**title/T1：** Synthetic Augmentation for Data-Scarce Object Detection: Allocation, Dose, and Filtering Across Six Datasets

**abstract/A1：** Robotic perception for capturing uncooperative orbital objects and inspecting variable industrial products must often operate with limited labelled imagery. We examine a modular synthetic-augmentation pipeline, evaluating generation planning and post-generation filtering as separate interventions, with computational cost as a design constraint. Across six object-detection datasets, FLUX.1-Fill with class-specific LoRA adaptation produced dataset-dependent dose effects; the validation-selected augmentation improved mAP@50:95 on four datasets and reduced it on two. Filtering did not yield consistent gains, and FID, KID, precision, recall, and LPIPS did not consistently track detector changes. The results do not establish that image quality alone identifies useful samples. They motivate standardised evaluation and inexpensive candidate-utility measures that could identify useful samples before detector retraining, reducing repeated training cost.

### 276. [Your Codec, Your Generator: Idempotent Generative Compression without Retraining](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31520v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31520

**作者：** Raz Haim、Assaf Shocher

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31520v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31520v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免重训的图像压缩框架：用冻结编解码器构造满射的伪可逆网络，借非线性右逆与反向投影实现循环一致的重复压缩，并让解码端独立选择生成先验。

**相关性简评：** 其「潜变量满射/右逆 + 反向投影将生成提议约束回码流」的思路，可能为 LVR 中如何确保 latent 状态保留任务必要信息、并沿真实解码路径校验提供概念线索，但领域较远，需核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Your Codec, Your Generator: Idempotent Generative Compression without Retraining

**abstract/A1：** We introduce an image compression framework with three properties: (i) adaptation of pretrained codecs without retraining or fine-tuning, (ii) cycle-consistent recompression, even of already-encoded images, and (iii) decoding with independently chosen generative priors. We wrap the frozen encoder with non-learned operations so that every continuous latent has a preimage, yielding a surjective pseudo-invertible neural network. A nonlinear right inverse built from the pretrained decoder satisfies $E'(D'(E'(x)))=E'(x)$. To extend consistency to quantized bitstreams, the receiver searches for a continuous latent that reproduces both the transmitted main symbols and entropy side information. A successful search and an exact correction preserve both streams under deterministic coding; the final reconstruction is checked through the actual coding path. The encoder's pseudo-inverse enables a nonlinear counterpart of back-projection. In the linear case, back-projection has the closed-form solution $x'=x+A^\\dagger(y-Ax)$, giving the closest reconstruction to $x$ satisfying $Ax'=y$. Our nonlinear formulation enforces the transmitted code on proposals from an independently chosen generative model. Adjusting the starting noise controls the prior's influence without changing that code. Experiments show small first-pass quality changes, higher retained quality than trained consistency codecs over 50 recompressions, also under 8-bit storage, and decoder-side control of the perception-distortion trade-off. Decoupling the codec from its prior lets the receiver adopt future generators without retraining or re-encoding.

</details>

**内容简述：** 构建基于 225 名合成 FHIR 患者、18,000 个任务的临床图表检索基准：固定问题与检索程序、只改变记录的证据状态，并重新执行检索程序核验参考标签与证据集；据此考察显式状态字段提示对严格成功率与「证据不足」判断的影响。

**相关性简评：** 其将检索、引用与分类分开评估，并指出检索失败会以「正确」的证据不足标签掩盖解释错误，可能为 LVR 中判断模型是否真正查看视觉证据、以及证据不足时的停止决策与评测设计提供借鉴，值得核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PatientFlowSynth: Evaluating FHIR Agents with Matched Patient Charts

**abstract/A1：** Agents that search patient charts must classify claims from retrieved records, including cases with missing or conflicting evidence. In Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR), status fields can change how those records should be interpreted. PatientFlowSynth provides 18,000 tasks from 225 synthetic patients and 18 templates that hold the patient, question, and retrieval program fixed across chart variants representing four evidence states. Re-executing the program verifies each variant's reference answer, evidence sets, and search requirements. Strict success requires a completed response with correct labels and citations exactly matching an accepted evidence set retrieved during the episode. Where required, a tool response must also show a complete search at the specified scope. In a study using GPT-5.6 Luna and 225 synthetic patients (3,600 matched pairs), explicit Encounter-status guidance increased strict success from 40.7% to 51.3% (+10.6 percentage points; 95% patient-bootstrap confidence interval, 8.4 to 12.8). Among cases whose primary reference label was insufficient evidence, label agreement fell from 49.2% to 29.3%. A prespecified two-model replication reproduced both changes. Failed retrieval can mask interpretation errors by producing a correct insufficient-evidence label without examining the relevant records. Additional model comparisons showed that the benefit of guidance was model-dependent. Retrieval, citation, and classification should be evaluated separately.

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 系统拆解神经算子中来自训练函数采样、输出离散化与模型初始化的认知不确定性，训练约4.6万个模型并构建集成，考察相对 L2 误差分布随架构、采样密度与离散结构的变化。

**相关性简评：** 其「区分不确定性来源」及集成能刻画总体误差却难以可靠估计单样本误差分位数的发现，可能可供核查 LVR 中随机种子、数据采样与表示离散化对 latent 贡献分配和个体级评价的影响。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Diagnosing Epistemic Uncertainty in Neural Operators: Effects of Initialization, Discretization, and Function Sampling

**abstract/A1：** Neural operators provide efficient surrogates for mappings between function spaces, but their reliability cannot be characterized by the performance of a single trained model. Existing neural operator uncertainty quantification approaches often characterize predictive uncertainty without separately identifying the contributions of individual sources of epistemic uncertainty. Finite sampling of the training function space, output discretization, and model initialization can produce substantial variation among learned operators even when the underlying physical problem is deterministic. We systematically investigate these sources of epistemic uncertainty across a diverse set of operator learning architectures. Across our experiments, we train approximately 46,000 neural operator models and construct ensembles over training datasets, model initializations, and output discretizations to characterize distributions of relative $L\_2$ error rather than individual trained realizations. We find substantial architecture-dependent differences in epistemic uncertainty, with model initialization often accounting for the largest proportion of variance in relative $L\_2$ error. The ranked performance of neural operator architectures can invert as the number and spatial distribution of output samples change, with the best architectures under sparse or randomly sampled observations differing from those at higher-resolution or structured discretizations. Furthermore, ensembles that reliably characterize aggregate operator error can provide unreliable estimates of error quantiles for individual test functions. These results highlight the importance of distinguishing the sources of epistemic uncertainty when evaluating neural operator reliability and establishing robust benchmarking practices.

</details>

### 279. [ECLIPSE: Embedding-Centered Foundation-Model Federated Knowledge Transfer for Data-Free Edge Intelligence](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31527v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31527

**作者：** S. Kawa Atapour、S. Jamal Seyedmohammadi、Maryam Hosseini、S. Mohammad Sheikholeslami、Jamshid Abouei、Konstantinos Plataniotis、Arash Mohammadi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31527v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31527v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向无共享参考数据的联邦边缘场景，提出以 embedding 为中心的框架：边缘端只上传本地任务的 embedding，服务器对齐聚合后据此生成任务相关的替代数据集，微调服务器侧基础模型，再蒸馏为轻量全局模型下发。

**相关性简评：** 其“仅传 embedding 再生成数据”的流程可视为对压缩表示保留多少任务必要信息的间接检验，可能为分析 LVR 中视觉细节经 latent 瓶颈后的保存与坍缩提供参照，但尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ECLIPSE: Embedding-Centered Foundation-Model Federated Knowledge Transfer for Data-Free Edge Intelligence

**abstract/A1：** Foundation Models (FMs) are envisioned to become an integral component of intelligent federated edge networks because of their strong representation and generalization capabilities. However, their integration into resource-constrained and privacy-sensitive edge environments remains challenging. This challenge is particularly pronounced in data-free settings, where no shared, public, or server-accessible reference dataset is available to establish a common reference space for aligning distributed knowledge. To address this challenge, we propose ECLIPSE, which is an embedding-centered FM-based federated knowledge transfer framework developed for data-free edge intelligence. ECLIPSE enables edge intelligence capitalizing on a server-hosted FM without sharing raw data, local models, or a public reference dataset. It establishes a shared embedding reference space through which edge devices encode their local task knowledge. Only the resulting embeddings are transmitted to the server for alignment and aggregation. Using the aggregated embeddings, the server constructs a task-aware surrogate dataset through an embedding-guided generative process. This surrogate dataset is then used to adapt the server-hosted FM to the downstream task. The adapted FM is subsequently distilled into a lightweight global model and distributed to the edge devices. This process allows edge devices to benefit from both distributed task knowledge and the generalization capabilities of the FM. Experimental results across diverse classification datasets show that ECLIPSE outperforms conventional Federated Learning (FL) and data-free Federated Knowledge-Transfer (FKT) baselines. It also achieves competitive performance compared with databased approaches. Furthermore, the framework remains robust under statistical and model heterogeneity across different data distributions and local architectures.

</details>
