### 280. [Agent Recovery Gone Wrong: Measuring Harm Beyond Duplicate Calls](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31554v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31554

**作者：** Artem Trofimov、Boris Novikov

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.DB、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31554v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31554v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文测量代码执行型 LLM agent 部分写入成功后重写代码继续执行所带来的危害：在 AppWorld 轨迹分层抽样中，加权估计 24.6% 的恢复有害，并比较模型自报标识与调用内容派生标识用于幂等契约的效果。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理无直接关系，但「由调用内容而非模型自报来判定同一操作」以及恢复/停止判据的检测缺口（重复调用规则仅覆盖 41% 危害），可能为核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真正绑定证据、以及诊断规则覆盖面提供类比线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Agent Recovery Gone Wrong: Measuring Harm Beyond Duplicate Calls

**abstract/A1：** Code-executing LLM agents submit blocks of code that issue several API writes. If a block fails after some of its writes have taken effect, the agent rewrites the block and continues. It is unknown how often such a recovery harms the external state when the failure occurs naturally in the code written by the agent. In this paper, we measure it on recorded trajectories of AppWorld agents. In a stratified random sample of 200 candidate episodes across ten models, 145 are partial executions confirmed by the database state. In the sample, 30 of 143 confirmed partial executions with a determinable outcome are followed by a harmful recovery, and its violation remains at the end of the run, which gives a stratification-weighted estimate of 24.6%. Two thirds of the harmful recoveries duplicate an effect, and the rest delete user data or make a wrong first-time write, e.g., an order of a wrong product. A rule that searches for repeated calls finds 75% of duplications but only 41% of all harm. We also examine two sources of operation identity for an idempotency contract. In a small pilot (17 episodes, one local model), identifiers supplied by the model do not detectably reduce harm, because the model issues a new identifier for the same operation. Identity derived from the call content, evaluated counterfactually on the sample, would have matched every harmful write in 14 to 18 of the 30 harmful recoveries, but in none of those with a wrong first-time write, and it would also have matched writes required by the task in 30 episodes. Based on these results, we outline design requirements for safer agent recovery.

**comment/C1：** 5 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Data, labels, and scripts: https://github.com/flame-stream/agent-recovery-harm

</details>

### 281. [COGENT: A Modular Cognitive Architecture for Agentic User Simulation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31559v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31559

**作者：** Yikun Chi、Adam Davies、Debarati Das、Lin Ai、Scott Counts

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.HC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31559v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31559v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出模块化 LLM 认知架构 COGENT，借鉴 Norman 行动周期与 ACT-R，将桌面界面上的用户模拟分解为感知、记忆、用户状态、意图与动作选择等显式表示模块，并用六个干预示例和三个基准评估行为与归因保真度。

**相关性简评：** 其显式模块化状态与「单点编辑沿认知管线传播」的干预思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的分解、因果作用与可干预性评价提供概念参照，但所述状态是模拟用户的心理量而非模型内部推理表示，需核查可比性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** COGENT: A Modular Cognitive Architecture for Agentic User Simulation

**abstract/A1：** LLM-based user simulation can support interface design, accessibility research, and interactive-agent evaluation, but standard computer-use agents are optimized for task completion rather than reproducing how people perceive, reason, and act. We introduce COGENT (COGnitive agENT), a modular cognitive architecture for simulating user interaction with desktop interfaces. COGENT draws on established cognitive theories, such as Norman's action cycle and ACT-R, to enable explainable, intervenable, and modular user simulation by decomposing the simulation process into cognitive modules with explicit representations of perception, memory, user state, intentions, and action selection. We begin by presenting six intervenability demonstrations, each tracing how a single edit to memory, a user attribute, or a processing module propagates through the cognitive pipeline to produce a behavioral change. We evaluate COGENT's behavioral and attributional fidelity across three benchmarks -- AgentNetBench, A11y-CUA, and SENSE-42 -- finding that it achieves statistically significant fidelity gains over computer-use baselines in reproducing recorded human behavior and recovers the relational structure among human self-reported psychological states. Together, these demos and evaluations demonstrate COGENT's utility toward more faithful, explainable, intervenable, and modular LLM-based cognitive simulations.

</details>

### 282. [Off-the-Shelf Autonomous Agents for Game Playtesting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31570v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31570

**作者：** Ayush Maniar、Eryk Banatt

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31570v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31570v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Buddy，一个用现成语言模型驱动的游戏试玩智能体，在未见过的 3D 角色扮演游戏中通过多轮行动—反馈循环完成长时程目标，并把成功轨迹转为分层任务网络用于回归测试。

**相关性简评：** 其「靠探索而非预训练记忆发现解法」的多轮证据获取与行动决策循环，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的成本分配与停止判断提供外部参照，但属于应用级智能体框架，没有涉及内部视觉状态或 latent 表示，可供核查的借鉴较间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Off-the-Shelf Autonomous Agents for Game Playtesting

**abstract/A1：** In playtesting games, a human operator is typically required to test most gameplay elements. In this work we present Buddy, an autonomous game solving agent which can solve long time horizon objectives in an unseen 3D role-playing game using off-the-shelf language model systems. Buddy will take actions, receive feedback on those actions, and pursue a goal across many turns. No written walkthrough or model training of any kind is required, and we show that this paradigm holds in a novel environment where the agent must discover solutions via exploration rather than recalling them from pretraining. We demonstrate three downstream capabilities: game solving with no provided walkthrough, logging bug tickets for encountered difficulties, and conversion of successful agent traces into scripted hierarchical task networks for regression testing. Unlike existing playtesting solutions, our framework is fully modular: language models and harnesses can be easily swapped out as capabilities improve over time.

### 283. [One Phase Is Enough: Sim-to-Real Transfer with Direct Visual Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31588v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31588

**作者：** John Marangola、Antonia Bronars、Younghyo Park、Stephen Andrews、Kushal Kedia、Pulkit Agrawal

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31588v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31588v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DRIFT：单阶段直接视觉强化学习配方，冻结预训练基础视觉编码器，仅用 RL 训练控制策略，从而避免视觉骨干反传，并实现从快速光栅化仿真到真机的迁移；在三项操作任务上平均真实成功率相对两阶段蒸馏提升 58.8%。

**相关性简评：** 其「冻结视觉编码器＋轻量策略头」的视觉旁路式训练与 ID 到 OOD 增益放大的现象，可供核查 LVR 中视觉旁路是否保留任务必要视觉信息、以及冻结编码器对表示坍缩和分布偏移下 latent 内容稳定性的影响。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** One Phase Is Enough: Sim-to-Real Transfer with Direct Visual Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) has enabled impressive robotic behaviors, yet deploying policies directly from vision remains challenging. A common approach first trains a teacher policy with RL using privileged state observations, then distills its behavior into a vision-based student via imitation. However, the resulting student can substantially underperform its teacher. Directly training visual policies with RL offers a promising alternative, but learning task-relevant visual representations from scratch can be sample-inefficient, making one-phase visual RL intractable. We propose DRIFT, a simple recipe for efficient one-phase visual RL using image observations available at test time. Our key insight is to use frozen, pretrained foundation vision encoders, allowing RL to focus on learning control from existing visual representations. Freezing the encoder avoids costly backpropagation through the vision backbone, while its pretrained representations enable real-world transfer from fast, rasterized simulation rendering. Under matched architectures, observations, and compute budgets, DRIFT outperforms two-phase distillation and achieves a 58.8% relative improvement in average real-world success rate across three manipulation tasks. Controlled simulation evaluations demonstrate that DRIFT's relative advantage grows from roughly 9% in-distribution to over 61% under out-of-distribution shifts, suggesting that stronger generalization contributes to superior real-world transfer. Project website: https://jmarangola.github.io/one-phase-visual-rl/

</details>

### 284. [RePT: 3D Geometry Emerges from 2D Relational Pretraining](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31601v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31601

**作者：** Xize Duan、Binke Hou、Xingqiao Huang、Xinyuan Guan、Jiaxin Huang、Kaiyuan Hu、Zipeng Sun、Hong Kang、Meng Bi、Xue Liu、Yili Jin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31601v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31601v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 RePT，用跨视角 2D 点预测学习不同物理点之间的紧凑关系表示，不设 3D 预测目标；结果显示该关系空间自发形成与真实三维位移一致的几何组织，且单一线性读出可跨场景迁移。

**相关性简评：** 其「不显式预测也能在潜空间形成几何结构」及「点迁移准确率更高不等于组织更强」的发现，可能为 LVR 中视觉任务必要信息是否保留、训练目标如何塑造 latent 表示几何及代理指标与结构解耦的核查提供参照。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RePT: 3D Geometry Emerges from 2D Relational Pretraining

**abstract/A1：** Learning spatial representations often relies on explicitly predicting geometric quantities, but how physical geometry is organized within learned representations remains less understood. We ask whether 3D structure can emerge from learning relations across 2D observations, without 3D prediction targets. We introduce RePT, which learns compact relations between distinct physical points through cross-view 2D point prediction. The learned relation space develops a geometric organization in which magnitudes, angles, and neighborhoods reflect physical 3D displacement. A single linear readout fitted on 16 scenes recovers displacement length and angle on 39 held-out scenes without refitting (Pearson r = 0.72 and 0.78). The ARKitScenes-trained checkpoint also retains strong geometric organization on ScanNet++, showcasing generalizability. In controlled comparisons, distinct-point relational prediction consistently yields stronger geometric organization than matched same-point correspondence learning. This organization depends on additive relations and adaptive scene context, and higher point-transfer accuracy does not by itself produce stronger organization. More broadly, our results suggest that 3D geometry need not be an explicit prediction target and can instead emerge as a structural property of representations trained to relate 2D observations, pointing to relational prediction as a complementary route to learning the representations that spatial intelligence builds on.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables

</details>

### 285. [What a Forecasting Leaderboard Can Establish: Resolution Reporting for Zero-Shot Time-Series Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31619v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31619

**作者：** Arya Sikder、Sriram Pillutla

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ME

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31619v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31619v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出排行榜「分辨率」这一指标，即榜单数据集能区分的最小差异，并用工具 Vernier 从榜单公开的逐数据集分数直接计算；结果显示多个时序基础模型榜单的分辨率远大于相邻名次差距，名次顺序还会随无关提交者变化。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 无直接内容关联，但「分辨率」与名次稳定性分析可能为 VLM 推理基准提供核查线索：当各 latent 方法分数差距小于榜单可分辨步长时，收益排序是否仍可成立。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What a Forecasting Leaderboard Can Establish: Resolution Reporting for Zero-Shot Time-Series Models

**abstract/A1：** A foundation model for time series is pretrained once and then asked to forecast series it has never seen, so the evidence for it is its score on held-out datasets. Such datasets are scarce, and a few public leaderboards carry most comparisons, yet none of them states how small a difference its datasets can detect. We call that quantity the resolution of a board and introduce Vernier, a tool that computes it from the files a board already publishes. Vernier also reports which entries a board cannot separate from its leader and whether its order changes when unrelated parties submit. GIFT-Eval resolves 6.8 rank places, and its displayed neighbours sit 0.91 apart. The ten places of its top ten hold fewer than two resolvable steps. fev-bench, Chronos Benchmark II and TIME show the same pattern: their resolution is 3.6 to 19 times the gap between neighbours. With each of its 2,554 series as an independent source, BOOM is the one board that resolves its top ten. Below the resolution the order depends on who else submitted: across four boards, rules that rank against the pool reversed 43 top-ten pairs with neither entry rerun, in one update in seven. Boards also do not record how much history a model receives. On 70 configurations, shortening it raised the error of three of four open models, two of them by 15%. We release Vernier, which runs this report with one command on any leaderboard that publishes per-dataset scores: https://github.com/therealram18/vernier

**comment/C1：** Oral presentation at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems (FMTS). 15 pages, 3 figures, 10 tables. Code: https://github.com/therealram18/vernier

</details>

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** E2SIM 是一个长时段用户行为模拟框架，把行为者内部状态的演化与共享环境的动态变化用「即时行动—延迟结果—个体特异观测」的反馈回路耦合起来，并提出一套衡量长程轨迹动态一致性与事件推进的诊断指标。

**相关性简评：** 其「个体特异观测」与状态、世界更新相互制约的设计，可能为 LVR 中部分可观测下的信念状态维护、以及 latent 状态长程漂移的评价提供概念线索；但论文不含视觉或多模态推理，借鉴需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** E2SIM: Long-Horizon Simulation of Everyday Human Behavior with Evolving States

**abstract/A1：** AI agents are increasingly expected to support users over long periods, across work, and daily life. This requires modeling not only who users are, but also how their goals, interests, activities, and interactions evolve over time. A challenge in longitudinal user simulation is maintaining consistency between these evolving states and the consequences of actions in a shared environment. We introduce E2SIM, a longitudinal user simulation framework that jointly models evolving actor states and a dynamic shared environment. E2SIM connects actor-state updates with shared-world changes through a feedback loop linking immediate actions, delayed outcomes, and actor-specific observations across work and life. This allows the consequences of earlier actions to shape later behavior, while preserving differences in what each actor knows. We further propose a suite of longitudinal trajectory diagnostics, measuring dynamic consistency, coherent event progression and collaboration, and non-degenerate trajectory development rather than static consistency alone. In one 60-day simulation, E2SIM produced more extracted event threads judged meaningful by our evaluator and fewer near-duplicate actions than four direct-generation baselines. The framework and evaluation methods provide a basis for studying longitudinal user simulation, with potential applications in training and evaluating AI agents that assist users over extended periods.

</details>

### 287. [Constructing physical mechanisms with artificial intelligence](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31653v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31653

**作者：** Vladimir A. Baulin、Austin Cook、Shagor Rahman

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cond-mat.soft

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31653v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31653v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 构建 equation-native 系统读取约 250 万篇 arXiv 论文中的方程，将散落在推导各步的机制信息编译出来，并用确定性计算跨学科地拆分、迁移、展开、组合机制部件，把「部件不匹配」的失败转化为缺失项的方程。

**相关性简评：** 其「拆解—迁移—重组」的机制构造与以失配定位缺失项的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的可组合结构、中间步骤贡献分配提供概念类比；但该工作不涉及视觉或多模态推理，线索需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Constructing physical mechanisms with artificial intelligence

**abstract/A1：** Mechanisms recur across the sciences: the equation for heat in a solid also describes molecular diffusion or a Brownian particle. A mechanism is rarely written in one equation; its operation, boundaries, parameters and closures are stated at different steps of a derivation, where methods that read text or fit formulas miss it. We built an equation-native system that reads the equations of all 2.5 million arXiv manuscripts, and show that mechanisms can be compiled from them and constructed by deterministic calculation. A constructor detaches, transfers, unfolds, composes and joins their parts across disciplines; where parts do not fit, the failure is an equation for the missing term. Constructions turn a threshold reactor into a memory that a weak signal writes, an oscillator into a switch through two changes that each fail alone, and a rhythm into the regulator of a chemical amount, each with conditions for an experimental test.

</details>

<a id="paper-288"></a>

### 288. [BRAG: Bayesian Retrieval Augmented Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31656v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31656

**作者：** Javier Movellan、Manjot Bilkhu、Young-mok Jung、Sirajul Salekin、Henry Tran、Zhao Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31656v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31656v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** BRAG 把文本记忆检索建成带隐效用的生成模型：每个 chunk 由锚定其 embedding 的 von Mises-Fisher 混合生成查询，效用随时间漂移，作者给出闭式滤波在线更新，并把检索表述为控制问题，说明已有反馈检索方法均为其特例。

**相关性简评：** 虽属文本 RAG 记忆场景，但其「隐效用状态的在线贝叶斯滤波 + 检索作为控制问题」的框架，可能为 LVR 中的多 latent 假设维护、视觉证据筛选与停止决策提供可核查的概念线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BRAG: Bayesian Retrieval Augmented Generation

**abstract/A1：** Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) ranks memory chunks by semantic similarity to the query. Many methods improve on this by learning from feedback on what was retrieved, but each is a separate heuristic, with no account of when it is the right choice. We introduce BRAG, a generative model of retrieval with use. Each chunk generates the queries it answers from a mixture of von Mises-Fisher components anchored at its original embedding, and each chunk has a latent utility that drifts over time. The model gives the optimal inference, a closed-form filter that stores a few keys and two scalars per chunk and updates them online from the labels of a curator, and it frames retrieval as a control problem. It also shows when existing methods are optimal. Query averaging, Rocchio-style feedback and frequency reranking are special cases with fixed parameters, NUDGE is the case of one key per chunk with no dynamics, and LADER the limit of one key per past query. On two public long-term memory benchmarks, BRAG matches these methods on queries asked before, as expected, because when nothing changes over time the assumptions behind these special cases hold. On harder problems, where a new chunk makes an old one obsolete, BRAG outscores them. They all stay at plain-search level (Recall@5 0.67-0.71), while BRAG retrieves the new chunk 0.80-0.86 of the time. We also ran BRAG on three of NUDGE's seven text benchmarks, and it matches or beats NUDGE on all three. On nine months of a personal agent's memory (20,640 chunks), BRAG raises Recall@5 on held-out queries from 0.75 to 0.98 and Recall@1 from 0.44 to 0.97, with little change on chunks never queried.

</details>

### 289. [A Piecewise-Linear Activation Function for Implicit Neural Representations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31666v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31666

**作者：** Shahd Hekal、Joram Kim、Jeova Farias Sales Rocha Neto

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31666v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31666v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 JaSIN——一类有界分段线性激活函数，在 ReLU 与分段线性正弦之间插值，用于坐标网络式隐式表示；实验考察有界性、单峰与峰居中、振荡次数对图像重建 PSNR 的影响，并利用 INR 仅在评估网格上拟合的性质无损失地删除可证不活跃单元。

**相关性简评：** 该文与 VLM 推理无直接关系，但其有界分段线性激活与「振荡次数」控制可供核查：内部表示中视觉细节的保留与频谱容量是否受激活形式约束；「前激活不触及激活支撑即可证单元在整个域上不活跃」的论证，也可能为判断 latent 或单元是否实际参与输出、贡献分配提供一种可验证的静态判据。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Piecewise-Linear Activation Function for Implicit Neural Representations

**abstract/A1：** Coordinate networks with ReLU activations perform poorly on implicit neural representation tasks, and the activations that address this, such as sinusoids and Gabor wavelets, all leave the piecewise-linear function class, so it remains unclear which property of ReLU is at fault. We introduce JaSIN, a family of bounded piecewise-linear activations that interpolates between ReLU and a piecewise-linear sinusoid without any the use of transcendental operation. Our results show that a bounded range improves image reconstruction PSNR on average by 0.06 dB, a single bump 3.29 dB, and centering that bump a further 3.64 dB. The oscillation count improves 6.30 dB more, raising ReLU from 24.0 to 37.3 dB on Kodak images, placing third over eleven activations, within 1.3 dB of the state-of-the-art, though beyond four oscillations the reconstruction collapses. Because an INR is fit on the grid on which it is evaluated, a unit whose pre-activations never reach the support of its activation is certifiably inactive over the entire domain; deleting such units is lossless without fine-tuning, removing up to 84% of parameters at zero loss in performance (dB) and decoding 3.2 times faster. Reference code and demos are available at https://github.com/jeovafarias/jasin.

**comment/C1：** 5 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027. Code: https://github.com/jeovafarias/jasin

</details>

### 290. [Medical Image Segmentation Is Now Just Another Coding Task](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31673v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31673

**作者：** Shuheng Cao、Ruiqi Chen、Qizhen Lan、Edward Wang、Xiyun Hu、Yilei Wang、Juqy Chen、Weilin Huang、Anhong Guo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31673v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31673v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文展示四个现成编码代理仅凭任务描述、标注数据和 CPU 就能为 13 个医学分割任务自动编写分割程序，并进一步研究代理能否通过检查自身预测的渲染图来修订分割；结果显示真正的瓶颈是缺少无参考的质量信号，并称之为「quality blind spot」。

**相关性简评：** 「无参考质量估计」作为代理自我修订、判断是否继续改进的决策信号，可能与 LVR 中自验证、视觉证据筛选及停止/计算分配问题存在概念联系，可供核查；但研究对象是代码生成的分割流水线而非 latent 推理状态，联系仅为启发层面。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Medical Image Segmentation Is Now Just Another Coding Task

**abstract/A1：** For decades, every new medical image segmentation task has needed an expert, a dedicated architecture, and a framework such as nnU-Net. This is no longer the case: medical image segmentation is now just another coding task. Given only a task description, labeled data, and a CPU (with no segmentation framework, no pretrained weights, and no human in the loop), four off-the-shelf coding agents built segmenters for 13 tasks across four imaging modalities within hours, an ability that has emerged rather than been built. On the nine 2D tasks, their best programs reach 99% of the Dice of a GPU-trained nnU-Net. Like any code, a segmenter improves by being revised and checked, so we ask how far the same agents can improve their own segmentations and what unlocks further gains. On unseen cases there is no reference, so the agents inspect renderings of their own predictions: this alone lifts the worst tenth of cases by 0.09 Dice and cuts boundary error (HD95) by almost a quarter. Far more is within reach. Told the true Dice of each attempt, the same agents improve in all 14 matched pairs, rescue 85% of failed masks instead of 30%, and surpass the GPU-trained nnU-Net on average, by producing better masks rather than by choosing among them. What unlocks these gains is a quality signal, which neither visual inspection, nor more rounds, nor a quality estimator trained by the agents themselves yet supplies: we call this the quality blind spot. The ability to build and to repair is already present; the next advance will come not from another segmentation model, but from reference-free quality estimation that coding agents can call.

</details>

### 291. [CROSS-Calib: Selective Channel Calibration for Ultrasound Reconstruction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31684v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31684

**作者：** Tongxiao Hu、Junyu Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31684v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31684v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 CROSS-Calib，一种超声通道恢复方法：以其他通道的预测作为幅相校准参考，并用上下文门控选择性地将校准测量与预测回波融合，在波束成形前修复不可靠样本、保留可用样本。

**相关性简评：** 其「预测与实测之间的可靠性门控、按样本选择性保留或修补」的机制，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与何时信任证据而非 latent 先验的问题提供概念类比，但领域与任务相距较远，需核查其门控判据能否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CROSS-Calib: Selective Channel Calibration for Ultrasound Reconstruction

**abstract/A1：** Ultrasound imaging provides views of internal tissue in real time for medical diagnosis. However, ultrasound signals may be affected by interference, and correcting errors and removing transient interference while preserving valid echoes remains challenging. We propose CROSS-Calib, a channel recovery method that uses predictions from other channels as references for amplitude and phase calibration, while a gate using context selectively combines calibrated measurements with predicted echoes to retain usable samples and repair unreliable ones. On the in vivo test set, CROSS-Calib outperforms all baseline models under gain errors and transient interference, while phantom tests show that the model restores cyst contrast with echo widths of wire targets close to the clean reference. CROSS-Calib can perform channel calibration and selective repair before beamforming to improve echo usability and image quality.

</details>

### 292. [GRUN: Generalized Retinex Unfolding Network for Image Restoration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31690v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31690

**作者：** Rihan Zhang、Fengyang Xiao、Yuhan Chen、Chunming He、Sina Farsiu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31690v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31690v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将经典 Retinex 的照明-反射分解推广为内容-环境因子先验，提出 MAP 引导的 K 阶段深度展开网络 GRUN，交替执行反射恢复、照明估计与退化推断，并用结合互信息最小化、梯度去相关与尺度锚定的耦合正则促使两因子互补。

**相关性简评：** 其分阶段交替状态更新与防止因子坍缩的解耦正则，可能为 LVR 中推理状态与视觉细节表征的分离及信息坍缩诊断提供可核查线索；但属像素级复原任务，与多模态推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GRUN: Generalized Retinex Unfolding Network for Image Restoration

**abstract/A1：** Image restoration remains a fundamental challenge in low-level vision, requiring methods that handle diverse degradations while preserving scene structures and details. We revisit classical Retinex theory and propose a Generalized Retinex formulation that extends the illumination-reflectance decomposition into a Retinex-inspired content-environment factorization prior for image restoration. The key idea is to restore images using two learned factors: a content-dominant response (generalized reflectance) capturing scene properties and an environment-side response (generalized illumination) encoding task-dependent variations associated with the observed degradations. Based on this formulation, we develop GRUN (Generalized Retinex Unfolding Network), a MAP-guided deep unfolding framework that alternates reflectance restoration, illumination estimation, and progressive degradation inference across K stages with degradation-conditioned proximal operators. We further introduce a Degradation-aware Coupling Regularizer (DCR) that combines mutual information minimization, gradient decorrelation, and scale anchoring to promote complementary content-environment factor representations. Experiments on seven image restoration tasks, including denoising, dehazing, deraining, low-light enhancement, deblurring, underwater enhancement, and backlit enhancement, demonstrate competitive results on multiple benchmarks using the same architecture with task-specific weights. Moreover, the proposed Generalized Retinex design can be integrated into existing restoration methods, demonstrating its cross-architecture applicability. Code will be released.

</details>

### 293. [E-Waste-Bench: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Visual Triage of Data-Center Hardware](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31703v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31703

**作者：** Nader Lobandi、Mohammad Mehdi Hosseini、Lombe Chileshe、Mohammad Mahoor

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31703v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31703v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文构建 E-Waste-Bench：从九个公开电子废弃物图像集与网页抓取中整理出 32.8 万张照片，标注类别、粒度、损伤状况与印刷编号，用开放权重 VLM 智能体辅助筛选新来源，并在近万张人工标注测试集上评测分类、状况判断、检测、文字感知与跨数据集迁移。

**相关性简评：** 其「遮挡下的状况判断＋读取印刷编号」多属性标签或可作为 VLM 是否保留并实际使用细粒度视觉证据的诊断资源，且近重复分组划分发现泄漏可高估 3.0 点的结论，对 latent/视觉推理基准的评测设计可供核查；但论文本身不做内部状态或 latent 分析。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** E-Waste-Bench: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Visual Triage of Data-Center Hardware

**abstract/A1：** Retired data-center hardware can often be refurbished or resold, but triage demands more than object categories. A model must tell visually similar parts apart, judge condition under damage and occlusion, and read the printed part number. We audit nine public e-waste collections. They cover mostly consumer devices (only 10% of images are labeled as a data-center part), label neither condition nor printed text, and contain 42% exact or augmented duplicates. We introduce E-Waste-Bench, 328K photographs drawn from 762K deduplicated images and labeled for class (24 classes), granularity, condition and printed text. Images come from those collections and the web, where a recipe-based crawler works beside an agent built on an open-weight vision-language model. The agent vets new sources and reads sites the crawler cannot parse, and both are steered toward under-represented classes. Training labels are model-made, splits follow near-duplicate groups, and human annotators label a test set of nearly 10,000 images. We benchmark classification, condition, detection, text perception and cross-dataset transfer. On this test set, a ConvNeXt-T trained on E-Waste-Bench reaches 64.3% top-1, against 31.5% with the public collections alone. Near-duplicate leakage inflates top-1 by 3.0 points under model-made test labels but by less than 0.1 under human labels, so model-labeled benchmarks need group splits. Accuracy falls to 42.1% on marketplace and auction photographs, the closest proxy for hardware leaving service. Data and code will be released.

**comment/C1：** 30 figures, 22 tables. Includes supplementary material

</details>

### 294. [Reproducing History Is Not Enough: Intervention-Level Assurance for LLM-Generated Simulators](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31736v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31736

**作者：** Ashraf Abdul-Muumin、Aniruddha Chattopadhyay、Noorbakhsh Golilarz、Kaushik Roy

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31736v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31736v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Vouch，把每个 what-if 问题转成结构化变更，检查 LLM 生成的流程仿真程序对该干预给出的答案是否可信，并记录各程序已通过或失败的变更类型以便复用，在制造、IT 运维、医药与贷款流程等四个领域做了评测。

**相关性简评：** 其「干预是否施加到问题所指的记录、策略修订后是否仍有效」的逐干预校验与测试复用思路，可能启发 LVR 中核查 latent 编辑或视觉证据是否真正作用于问题相关实体、状态更新后答案是否仍可信的问题，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reproducing History Is Not Enough: Intervention-Level Assurance for LLM-Generated Simulators

**abstract/A1：** Large language models can now write simulation programs of operational processes and workflows. These programs can be reused to answer what-if questions on new records and policies. However, a program that reproduces recorded history can still give wrong answers to what-if questions; requested changes may be applied wrongly, or they may be applied to records other than the ones the question is about, or the program may stop being valid once its policy is revised. Current checks return a pass-or-fail verdict for the whole program, which says little about whether any single answer can be trusted. We propose Vouch, a library that judges whether an answer from a generated simulator can be trusted for the change being asked about. Each what-if question is turned into a structured change, which is checked against the program and the current records. The library also keeps a record of the kinds of change each program has passed or failed, and repeats the relevant tests whenever the program is reused. We apply it to three program-generation platforms, with programs built by five language models, across four domains: manufacturing, IT operations, and pharmacy and loan-application workflows, using independently checked reference answers. Our baselines are the platforms' own checks where such checks exist, an LLM-as-a-judge, and a ReAct agent that can run the program. We measure how many correct answers are trusted, how many are wrongly rejected, how many wrong answers are accepted, and what the checking costs. On programs written by Haiku and Sonnet in one platform, Vouch removes 97.6% of the wrong answers, while still trusting 80.1% of all answers. At equal coverage, it accepts fewer wrong answers than LLM judges built on Claude Haiku. We disclose code and results for reproducibility.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages

</details>

### 295. [Xtream: An Explicit Metric State for Large-Scale Streaming Reconstruction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31757v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31757

**作者：** Ernesto Lozano、Alberto Jaenal、Javier Civera

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31757v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31757v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Xtream，一个混合流式重建管线：以关键帧上的因子图维护显式度量状态，3D 基础模型仅作几何前端，并借助度量尺度预测或惯性测量补足单目几何缺失的尺度可观测性以抑制漂移。

**相关性简评：** 其「显式状态＋因子图」与递归隐式记忆的对比，可能为 LVR 中长跨度推理状态的显式维护、漂移与状态更新提供概念参照；但该工作面向三维重建而非 VLM 推理，联系需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Xtream: An Explicit Metric State for Large-Scale Streaming Reconstruction

**abstract/A1：** 3D foundation models (3DFMs) enable dense reconstruction in a feed-forward pass, yet their effective span is limited by cross-view attention. Local consistency has been expanded through geometric alignment of video chunks and recursive updates of an implicit memory, and large-scale scenes with pose graphs. However, both strategies are prone to drift, largely due to the lack of metric-scale observability from monocular geometry. We present Xtream,a hybrid streaming pipeline that maintains an explicit metric state through a factor graph over keyframes, while using a 3DFM as a geometric front end. Xtream incorporates metric information in two ways: through metric scale predictions from 3DFMs; or through inertial measurements if available. Across the large-scale benchmarks of VBR, Oxford Spires and KITTI, Xtream achieves state-of-the-art performance in 3DFM-based online reconstruction, reducing average absolute trajectory errors compared with published baselines and concurrent work. https://ernestolozano.github.io/xtream

### 296. [A Well-Posed Fourth-Order Navier-Stokes Model for Image Inpainting: Theory, Order Selection, and Stripe Decomposition](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31777v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31777

**作者：** Yiwen Dou、Yiqiang Ding、Zhongyun Bao、Senyan Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、eess.IV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31777v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31777v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文为 Bertalmío–Bertozzi–Sapiro 的 Navier-Stokes 图像修复模型构造良定的四阶扩展：在涡量-流函数形式下加入带门控的四阶项，论证反向形式为 Hadamard 不适定且有害、正向形式一致抛物且能量稳定，并给出奇阶色散/偶阶耗散的阶数-耗散原则；另以 Telea 底填加交错狭缝 NS 迭代处理大块缺失。

**相关性简评：** 该工作本身与 VLM 推理无直接关联，但其对迭代状态更新的适定性/能量稳定性判别（正向稳、反向反扩散发散）以及门控失效后改用结构性分块填充的思路，或可作为 latent 状态循环更新稳定性与缺失证据分阶段补全的类比线索，需核查其可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Well-Posed Fourth-Order Navier-Stokes Model for Image Inpainting: Theory, Order Selection, and Stripe Decomposition

**abstract/A1：** The Navier-Stokes (NS) inpainting model of Bertalmío, Bertozzi and Sapiro is the only transport-type paradigm among PDE-based methods, yet it has never received a systematic higher-order extension. We show that the obvious fourth-order correction is ill-posed, and we construct the corrected, well-posed model. In the vorticity-streamfunction formulation we add a gated fourth-order term whose sign is decisive: the backward form is a Perona-Malik-type anti-diffusion, Hadamard ill-posed and consistently harmful in experiments, whereas the forward form is uniformly parabolic, energy-stable and consistently beneficial. An order-dissipation principle, stating that odd orders are dispersive and even orders dissipative, singles out the fourth order as the lowest admissible one. Large missing blocks pose a separate problem, because the correction gate stays silent there; we answer it with stripe decomposition, a Telea base fill followed by interleaved slit-wise NS passes, which converts block damage into the structural-slit regime where the model excels. The device is base-agnostic, and its gains add to those of the forward correction. On three datasets, namely BSDS500, DIV2K and a classical Chinese painting benchmark, and on three damage types, namely cracks, blocks and text occlusion, the training-free model beats every classical baseline on every sample of structure-dominated damage, gains +1.02 dB PSNR over Telea on the full 42-image painting test set with a 42/42 per-sample win rate, matches the strongest recent PDE solvers within 0.4 dB while attaining the best perceptual quality of the entire PDE family, and runs at 4-16 s per image on a consumer GPU.

**comment/C1：** 33 pages, 11 figures, 10 tables

</details>

### 297. [AGL-SKILL: Coding Harnesses as Agentic Optimizers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31794v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31794

**作者：** Ryan Tsui、Yuge Zhang、Yuqing Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31794v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31794v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将 skill（可复用的工作流、代码与提示）视为可编辑的优化对象，用 coding agent 自身在给定评价指标下迭代改写 skill，并在五个基准上超过已发表的 skill 优化方法。

**相关性简评：** 其“以指标为信号、由 agent 自行搜索并改写行为上下文”的闭环，或可启发 LVR 中对推理脚手架与 latent 推理策略的自动调优及监督分配，但作用面是文本 skill 而非内部状态，需核查能否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AGL-SKILL: Coding Harnesses as Agentic Optimizers

**abstract/A1：** Frontier models are increasingly used through harnesses as agents, with growing autonomy to do useful work. Agent performance can often be enhanced by the use of skills: reusable workflows, code, and prompts that provide task-related information or guide the behaviour of the model. Skills, being textual in nature, present themselves as another editable surface to be optimized; current methods have improved on handcrafting and one-shot generation by treating skill development as an iterative process, using score-driven search to tweak and improve performance. In this paper, we demonstrate the efficacy of the agents themselves as optimizers: across five benchmarks, a coding agent without guidance substantially improves every target and outperforms published skill-optimization methods. More broadly, this shows the capability of agents to do such work and to refine their own behaviour to provide task-specific context, as long as they are given a metric to measure against.

### 298. [Constructive Causal Abstraction and a Case Study in Mechanistic Interpretability](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31795v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31795

**作者：** Yuchen Zhu、Sergio Hernan Garrido Mejia、Dominik Janzing

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31795v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31795v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将定义不良的宏观干预视为宏观层面缺失变量，引入保留被遗漏因果状态的互补变量 q，提出 Constructive Causal Abstraction 框架：线性情形给出 q 的唯一形式与实现存在条件，非线性情形给出基于 ODE 的构造算法；并以 Bias-in-Bios 案例区分模型审计与编辑，用该框架解释「可解释性幻觉」。

**相关性简评：** 其「缺失变量＋宏观干预一致性」形式化可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留任务必要视觉信息、以及编辑/探测子空间与真实信号通路不匹配（可解释性幻觉）提供核查工具，具体适用性尚待阅读原文判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Constructive Causal Abstraction and a Case Study in Mechanistic Interpretability

**abstract/A1：** Existing frameworks in causal abstraction first propose a high-level causal model, and then verify whether its interventional effects agree with those of a given micro-level model - the two models are declared causally consistent when the discrepancy is zero. However, proposing a consistent macro causal model is difficult, because macro causal relations are almost never well-defined, since distinct micro-level interventions associated with the same apparent macro intervention can produce different effects. Our central insight is that causally consistent macro-level models can be obtained constructively: ill-defined macro interventions can be interpreted as missing variables on the macro level, and can be accounted for by introducing a complementary variable q that retains omitted causally relevant state. In the linear case, q has a unique form and we provide sufficient conditions for valid implementations to exist; in the nonlinear case, we provide an ODE-based algorithm for constructing implementations. We call this framework Constructive Causal Abstraction (CCA), and use CCA to formulate the difference between machine-learning model auditing and editing. With the Bias-in-Bios biographies dataset, we demonstrate that CCA allows practitioners to articulate assumptions when detecting the model's gender bias. Finally, CCA resolves a well-known paradox known as "interpretability illusion" which points to a mismatch between the subspace for editing and the one where the model implements a signal-to-output pathway.

</details>

### 299. [A Generative AI Agent to Emulate Interactive Human-driven Vehicles for Automated Driving Testing in Urban Areas](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31797v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31797

**作者：** Jia Hu、Changjian Yu、Panqu Wang、Jaehyun So、Yang Chang、Xuerun Yan、Jintao Lai

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31797v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31797v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出生成式 AI 代理模拟城市中人类驾驶车辆的交互行为，用视野遮挡建模、贯穿初/中/末阶段的五项交互指标、动态混合专家网络与残差强化学习生成安全关键交互轨迹，并在 INTERACTION 数据集上显著降低与真实分布的差异。

**相关性简评：** 其遮挡条件下的可观测性建模与多风格专家混合，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、部分可观测下的状态表示与多样性轨迹监督提供线索，但跨领域迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Generative AI Agent to Emulate Interactive Human-driven Vehicles for Automated Driving Testing in Urban Areas

**abstract/A1：** Realistic modeling of human-driven vehicle (HDV) interactions is essential for automated driving safety testing in urban areas. Existing methods struggle to reproduce realistic safety-critical interactions involving high collision risk for the following reasons: they often assume full observability, overlooking interactions arising from occlusion. Driving styles are mainly characterized by vehicle maneuvers, limiting the diversity of safety-critical interaction behaviors. Moreover, learning signals from safety-critical interactions can be diluted by non-critical driving behaviors. To address these issues, we propose a generative AI agent to emulate interactive HDVs. The agent incorporates field-of-view modeling to account for driver visibility under occlusion and characterizes the interaction process using five metrics spanning its initial, intermediate, and final stages. It automatically learns diverse interaction styles through a dynamic mixture-of-experts network. Through residual reinforcement learning, the agent further refines generated trajectories to match the real-world distributions of safety-critical interaction characteristics. Experiments on the INTERACTION dataset show that our method reduces Jensen--Shannon divergence (JSD) by 39.9\\%--87.1\\% across five interaction characteristics compared with a state-of-the-art baseline. Our method achieves greater improvements of up to 87.1\\% in final-stage interaction metrics, suggesting that it can reduce error accumulation in long-horizon trajectory generation. Ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of each proposed component, particularly highlighting the importance of residual refinement. Generalization experiments show that our method approaches the performance of full training on unseen intersections with only one epoch of fine-tuning.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 5 figures

</details>

### 300. [SceneMemBench: A Benchmark for Scene Memory in Interactive Video World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31803v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31803

**作者：** Yuheng Si、Linye Lyu、Jiawei Zhou、Lingyi Du、Nanfei Ye、Aobo Liu、Yu Liu、Yu Li、Cheng Zhuo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31803v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31803v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SceneMemBench，用 600 条受控轨迹（33 个 Unreal 场景）与 60 个完整交互案例评估交互式视频世界模型的场景记忆，区分已见视角回忆与新视角恢复，并在共享真值历史上续跑以隔离记忆与轨迹跟随误差。

**相关性简评：** 「受控历史续跑」与「完整 rollout」的对照诊断，可能为 LVR 中把内部状态所保留的视觉／几何信息与累积生成退化、轨迹漂移分离提供评测思路；但对象是视频世界模型生成，与 VLM 推理期 latent 使用联系较间接，需核查其指标是否可用于状态内容诊断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SceneMemBench: A Benchmark for Scene Memory in Interactive Video World Models

**abstract/A1：** Interactive video world models generate navigable worlds frame by frame, but a persistent world requires previously observed scenes to remain recoverable as users move away and return. Existing memory evaluations, however, often focus on seen-view revisits and full rollouts, leaving cross-view scene recovery underexplored while entangling memory with trajectory-following errors and accumulated generation degradation. We introduce SceneMemBench, a benchmark for scene memory in interactive video world models. It evaluates two complementary dimensions: seen-view recall versus novel-view recovery, and controlled diagnosis versus end-to-end interaction. We introduce Continued Rollout from a shared ground-truth observation history, alongside Full Rollout over complete model-generated interactions. SceneMemBench contains 600 controlled trajectories across 33 Unreal Engine scenes and 60 Full Rollout cases, covering eight representative open- and closed-source models. We evaluate scene recovery along subject consistency, appearance fidelity, and geometric consistency. Results show that novel-view recovery is generally more challenging than seen-view recall, while model profiles under controlled histories can differ markedly from those observed in full interaction. Together, these findings reveal complementary failure modes obscured by seen-view revisits or end-to-end rollouts alone.

**comment/C1：** 32 pages, 14 figures, 23 tables. Project page: https://yuheng-si.github.io/SceneMemBench/

</details>

### 301. [GaokaoMathGen: Chinese Gaokao Mathematics Finale Problem Generation Controlled by Latent Reasoning Structures](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31823v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31823

**作者：** Qian Chen、Kun Zhu、Zhongyi Wang、Ling Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31823v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31823v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 GaokaoMathGen，从种子题中抽取标准化的「潜在推理结构」（技能、方法、核心恒等式、关键步骤），并以此作为结构控制生成高考数学压轴题，同时用逻辑质量过滤、固定 solver 解码开销与结构特征估计实际难度。

**相关性简评：** 其「潜在推理结构」只是数据侧的推理骨架标注而非模型内部状态，但「用解题轨迹骨架约束生成」与「以 solver 解码开销度量难度」可能为 LVR 的轨迹监督设计和 THINK 成本—收益评估提供可核查的参照。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GaokaoMathGen: Chinese Gaokao Mathematics Finale Problem Generation Controlled by Latent Reasoning Structures

**abstract/A1：** Generating Chinese Gaokao mathematics finale problems requires controlling not only the included skills, but also the underlying mathematical kernel and solution path. Existing LLM-based methods mainly rely on surface-level specifications, while the realized difficulty of generated problems cannot be determined directly from prompted targets. Therefore, we propose GaokaoMathGen, a framework for Chinese Gaokao mathematics finale problem generation controlled by latent reasoning structures. It extracts standardized latent reasoning structures from seed problems and performs constrained synthesis using skills, methods, a core identity, and a pivot step as structural controls. We further estimate realized difficulty through logical-quality filtering, fixed-solver decoding effort, structural features, and solver-output search signals. Experiments show that semantic normalization improves cross-annotator comparability and that 78.0% of 609 scored candidates pass the logical-quality filter. In a teacher audit of the 60 highest-effort candidates, all were judged to reach finale or penultimate problem difficulty, and only one exhibited a severe logical issue. These results support latent reasoning structures as effective control signals for generating high-difficulty mathematical problems.

**comment/C1：** 13 pages, 1 figure, 16 tables, including the technical supplement

</details>

### 302. [Not All Interpretation Methods Are Created Equal: Tiered Evaluation of AI Interpretability](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31833v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31833

**作者：** Nicolas Sanchez、Bin Yu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.HC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31833v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31833v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TRUST 分层评估框架，按五个层级为可解释性方法评定证据可信度，并以迭代随机森林（iRF）为案例演示该评估流程。

**相关性简评：** 其「证据层级、范围可迁移性、前瞻验证」的分级思路，可能为核查 latent 状态解释是否成立、是否真正承载任务信息提供评价视角，但论文针对通用可解释性方法而非 VLM 推理机制，需较多迁移核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Not All Interpretation Methods Are Created Equal: Tiered Evaluation of AI Interpretability

**abstract/A1：** As AI transitions to sociotechnical deployments, uninterpretable models pose serious threats to reliability, public trust and contestability. However, not all interpretation methods are created equal: for interpretability to enhance deployment safety and effectiveness, interpretation methods must be evaluated in a tiered system to differentiate evidence levels of trustworthiness, rather than validated through isolated interpretation instances. Our core vision is that elevating the evaluation of interpretation methods to a core AI assessment metric will drive robust knowledge discovery from data (KDD) and ensure safe, contestable sociotechnical deployments of AI. To this end, we propose TRUST, a tiered evaluation framework that builds upon the Predictability-Computability-Stability (PCS) principles for Veridical Data Science (VDS) and the Predictive, Descriptive and Relevant (PDR) foundations. To differentiate interpretation methods effectively and systematically, TRUST grades interpretation across five tiers: Task-Aligned PDR Foundations, Rigorous Epistemic Grounding, Unifying Semantic Understanding, Scope Transferability, and Targeted Prospective Validation. We present a start-to-finish case study of the iterative Random Forest (iRF) family under TRUST and contrast it with other LLM interpretation methods that struggle to clear specific tiers. Finally, we conclude with brief initial thoughts on how TRUST principles can extend in autonomous agentic frameworks. Ultimately, the TRUST framework fosters contestability and epistemic grounding as foundational evaluation principles for human-machine workflows and, eventually, autonomous agentic workflows.

</details>

### 303. [Start Where the Data Are: Statistical Priors for One-Step Generation on Manifolds](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31856v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31856

**作者：** Yuyao Wang、Haoliang Sun、Xiankai Lu、Xinxin Zhang、Yongshun Gong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31856v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31856v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究流形上的一步生成，提出以切空间高斯混合估计数据统计先验，并通过后验耦合为每个数据点条件采样潜分量与配对噪声，再用隐马尔可夫先验扩展到长扭转角链。

**相关性简评：** 其「条件采样潜分量 + 序列隐状态先验」的构造或可为 LVR 的 latent 状态初始化、序列依赖与潜变量监督提供线索，但该工作面向流形生成而非视觉多模态推理，迁移可行性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Start Where the Data Are: Statistical Priors for One-Step Generation on Manifolds

**abstract/A1：** Fast generation on manifolds is important for scientific applications such as protein design, yet existing one-step generators often produce spurious samples in low-density gaps between data modes. Our analysis highlights the mismatch between uniform noise and concentrated data, motivating a statistical prior that captures the data's coarse structure. We first estimate this prior by fitting mixtures of tangent-space Gaussians through geometry-aware moment matching. However, independent noise-data pairing can still connect different modes and weaken the benefit of the fitted prior. We therefore introduce posterior coupling, which samples a latent component conditioned on each data point and draws its paired noise from that component. To extend this approach to long torsion-angle chains, where full-covariance mixtures become costly, we use a hidden Markov prior to model sequential dependence with shared parameters. The resulting framework plugs into existing one-step training pipelines while retaining the generator architecture, training objective, and single network evaluation at inference. Experiments on spheres, tori, and SO(3) demonstrate substantial improvements across multiple generators, reducing distributional error by up to $125\\times$ and the protein Ramachandran outlier rate from 12.1% to 0.55%.

**comment/C1：** 33 pages (8 main + references + 22 supplementary), 22 figures, 24 tables. Code: https://github.com/olivia3395/statprior-onestep

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其「带证据问答」的合成流程与基于量规的评测，可能为 LVR 中如何构造并验证「答案确实使用证据」的推理轨迹提供线索；但该工作仅限代码文本，无视觉输入与 latent 状态，需人工核查可迁移性。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RepoEviAgent: Scalable Synthesis of Evidence-Grounded Repository-Level Question Answering Tasks

**abstract/A1：** Real-world software engineering (SWE) tasks require agents to understand repository structures, cross-module dependencies, and runtime behaviors, posing significant challenges for constructing high-quality training and evaluation data. To address this, we propose RepoEviAgent, a scalable SWE data construction framework that integrates quality-aware data curation and role-specialized multi-agent task synthesis. Starting from 8,477 open-source repositories and approximately 2.48 million pull request records, we employ semantic alignment, complexity constraints, and multidimensional quality assessment to identify valuable SWE data. We further develop a sandbox-based multi-agent framework that integrates automated environment construction, execution validation, repository exploration, and evidence-grounded Q&amp;A synthesis. Based on this framework, we construct RepoEviQA, a benchmark for Repository-Level Evidence-Grounded Question Answering, comprising 334 tasks across five programming languages and diverse SWE categories, with rigorous rubric-based evaluation. We evaluate five frontier coding models on RepoEviQA, revealing substantial performance differences across task categories and programming languages.

</details>

### 305. [EEG-Jev: A Unified Single-Pass Decision Model for EEG](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31875v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31875

**作者：** Zhifei Zhu、Hongtao Zhang、Yu Ren、Wei Zhou、Zeping Xie、Yi He

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、physics.bio-ph

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31875v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31875v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 EEG-Jev：给定 EEG 窗口、问题与答案规格，单次前向即输出带类型的读出（CHOICE 候选分布、NOUL 命题概率、SCORE 有序等级分布与期望），一个检查点联合训练并在 35 个公共数据源上评估，另做先验校正与温度缩放校准。

**相关性简评：** 其「单次前向直接读出＋概率校准」并与生成式解码对比延迟的做法，可能为 LVR 中内部状态如何被答案读出使用、单步停止与置信度校准提供参照，但属远领域且无视觉/多模态推理，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EEG-Jev: A Unified Single-Pass Decision Model for EEG

**abstract/A1：** EEG analysis spans choosing alternatives, judging statements, and rating ordered attributes, requiring calibratable probabilities with explicit meaning. We present EEG-Jev, a unified single-pass decision model for EEG. Given an EEG window, a question and an answer specification, one forward pass returns a typed readout: CHOICE gives a candidate distribution, NOUL a proposition probability, and SCORE an ordered-level distribution and expectation. One checkpoint is trained jointly and evaluated once on held-out splits of 35 public sources. Core raw outputs reach 54.08% balanced accuracy on Stieger2021 motor imagery, 70.45% on Sleep-EDF-SC sleep staging, 72.11% per window at threshold 0.5 on CHB-MIT seizure detection with 0.825 AUROC, and 1.700 MAE on 0-10 ds005292 pain ratings. Prior correction and temperature scaling lower negative log-likelihood from 0.766 to 0.606 on Sleep-EDF-SC and 0.166 to 0.019 on CHB-MIT, while direct readout cuts batch-1 latency from 122.43 to 63.11 ms (1.94-fold) against a matched-backbone generative comparator. Interactive demonstration and aggregate results: https://neuroimglab.github.io/EEG-Jev/.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出零样本骨架动作识别仅评测扁平叶标签、其对齐难以迁移到上层概念，提出在双曲 Lorentz 空间为动作分类树每个节点构建语义原型 $H^2SP$：以父子测地插值和单一树级门控合成原型，再用切空间对齐与蕴含锥正则把骨架运动接地传播到祖先概念，并在 NTU 四个划分及跨分类体系迁移上评测。

**相关性简评：** 骨架动作识别与分层概念预测不在 VLM 推理主线内，但其「子节点原型由父节点插值合成、以方向性蕴含约束组织层级」的做法，可能为 latent 推理状态的层级抽象与表示几何组织提供可供核查的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Don't Miss the Forest for the Trees: Zero-Shot Skeleton Action Recognition with Hyperbolic Hierarchical Semantic Prototypes

**abstract/A1：** Zero-shot skeleton-based action recognition is evaluated almost exclusively on flat leaf labels, which leaves open whether a representation also grounds the broader concepts that contain an action in skeleton motion. We find that strong leaf alignment does not carry over to them: when ancestor concepts are scored directly under independent decoding, eight flat methods with 57.86-73.29% mean leaf Top-1 reach only 6.15-31.21% mean full-path accuracy across four NTU RGB+D splits. We propose the Hyperbolic Hierarchical Semantic Prototype ($H^2SP$) framework, which represents every node of an action taxonomy in the Lorentz model of hyperbolic space. First, instead of learning a free vector per node, $H^2SP$ synthesizes hierarchy-aware prototypes by recursive parent-child geodesic interpolation under a single tree-wide gate. Second, tangent-space semantic and distributional alignment on seen classes anchor the leaf prototypes in skeleton motion. Third, a soft entailment-cone regularizer encourages directional parent-child inclusion, propagating this motion grounding to ancestor concepts. We evaluate hierarchical concept prediction under independent and cascade decoding, and transfer to an alternative taxonomy without retraining. Across the four splits, $H^2SP$ attains the best mean independent and cascade full-path accuracy among the evaluated methods, at a comparable leaf Top-1 of 72.40%. Transferred to the alternative taxonomy, it outperforms both flat baselines and the same-tree Euclidean control across every split and decoding mode, indicating that its concept-level correspondence extends beyond the training taxonomy.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 NeuTNN-AV，一种基于多树突段神经元、4-bit 权重与局部奖励调制 STDP 的脉冲网络，用于低精度音视频分类，并展示单遍学习与在线持续学习的效率优势。

**相关性简评：** 其「每个输入线至多发放一次」的时序编码与多树突段状态，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据的稀疏压缩表示、状态更新和推理能耗核算提供可核查的启发，但论文本身不涉及生成式推理或多模态推理链。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HEAR, SEE, SPIKE ONCE: Highly Efficient NeuroAI Temporal Neural Networks for Low-Precision Multimodal Audio-Visual Classification and Online Learning

**abstract/A1：** Spiking neural networks for multimodal audio-visual classification reach high accuracy by adopting deep-learning machinery: multi-stage convolutional or transformer encoders trained end-to-end with surrogate-gradient backpropagation through time. These prior works typically rely on full-precision (32-bit) parameters and do not treat hardware efficiency as a primary design objective. In this paper, we propose NeuTNN-AV, a much simpler hardware-amenable multimodal substrate built on the recently proposed NeuroAI Temporal Neural Network (NeuTNN) and demonstrate that it can match or outperform state-of-the-art SNN baselines with a fraction of their synapse counts. NeuTNN neurons carry multiple active dendritic segments. Each input line spikes at most once (temporal coding) and every weight is learned via a local reward-modulated spike-timing dependent plasticity (STDP) rule. All weights are 4-bit integers and inference uses only comparisons and additions. On CREMA-D, it reaches 78.6% with 2.34M synapses establishing a new state-of-the-art SNN accuracy, against 77.14% for MISNet-XL (31M parameters). On UrbanSound8K-AV, NeuTNN reaches 98.82% with 1.38M synapses, against 96.85% for SMMT (9.99M parameters) and 98.96% for MISNet-XL (31M parameters). Weight memory is 23-106x smaller than the spiking baselines, and the measured synaptic energy per inference is two to three orders of magnitude lower. Furthermore, the proposed NeuTNN learns CREMA-D in a single pass with 73.8% accuracy and demonstrates rapid online continual learning by adapting to unseen actors from a few dozen clips.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 OrangeTree，用线性与树结构使模型参数与序列长度解耦，由 Segment Tree Encoder 与 Inverse Tree Decoder 配合 Range Weighter 和 Feature Fuser，在单一架构内完成多输入、多输出长度的时间序列预测。

**相关性简评：** 其与长度无关的树状编码和「动态选择并融合相关区段」的机制，可能为 LVR 中变长输入的 latent 状态聚合、证据筛选与长度泛化提供可核查的结构线索，但领域相隔较远，迁移价值需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OrangeTree: A Linear and Tree-based Time Series Forecasting Model Supporting Multiple Input and Output Lengths

**abstract/A1：** Time series forecasting (TSF) models suffer from a critical rigidity: the inability to handle Multiple Input and Output Lengths (MIOL) within a single architecture. Current workarounds, such as padding or autoregression, often incur computational redundancy or suffer from error accumulation. We propose OrangeTree, a linear and tree-based architecture that decouples model parameters from sequence lengths. It employs a Segment Tree Encoder and an Inverse Tree Decoder to translate multi-length input history into multi-length output predictions within a unified framework. Crucially, a Range Weighter and a Feature Fuser bridge these components, dynamically selecting and fusing relevant ranges into optimal contexts for forecasting. Experiments on six benchmarks confirm OrangeTree achieves the SOTA performance. In MIOL settings, it matches the accuracy of length-fixed models without substantial accuracy degradation or a substantial increase in inference latency typical of heuristic methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Tang-Yiqi/OrangeTree.

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出 CogFormerV2：一个元摊销贝叶斯推断框架，用单一网络一次训练（单 GPU 约一天）即可对跨越 146 亿种配置的认知模型空间给出校准良好的后验，并支持持续学习扩展到新模型。

**相关性简评：** 跨模型空间的摊销后验估计与表示迁移，可能为 LVR 中同时维护多种 latent 假设并为假设分配概率、以及在结构或配置变化时复用推理计算提供概念线索，具体机制可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Meta-Amortized Cognitive Modeling

**abstract/A1：** Cognitive modeling is highly iterative. Researchers repeatedly revise model structures, parameterizations, covariates, and experimental designs as theories evolve and data accumulates. Amortized Bayesian inference with neural networks provides rapid estimation for individual models, but every revision requires new simulations and training. Here, we introduce CogFormerV2, a meta-amortized framework that enables researchers to specify, revise, and fit cognitive models with a single network, carrying amortization across an entire space of models all at once. Trained once in about a day on a single GPU, it delivers accurate, well-calibrated posteriors across more than 14.6 billion model configurations spanning binary, multi-alternative, and continuous decisions, with varying parameter sets, covariate structures, trial counts, and contamination levels. It can fit empirical data from distinct behavioral tasks and extends to new models through continual learning and representation transfer. Released as an open-source interactive application, CogFormerV2 provides a reusable infrastructure for meta-amortized inference in cognitive modeling, while carrying the potential to accelerate computational modeling workflows at large.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文提出从多尺度时间片段中挖掘可复用的「时间序列基础单元」（TFUs），显式复用与组合跨域共有的局部动态规律，据此构建统一基础模型 UniTFU，并在七个公开数据集上验证跨域预测与少量目标数据下的适配。

**相关性简评：** 从片段中抽取可复用动态原语并加以组合、再用少量数据更新组件的做法，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态更新的可组合原语及增量适配形成概念类比，但属较远领域线索，其单元是否具备状态抽象语义仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rethinking Universal Time Series Foundation Models from Unified Representations to Shared Dynamics (UniTFU)

**abstract/A1：** Time series foundation models (TSFMs) have attracted increasing attention in cross-domain forecasting. Existing works mainly rely on large-scale pre-training and general modeling paradigms. However, the former heavily relies on the diversity and domain coverage of pre-training data. Meanwhile, the latter learns unified representations across heterogeneous domains without explicitly identifying the temporal regularities shared among them, limiting robust cross-domain generalization. This work explores cross-domain generalization by characterizing commonalities in recurring local dynamics across domains, rather than relying solely on implicitly learned temporal representations. To capture such cross-domain commonalities, we propose Time Series Foundation Units (TFUs) as reusable building blocks discovered from multi-scale temporal segments, each characterizing a recurring local dynamic pattern shared across domains. Building on TFUs, we develop a unified time series foundation model (UniTFU) that explicitly reuses and composes shared temporal regularities across domains for forecasting. Experiments on seven public datasets show that UniTFU substantially outperforms existing TSFMs in cross-domain forecasting and can efficiently adapt to target-domain dynamics by updating its reusable components with limited target data. UniTFU also achieves strong forecasting performance compared with state-of-the-art methods.

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Decompose, Verify, Evolve: Physically Grounded Shape Decomposition

**abstract/A1：** Shape decomposition represents 3D objects as a compact set of geometric primitives for interpretable modeling and simulation. However, existing decomposition methods are trained primarily for geometric fidelity, without explicit constraints on physical plausibility, and can therefore produce disconnected parts or physically unstable reconstructions. We present PhysDec, an agentic framework that draws on a pretrained vision-language model's semantic understanding and commonsense reasoning to predict material-aware primitive decompositions from a few images. Within this framework, PhysDec-Loop is an agentic pipeline that reasons about part structure and materials, using a reference 3D point cloud for geometric feedback and physical verifiers to guide iterative refinement. Through self-evolution, we further develop another agentic pipeline, PhysDec-Evolved, which learns from prior corrections to predict primitive decompositions from images without point-cloud feedback or a correction loop at inference. Experiments show that PhysDec-Loop improves geometric fidelity, physical plausibility and visual quality over geometry-focused baselines, while PhysDec-Evolved approaches its performance at substantially lower inference cost.

</details>

**内容简述：** 该工作构建 TACTUS 手术动作理解数据集与基准，统一标注工具与动作类别、嵌套的动作与交互时间窗、器械关键点轨迹及组织区域跟踪，并重新标注 141 个视频共 22,995 个片段，同时提出 TactusNet 参考网络联合评测语义、时间与空间预测。

**相关性简评：** 其接触窗口起止与器械轨迹的密集时空标注，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与「何时停止/证据是否充分」的判定提供监督和评价参照，但论文不涉及 latent 状态或多模态推理，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TACTUS: Unifying Surgical Action Understanding in Time and Space

**abstract/A1：** Advancing surgical automation requires a comprehensive spatio-temporal understanding of how instruments act on tissue throughout an action. Existing surgical benchmarks, however, largely define supervision through task-specific targets, leaving the relationships between action semantics, instrument motion, and tissue interaction incompletely specified. To address this limitation, we introduce TACTUS (Tool, Action, Contact and Trajectory Understanding in Surgery), a new dataset and benchmark that establishes a unified annotation framework for complete surgical actions. The framework jointly specifies tool and action identities, nested action and interaction windows, instrument-specific landmark trajectories, and tissue-region tracks. To construct these annotations at scale, we develop a two-tier pipeline combining human annotation, point tracking, and model-generated spatial prompts. Using this pipeline, we re-annotate 141 videos from five public sources, producing 22,995 action clips spanning 2.9 million frames. The dataset comprises 15,668 Gold clips with human spatial prompts followed by review and re-checking, and 7,327 Silver clips combining human semantic and temporal annotations with model-generated spatial prompts. We further introduce TactusNet, the companion reference network, to benchmark semantic, temporal, and spatial prediction from shared video features. Across TactusNet and 13 published baselines, tool-action accuracy reaches 95.8% with per-head encoder fine-tuning, while the best temporal recall and contact Dice reach 46.6% at temporal IoU 0.7 and 0.351, respectively. Moreover, adding Silver improves the default TactusNet's pair accuracy from 93.8% to 95.5%. Together, these contributions establish a foundation for learning and evaluating the instrument-tissue interactions underlying future surgical automation.

### 313. [Sounding the Black Box: Online Training of Embedded Neural Networks in Forward-Only Physical Simulators](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31964v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31964

**作者：** Ruiqi Shu、Tianrun Gao、Haomin Wen、Xiaomeng Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31964v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31964v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 FORGE，在只有前向、不可微接口的黑箱 PDE 求解器中在线训练嵌入式神经网络：先用沿输出正交方向的低维 Gauss-Newton 步骤并做末层校正，再通过扰动空间输出场拟合有界因果线性响应算子，从而更新全部权重以降低多步 rollout 误差。

**相关性简评：** 其在不可微黑箱前向过程中做多步信用分配并校正逐层状态漂移，可能与 LVR 中非可微推理轨迹的监督与贡献分配问题有概念联系，可供核查；但与视觉或多模态推理本身无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sounding the Black Box: Online Training of Embedded Neural Networks in Forward-Only Physical Simulators

**abstract/A1：** Hybrid physics-neural simulators embed neural networks in partial differential equation (PDE) solvers to model unresolved subgrid dynamics while preserving resolved physics and conservation laws. Because closure outputs feed back across time steps, single-step offline regression does not directly minimize multi-step rollout error, motivating online trajectory optimization. Solver backpropagation through time (BPTT) is the standard online solution when solver derivatives are available, yet many operational Fortran and C/C++ simulators expose only non-differentiable, forward-only interfaces. We introduce FORGE (Forward-Only Response and Gauss-Newton Estimation), an online framework that trains embedded networks from forward runs alone by decoupling exact network derivatives from black-box simulator dynamics. Stage I warms up the rollout via a low-dimensional Gauss-Newton step along output-orthonormal weight directions, canceling multi-layer feature drift via a final-layer correction. Stage II perturbs spatial output fields to fit a gain-bounded causal linear response operator across rollout steps, solves for regularized target outputs, and updates all weights via network backpropagation. Across five 2D and 3D benchmarks spanning phase separation, reaction-diffusion, fluid and MHD turbulence, and ocean circulation, FORGE outperforms gradient-free, reinforcement-learning, and emulator-based baselines, cutting coarse-solver test mean squared error (MSE) by 50%-96% in 2D and 70% in 3D, outperforming the strongest forward-only baseline by 16%-69%, and recovering 88%-98% of Solver BPTT's gains. Code is available at https://github.com/ChiyodaMomo01/FORGE.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Coding4Games 基准：覆盖 15 款现代游戏的视觉与操作需求，让编码 agent 在沙盒中通过标准玩家接口反复试玩、迭代开发独立游戏程序，随后冻结程序、在无语言模型推理的条件下独立测试，并同时评估结果与开发过程。

**相关性简评：** 其「开发期反复推理、测试期零推理执行成品程序」的设定，可能为 LVR 中逐步 latent 推理与把推理外化为可复用状态或策略之间的计算分配与成本对照提供线索，但论文不分析内部视觉表征，具体可借鉴性需核查原文。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Coding4Games: Can Modern Coding Agents Play Modern Video Games?

**abstract/A1：** Games, especially modern AAA games, challenge language models to perceive complex scenes, control actions, and make decisions over long horizons. Existing game benchmarks primarily test language models as computer-use agents that query a language model throughout play, incurring repeated inference cost and, in real-time games, acting while the environment continues to evolve. We ask whether coding agents can learn from game interaction to develop standalone game-playing programs that run without language model inference. We thus introduce Coding4Games, a benchmark for evaluating whether coding agents can develop standalone programs that play modern games through visual observations and standard game inputs. Coding4Games has three defining features: 1) Diverse Modern Games, covering 15 games with diverse visual, strategic, and control demands; 2) Development-Test Separation, in which a coding agent uses a sandbox and the standard player interface to iteratively develop a program, after which the selected program is frozen and independently tested without language-model inference; and 3) Outcome and Process Evaluation, which measures not only game performance and reliability but also how agents use feedback, revise programs, and resolve problems during development. Across 15 games, the best program per game outscores the strongest GUI baseline on 13 and ties it on one. The human player outscores all agents on 10 games. We additionally examine the effects of development budgets. Coding4Games evaluates whether coding agents can turn their understanding of complex interactive environments into programs that work reliably on their own.

**comment/C1：** Project Page: https://coding4game.github.io/

</details>

### 315. [Discovering Bandwidth-Efficient Prefetchers to Shrink the Cache Hierarchy](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31983v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31983

**作者：** Patrick Tser Jern Kon、Akanksha Jain、Abraham Gonzalez、Rui Meng、Dilara Soylu、Shubham Agarwal、Yawen Wang、Iman Hosseini、Hanna Alam、Jinsung Yoon、Tomas Pfister、Nanyun Peng、Chun-Liang Li、Parthasarathy Ranganathan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.AR、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31983v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31983v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DuoArchitect 代理框架，联合演化快速仿真代理与 L1D/L2/LLC 多层预取策略，并在缩减缓存预算下搜索出预取器 DuoArch-Nano。

**相关性简评：** 属微体系结构预取器设计，与视觉或多模态推理无直接关联；其以快速仿真代理和诊断 oracle 在预算约束下引导协同搜索的做法，或可类比 LVR 中廉价代理评估与「思考/查看」计算成本的权衡，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Discovering Bandwidth-Efficient Prefetchers to Shrink the Cache Hierarchy

**abstract/A1：** Shared last-level caches (LLCs) increasingly dominate server processor die area, forcing architects to trade core counts for cache capacity. While intelligent data prefetching offers a pathway to reclaim this silicon, designing coordinated, multi-level prefetching policies for multi-core systems is bottlenecked by day-long, cycle-level simulations. This simulation wall limits even LLM-based microarchitecture discovery; the state-of-the-art ArchAgent system evolves one cache level at a time on single-core benchmarks, adds multi-core configurations only at the end, and trails the human champion under multi-core shared cache contention. We introduce DuoArchitect, an autonomous agentic framework for multi-fidelity, multi-core co-discovery of prefetchers. Agents jointly evolve evaluation proxies and coordinated prefetching policies across the L1D, L2, and LLC hierarchies, constructing simulation proxies 3-26x faster than cluster evaluation and hardware diagnostic oracles to guide the search. To study how much cache silicon a smarter prefetcher can replace, we evaluate and evolve prefetchers under reduced cache budgets, and find that evolving under our tightest cache constraint (with both the L2 and LLC halved) produced our strongest prefetcher overall at every cache size we tested: DuoArch-Nano. On the Fourth Data Prefetching Championship (DPC4) benchmarks with full-size caches, DuoArch-Nano delivers a 9.2% geomean IPC speedup (+10.5% on four-core mixes) while reducing four-core DRAM traffic by 11.4%, more than doubling the gains of the human champion BertiGO and the agentic ArchAgent v2. When the LLC is halved, DuoArch-Nano erases the baseline's 8.6% overall slowdown and edges out the full-LLC baseline overall (+0.88%), showing that agentic frameworks can generate prefetchers that reclaim megabytes of LLC SRAM per core with zero overall IPC penalty.

</details>
