### 316. [WaveSR: Physics-Inspired Wave Evolution Attention for Efficient Image Super-Resolution](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31984v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31984

**作者：** Xiaoyan Lei、Biao Luo、Wenlong Zhang、Tingwen Huang、Chunhua Yang、Weihua Gui

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31984v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31984v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 WaveSR，用二维波动方程的 FFT 闭式解实现注意力中的特征交互，各频率分量以可学习波速与阻尼独立演化，并配合频域自适应前馈网络与空间-频域混合损失做图像超分。

**相关性简评：** 任务是低层图像重建，缺乏推理与证据使用；但「可学习阻尼的频率解耦状态演化」或可作为一种 latent 状态更新与衰减机制的类比线索，需核查其是否可与 LVR 的迭代计算、停止决策建立实质联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** WaveSR: Physics-Inspired Wave Evolution Attention for Efficient Image Super-Resolution

**abstract/A1：** Recently, physics-inspired neural networks have gained widespread attention due to their interpretability. The closed-form, frequency-time decoupled solution of the wave equation offers linear complexity and allows different frequency components to evolve independently, making it a potential alternative solution for efficient image super-resolution. Therefore, a physics-inspired wave evolution attention framework is proposed, namely WaveSR. The WaveSR framework involves two key modules, i.e., wave evolution attention (WEA) and Frequency-Adaptive Feed-Forward Network (FA-FFN). The WEA module achieves feature interactions through the analytical solution of the 2D wave equation in the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) domain, enabling independent evolution of different frequency components with learnable wave speed \\(c\\) and damping coefficient \\(α\\). The FA-FFN module realizes adaptive frequency feature selection through learnable spectral modulation, effectively enhancing feature representation capability. Subsequently, we employ a two-stage training strategy with a hybrid objective that combines a spatial-domain pixel loss and a frequency-domain loss to improve reconstruction quality. Our method provides a preliminary exploration of physics-inspired neural networks for efficient image super-resolution.

**comment/C1：** This paper has been accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia

</details>

### 317. [Reconstructing Natural Images from Brain Activity during Natural Vision](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31989v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31989

**作者：** Tejasvi Kothapalli、Ryan Ressmeyer、Declan Rowley、Gregory D. Horwitz、Jude Mitchell、Alexander C. Huk、Bruno Olshausen、Jacob Yates

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31989v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31989v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该研究在猕猴自由注视静态自然场景时记录 LGN 与 V1 的高密度阵列活动，将脉冲与眼动 token 化后送入 transformer 与扩散模型，从局部感受野覆盖的神经信号跨眼动、试次与会话重建完整图像，并分析证据量、眼动追踪精度与图像先验对重建质量的影响。

**相关性简评：** 其「跨注视累积视觉证据并依赖自然图像先验填补缺失输入」的框架，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、何时停止获取证据及内部视觉先验的作用提供概念参照，但属神经解码研究，与 VLM 推理机制的直接联系尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reconstructing Natural Images from Brain Activity during Natural Vision

**abstract/A1：** Reconstructing images from brain activity has two broad goals. The first is to build brain-computer interfaces. The second is to understand how the brain sees. The eyes deliver incomplete, noisy input, so the brain must fill in the gaps with its expectations of what natural scenes look like. This filling-in relies on the brain's prior over natural images. Image reconstruction lets us test which natural image prior best matches the brain's natural image prior. However, most previous work on image reconstruction relies on an unnatural condition: subjects must hold their eyes still. In reality, primates constantly move their eyes to see the world. We introduce a framework for reconstructing images from neural activity while a primate freely views a static natural scene. We record from five monkeys with high-density electrode arrays in the lateral geniculate nucleus (LGN) and primary visual cortex (V1). The recorded receptive fields cover only a small part of the image. Thus, we combine neural activity across eye movements, trials, and sessions to reconstruct the full image. We first present a simple linear method with a 1/f prior. We then scale this approach up with modern deep learning. We train a decoder by tokenizing spiking activity and measured gaze; these tokens are fed into a transformer and diffusion model to reconstruct the full scene. Three factors determine reconstruction quality: the amount of neural evidence combined over viewing time, the accuracy of eye tracking, and the choice of image prior. Our method sets a new state-of-the-art performance in reconstructing natural images from brain activity, across brain recording modalities: fMRI, EEG, MEG and electrophysiology.

**comment/C1：** 40 pages, 18 figures, 4 tables. Includes supplementary material

</details>

### 318. [Metric-Dependent Scaling Laws for Sketched Multiclass Softmax Regression](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31995v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31995

**作者：** Ziyan Chen、Linhe Zheng、Peilin Liu、Zhongzhu Zhou、Ding-Xuan Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文在 Gaussian teacher-student 模型下分析随机特征 sketch 下多类 softmax 回归的 full-batch 梯度下降缩放律，给出交叉熵与零一风险的谱尺度分解，并推导最优的 sketch 分辨率与训练时长选择。

**相关性简评：** 其将超额风险拆为分辨率项与「有效学习维度/样本量」项，且 sketch 造成模型误配，可能为分析视觉特征被压缩进 latent 状态时精度与样本、算力的权衡提供可核查的解析参照。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Metric-Dependent Scaling Laws for Sketched Multiclass Softmax Regression

**abstract/A1：** We study scaling laws for full-batch gradient descent with general stable deterministic learning rates in sketched multiclass softmax regression. In a Gaussian teacher student model with power law feature and teacher spectra, the student observes a random feature sketch and reuses a finite labeled sample throughout optimization. Sketching generally makes the student misspecified, so the analysis must jointly account for approximation, nonlinear finite time learning, and the fixed empirical perturbation induced by data reuse. On an exponentially likely sketch event, we show that cross entropy excess and excess zero one risk share a common spectral scale, consisting of a resolution term and an effective learned dimension divided by sample size; teacher student decision disagreement follows the square root of that scale. The resulting balance gives rate optimal sketch and cumulative horizon choices, and synthetic experiments support the predicted regimes and metric dependent exponents.

**comment/C1：** 53 pages, 2 figures

</details>

### 319. [Distractors are the Real Enemy: Visual Distraction Adversarial Perturbations on SAM2-Based Video Tracking and Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32011v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32011

**作者：** Adonay Demewez Gebremedhin、Mohamad Alansari、Wessam Shehieb、Muzammal Naseer

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32011v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32011v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究 SAM2 类可提示视频跟踪器在对抗扰动下的鲁棒性，提出白盒攻击 DistractAttack，用背景干扰物制造持续的目标跟踪破坏，其核心反事实干扰物搜索并行传播干净与受攻击轨迹，随时间累积证据以削弱目标支持。

**相关性简评：** 通过并行对比干净与受扰轨迹、定位对结果产生因果影响区域并累积证据的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与「哪些视觉细节真正支撑内部状态」的诊断设计，但原文面向跟踪鲁棒性而非推理机制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Distractors are the Real Enemy: Visual Distraction Adversarial Perturbations on SAM2-Based Video Tracking and Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Promptable video trackers such as SAM2 achieve accurate and robust performance through strong temporal consistency, making them important foundations for downstream video understanding and tracking applications. As their use continues to expand, understanding their robustness to adversarial perturbations becomes increasingly important. Existing attacks on SAM2 largely focus on local mask degradation and short-term temporal feature disruption, leaving its longer-term dynamics and competing object interferences (Distractors) insufficiently explored. We observe that SAM2 itself exposes useful distractor cues when tracking becomes uncertain. Based on these observations, we propose DistractAttack, a white-box attack that uses background distractors to disrupt target tracking persistently. Its core procedure, Counterfactual Distractor Search (CDS), propagates clean and attacked trajectories in parallel to discover plausible competing regions and identify those that become increasingly effective under perturbation. The discovered evidence is accumulated over time to weaken target support and promote recurrent alternatives or disappearance predictions. Extensive experiments under video-level and one-shot perturbations across Visual Object Tracking and Video Object Segmentation demonstrate strong attack effectiveness, raising DRE to $4.4\\times$ and NRE to $7.3\\times$ their nearest baselines under video perturbation, while transferring effectively across model scales and tracker variants in black-box settings. Project page: https://adonaydem.github.io/sam2-da-page/

</details>

### 320. [Structure-Aware Transformers for Hierarchical Authorization in Personal AI Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32018v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32018

**作者：** Dongyu Cui、Jie Ding、Xuan Bi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、stat.ME

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32018v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32018v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 PATH，一种带层级感知注意力掩码与父节点门控概率分解的 Transformer，用于预测个人 AI 代理中用户的层级化授权偏好，并在模拟、合成画像与真实数据上报告了无层级违例的预测表现。

**相关性简评：** 其层级一致性约束与父门控概率分解可能为 LVR 中结构化视觉证据的可行性筛选与层级化 latent 状态更新提供可核查线索，但对象是用户授权偏好而非多模态推理，联系需较多推断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Structure-Aware Transformers for Hierarchical Authorization in Personal AI Agents

**abstract/A1：** Personal AI agents can carry out complex, multi-step tasks on users' behalf, but doing so often involves numerous permission requests. Manually reviewing each request is time-consuming, while indiscriminate approval poses privacy and security risks. Predicting users' authorization preferences offers a way to reduce this burden while preserving user control. However, authorization prediction is challenging because permission requests are often hierarchical and observed user decisions are sparse and potentially correlated. To address these challenges, We propose the Parent-gated Authorization Transformer for Hierarchies (PATH) to predict users' authorization preferences for personal AI agents. PATH is a novel neural network architecture that combines hierarchy-aware attention masks with a parent-gated probability formulation to ensure hierarchy-consistent predictions. Hierarchy-level embeddings further support learning from sparse observations and patterns shared within each authorization level. We establish finite-sample risk bounds and provide sufficient conditions for consistent authorization probability estimation and algorithmic convergence. Experiments on simulated data, AI-generated user profiles, and real user authorization data demonstrate strong predictive performance with zero hierarchy violations.

</details>

### 321. [Online Environment Repair for Coding Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32037v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32037

**作者：** Sheng Lu、Rui Mao、Zewei Chen、Chihua Ying、Beiduo Chen、Dingxin Hu、Tinghao Yu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CR、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32037v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32037v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文针对 coding agent 的 RL 训练中验证器缺陷与单测不全导致的奖励黑客问题，提出「在线环境修复」：不改变触发 rollout 的奖励以避免策略隐藏捷径，并在训练中异步修补被利用的环境，候选修复须通过三道自动校验门（阻断利用且保留合法解）才上线。

**相关性简评：** 其核心概念——用自动校验区分「真正完成任务」与「走了捷径仍获满分」——或可启发 LVR 中判断答案是否真正使用 latent／视觉证据而非语言先验捷径的评价设计；但该方法面向代码仓库与奖励信号，与多模态推理状态的关联仅停留在类比层面，需核查其校验门构造的可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Online Environment Repair for Coding Agents

**abstract/A1：** Programmatic verifiers provide scalable reward signals for training coding agents with reinforcement learning, yet subtle harness defects and incomplete unit tests allow policies to earn full credit without solving the intended task. Existing training-time defenses intervene either by penalizing suspicious outputs or by filtering flagged tasks and rollouts. However, output penalties leave the underlying verifier exploitable, driving policies to disguise shortcuts under reasoning monitors or zeroing out valid solutions under detector false positives, whereas task and rollout filtering discards or mutes the hardest problems where shortcuts emerge earliest. Pre-training verifier hardening repairs the environment directly, but misses vulnerability classes that surface only as the policy improves during reinforcement learning. In this paper, we propose online environment repair, which leaves triggering rollout rewards unchanged to remove hiding incentives and asynchronously patches exploited environments during training. Candidate repairs triggered by execution invariants or differential fuzzing are deployed only after passing three automated validation gates that block the exploit while preserving valid solutions, canceling detector false positives and enabling structural propagation across repositories without scaffold labels or reference solutions. Across 20 controlled GRPO experiments on heterogeneous software-engineering repositories, online environment repair reduces cumulative reward hacking from 36.9% to 0.06% and improves held-out Pass@8 from 21.7% to 46.7%, consistently outperforming reward-penalty, rollout-filtering, and static-hardening baselines while eliminating zero-shot exploitation on unseen loophole classes.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 7 figures

</details>

**作者：** Wenchong Tian、Shixun Li、Ruozhou Lin、Peng Ye、Zhiyu Zhang、Shi Tao、Yu-Qi Wang、Ling Shi、Mingfu Guan、Haoran Duan、Zhiguo Yuan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、eess.SY

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 AgenticAI-Control，用两个耦合的 LLM agent 检索多源气象预警并与工程领域知识融合，生成城市排水系统实时控制策略；在中国东部一个合流制流域的 10 场真实降雨模拟中，相较规则基线将内涝与溢流总量降低 69.1%–90.6%。

**相关性简评：** 其「传感稀疏时引入外部证据源并做闭环控制/决策」的设定，可能与 LVR 中何时调用外部视觉证据、证据价值如何影响决策与停止的问题构成类比，但属水利控制应用，可借鉴的方法线索需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Rule-based to Agentic: LLM Agent based Real-time Control of Urban Drainage Systems for Flooding and Sewer Overflow Mitigation

**abstract/A1：** Real-time control (RTC) for urban drainage systems (UDS) remains hampered by sparse in-network sensing. While heterogeneous multi-modal meteorological early warnings often contain decision-critical information for UDS RTC, none of the existing approaches can exploit such externally-sourced information within the control workflow. Here we introduce AgenticAI-Control, an agentic artificial intelligence framework able to assimilate multi-source meteorological early warnings in RTC. Two coupled large language model agents are integrated to generate control strategies by retrieving meteorological early-warnings and fusing them with domain engineering expertise. Validated via simulation studies of a combined sewer catchment in eastern China across 10 real-world rainfall events, the AgenticAI-Control achieved 69.1-90.6% reduction in aggregated flood and overflow volumes compared to the rule-based baseline control. Rigorously standardized prompt engineering and modular workflow constraints substantially compress performance disparities among four distinct LLMs. Our work establishes AgenticAI as a viable tool to unify multi-source meteorological monitoring and practitioner domain knowledge, surmounting longstanding monitoring limitations of UDS RTC and delivering cost-efficient, robust intelligent control solutions for sensor-sparse sewer infrastructures.

</details>

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32054v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32054v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SurgGenesis，一个在潜空间学习未来手术状态转移的生成式手术世界模型，用三阶段渐进 LoRA 适配视频扩散模型，并将生成片段作为手术数据引擎用于长尾重平衡与下游理解任务。

**相关性简评：** 其「预测潜空间未来状态」及用 GT-latent prediction gap、时间跨度分析检验未来感知的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉状态预测与 latent 表示评估提供参照；但该工作面向数据生成而非多模态推理，与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 等主线联系需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SurgGenesis: A Generative Surgical World Model for Future-Aware Surgical Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Surgical scene understanding is constrained by data scarcity and long-tail class imbalance, as annotating surgical videos demands scarce clinical expertise while rare procedural events remain underrepresented. We tackle this through data generation and propose SurgGenesis, a generative surgical world model that learns future surgical state transitions in a latent space from visual observations and textual procedural descriptions, serving as a scalable surgical data engine. To adapt a large-scale video diffusion model to the data-scarce surgical domain without catastrophic forgetting, we introduce a three-stage progressive LoRA strategy that incrementally injects endoscopic visual priors, procedural semantics, and spatial motion cues. Rather than judging generation by visual fidelity alone, we validate SurgGenesis along two axes that separate a world model from a generic generator: (i) future-awareness, by comparing predicted futures against the real future through a GT-latent prediction gap and temporal-horizon analysis, and (ii) action-faithful usefulness, by checking that generated clips contain the commanded surgical triplet and that using them to rebalance long-tail events and drive downstream understanding (segmentation, triplet recognition, 3D reconstruction) yields action-specific gains. Conditioned futures therefore complement conventional long-tail sampling. Code: https://zh-qr.github.io/SurgGenesis

</details>

### 324. [A Fused Gaussian Process Bandit Framework for Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32092v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32092

**作者：** Muyun Lu、Jose E Aguilar Escamilla、Huazheng Wang、Ying Lin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.IT

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32092v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32092v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文将多保真贝叶斯优化重新表述为融合高斯过程 bandit 问题，用自回归高斯过程融合不同保真度的观测并显式量化参数估计不确定性，提出 FGP-UCB 算法并给出简单遗憾界。

**相关性简评：** 其“低成本近似观测—高保真验证”的取舍与不确定性驱动的采集准则，可能为 LVR 中按成本选择视觉证据粒度、以及 LOOK 与 STOP 的预算分配提供可核查的概念类比；但该方法面向连续黑箱函数优化，与 VLM 内部推理状态无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Fused Gaussian Process Bandit Framework for Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Bayesian optimization (BO) is widely used to maximize expensive black-box functions when direct evaluation is costly. In many real-world applications, the high-fidelity objective can be approximated by a series of lower-fidelity models that provide partial but informative signals at substantially reduced cost. Multi-fidelity BO (MFBO) algorithms aim to strategically combine these information sources to achieve an optimal trade-off between accuracy and evaluation cost. However, existing MFBO methods often oversimplify the complex dependencies between fidelity levels or rely on heuristic acquisition functions that lack theoretical performance guarantees. To address these limitations, we introduce a new formulation of the MFBO problem as a fused Gaussian Process bandit and develop a corresponding Fused Gaussian Process Upper Confidence Bound (FGP-UCB) algorithm. Our approach accurately predicts the high-fidelity function by fusing multi-fidelity observations through an autoregressive Gaussian Process model and explicitly quantifies the uncertainty arising from parameter estimation across fidelity levels. The proposed method also provides theoretical simple-regret guarantees, overcoming a key limitation of existing MFBO algorithms that lack provable performance bounds. Effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated via both theoretical analysis and empirical studies.

**comment/C1：** 27 pages, 6 figures

</details>

### 325. [Rethinking Post-Training Quantization for Large Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32096v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32096

**作者：** Minchan Kang、Kyeonghye Park、Seoyoung Cho、Junhee Lee、Daeshik Kim、Yucheol Cho

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32096v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32096v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文诊断 LVLM 低比特后训练量化的性能退化来源，发现 per-channel 权重与 per-token 激活共享的量化范围被少数离群值主导，使多数数值分辨率不足甚至被映射为零；据此提出 Rotate-and-Refine Quantization，用局部 Hadamard 变换结合分组量化与分组感知执行，在 8 项多模态任务上优于基线。

**相关性简评：** 「多数数值被压到零、分辨率不足」可视为内部状态信息坍缩的一种外显形式，或可作为扰动手段检验视觉细节在 VLM 内部表示中的保留与因果贡献，但与 latent 推理过程的联系尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rethinking Post-Training Quantization for Large Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Post-training quantization (PTQ) compresses large vision-language models (LVLMs) by calibrating quantization parameters on a small dataset without retraining. However, despite increasingly sophisticated calibration strategies, prior methods suffer substantial performance degradation under low-bit weight--activation quantization. To understand this degradation, we locate where quantization error is concentrated and examine the corresponding weight and activation distributions. We observe that a few outliers dominate the ranges shared by per-channel (PC) weights and per-token (PT) activations, leaving insufficient resolution for most values and mapping many of them to zero. These findings motivate a shift in focus from calibration refinement to the underlying quantization representation. We therefore present Rotate-and-Refine Quantization (RRQ) as a simple, effective baseline for LVLM PTQ, combining local Hadamard transforms with group quantization and efficient group-aware execution. Across 8 multimodal tasks and diverse quantization settings, RRQ substantially outperforms baselines while reducing inference time and memory usage. At W4A4, it retains over 96\\% of full-precision performance on 8B models and over 99\\% on a 32B model, compared with less than 8\\% for these baselines. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/kmc3661/RRQ

</details>

### 326. [PreferenceScene: Personalized Indoor Scene Synthesis from Feedback](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32099v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32099

**作者：** Seongrae Noh、RyunHa Lee、HyeongYeop Kang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.GR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32099v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32099v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究隐藏偏好下的个性化室内场景合成：多轮展示渲染图并接收简短自由反馈与满意度分数，由 LLM 维护对房间各设计属性的显式偏好估计并整体修订，再由场景实例化模块生成完整房间。

**相关性简评：** 其「隐藏偏好状态 + 局部反馈后整体更新（含未被提及部分）」的信念状态维护与跨轮信用分配，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态如何被稀疏证据更新提供概念参照；但主体是 3D 生成而非 VLM 推理，需核查状态演化是否只是一般偏好估计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PreferenceScene: Personalized Indoor Scene Synthesis from Feedback

**abstract/A1：** Text-to-scene methods turn a short instruction into a furnished 3D room, but the room that a particular person wants rarely comes across fully in words: many preferences surface only when the person sees a concrete room and can point to what they like and dislike in it. We therefore study personalized indoor scene synthesis under hidden user preferences: over several turns, a system shows a 3D scene, and the user, who sees only rendered images of the scene, replies with brief free-form feedback and a satisfaction score. The system must therefore bring the whole room toward the user's preferences from feedback that comments on only part of it at a time. It must also be able to change every part of the room, because a preference concerns not only single objects but the look and atmosphere that surfaces, lighting, textiles, furniture and their arrangement create together. We present PreferenceScene, in which a large language model keeps an explicit estimate of the user's preferences for every design attribute of the room and, after each turn, infers the taste behind the feedback and revises the whole estimate, including the parts that the feedback does not mention. A scene instantiation module builds every estimated value as its own part of the room, so that each of these parts can follow the user's preferences. We evaluate on the test set of a benchmark with 320 instances in ten room types, with a simulated user and a render-based evaluator. PreferenceScene matches the hidden preferences better than five published text-to-scene baselines adapted to the same interaction, and its match rises with every turn. It even surpasses them when they are given the preferences directly, and a vision-language model rates its scenes as the most realistic and functional.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://seongraenoh.github.io/preferencescene/

</details>

### 327. [VIDE : Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection via Visual Intrinsic Distribution Estimation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32138v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32138

**作者：** Kevin D. Nguetche、Atif Belal、Lilian Hollard、Eric Granger、Marco Pedersoli

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32138v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32138v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练视频异常检测框架 VIDE：基于冻结 CLIP 嵌入，用初始低异常分片段估计各测试视频的正常场景内容，据此局部修正文本导出的正常性参考、重标定类别响应并精化异常方向，再对多个提示视角与两个编码器的分数进行融合。

**相关性简评：** 其「困难/高相似片段带来的异常偏置」、提示选择敏感性及按视频用视觉证据校正文本参考的做法，可能与 LVR 中 latent 相似度评分受内容与文本偏置影响、视觉证据筛选与打分校准的问题相通，可供核查；但论文本身不涉及推理状态生成或动态计算，迁移性待验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VIDE : Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection via Visual Intrinsic Distribution Estimation

**abstract/A1：** In embedding-based video anomaly detection (VAD), normal clips can have high similarity to anomalous descriptions, an anomaly bias that leads to false positives. Methods such as PRISM mitigate this bias by measuring deviations from a normality reference along anomaly directions. Both the normality reference and the anomaly directions are derived from text and shared across videos, although normal activity and the appearance of anomalies vary across scenes. The resulting scores are also sensitive to prompt selection. To address these limitations, we propose Visual Intrinsic Distribution Estimation (VIDE), a training-free framework that adapts text-derived scoring to each test video using frozen clip embeddings. VIDE estimates normal scene content from clips with low initial anomaly scores and uses this estimate to partially correct the textual reference. It then rescales category responses, penalizes clips with strong responses across categories, and refines the anomaly directions using high-scoring clips. VIDE averages scores across prompt views to reduce sensitivity to prompt selection and fuses scores from two frozen encoders. With both encoders, VIDE improves AUC over the best PRISM result by $1.5$, $1.9$, and $3.5$ points on UCF-Crime, XD-Violence, and MSAD, respectively, and AP by $6.5$ points on XD-Violence and $9.3$ points on MSAD. VIDE yields the highest AUC among the compared training-free methods on all three benchmarks and the highest reported AUC among all compared methods on XD-Violence and MSAD. Our code is included in the supplementary material and will be made publicly available.

</details>

### 328. [DocPristine: Content-Aware Document Appearance Enhancement under Real-World Mixed Degradations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32176v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32176

**作者：** Zihan Huang、Junle Liu、Zhonghao Ye、Yuyi Zhang、Peirong Zhang、Hanlin Li、Yongxin Shi、Lianwen Jin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32176v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32176v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DocPristine，利用冻结文档视觉编码器在退化图像上仍能关注文本区域这一现象，融合其多层特征并通过层级门控条件与移位窗口交叉注意力注入像素复原网络，同时构建合成混合退化训练集与真实测试集 DocACE。

**相关性简评：** 其「冻结视觉编码器在强退化下仍保留文本区域定位」的观察，可能为 LVR 中「视觉细节与任务必要信息是否留存于内部状态」及视觉证据筛选提供可供核查的线索，但论文任务是文档外观复原而非推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DocPristine: Content-Aware Document Appearance Enhancement under Real-World Mixed Degradations

**abstract/A1：** Camera-captured documents often exhibit mixed degradations, such as highlights, shadows, and blur, that distort backgrounds and obscure text details. Document appearance enhancement (DAE) aims to mitigate these degradations and improve readability. Existing document appearance enhancement methods rely either on input-derived visual cues that can become unreliable under severe degradation or on LLM-based degradation diagnosis that lacks spatial guidance. Notably, we find that pretrained document visual encoders continue to attend to text regions in degraded documents, providing content-aware guidance. Based on this insight, we propose DocPristine, which adaptively fuses multi-layer features from a frozen document visual encoder and injects them into a pixel restoration network. To integrate these features into a pixel restoration network, DocPristine combines Adaptive Multi-Layer Feature Fusion (AMFF), Hierarchical Gated Conditioning (HGC), and Shifted-Window Cross-Attention (SWCA). Specifically, SWCA draws on structural cues from neighboring locations across window boundaries to recover fine text details.We also introduce DocACE, with a synthetic mixed-degradation training set (DocACE-Synthetic) and a real-world test set (DocACE-Real) containing manually restored ground-truth images and document parsing annotations. Comprehensive experiments across three benchmarks demonstrate that DocPristine achieves state-of-the-art appearance enhancement quality and consistently improves downstream document parsing. Code, models, and data will be publicly available.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 5 figures

</details>

### 329. [Who gets the information? An $α$-fair label-coverage framework for multi-label feature selection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32200v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32200

**作者：** Zhenzhi Tang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32200v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32200v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将多标签特征选择中的相关性分配视为社会选择问题，提出 FLIC：把每个标签当作领取信息的「agent」，用单一参数 α 在功利主义、比例公平与 max-min 之间滑动，最大化 per-label 信息覆盖的 α-fair 福利，并证明目标在 α≥0 时单调子模、贪心可得 (1−1/e) 近似，在 22 个数据集上与 14 种信息论过滤器比较。

**相关性简评：** 其 α-fair 福利族提供了一种刻画「信息在多个受体间如何分配」的目标形式，可能可供核查于共享 latent 状态中按标签/子任务平衡信息覆盖、避免部分任务信息被吞没的问题，子模性与近似保证也可作为证据筛选或容量分配的参考；但原文是非视觉的表格特征选择，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Who gets the information? An $α$-fair label-coverage framework for multi-label feature selection

**abstract/A1：** Recent information-theoretic filters for multi-label feature selection disagree on how to distribute relevance over labels: some amplify features that inform a few labels, others balance what every label receives. We show these choices are implicit social welfare functions. Treating labels as agents whose utility is the information they receive, we propose FLIC, which greedily maximises the $α$-fair welfare of per-label information coverage. A single parameter $α$ moves from utilitarian ($α=0$) through proportionally fair ($α=1$) to max-min selection ($α\\to\\infty$), and a dozen published relevance terms lie on this axis, most as special cases, first-order approximations or limits. The objective is monotone submodular for every $α\\ge0$ whenever each label's information is, so greedy selection is a $(1-1/e)$-approximation; this fails for $α&lt;0$, and the max-min limit is inapproximable. Fano's and the Hellman-Raviv inequalities tie raw coverage to the Bayes Hamming loss and normalised coverage to per-label relative error. FLIC uses bias-corrected, label-wise conditional information and has no relevance-redundancy trade-off parameter. On 22 data sets, FLIC is the best of 14 information-theoretic filters on seven of nine metrics, winning 86 of 117 pairwise comparisons significantly and losing none significantly. Among 17 methods it ranks first on ranking loss, coverage and macro-AUC with two classifiers and has the best mean rank (narrowly with ML-kNN), while three embedded methods lead on Hamming loss, one-error and micro-F1.

**comment/C1：** 25 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Supplementary material is provided as an ancillary file

</details>

### 330. [FaceNet versus VGG Features in Wasserstein Distortion for Face Image Compression](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32220v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32220

**作者：** Xinyu Wang、Jona Ballé

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32220v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32220v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 Cool-Chic 编解码器中把 Wasserstein 失真目标里的 VGG 特征替换为 FaceNet 中间特征，在约 0.15 bpp 的匹配码率下比较 20 张 LFW 人脸图像，并用初步成对人工评测显示 FaceNet 版本在 72.5% 的判断中被偏好。

**相关性简评：** 该工作不涉及视觉推理或 latent 状态生成，但它说明换用不同网络、不同中间层特征会改变基于特征距离的评价结论，这一线索可能供核查 LVR 中 latent 相似度对特征来源与深度的敏感性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FaceNet versus VGG Features in Wasserstein Distortion for Face Image Compression

**abstract/A1：** Wasserstein distortion (WD) compares local statistics of deep features and has been used to optimize learned image codecs for perceptual quality, but existing WD objectives rely on features from networks trained for generic image classification, such as VGG. We ask whether features from a face recognition network better reflect the perceived quality of compressed faces. In the Cool-Chic codec, we replace the VGG features in a WD-based objective with intermediate feature maps of FaceNet, and compare the two objectives on 20 LFW face images at a matched average bitrate of about 0.15 bits per pixel. In a preliminary pairwise human study, FaceNet-based reconstructions were preferred in 72.5% of judgments and by a majority of participants on 16 of the 20 images. These results suggest that the choice of feature network inside WD affects the perceived quality of face images, and that face recognition features are a promising direction for face-aware perceptual compression.

**comment/C1：** 6 pages, 2 figures

</details>

### 331. [MYSTIQUE: Few-Shot Facial Identity Transfer with Performance Preservation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32232v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32232

**作者：** Shihan Cheng、David Hyde、Junting Deng、Michael Bao、Paul Debevec、Roshni Cooper、Soshi Shimada

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.GR、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32232v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32232v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MYSTIQUE，一种基于 diffusion 的少样本人脸身份迁移方法：从目标人物照片取身份，经相互分离的流读取表情、光照与场景，并用多阶段训练和输入端随机遮挡、自增强、换脸等策略抑制自重建中的身份泄漏捷径。

**相关性简评：** 其「任何读取驱动图像的输入都可能泄漏身份」及用输入端扰动阻断捷径的思路，可能为核查 LVR 中答案是否绕过视觉流、以及各输入流贡献如何分配提供概念类比，但属图像生成任务，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MYSTIQUE: Few-Shot Facial Identity Transfer with Performance Preservation

**abstract/A1：** In visual effects, identity transfer replaces the identity in a driving image with that of a target person, while preserving the expression, lighting, pose and scene of that image. Paired ground truth is rarely available, so many methods are trained by self-reconstruction, where the model can learn a shortcut by copying identity cues from the driving image. This shortcut causes identity leakage at inference, where the driving image shows a different person. Our key observation is that leakage can enter through any input that reads the driving image. We therefore present MYSTIQUE, a diffusion-based identity transfer method that takes identity from a set of the target's photos and reads expression, lighting and scene through separate streams. It learns to disentangle identity from the other streams through multi-stage training, with disentanglement strategies at their inputs: a random block mask whose boundaries do not follow the face outline, self-augmentation, which randomly changes the face shape in the expression input and keeps its expression, and face randomization, which replaces the person in the expression and lighting inputs while the ground truth stays the driving image. At inference, we also warp the lighting input onto the face shape of a first pass, which reduces face-shape leakage through the lighting stream. Since face-recognition scores and human judgments each have limits, we evaluate identity with both, together with face-shape metrics on rendered faces of known shape. In a user study, raters judge MYSTIQUE's results more like the target than those of each compared method. Among these methods, MYSTIQUE also recovers the target's face shape most accurately, and its recognition score gains the most as more photos of the target are given.

</details>

<a id="paper-332"></a>

### 332. [Can You Find the Edit When Nothing Looks Wrong? A Paired Benchmark for Text-Driven Image Manipulation Localization Beyond Semantic Abnormality](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32242v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32242

**作者：** Peiyu Zhuang、Jianquan Yang、Zhuoying Cai、Yi Jiang、Yingquan Chen、Xinle Wang、Zeqin Yu、Dongdong Lin、Ruitao Xie、Kaige Li、Xiaochun Cao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32242v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32242v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 构建配对基准：对同一目标分别生成语义合理与语义异常的编辑（同一编辑器与设置），保留掩码充分重叠的配对，在 6,500 张照片上比较九种定位器，发现编辑结果「看起来正常」时定位 IoU 系统性下降。

**相关性简评：** 其「语义合理性捷径」与配对控制设计可能可供核查：模型是否依赖语义先验而忽略细粒度视觉证据，可作为 VLM 视觉证据使用与捷径诊断的评价参考；但领域属图像取证，与 LVR 状态生成无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Can You Find the Edit When Nothing Looks Wrong? A Paired Benchmark for Text-Driven Image Manipulation Localization Beyond Semantic Abnormality

**abstract/A1：** Instruction-driven image editing can alter a photograph while keeping the result coherent with the scene. Existing benchmarks lack matched plausible and anomalous edits of the same target, making it difficult to measure how localization performance changes with semantic plausibility. We construct a paired benchmark by generating semantically plausible and anomalous replacements of the same target in each source photograph. Both edits use the same editor, language, and generation settings. We estimate a separate mask for each output and retain pairs with sufficient mask overlap, enabling direct comparison of localization performance under the two semantic conditions. The release contains 47,747 bilingual triplets from 6,500 photographs, spanning four editors, three source domains, and six intended violation types. Across nine public localizers, editor-averaged IoU is lower on plausible edits in 26 of 27 model-dataset comparisons. This gap persists under pixel-change controls and region-size analyses. These findings reveal a semantic-plausibility shortcut: localization often weakens when an edited result looks ordinary. The benchmark provides a controlled setting for measuring this gap and developing localizers that remain effective on plausible edits.

</details>

### 333. [Refining and Aligning Clinical Reasoning with Health Guidelines via Formal Constraints](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32247v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32247

**作者：** Xiaoyang Fan、Yufan Cai、Zhe Hou、Jin Song Dong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32247v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32247v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 VerClin：将临床指南的条件、排除项、推荐与优先级抽取为可执行知识，用四值确定性推理器给出可追溯的指南匹配并保留不确定性，再由多专科 agent 筛选适用性、经形式约束通道生成建议；在 HealthBench Hard/Professional 上优于直接生成与 Top-5 RAG。

**相关性简评：** 其「保留不确定性并强制排除」的显式推理状态、专科证据适用性筛选与排序呈现，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、状态不确定性表示及可追溯的停止与弃权决策提供远域参照；但论文为纯文本临床场景、无视觉或多模态成分，可供核查迁移价值。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Refining and Aligning Clinical Reasoning with Health Guidelines via Formal Constraints

**abstract/A1：** Clinical reasoning from incomplete or conflicting patient evidence must account for low-probability but high-risk concerns while remaining grounded in health guidelines. We introduce VerClin, an explainable framework that extracts guideline conditions, exclusions, recommendations, and priorities into executable knowledge and represents patient conversations as scoped cases. A deterministic four-valued reasoner produces traceable guideline matches while preserving uncertainty and enforcing exclusions. Multiple specialty agents then screen matched guidelines for case applicability, and a consultation model synthesizes accepted guidance through specialty recommendations and a sentence-preserving formal-constraint channel. We present accepted guidance in ascending order of the sum of its priority and trigger-strength ranks, which can surface high-risk guidance with weaker triggers. VerClin outperforms direct generation and Top-5 RAG on HealthBench Hard and HealthBench Professional. On the LLMEval-Med subset, it outperforms direct generation and ties Top-5 RAG. Component analyses further examine semantic closure, example-guided refinement, specialty screening, and constraint-conditioned delivery.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 6 figures

</details>

### 334. [Pando: Noise-Coupled Parallel Draft Trees for Efficient Edge Speculative Decoding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32269v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32269

**作者：** Joren Dumoulin、Hyoukjun Kwon、Subhankar Pal、Steven Li、Vignesh Vivekraja、Marian Verhelst

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32269v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32269v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 Pando：在并行 draft 模型之上动态构建 draft 树，用「噪声耦合」剪枝按目标模型采样噪声排序候选分支，从而突破固定 draft 链长上限；并在边缘设备上以 roofline 归一化分析速度与能耗收益。

**相关性简评：** 该工作属纯文本推理加速，但其在有限验证预算下按目标分布噪声筛选分支树的做法，可能与 LVR 中多假设 latent 扩展、候选验证与计算/能耗成本核算的问题表述形成类比，可供核查是否借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Pando: Noise-Coupled Parallel Draft Trees for Efficient Edge Speculative Decoding

**abstract/A1：** Autoregressive (AR) decoding emits one token per forward pass, reloading the full model each time, so LLM inference on edge devices is memory-bound while the compute units sit idle. Speculative decoding puts that idle compute to work by verifying several drafted tokens in a single pass. State-of-the-art parallel drafters such as DFlash and DSpark propose an entire block of draft tokens in one forward pass, which makes drafting compute-efficient. However, they are deployed with draft chains whose length is capped by the block size they are trained for, leaving most of the computational budget for verification unused. To tackle this problem, we propose Pando, which builds dynamic draft trees on top of a parallel drafter and thereby removes this cap. Pando employs noise-coupled pruning, which draws the target model's sampling noise before drafting and ranks candidate branches under that noise, so the tree retains the branches the target will actually sample. Noise coupling is lossless and requires no retraining or additional model pass, yet increases acceptance length by up to $8.4\\%$ on Qwen3-8B. To optimize and evaluate Pando configurations across hardware, we normalize an operator-level roofline to AR decoding, reducing every platform to its ridge point. On a representative edge device, a 16-node Pando tree attains $5.3\\times$ speedup and $4.2\\times$ energy reduction over AR decoding: $25\\%$ faster than DSpark's released chain, and $27\\%$ faster and $72\\%$ more energy-efficient than an EAGLE-3 tree. The best configurations remain memory-bound on every edge device we model, so added compute capacity does not reduce their latency.

</details>

### 335. [$ε$-Seg++: Ensembling Across Hierarchy and Training Time for Label-Efficient EM Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32290v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32290

**作者：** Edoardo Giacomello、Sheida Rahnamai Kordasiabi、Mehdi Seifi、Florian Jug

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32290v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32290v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作面向电子显微镜体积的稀疏标注语义分割，在层级 VAE 的每一层配置语义专家并用无参数 product of experts 融合，同时加入无泄漏的 3D 子体积切分协议与跨训练检查点的集成选择。

**相关性简评：** 其「不只读顶层 latent、而在各层级读出并用乘积专家合并」的做法，可为核查多深度 latent 内容分工与读出位置提供类比；检查点平均也触及「同一表示在不同训练时刻是否稳定」的问题，但距离 VLM 推理尚远，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** $ε$-Seg++: Ensembling Across Hierarchy and Training Time for Label-Efficient EM Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Semantic segmentation of electron microscopy (EM) volumes is a central step in quantitative cell biology, but dense voxel-wise annotation is prohibitively expensive. $ε$-Seg showed that a hierarchical variational autoencoder trained on sparsely annotated voxels can yield competitive segmentations, but it classifies from its topmost latent level only and operates exclusively on 2D patches. We introduce $ε$-Seg++, which places a semantic expert at every level of the hierarchy and consolidates their predictions with a parameter-free product of experts. We further enable 3D inputs through a leakage-free sub-volume splitting protocol, which allows 2D and 3D models to be compared under identical sparse supervision. Because validation labels are just as scarce as training labels, we treat checkpoint selection as part of the method and average the top-ranked checkpoints, a second ensemble, this time across training time. On the BetaSeg FIB-SEM dataset, the multi-level experts improve 2D mean Dice by about 0.1 at 2,500 training labels. With up to 600 training labels, the 2D model matches or exceeds 3D $ε$-Seg at about one eleventh of its prediction cost. Above roughly a thousand labels, 3D inputs dominate, and at matched annotation cost 3D $ε$-Seg++ reaches a mean Dice of 0.905 versus 0.880 for D3PM, while predicting between 5.4 and 27 times faster (with our checkpoint ensemble or a single model, respectively). Checkpoint ensembling matches single-best selection on average and markedly improves the worst case when the validation set is small.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages, 9 figures, 10 tables. Edoardo Giacomello and Sheida Rahnamai Kordasiabi contributed equally and are listed in alphabetical order

</details>

### 336. [Query-Guided Visual Minimization for Selective Disclosure to Cloud VLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32302v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32302

**作者：** Pedram Zaree、Kleomenis Katevas、Vandana Rajan、Nael Abu-Ghazaleh、Hamed Haddadi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.CR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32302v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32302v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究云端 VLM 场景下的「查询引导视觉最小化」：用查询定位结合独立敏感项清单，在类型、实例与文本内容层面判断披露必要性，重绘最小化图像供黑盒 VLM 使用，并在多个基准上同时衡量任务效用与可恢复的隐私泄漏。

**相关性简评：** 其「视觉相关性」与「披露必要性」的区分，以及按查询必要性筛选、保留视觉内容的管线，可能为 LVR 中任务必要视觉证据的筛选与保留策略提供问题表述和评价线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Query-Guided Visual Minimization for Selective Disclosure to Cloud VLMs

**abstract/A1：** Cloud-hosted vision-language models (VLMs) require sending images beyond the user's local trust boundary, potentially exposing sensitive information the query does not need. We study query-guided visual minimization: a trusted local transformation preserves query-relevant visual content and reduces unnecessary disclosure before transmission. Unlike query-agnostic anonymization, it preserves the same sensitive content when the query requires it and suppresses it otherwise. We introduce QGVM, a framework that combines query grounding with an independent sensitive-item inventory, determines disclosure necessity at the type, instance, and text-content levels, and renders a minimized image for a black-box downstream VLM. We evaluate QGVM on complementary benchmarks measuring task utility, directly recoverable sensitive information, and inferential geolocation leakage. With OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol, QGVM achieves 85.3% DoxBench answer correctness versus 77.5% for PGP, while a separately prompted Sol geolocation attacker succeeds within 1 km on 5.8% of QGVM images versus 25.7% of unprotected images. On Scene-Privacy, QGVM reduces face re-identification from 27.7% (PGP) to 4.5%. On held-out BIV-Priv-Seg, unnecessary private-text recovery falls from 33.9% (PGP) to 15.3%. To verify that disclosure is query-dependent, we evaluate paired queries that either require or do not require the same sensitive information. QGVM achieves 69.6% correct disclosure switching, compared with 29.1% for grounding-only cropping. These findings highlight the value of distinguishing visual relevance from disclosure necessity, while revealing the privacy-utility trade-offs of selective visual disclosure.

</details>

### 337. [Alpha-Beta Pruning via Monadic Continuations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32320v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32320

**作者：** Martín Escardó、Paulo Oliva

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.GT、math.LO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32320v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32320v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文用 continuation monad 与 reader monad 的组合形式化 alpha-beta 剪枝，把搜索界记录在 monadic 结果而非走法类型中，并说明普通 continuation monad 即可同时算出最优结果与最优走法序列；作者在井字棋上实现（相较穷举搜索评估走法数减少 39 倍），并证明其结果与穷举 minimax 一致。

**相关性简评：** 其「哪些分支可安全跳过」的可证明剪枝构造，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛除、搜索宽度控制与提前停止决策提供可供核查的抽象框架，但论文完全不涉及视觉或多模态内部状态，迁移需较多工作。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Alpha-Beta Pruning via Monadic Continuations

**abstract/A1：** Alpha-beta pruning is a fundamental technique in game-playing AI, enabling efficient minimax search by avoiding the exploration of branches that cannot affect the optimal decision. We present a monadic formulation of alpha-beta pruning based on the combination of the continuation monad and the reader monad. Unlike previous approaches that encode alpha-beta bounds into the types of available moves, our construction records these bounds within monadic outcomes, leaving the move types unchanged. We further show that the ordinary continuation monad suffices to compute not only optimal outcomes but also optimal plays, by extending the outcome type to include the corresponding sequences of moves. This provides an alternative to generalisations of the continuation monad proposed to address the inefficiencies associated with the selection monad in alpha-beta search. We illustrate our approach with an implementation of Tic-Tac-Toe, observing a 39-fold reduction in the number of plays evaluated, compared with exhaustive search, in computing an optimal play. Finally, we formally establish the correctness of our construction by proving that the monadic alpha-beta search computes the same optimal outcomes and plays as exhaustive minimax search. Our results demonstrate how a foundational algorithm in AI can be expressed and verified using standard monadic abstractions, providing a basis for further development of compositional approaches to adversarial search.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PhyEvo-Mic-RSI，一个由物理先验与专家反馈驱动的递归自我改进框架，通过版本化继承更新可执行算子、参数和路由规则，并在固定预算下测试与继承代码更新，用于电镜局域原子结构与界面分析。

**相关性简评：** 其依据图像特征路由分析路径、在固定预算下验证更新的机制，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、动态计算分配与停止决策提供类比线索，但该工作属任务专用的显微图像分析平台，可迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A recursive self-improvement framework for electron microscopy analysis

**abstract/A1：** Resolving local atomic structures such as defects and interfaces from electron microscopy contrast relies heavily on researcher judgement, leading to low efficiency and subjective standards. Here we present PhyEvo-Mic-RSI, a physics-guided and expert-informed recursive self-improvement framework that turns one-off human corrections into reusable, verifiable capabilities by updating executable operators, parameters and routing rules with versioned inheritance. Given researcher-defined tasks, the system selects analysis paths from image features without expert labels, while testing and inheriting code updates under fixed budgets. Combining physical priors with expert feedback improves atomic point-defect detection over larger models and raises cross-material interface coverage from 5.13% to 72.11% within a 10% area budget. Adapting the framework to micrographs from unseen studies further separates touching nanoparticles by aligning optimization with particle-level measurements. This work moves computational microscopy beyond standalone models and static scripts towards self-evolving platforms that accumulate human scientific expertise

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其「嵌入余弦相似度高并不代表下游可用」的结论，可能为 LVR 中 latent 相似度指标与实际答案利用之间的脱节提供类比与核查线索；跨版本轻量转换也可供思考跨层或跨版本的 latent 状态对齐。

**title/T1：** Cross-Version Compatibility of TESSERA Embeddings Through Lightweight Translation

**abstract/A1：** Downstream models often outlive the embedding release on which they were trained. We test whether lightweight converters let a classifier trained on one Tessera release use embeddings from another. We fit converters between v1, v1.1, and v2 on 6,280 co-located triplets from 25 sites in 2024, with disjoint training, validation, and test sites. On a four-class land-cover test, a classifier trained on true v2 reaches 0.937 accuracy and 0.844 macro-F1. The same classifier scores 0.061 and 0.050 on raw v1.1, but 0.917 and 0.795 on converted v1.1. Direct v1-to-v2 translation has lower error than composition through v1.1. Geographic transfer is less reliable. On a separate cohort of 20 sites, a converter trained on the original sites reaches 0.597 accuracy despite 0.902 cosine similarity to v2, whereas a converter trained within the new cohort reaches 0.784. Tests with 2021 WorldCover labels and at 24 sampled sites without valid native v2 values extend the evaluation. Conversion recovers much of the frozen classifier's performance on the tested sites, but the new-site result shows that embedding similarity cannot stand in for downstream evaluation.

### 340. [From the ELBO to Maximum Likelihood: Convergence of Variational Autoencoders for Nonlinear Mixed-Effects Modeling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32372v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32372

**作者：** Jan Rohleff、Johannes Schropp

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.ST、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32372v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32372v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文对用于非线性混合效应模型的 VAE 算法作收敛性分析：先证明 ELBO 版本几乎必然收敛到 ELBO 的驻点，再证明将训练好的编码器作为重要性加权充分统计量的提议分布时，算法几乎必然收敛到边际似然（MLE）的驻点。

**相关性简评：** 其「摊销后验 + 重要性加权修正」的思路可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的提议与偏差校正、以及在无法精确推断时如何监督内部状态提供概念线索，但领域相隔较远，需核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From the ELBO to Maximum Likelihood: Convergence of Variational Autoencoders for Nonlinear Mixed-Effects Modeling

**abstract/A1：** Nonlinear mixed-effects (NLME) models are the central statistical models of pharmacometrics, where they support dose selection, individualized dosing and regulatory decisions in drug development. Statistically, NLME modeling is a marginalized likelihood problem. Variational autoencoders (VAEs) solve such problems with a neural network encoder that amortizes the approximation of the intractable posterior distribution, and allow the integration of AI components into NLME modeling. This paper provides the convergence analysis of the VAE-NLME algorithm. First, its version for the evidence lower bound (ELBO) is proven to converge almost surely to the set of stationary points of the ELBO, without assuming that the encoder is trained exactly. Second, the final VAE-NLME algorithm trains the encoder on the ELBO by gradient-based optimization and uses it as proposal for importance-weighted sufficient statistics. It converges almost surely to the set of stationary points of the marginal log-likelihood, without any assumption on the training of the encoder. Thus, it combines the fast gradient-based training of VAEs with the limit of maximum likelihood estimation.

**comment/C1：** 39 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出一个基于 SDXL 的模块化流程，结合 LoRA、ControlNet、IP-Adapter 与持久身份记忆，并用 Best-of-K 重排序提升多帧视觉故事生成中的角色身份一致性。

**相关性简评：** 其「持久记忆 + 基于 CLIP/DINO 相似度的候选重排序」可能为 LVR 的跨步状态缓存与视觉证据筛选、相似度评价提供可核查的类比，但研究对象是图像生成的帧间一致性，与推理状态生成无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Improving Character Identity Consistency in Diffusion-Based Visual Story Generation through Identity Memory and Automatic Reranking

**abstract/A1：** Automatic visual story generation using diffusion-based models has become an increasingly important research direction in generative artificial intelligence. However, maintaining character identity consistency across consecutive frames remains an open challenge, as existing models often produce significant variations in facial traits, clothing, visual style, or anatomical proportions. This paper proposes a modular pipeline to improve character identity consistency in multi-frame visual story generation using Stable Diffusion XL alongside additional conditioning and automatic selection mechanisms. The proposed system integrates LoRA fine-tuning for character personalization, ControlNet for pose-based structural control, and IP-Adapter for visual identity transfer. Furthermore, a reranking mechanism based on Best-of-K candidate selection and persistent identity memory is introduced to automatically select the most visually consistent generated images. The work also includes integrating and extending the StoryDiffusion framework into a reproducible local workflow, along with improvements for generated frame selection. Performance evaluation uses automatic metrics such as CLIP image similarity, DINO similarity, and CLIP text-image alignment. Experimental evaluation was conducted on a custom benchmark of multiple characters and visual stories organized into difficulty levels (easy, medium, and difficult). Both progressive variants of the proposed pipeline and extended versions of StoryDiffusion were evaluated, including SDXL baseline, Best-of-K, Identity Memory, and the Full Pipeline. Results show that reranking, identity memory, and visual conditioning reduce identity drift across frames and improve the overall coherence and stability of generated visual stories.

**comment/C1：** 12 pages, 9 figures. Project repository available at: https://github.com/MerryWex/character-consistency-visual-storytelling

</details>

<a id="paper-342"></a>

### 342. [Adaptive and Detection-Aware Super-Resolution for Small Object Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32394v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32394

**作者：** Cezica-Elena Luncanu、Stelian Spînu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32394v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32394v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 x4 单图超分（SRCNN 基线、残差学习、Charbonnier 与三区域自适应损失），并用 PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS/EdgeMAE 和 YOLOv8 检测结果评估超分对检测的影响。

**相关性简评：** 其「重建质量提升不等于检测提升、需任务感知评估」的结论，可能与 LVR 中「视觉细节是否被内部状态真正用于答案」的评价问题相关，可供核查如何用下游任务而非保真度指标衡量视觉证据保留。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Adaptive and Detection-Aware Super-Resolution for Small Object Detection

**abstract/A1：** Image super-resolution aims to reconstruct a high-resolution image from a low-resolution input and is relevant for surveillance, satellite imagery, medical imaging, and object detection. This paper investigates SRCNN-based single-image super-resolution for a scale factor of x4, starting from a classical baseline and progressively introducing residual learning, Charbonnier loss, and adaptive loss functions. The proposed approach includes a three-region adaptive loss, where image areas are divided into smooth, texture, and edge regions using gradient information. The models are evaluated using PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and EdgeMAE in order to measure both reconstruction quality and structural detail preservation. In addition to reconstruction evaluation, the paper analyzes the impact of super-resolution on object detection. A YOLOv8 detector is applied to images processed through bicubic interpolation and SRCNN-based variants, using images from the COCO validation dataset. The results show that improved reconstruction quality does not always lead to better detection performance. However, for small objects, a detection-aware variant combined with residual scaling improves the F1 score compared to the bicubic baseline. These results highlight the importance of task-aware evaluation when super-resolution is used in computer vision pipelines.

**comment/C1：** 6 pages, 3 figures. Project repository available at: https://github.com/cezica/adaptive-detection-aware-super-resolution

</details>

### 343. [Optimal Transport Meets t-SNE: Integrated Visualization without Batch Effects in OT-tSNE](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32402v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32402

**作者：** Azhar Akhmetova、Edward Eichhorn、Boris Landa、Dmitry Kobak、Sebastian Damrich

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32402v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32402v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 OT-tSNE，用熵正则最优传输得到的全局耦合亲和度替代 t-SNE 中基于跨批次最近邻的匹配，以在去除批次效应的同时联合可视化多个数据集，并在合成数据与七个单细胞数据集上做基准比较。

**相关性简评：** 单细胞可视化属较远领域，但其“以全局 OT 耦合替代局部最近邻对应”的思路，可能为跨条件比较 latent 状态相似度（如内容、层深、缓存差异下的对应关系可靠性）提供可核查的度量借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Optimal Transport Meets t-SNE: Integrated Visualization without Batch Effects in OT-tSNE

**abstract/A1：** Visual exploration is an integral step in understanding the structure of datasets. However, systematic variation between datasets collected under different conditions, known as batch effects, can obscure shared structure and complicate their joint visualization. Existing methods often rely on cross-batch nearest-neighbor relations to integrate the batches. Yet, these local correspondences can be unreliable for challenging cross-batch geometries. We propose optimal-transport t-SNE (OT-tSNE), which replaces nearest-neighbor-based matching with globally coupled affinities derived from entropic optimal transport. Controlled synthetic experiments demonstrated that nearest-neighbor-based methods can deteriorate, while optimal-transport affinities and OT-tSNE embeddings remain robust. Across seven real single-cell datasets, we benchmarked OT-tSNE against a broad range of integration and visualization methods and found that it achieves a Pareto-efficient trade-off between batch mixing and biological conservation, and integrates batches particularly well.

**comment/C1：** 35 pages, 18 figures, 5 tables. Code at https://github.com/NDR-lab/ot-tsne

</details>

### 344. [A Framework for Graph Node Symmetric Quantification under Dataset Shift](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32403v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32403

**作者：** Alessio Micheli、Alejandro Moreo、Marco Podda、Fabrizio Sebastiani、Domenico Tortorella

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32403v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32403v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GSQ 框架用于数据集偏移下的图节点量化：训练仅需按类别分布标注的节点样本，不需节点级分类器，而是由编码器、池化器、流行度预测器和可选事后缩放直接估计样本的类别比例，并在不同同质性与偏移条件下评估。

**相关性简评：** 其「集合级分布监督＋池化后直接输出比例」的思路或可类比 LVR 中的证据聚合与答案分布校准问题，但论文不涉及视觉输入与 latent 推理机制，属较远领域线索，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Framework for Graph Node Symmetric Quantification under Dataset Shift

**abstract/A1：** Graph node quantification is the supervised learning task of estimating the prevalence of different classes within an arbitrary sample of unlabelled nodes from a graph, subject to some form of dataset shift. Existing approaches to graph node quantification typically follow the standard aggregative paradigm, i.e., they use labelled nodes from the graph to train an intermediate node classifier, and obtain an estimated class distribution for the sample by aggregating the classifier's predictions for the individual nodes and then correcting the result via some adjustment strategy that accounts for dataset shift. In this work we propose a framework for graph node quantification that does away with both node-level supervision, since its training phase only requires node samples labelled by their class distribution, and node-level predictions, since it estimates class prevalence values directly, without the need of any intermediate node classifier. The framework thus allows symmetric quantification, since (unlike in standard \`\`asymmetric'' quantification methods) the labelled items used for training and the unlabelled items on which predictions must be issued are of the same type (i.e., node samples). This framework (that we dub GSQ, for Graph Node Symmetric Quantification) allows building pipelines consisting of a node encoder, an embedding pooler, a prevalence predictor, and an optional post-hoc scaling step. These components can be instantiated by choosing from different trainable and reservoir-based encoders, different pooling operators, and different prediction objectives. We evaluate the GSQ framework on binary and multi-class datasets with different levels of homophily, under prior probability shift and under structural covariate shift.

</details>

### 345. [NRG-Twins: Pixel-Level Ground Truth for Rigidity Violations in Generated Videos](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32431v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32431

**作者：** Chenrui Fan、Qiyang Hu、Luca Scharr、Paolo Favaro

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32431v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32431v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建 NRG-Twins：将真实视频与关键帧条件生成器重建的「孪生」视频配对，逐像素测量其偏离刚性场景的视角误差，发布基准，并训练仅凭 RGB 预测该误差的检测器 NRG-PD。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接交集；其像素级刚性偏差标注或许可供核查，用来诊断多模态模型内部表示是否保留几何一致性，或作为视觉证据可靠性的监督信号。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** NRG-Twins: Pixel-Level Ground Truth for Rigidity Violations in Generated Videos

**abstract/A1：** Video generators now produce realistic clips of scenes and objects, which makes generated video an attractive source of 3D content. Yet generated video is not 3D consistent: static content slowly deforms or slides, 3D reconstruction degrades, and the errors are too subtle to label by hand. To make generators 3D consistent, or to build rewards and guidance that push them there, we need data that say where and by how much a generated video breaks rigidity, and these data must come from generated video itself. We obtain per-pixel ground-truth labels from real-generated twins: a real clip paired with its re-creation by a keyframe-conditioned video generator. After inserting real keyframes so that the twin camera roughly follows the real one, we measure per pixel, in degrees, how far the twin departs from a rigid scene seen along its own camera path. We release Non-Rigidly Generated Twins (NRG-Twins), 871 twins, the code that builds them for new generators, and a benchmark with an official test split. A detector trained on these data, the Non-Rigidly Generated Pixel Detector (NRG-PD), predicts the per-pixel angle from RGB alone. It separates inconsistent from consistent pixels with AUROC 0.85, against 0.40-0.74 for seven existing consistency and motion-segmentation methods, and its predictions improve 3DGS of video that contains generated content.

**comment/C1：** 35 pages including supplementary material; 15 figures, 32 tables

</details>

### 346. [PVWander: 3D Memory-guided Panoramic Video Wandering with Path-Facing Canonicalization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32443v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32443

**作者：** Chuanxin Song、Xiaodong Wang、Shijie Chen、Junliang Xie、Zhanmi Zhong、Suiying Wu、Peixi Peng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32443v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32443v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PVWander，用于长时程全景视频漫游：将已生成的观测累积为在线点云记忆并重投影以引导后续生成，配合「Path-Facing 规范化」统一各片段的 ERP 朝向以实现运动—朝向对齐，并用时间步感知的门控调制自适应调节记忆引导强度。

**相关性简评：** 该工作本身是全景视频生成，但其对不完美重投影记忆按去噪阶段做通道级门控的思路，可能与 LVR 中如何随推理步骤调节视觉证据注入强度、抑制不可靠视觉旁路的问题存在概念联系，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PVWander: 3D Memory-guided Panoramic Video Wandering with Path-Facing Canonicalization

**abstract/A1：** Long-horizon panoramic video wandering aims to continuously synthesize scene-consistent $360^\\circ$ observations along user-specified camera trajectories from an initial equirectangular projection (ERP) panorama. Existing panoramic video models have achieved promising results in camera-controlled generation, while recent 3D-guided approaches further provide geometric guidance for improving scene consistency. However, stable long-horizon wandering remains challenging due to diverse motion--orientation relationships and imperfect memory guidance induced by accumulated generation artifacts and depth inaccuracies. To address these challenges, we propose \\textbf{PVWander}, a 3D-memory-guided framework that accumulates generated observations into an online point-cloud memory and reprojects it to guide subsequent generation, with two complementary designs: \\textit{Path-Facing canonicalization} for motion--orientation alignment and \\textit{Timestep-aware gating modulation} for adaptive memory guidance. \\textit{Path-Facing canonicalization} exploits the horizontal cyclic symmetry of ERP panoramas to uniformly align each clip's ERP orientation with its principal translation direction, yielding more consistent, forward-like relative motions while preserving the prescribed camera path. \\textit{Timestep-aware gating modulation} exploits the coarse-to-fine nature of diffusion denoising to adaptively regulate reprojected memory guidance through timestep-dependent channel-wise gates, preserving its structural benefits while mitigating visual artifacts from imperfect projections. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PVWander achieves improved long-horizon generation quality, while ablations validate the effectiveness of both designs.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://chuanxinsong.github.io/pvwander-project-page

</details>

<a id="paper-347"></a>

### 347. [A Mesh to Remember: Persistent Appearance for Interactive Video Worlds](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32445v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32445

**作者：** Joonghyuk Shin、Alex Trevithick、Katarína Tóthová、Liyuan Zhu、Shengyu Huang、Jaesik Park、Shalini De Mello、Laura Leal-Taixé、Riccardo de Lutio、Haithem Turki

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32445v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32445v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 M2R：把视频渲染器自身特征存放在所描绘的网格表面上（按各物体自身坐标系），表面重新进入视野时通过光栅化网格取回，从而让外观随物体移动、跨重访与跨智能体保持一致；仅用合成数据训练即可零样本迁移到真实室内扫描与代码智能体构建的世界。

**相关性简评：** 其「以表面身份而非帧序寻址的持久特征缓存」可能为 LVR 中视觉证据跨视角留存、以及 latent 检索中位置/缓存/注意力结构的影响提供概念参照，但该工作面向渲染一致性而非推理，线索尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Mesh to Remember: Persistent Appearance for Interactive Video Worlds

**abstract/A1：** Video world models synthesize photorealistic observations in response to user actions but struggle to remain consistent over long interactions. Coding agents and text-to-3D models instead generate explicit 3D worlds whose geometry and state persist by construction, but whose appearance falls far short of photorealism. Recent methods combine the strengths of both by rendering such worlds into coarse proxies that guide a video model. However, since these proxies only specify where things are, the renderer must invent what they look like as the world is explored, and anything it forgets is reinvented when a surface reappears. Our key insight is that a mesh identifies which surface each pixel shows, across frames and views, even as objects move, allowing it to serve as an address for what the renderer generates. We propose M2R (Mesh to Remember), a few-step causal video renderer that stores its own features on the surfaces they depict, in each object's frame, and retrieves them by rasterizing the mesh whenever those surfaces come back into view. Appearance thus travels with objects wherever they move, persists across revisits, and is shared by every agent that observes it, while memory grows with the surfaces seen instead of the number of frames. Trained only on synthetic data, M2R transfers zero-shot to real indoor scans and to worlds authored by coding agents. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods in consistency across static, dynamic, and multi-agent benchmarks, more than doubling object permanence and nearly doubling cross-agent consistency, while rendering 720p video in real time (40 FPS).

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/sil/projects/m2r/

</details>

### 348. [MAGPIE: Agentic Multi-Reference Image Generation via Executable Scene Construction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32462v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32462

**作者：** Yifan Dai、Daili Hua、Bohan Zeng、Yuran Wang、Jialing Liu、Bozhou Li、Chengzhuo Tong、Yang Shi、Kai Zeng、Liu Yang、Xinyu Liu、Shujie Li、Yiyan Ji、Bingyin Mei、Yushuo Guan、Yuanxing Zhang、Fangcheng Fu、Wentao Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32462v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32462v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** MAGPIE 面向多参考图生成，把目标构图表示为由 Blender 程序定义的可执行 3D 场景：编码 agent 将每个场景实例链接到对应参考图，比对几何与渲染视图和指令是否一致并据此改写程序，最后以代理渲染作为视觉计划来训练图像生成器。

**相关性简评：** 该工作的核心是把难以直接检查的中间构思外化为可执行、可渲染核查并按差异修正的显式状态，与 LVR 中可检查的推理状态、视觉证据筛选和「看—改」循环可能有概念联系，可供核查其验证与修正机制；但任务是图像生成而非视觉推理，迁移性需判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MAGPIE: Agentic Multi-Reference Image Generation via Executable Scene Construction

**abstract/A1：** Multi-reference image generation requires a model to preserve the appearance of selected subjects while arranging them according to an instruction. Despite recent progress in reference-based generation and compositional control, reliably organizing selected subjects into the intended scene remains challenging. Although existing methods provide various forms of compositional guidance, the planned relationships are not always explicitly instantiated for inspection and refinement before image synthesis. To address this limitation, we introduce MAGPIE, which represents the intended composition as a simplified 3D scene defined by an executable Blender program. A coding agent links each scene instance to its reference, checks the geometry and rendered view against the instruction, and revises the program to correct discrepancies. The final proxy rendering serves as a visual plan for the image generator. Using MAGPIE-Instruct-3K, we train the generator to follow this plan while drawing each subject's appearance from its reference. MAGPIE improves both Qwen and FLUX on DreamOmni2 and SconeEval. With FLUX, it improves overall success on DreamOmni2 by 28.21 percentage points over the original backbone and achieves the highest overall score among the models evaluated on SconeEval.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 11 figures

</details>

### 349. [OmniPersist: Persistent Dynamic World Modeling via Coupled Panoramic Evolution](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32473v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32473

**作者：** Zhilu Zhang、Xiaoyu Liu、Wenxi Liu、Shengfeng He

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32473v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32473v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 OmniPersist，在单阶段扩散模型中耦合透视视频生成与低帧率全景演化，用几何锚定做空间对应、时间补偿做时序聚合，使镜头离开后视野外的运动实体在 latent 中持续合理演化，并在新构建的动态基准上评测重访一致性与动态持续性。

**相关性简评：** 其为视频世界模型而非 VLM 推理工作，但「视野外实体在 latent 中持续演化、重访时保持一致」的状态保持与重访校验问题表述，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态能否保存并复用暂时离开视野的视觉证据提供概念参考，需核查其 latent 条件与时间聚合是否可迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OmniPersist: Persistent Dynamic World Modeling via Coupled Panoramic Evolution

**abstract/A1：** Action-conditioned world models play a vital role in robotics and autonomous driving, yet existing video diffusion models struggle to maintain dynamic object persistence. When the camera turns away and returns, out-of-view moving entities fail to evolve plausibly in latent space, often mutating or vanishing entirely due to bounded perspective views. To resolve this issue, we propose OmniPersist, a unified framework that couples perspective video generation with panoramic evolution within a single-stage diffusion model, without relying on auxiliary models or initial panoramic inputs. To maintain efficiency, we model the panoramic stream at a lower frame rate, bridging both views across space and time via Geometric Anchoring (GeoAnch) for spatial correspondence and Temporal Compensation (TemComp) for temporal aggregation. OmniPersist is agnostic to camera-control architectures, supporting both latent-level and attention-level conditioning. Extensive experiments on a newly constructed dynamic benchmark across image-to-video and video continuation tasks demonstrate consistent gains in visual quality, camera controllability, revisit consistency, and dynamic persistence.

**comment/C1：** Project: https://omnipersist.github.io Code: https://github.com/cszhilu1998/OmniPersist

</details>

### 350. [When Knowledge-Tracing Rankings Depend on Available History: A Source-Correction and Matched-Information Audit on ASSISTments 2009 and 2015](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32489v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.32489

**作者：** Devis Wawan Saputra

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32489v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32489v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文在 ASSISTments 2009/2015 知识追踪数据上做数据溯源校正，并把不同模型限制在同一 prior-response 窗口内比较，发现在匹配信息后，简单的顺序感知 logistic 模型反而优于 GRU。

**相关性简评：** 其「匹配可用历史信息再比较模型」的审计思路可能可供核查 LVR/VLM 中 latent 状态与显式历史、更多上下文基线之间的比较是否控制了信息量与数据来源差异。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Knowledge-Tracing Rankings Depend on Available History: A Source-Correction and Matched-Information Audit on ASSISTments 2009 and 2015

**abstract/A1：** Knowledge-tracing benchmarks often compare models that have different access to a learner's previous responses. We examine how data provenance, history length, and representation affect those comparisons. First, we compare a pinned ASSISTments 2009 sequence mirror against the corrected official release. Of 4,148 learners represented in both, 817 have different ordered skill-response sequences; the mirror also contains fewer labeled events. Second, we retain earlier learner-disjoint model evaluations on the 2009 and 2015 datasets, distinguishing exploratory results from a corrective 2015 replication. Finally, we evaluate a new, nonoverlapping sample of 4,000 ASSISTments 2015 learners using three models constrained to the same one-event or 20-event prior-response window. On 20,592 test responses from 582 learners, the 20-event Brier scores were 0.17667 for count-based logistic regression, 0.17389 for an order-aware logistic model, and 0.17514 for a GRU. The GRU-minus-order-aware difference was 0.00125 (95% learner-cluster bootstrap interval \[0.00008, 0.00243\]); at one prior event, the corresponding difference was 0.00212 \[0.00120, 0.00301\]. Earlier comparisons had favored the GRU against simpler history summaries. The newer analysis instead favors a logistic comparator that represents order using the same permitted event stream. These results concern predictive performance on particular historical cohorts and model settings. They neither isolate an architectural effect nor establish generalization to contemporary classrooms.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32496v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.32496v1>)
